 SUM(g.gap_amount)FILTER(WHERE g.gap_amount>0 AND q.amount_complete) AS amount_yi,
 SUM(g.gap_energy)FILTER(WHERE g.gap_energy>0 AND q.energy_complete) AS energy_gwh,
 COUNT(*)FILTER(WHERE (g.gap_amount>0 AND q.amount_complete) OR (g.gap_energy>0 AND q.energy_complete))::bigint AS item_count,
 NULL::numeric AS ratio_value,NULL::numeric AS days_value,
 '已按客户汇总；正缺口及输入完整性见明细'::text AS status,
 '仅原储能客户名单内，先按客户ID合计全部年度目标、进度和剩余预测，再分别判断金额/电量正缺口。同客户内部可抵扣，不跨客户抵扣。主金额/电量为各自完整正缺口客户合计；主数量为两口径正缺口客户并集。进度为观察月以前已签预测，剩余为观察月至年底全部预测；单侧或输入缺失保留NULL。'::text AS note,
 COALESCE(JSONB_AGG((TO_JSONB(g)-'__summary_order')||JSONB_BUILD_OBJECT(
  '金额输入完整',q.amount_complete,'电量输入完整',q.energy_complete,
  '金额目标支撑率_原始小数',g.coverage_amount/NULLIF(g.target_amount,0),
  '金额目标支撑率_百分比数值',g.coverage_amount/NULLIF(g.target_amount,0)*100,
  '电量目标支撑率_原始小数',g.coverage_energy/NULLIF(g.target_energy,0),
  '电量目标支撑率_百分比数值',g.coverage_energy/NULLIF(g.target_energy,0)*100)
  ||CASE WHEN g.__summary_order=1 THEN JSONB_BUILD_OBJECT('风险专用正缺口汇总',(SELECT risk_summary FROM customer_positive_gap_summary)) ELSE '{}'::jsonb END ORDER BY g.account_id),
  JSONB_BUILD_ARRAY(JSONB_BUILD_OBJECT('风险专用正缺口汇总',(SELECT risk_summary FROM customer_positive_gap_summary)))) AS detail
 FROM(SELECT x.*,ROW_NUMBER()OVER(ORDER BY account_id) AS __summary_order FROM customer_gaps x)g
 JOIN customer_risk_input_quality q USING(account_id)
)
SELECT
  r.code AS "指标序号",
  r.metric_name AS "指标名称",
  r.product_team AS "产品团队",
  p.start_date AS "期间开始",
  p.end_exclusive AS "期间结束不含",
  p.cutoff AS "周期观察截止",
  r.amount_yi AS "金额_亿元",
  r.energy_gwh AS "电量_GWh",
  r.item_count AS "数量",
  r.ratio_value AS "比率_原始小数",
  r.days_value AS "平均周期_天",
  CASE
    WHEN r.status = '查询已实现；缺失输入及部分合计见明细'
    THEN CASE
      WHEN r.amount_yi IS NOT NULL
      OR r.energy_gwh IS NOT NULL
      OR r.item_count IS NOT NULL
      OR r.ratio_value IS NOT NULL
      OR r.days_value IS NOT NULL
      THEN '已有查询结果；完整性与适用列见明细'
      ELSE '没有可计算结果；检查输入、时间及关联范围'
    END
    ELSE r.status
  END AS "计算说明状态",
  r.note AS "取值说明",
  r.detail AS "分组明细及缺口"
FROM metric_results AS r
CROSS JOIN context AS p
ORDER BY
  r.sort_no,
  r.product_team;

R09.name: 待突破的战略客户数
R09.definition: 以本次底稿既有储能客户集合为范围，取截至日前已创建、当前等级1的客户；通过accountid＝商机parentaccountid关联截至日前已创建商机，按客户ID统计无任何关联商机者。客户不必有商机，不要求本期新建。
R09.formula: 战略客户关联商机数为0时列待突破。客户与商机仅设创建截至上限，不设本期期初下限，不额外按审核、状态、签单或预测有无筛选。储能范围及客户等级沿当前值。
R09.caliber: 客户等级0/核心大客户及1/战略大客户中，不存在new_opportunitystatus=0在跟商机的客户，按客户ID去重；还按客户.createdon落所选期间。
R09.attributes:
LE01-A0001 商机管理.主键（opportunityid，空 0%）
LE01-A0476 商机管理.客户（parentaccountid，空 0%）
LE05-A0001 客户.主键（accountid，空 0%）
LE05-A0244 客户.客户等级（new_accountlevel，空 0%）
R09.dimension: 客户/商机createdon：观察截至上限，不按本期新增归期
R09.physicalFields:
客户.accountid/new_accountlevel；商机.opportunityid/parentaccountid
储能客户过滤：客户.owninguser；商机.ownerid；团队人员.systemuserid/teamid；团队.teamid。
R09.dashboardSql: 客户等级0/核心大客户及1/战略大客户中，不存在new_opportunitystatus=0在跟商机的客户，按客户ID去重；还按客户.createdon落所选期间。
R09.notes: 客户底表、储能当前团队范围、战略等级1、截至日创建上限及无任何关联商机的原判定保持。新增逐户目标金额/电量及版本、缺值信息用于原因核实；R09数量不等同RK06正缺口客户数，也不单独触发客户目标不足。
R09.sqlStatus: 按结果动态判定（见 SQL 中 status 的 CASE）
R09.role: 原因事实 / 结构下钻；不独立触发客户预测不足；最终分析仅读总体、客户、商机及阶段事实，范围见BR-V12
R09.ctes: parameters → context → account_rows → accounts → opportunity_rows → customer_coverage → storage_customer_ids → storage_opportunity_owners → storage_team_ids → storage_user_ids → customer_latest → target_rows → r09_target_cells → r09_target_by_account
R09.sql:
WITH parameters AS MATERIALIZED (
  SELECT
    CAST(%s AS DATE) AS start_date,
    CAST(%s AS DATE) AS end_exclusive,
    CAST(%s AS TIMESTAMP) AS observed_at,
    CAST(ARRAY['1'] AS TEXT[]) AS strategic_levels,
    CAST(ARRAY['1', '2'] AS TEXT[]) AS focus_levels,
    CAST(1000000 AS DECIMAL) AS target_power_units_per_gwh
), context AS MATERIALIZED (
  SELECT
    p.*,
    CAST((
      DATE_TRUNC('DAY', observed_at) + INTERVAL '1 DAY'
    ) AS TIMESTAMP) AS as_of_exclusive,
    LEAST(
      CAST(end_exclusive AS TIMESTAMP),
      DATE_TRUNC('DAY', observed_at) + INTERVAL '1 DAY'
    ) AS effective_end_exclusive,
    LEAST(
      CAST(end_exclusive AS TIMESTAMP),
      DATE_TRUNC('DAY', observed_at) + INTERVAL '1 DAY'
    ) - INTERVAL '1 MICROSECOND' AS cutoff,
    MAKE_DATE(CAST(EXTRACT(YEAR FROM start_date) AS INT), 1, 1) AS year_start,
    MAKE_DATE(CAST(EXTRACT(YEAR FROM start_date) AS INT) + 1, 1, 1) AS next_year_start,
    GREATEST(
      CAST(0 AS DECIMAL),
      LEAST(
        CAST(1 AS DECIMAL),
        CAST((
          CAST(LEAST(
            CAST(end_exclusive AS TIMESTAMP),
            DATE_TRUNC('DAY', observed_at) + INTERVAL '1 DAY'
          ) AS DATE) - MAKE_DATE(CAST(EXTRACT(YEAR FROM start_date) AS INT), 1, 1)
        ) AS DECIMAL) / (
          MAKE_DATE(CAST(EXTRACT(YEAR FROM start_date) AS INT) + 1, 1, 1) - MAKE_DATE(CAST(EXTRACT(YEAR FROM start_date) AS INT), 1, 1)
        )
      )
    ) AS time_progress
  FROM parameters AS p
), account_rows AS MATERIALIZED (
  SELECT
    CAST(a.accountid AS TEXT) AS account_id,
    CAST(a.name AS TEXT) AS account_name,
    CAST(a.new_accountlevel AS TEXT) AS level_code,
    CAST(a.new_sapdate AS TIMESTAMP) AS sap_created_at,
    CAST(a.new_sapsubmitdate AS TIMESTAMP) AS sap_submitted_at,
    CAST(a.new_approved_time_facreview AS TIMESTAMP) AS account_factory_approved_at,
    CAST(a.new_submit_time_facreview AS TIMESTAMP) AS account_factory_submitted_at,
    CAST(a.new_sinosurestartdate AS TIMESTAMP) AS account_sinosure_start,
    CAST(a.new_sinosureenddate AS TIMESTAMP) AS account_sinosure_end,
    CAST(a.new_submit_time_accredit AS TIMESTAMP) AS account_credit_submitted_at,
    CAST(a.new_approvaltime_accredit AS TIMESTAMP) AS account_credit_approved_at,
    CAST(a.new_cdastartdate AS TIMESTAMP) AS account_cda_start,
    CAST(a.new_cdaenddate AS TIMESTAMP) AS account_cda_end,
    CAST(a.new_cda_submittime AS TIMESTAMP) AS account_cda_submitted_at,
    CAST(a.new_cda_approved_time AS TIMESTAMP) AS account_cda_approved_at,
    CAST(a.new_approvalstatus_facreview AS TEXT) AS account_factory_approval_status,
    CAST(a.new_sapcode AS TEXT) AS sap_code,
    CAST(a.new_issap AS TEXT) AS sap_registered,
    CAST(a.new_issapnew AS TEXT) AS sap_registration_kind,
    ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
      PARTITION BY a.accountid
      ORDER BY a.modifiedon DESC NULLS LAST, a.createdon DESC NULLS LAST
    ) AS rn
  FROM (
    SELECT
      __x360_raw.*
    FROM ded_public.p_fm_edw_v_ods_crm_account_esb AS __x360_raw
    CROSS JOIN context AS __x360_ctx
    WHERE
      CAST(__x360_raw.createdon AS TIMESTAMP) < __x360_ctx.as_of_exclusive
  ) AS a
  WHERE
    NULLIF(TRIM(CAST(a.accountid AS TEXT)), '') IS NOT NULL
), accounts AS MATERIALIZED (
  SELECT
    account_id,
    account_name,
    level_code,
    sap_created_at,
    sap_submitted_at,
    account_factory_approved_at,
    account_factory_submitted_at,
    account_sinosure_start,
    account_sinosure_end,
    account_credit_submitted_at,
    account_credit_approved_at,
    account_cda_start,
    account_cda_end,
    account_cda_submitted_at,
    account_cda_approved_at,
    account_factory_approval_status,
    sap_code,
    sap_registered,
    sap_registration_kind
  FROM account_rows
  WHERE
    rn = 1
), opportunity_rows AS MATERIALIZED (
  SELECT
    ranked.*
  FROM (
    SELECT
      CAST(o.opportunityid AS TEXT) AS opportunity_id,
      CAST(o.parentaccountid AS TEXT) AS account_id,
      CAST(o.name AS TEXT) AS project_name,
      CAST(o.ownerid AS TEXT) AS owner_id,
      CASE
        WHEN CAST(o.new_accproducttype AS TEXT) IN ('1', '电芯')
        THEN '电芯'
        WHEN CAST(o.new_accproducttype AS TEXT) IN ('2', 'PACK')
        THEN 'PACK'
        ELSE '其他'
      END AS product_type,
      o.__x360_asof_process_stage AS process_stage,
      CAST(o.statecode AS TEXT) AS system_state,
      CAST(o.new_demandinput AS TEXT) AS demand_status,
      CAST(o.createdon AS TIMESTAMP) AS created_at,
      CAST(o.new_stage1enddate AS TIMESTAMP) AS s1,
      CAST(o.new_stage2enddate AS TIMESTAMP) AS s2,
      CAST(o.new_stage3enddate AS TIMESTAMP) AS s3,
      CAST(o.new_stage4enddate AS TIMESTAMP) AS s4,
      CAST(o.new_stage5enddate AS TIMESTAMP) AS s5,
      CAST(o.new_cdastartdate AS TIMESTAMP) AS new_cdastartdate,
      CAST(o.new_cdaenddate AS TIMESTAMP) AS new_cdaenddate,
      CAST(o.new_approved_time_acneed AS TIMESTAMP) AS new_approved_time_acneed,
      CAST(o.new_submit_time_acneed AS TIMESTAMP) AS new_submit_time_acneed,
      CAST(o.new_approved_time_projectassess AS TIMESTAMP) AS new_approved_time_projectassess,
      CAST(o.new_submit_time_projectassess AS TIMESTAMP) AS new_submit_time_projectassess,
      CAST(o.new_sampletestpass_time AS TIMESTAMP) AS new_sampletestpass_time,
      CAST(o.new_sampletime AS TIMESTAMP) AS new_sampletime,
      CAST(o.new_technicalsigningdate AS TIMESTAMP) AS new_technicalsigningdate,
      CAST(o.new_submit_time_techcon AS TIMESTAMP) AS new_submit_time_techcon,
      CAST(o.new_warrantysigningdate AS TIMESTAMP) AS new_warrantysigningdate,
      CAST(o.new_submit_time_qsl AS TIMESTAMP) AS new_submit_time_qsl,
      CAST(o.new_isneedcda AS TEXT) AS new_isneedcda,
      CAST(o.new_approvalstatus_acneed AS TEXT) AS new_approvalstatus_acneed,
      CAST(o.new_approvalstatus_projectassess AS TEXT) AS new_approvalstatus_projectassess,
      CAST(o.new_approvalstatus_techcon AS TEXT) AS new_approvalstatus_techcon,
      CAST(o.new_approvalstatus_qsl AS TEXT) AS new_approvalstatus_qsl,
      CAST(o.new_sampletestresult AS TEXT) AS new_sampletestresult,
      ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
        PARTITION BY o.opportunityid
        ORDER BY o.modifiedon DESC NULLS LAST, o.createdon DESC NULLS LAST
      ) AS rn
    FROM (
      SELECT
        __x360_raw.*,
        CASE
          WHEN CAST(__x360_raw.new_stage1enddate AS TIMESTAMP) IS NULL
          OR CAST(__x360_raw.new_stage1enddate AS TIMESTAMP) >= __x360_ctx.as_of_exclusive
          THEN '11'
          WHEN CAST(__x360_raw.new_stage2enddate AS TIMESTAMP) IS NULL
          OR CAST(__x360_raw.new_stage2enddate AS TIMESTAMP) >= __x360_ctx.as_of_exclusive
          THEN '12'
          WHEN CAST(__x360_raw.new_stage3enddate AS TIMESTAMP) IS NULL
          OR CAST(__x360_raw.new_stage3enddate AS TIMESTAMP) >= __x360_ctx.as_of_exclusive
          THEN '13'
          WHEN CAST(__x360_raw.new_stage4enddate AS TIMESTAMP) IS NULL
          OR CAST(__x360_raw.new_stage4enddate AS TIMESTAMP) >= __x360_ctx.as_of_exclusive
          THEN '14'
          WHEN CAST(__x360_raw.new_stage5enddate AS TIMESTAMP) IS NULL
          OR CAST(__x360_raw.new_stage5enddate AS TIMESTAMP) >= __x360_ctx.as_of_exclusive
          THEN '15'
          ELSE 'completed'
        END AS __x360_asof_process_stage
      FROM ded_public.p_fm_edw_v_ods_crm_opportunity_esb AS __x360_raw
      CROSS JOIN context AS __x360_ctx
    ) AS o
    WHERE
      NULLIF(TRIM(CAST(o.opportunityid AS TEXT)), '') IS NOT NULL
  ) AS ranked
  CROSS JOIN context AS p
  WHERE
    ranked.created_at < p.as_of_exclusive
), customer_coverage AS MATERIALIZED (
  WITH storage_customer_ids AS MATERIALIZED (
    WITH storage_opportunity_owners AS MATERIALIZED (
      SELECT DISTINCT
        owner_id
      FROM (
        SELECT
          CAST(o.ownerid AS TEXT) AS owner_id,
          ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
            PARTITION BY o.opportunityid
            ORDER BY o.modifiedon DESC NULLS LAST, o.createdon DESC NULLS LAST
          ) AS rn
        FROM ded_public.p_fm_edw_v_ods_crm_opportunity_esb AS o
        WHERE
          NULLIF(TRIM(CAST(o.opportunityid AS TEXT)), '') IS NOT NULL
      ) AS ranked
      WHERE
        rn = 1 AND NULLIF(TRIM(owner_id), '') IS NOT NULL
    ), storage_team_ids AS MATERIALIZED (
      SELECT DISTINCT
        CAST(tm.teamid AS TEXT) AS team_id
      FROM ded_public.p_fm_edw_v_ods_crm_teammembership_esb AS tm
      JOIN ded_public.p_fm_edw_v_ods_crm_team_esb AS t
        ON t.teamid = tm.teamid
      WHERE
        CAST(tm.systemuserid AS TEXT) IN (
          SELECT
            owner_id
          FROM storage_opportunity_owners
        )
        AND NULLIF(TRIM(CAST(tm.teamid AS TEXT)), '') IS NOT NULL
    ), storage_user_ids AS MATERIALIZED (
      SELECT DISTINCT
        CAST(tm.systemuserid AS TEXT) AS user_id
      FROM ded_public.p_fm_edw_v_ods_crm_teammembership_esb AS tm
      WHERE
        CAST(tm.teamid AS TEXT) IN (
          SELECT
            team_id
          FROM storage_team_ids
        )
        AND NULLIF(TRIM(CAST(tm.systemuserid AS TEXT)), '') IS NOT NULL
    ), customer_latest AS MATERIALIZED (
      SELECT
        CAST(a.accountid AS TEXT) AS account_id,
        CAST(a.owninguser AS TEXT) AS owning_user,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
          PARTITION BY a.accountid
          ORDER BY a.modifiedon DESC NULLS LAST, a.createdon DESC NULLS LAST
        ) AS rn
      FROM ded_public.p_fm_edw_v_ods_crm_account_esb AS a
      WHERE
        NULLIF(TRIM(CAST(a.accountid AS TEXT)), '') IS NOT NULL
    )
    SELECT
      account_id
    FROM customer_latest
    WHERE
      rn = 1 AND owning_user IN (
        SELECT
          user_id
        FROM storage_user_ids
      )
  )
  SELECT
    a.account_id,
    a.account_name,
    a.level_code,
    COUNT(DISTINCT o.opportunity_id) AS opportunity_count,
    COUNT(DISTINCT o.opportunity_id) FILTER(WHERE
      o.product_type = '电芯') AS cell_opportunity_count,
    COUNT(DISTINCT o.opportunity_id) FILTER(WHERE
      o.product_type = 'PACK') AS pack_opportunity_count
  FROM accounts AS a
  CROSS JOIN context AS p
  LEFT JOIN opportunity_rows AS o
    ON o.account_id = a.account_id AND o.rn = 1
  WHERE
    a.level_code = ANY(
      p.strategic_levels
    )
    AND a.account_id IN (
      SELECT
        account_id
      FROM storage_customer_ids
    )
  GROUP BY
    a.account_id,
    a.account_name,
    a.level_code
), target_rows AS MATERIALIZED (
SELECT
    CAST(t.new_targetid AS TEXT) AS target_id,
    CAST(t.new_opportunity_id AS TEXT) AS opportunity_id,
    CAST(t.new_year AS INT) AS year_no,
    CAST(t.new_account_id AS TEXT) AS account_id,
    CAST(t.ownerid AS TEXT) AS owner_id,
    CAST(t.owningteam AS TEXT) AS owning_team_id,
    CAST(t.new_producttype_id AS TEXT) AS product_type_id,
    t.new_month1,
    t.new_month2,
    t.new_month3,
    t.new_month4,
    t.new_month5,
    t.new_month6,
    t.new_month7,
    t.new_month8,
    t.new_month9,
    t.new_month10,
    t.new_month11,
    t.new_month12,
    t.new_month1_power,
    t.new_month2_power,
    t.new_month3_power,
    t.new_month4_power,
    t.new_month5_power,
    t.new_month6_power,
    t.new_month7_power,
    t.new_month8_power,
    t.new_month9_power,
    t.new_month10_power,
    t.new_month11_power,
    t.new_month12_power,
    ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
      PARTITION BY COALESCE(NULLIF(TRIM(CAST(t.new_opportunity_id AS TEXT)), ''), CAST(t.new_targetid AS TEXT)), t.new_year
      ORDER BY t.createdon DESC NULLS LAST, t.new_targetid DESC NULLS LAST
    ) AS rn
  FROM (
    SELECT
      __x360_raw.*
    FROM ded_public.p_fm_edw_v_ods_crm_new_target_esb AS __x360_raw
    CROSS JOIN context AS __x360_ctx
    WHERE
      CAST(__x360_raw.createdon AS TIMESTAMP) < __x360_ctx.as_of_exclusive
  ) AS t
  CROSS JOIN context AS p
  WHERE
    CAST(t.new_year AS INT) = CAST(EXTRACT(YEAR FROM p.start_date) AS INT)
    AND t.new_targetid IS NOT NULL
),
r09_target_cells AS MATERIALIZED (
SELECT t.account_id,t.target_id,v.amount_yuan/1e8::numeric AS amount_yi,
 v.power_value/p.target_power_units_per_gwh AS energy_gwh
 FROM target_rows t CROSS JOIN context p CROSS JOIN LATERAL(VALUES
 (t.new_month1,t.new_month1_power),
(t.new_month2,t.new_month2_power),
(t.new_month3,t.new_month3_power),
(t.new_month4,t.new_month4_power),
(t.new_month5,t.new_month5_power),
(t.new_month6,t.new_month6_power),
(t.new_month7,t.new_month7_power),
(t.new_month8,t.new_month8_power),
(t.new_month9,t.new_month9_power),
(t.new_month10,t.new_month10_power),
(t.new_month11,t.new_month11_power),
(t.new_month12,t.new_month12_power)
 )v(amount_yuan,power_value) WHERE t.rn=1
),
r09_target_by_account AS MATERIALIZED (
SELECT account_id,SUM(amount_yi) AS target_amount,SUM(energy_gwh) AS target_energy,
 COUNT(DISTINCT target_id) AS target_versions,
 COUNT(*)FILTER(WHERE amount_yi IS NULL) AS missing_amount_cells,
 COUNT(*)FILTER(WHERE energy_gwh IS NULL) AS missing_energy_cells
 FROM r09_target_cells GROUP BY account_id
),
metric_results AS MATERIALIZED (
SELECT
    10 AS sort_no,
    CAST('R09' AS TEXT) AS code,
    CAST('待突破的战略客户数' AS TEXT) AS metric_name,
    CAST(NULL AS TEXT) AS product_team,
    CAST((
      NULL
    ) AS DECIMAL) AS amount_yi,
    CAST((
      NULL
    ) AS DECIMAL) AS energy_gwh,
    CAST((
      COUNT(*) FILTER(WHERE
        c.opportunity_count = 0)
    ) AS BIGINT) AS item_count,
    CAST((
      NULL
    ) AS DECIMAL) AS ratio_value,
    CAST((
      NULL
    ) AS DECIMAL) AS days_value,
    CAST((
      '已实现；客户底表按关联商机数判定'
    ) AS TEXT) AS status,
    CAST('以储能客户名单为底表，客户等级默认1；accountid＝商机parentaccountid关联全部最新商机。关联商机数为0的客户，按客户ID去重统计。客户本身不必已有商机，不按客户创建年份、审核或预测存在性筛选。' AS TEXT) AS note,
    CAST((
      JSONB_BUILD_OBJECT(
        '战略客户总数',
        COUNT(*),
        '有商机客户',
        COUNT(*) FILTER(WHERE
          opportunity_count > 0),
        '无商机客户',
        COUNT(*) FILTER(WHERE
          opportunity_count = 0),
        '客户明细',
        JSONB_AGG(TO_JSONB(c) || JSONB_BUILD_OBJECT('目标金额_亿元',t.target_amount,'目标电量_GWh',t.target_energy,'目标版本数',t.target_versions,'目标金额缺失单元格数',t.missing_amount_cells,'目标电量缺失单元格数',t.missing_energy_cells,'是否查到目标',t.account_id IS NOT NULL) ORDER BY c.account_id)
      )
    ) AS JSONB) AS detail
  FROM customer_coverage AS c LEFT JOIN r09_target_by_account t USING(account_id)
)
SELECT
  r.code AS "指标序号",
  r.metric_name AS "指标名称",
  r.product_team AS "产品团队",
  p.start_date AS "期间开始",
  p.end_exclusive AS "期间结束不含",
  p.cutoff AS "周期观察截止",
  r.amount_yi AS "金额_亿元",
  r.energy_gwh AS "电量_GWh",
  r.item_count AS "数量",
  r.ratio_value AS "比率_原始小数",
  r.days_value AS "平均周期_天",
  CASE
    WHEN r.status = '查询已实现；缺失输入及部分合计见明细'
    THEN CASE
      WHEN r.amount_yi IS NOT NULL
      OR r.energy_gwh IS NOT NULL
      OR r.item_count IS NOT NULL
      OR r.ratio_value IS NOT NULL
      OR r.days_value IS NOT NULL
      THEN '已有查询结果；完整性与适用列见明细'
      ELSE '没有可计算结果；检查输入、时间及关联范围'
    END
    ELSE r.status
  END AS "计算说明状态",
  r.note AS "取值说明",
  r.detail AS "分组明细及缺口"
FROM metric_results AS r
CROSS JOIN context AS p
ORDER BY
  r.sort_no,
  r.product_team;

C01.name: 处于 P0 阶段的战略客户未签单商机数及预测量
C01.definition: 储能客户名单内、当前等级1、商机statecode=0、截至日明确未签单（signed IS FALSE）的商机；P0由观察日前各阶段结束链推断。按商机ID去重计数并独立汇总所选期间截至前的商机＋月份最新预测；客户、商机均须在观察日次日前创建。
C01.formula: 不额外要求new_demandinput=0；需求情况仍可供AI下钻。数量不依赖预测存在，金额和电量分别计算。已签/未签统一执行BR-Q02：真实订单关联且商机P3结束new_stage4enddate早于观察日次日为已签；无订单、P3结束空或截至后结束均按未签。历史P0判断不直接使用当前new_processstage枚举。
C01.attributes:
LE01-A0001 商机管理.主键（opportunityid，空 0%）
LE01-A0451 商机管理.项目阶段（new_processstage，空 0%）
LE01-A0476 商机管理.客户（parentaccountid，空 0%）
LE01-A0488 商机管理.状态（statecode，空 0%）
LE02-A0039 项目月度销售预测.预测订单金额(未税/人民币)（new_forecast_amt_rmb，空 0%）
LE02-A0043 项目月度销售预测.项目（new_opportunity_id，空 0%）
LE02-A0052 项目月度销售预测.瓦时单价(国内含税/海外未税)（new_whprice，空 3.74%）
LE02-A0057 项目月度销售预测.预测年月(用于排序与过滤)（new_accountdate，空 0%）
LE05-A0001 客户.主键（accountid，空 0%）
LE05-A0244 客户.客户等级（new_accountlevel，空 0%）
LE07-A0001 订单.主键（salesorderid，空 0%）
LE08-A0025 订单产品.项目（new_opportunity_id，空 53.23%）
LE08-A0109 订单产品.订单（salesorderid，空 0%）
C01.physicalFields:
商机.opportunityid/new_processstage/statecode/parentaccountid；客户.accountid/new_accountlevel；订单明细.new_opportunity_id/salesorderid；订单.salesorderid；月度预测.new_opportunity_id/new_accountdate/new_forecast_amt_rmb/new_whprice
储能客户过滤：客户.owninguser；商机.ownerid；团队人员.systemuserid/teamid；团队.teamid。
截至日签单还读取商机.new_stage4enddate；明细.new_opportunity_id/salesorderid连接真实订单.salesorderid。
C01.notes:
储能客户名单先按商机负责人关联团队确定，再按客户owninguser筛选；客户不必已有商机、不要求本期新建，但客户/商机须在观察截止前创建。计数对象保留，时间版本、历史阶段及签单截至按本轮统一规则。
本体截至日签单仅设观察日次日上限，不加本期期初下限；只有专门统计本期新增签单时才另加start_date下限。签单判定不使用订单OA审批日期、订单createdon或合同确认枚举。 P3结束为空统一计未签；已签与未签按该二态互斥划分。金额、电量字段本身的缺值处理保持原口径。
C01.sqlStatus: 已实现；P0有效战略未签集合，数量与预测分开计算
C01.role: 根因判定 / 行动跟踪；最终分析仅读总体、客户、商机及阶段事实，范围见BR-V12
C01.ctes: parameters → context → forecast_rows → account_rows → accounts → opportunity_rows → orders → order_line_links → signed_orders → asof_signing_flags → strategic_p0_missing_p3_end → storage_customer_ids → storage_opportunity_owners → storage_team_ids → storage_user_ids → customer_latest → strategic_p0_unsigned → strategic_p0_values
C01.sql:
WITH parameters AS MATERIALIZED (
  SELECT
    CAST(%s AS DATE) AS start_date,
    CAST(%s AS DATE) AS end_exclusive,
    CAST(%s AS TIMESTAMP) AS observed_at,
    CAST(ARRAY['1'] AS TEXT[]) AS strategic_levels,
    CAST(ARRAY['1', '2'] AS TEXT[]) AS focus_levels,
    CAST(1000000 AS DECIMAL) AS target_power_units_per_gwh
), context AS MATERIALIZED (
  SELECT
    p.*,
    CAST((
      DATE_TRUNC('DAY', observed_at) + INTERVAL '1 DAY'
    ) AS TIMESTAMP) AS as_of_exclusive,
    LEAST(
      CAST(end_exclusive AS TIMESTAMP),
      DATE_TRUNC('DAY', observed_at) + INTERVAL '1 DAY'
    ) AS effective_end_exclusive,
    LEAST(
      CAST(end_exclusive AS TIMESTAMP),
      DATE_TRUNC('DAY', observed_at) + INTERVAL '1 DAY'
    ) - INTERVAL '1 MICROSECOND' AS cutoff,
    MAKE_DATE(CAST(EXTRACT(YEAR FROM start_date) AS INT), 1, 1) AS year_start,
    MAKE_DATE(CAST(EXTRACT(YEAR FROM start_date) AS INT) + 1, 1, 1) AS next_year_start,
    GREATEST(
      CAST(0 AS DECIMAL),
      LEAST(
        CAST(1 AS DECIMAL),
        CAST((
          CAST(LEAST(
            CAST(end_exclusive AS TIMESTAMP),
            DATE_TRUNC('DAY', observed_at) + INTERVAL '1 DAY'
          ) AS DATE) - MAKE_DATE(CAST(EXTRACT(YEAR FROM start_date) AS INT), 1, 1)
        ) AS DECIMAL) / (
          MAKE_DATE(CAST(EXTRACT(YEAR FROM start_date) AS INT) + 1, 1, 1) - MAKE_DATE(CAST(EXTRACT(YEAR FROM start_date) AS INT), 1, 1)
        )
      )
    ) AS time_progress
  FROM parameters AS p
), forecast_rows AS MATERIALIZED (
  SELECT
    CAST(m.new_oppmonthid AS TEXT) AS forecast_id,
    CAST(m.new_opportunity_id AS TEXT) AS opportunity_id,
    CAST(m.new_accountdate AS TIMESTAMP) AS forecast_month,
    CAST(m.new_forecast_amt_rmb AS DECIMAL) AS amount_yuan,
    CAST(m.new_whprice AS DECIMAL) AS wh_price,
    ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
      PARTITION BY m.new_opportunity_id, DATE_TRUNC('MONTH', CAST(m.new_accountdate AS TIMESTAMP))
      ORDER BY m.createdon DESC NULLS LAST, m.modifiedon DESC NULLS LAST, m.new_oppmonthid DESC NULLS LAST
    ) AS rn
  FROM (
    SELECT
      __x360_raw.*
    FROM ded_public.p_fm_edw_v_ods_crm_new_oppmonth_esb AS __x360_raw
    CROSS JOIN context AS __x360_ctx
    WHERE
      CAST(__x360_raw.createdon AS TIMESTAMP) < __x360_ctx.as_of_exclusive
  ) AS m
  CROSS JOIN context AS p
  WHERE
    NULLIF(TRIM(CAST(m.new_oppmonthid AS TEXT)), '') IS NOT NULL
    AND NULLIF(TRIM(CAST(m.new_opportunity_id AS TEXT)), '') IS NOT NULL
    AND CAST(m.new_accountdate AS TIMESTAMP) >= p.start_date
    AND CAST(m.new_accountdate AS TIMESTAMP) < p.end_exclusive
), account_rows AS MATERIALIZED (
  SELECT
    CAST(a.accountid AS TEXT) AS account_id,
    CAST(a.name AS TEXT) AS account_name,
    CAST(a.new_accountlevel AS TEXT) AS level_code,
    CAST(a.new_sapdate AS TIMESTAMP) AS sap_created_at,
    CAST(a.new_sapsubmitdate AS TIMESTAMP) AS sap_submitted_at,
    CAST(a.new_approved_time_facreview AS TIMESTAMP) AS account_factory_approved_at,
    CAST(a.new_submit_time_facreview AS TIMESTAMP) AS account_factory_submitted_at,
    CAST(a.new_sinosurestartdate AS TIMESTAMP) AS account_sinosure_start,
    CAST(a.new_sinosureenddate AS TIMESTAMP) AS account_sinosure_end,
    CAST(a.new_submit_time_accredit AS TIMESTAMP) AS account_credit_submitted_at,
    CAST(a.new_approvaltime_accredit AS TIMESTAMP) AS account_credit_approved_at,
    CAST(a.new_cdastartdate AS TIMESTAMP) AS account_cda_start,
    CAST(a.new_cdaenddate AS TIMESTAMP) AS account_cda_end,
    CAST(a.new_cda_submittime AS TIMESTAMP) AS account_cda_submitted_at,
    CAST(a.new_cda_approved_time AS TIMESTAMP) AS account_cda_approved_at,
    CAST(a.new_approvalstatus_facreview AS TEXT) AS account_factory_approval_status,
    CAST(a.new_sapcode AS TEXT) AS sap_code,
    CAST(a.new_issap AS TEXT) AS sap_registered,
    CAST(a.new_issapnew AS TEXT) AS sap_registration_kind,
    ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
      PARTITION BY a.accountid
      ORDER BY a.modifiedon DESC NULLS LAST, a.createdon DESC NULLS LAST
    ) AS rn
  FROM (
    SELECT
      __x360_raw.*
    FROM ded_public.p_fm_edw_v_ods_crm_account_esb AS __x360_raw
    CROSS JOIN context AS __x360_ctx
    WHERE
      CAST(__x360_raw.createdon AS TIMESTAMP) < __x360_ctx.as_of_exclusive
  ) AS a
  WHERE
    NULLIF(TRIM(CAST(a.accountid AS TEXT)), '') IS NOT NULL
), accounts AS MATERIALIZED (
  SELECT
    account_id,
    account_name,
    level_code,
    sap_created_at,
    sap_submitted_at,
    account_factory_approved_at,
    account_factory_submitted_at,
    account_sinosure_start,
    account_sinosure_end,
    account_credit_submitted_at,
    account_credit_approved_at,
    account_cda_start,
    account_cda_end,
    account_cda_submitted_at,
    account_cda_approved_at,
    account_factory_approval_status,
    sap_code,
    sap_registered,
    sap_registration_kind
  FROM account_rows
  WHERE
    rn = 1
), opportunity_rows AS MATERIALIZED (
  SELECT
    ranked.*
  FROM (
    SELECT
      CAST(o.opportunityid AS TEXT) AS opportunity_id,
      CAST(o.parentaccountid AS TEXT) AS account_id,
      CAST(o.name AS TEXT) AS project_name,
      CAST(o.ownerid AS TEXT) AS owner_id,
      CASE
        WHEN CAST(o.new_accproducttype AS TEXT) IN ('1', '电芯')
        THEN '电芯'
        WHEN CAST(o.new_accproducttype AS TEXT) IN ('2', 'PACK')
        THEN 'PACK'
        ELSE '其他'
      END AS product_type,
      o.__x360_asof_process_stage AS process_stage,
      CAST(o.statecode AS TEXT) AS system_state,
      CAST(o.new_demandinput AS TEXT) AS demand_status,
      CAST(o.createdon AS TIMESTAMP) AS created_at,
      CAST(o.new_stage1enddate AS TIMESTAMP) AS s1,
      CAST(o.new_stage2enddate AS TIMESTAMP) AS s2,
      CAST(o.new_stage3enddate AS TIMESTAMP) AS s3,
      CAST(o.new_stage4enddate AS TIMESTAMP) AS s4,
      CAST(o.new_stage5enddate AS TIMESTAMP) AS s5,
      CAST(o.new_cdastartdate AS TIMESTAMP) AS new_cdastartdate,
      CAST(o.new_cdaenddate AS TIMESTAMP) AS new_cdaenddate,
      CAST(o.new_approved_time_acneed AS TIMESTAMP) AS new_approved_time_acneed,
      CAST(o.new_submit_time_acneed AS TIMESTAMP) AS new_submit_time_acneed,
      CAST(o.new_approved_time_projectassess AS TIMESTAMP) AS new_approved_time_projectassess,
      CAST(o.new_submit_time_projectassess AS TIMESTAMP) AS new_submit_time_projectassess,
      CAST(o.new_sampletestpass_time AS TIMESTAMP) AS new_sampletestpass_time,
      CAST(o.new_sampletime AS TIMESTAMP) AS new_sampletime,
      CAST(o.new_technicalsigningdate AS TIMESTAMP) AS new_technicalsigningdate,
      CAST(o.new_submit_time_techcon AS TIMESTAMP) AS new_submit_time_techcon,
      CAST(o.new_warrantysigningdate AS TIMESTAMP) AS new_warrantysigningdate,
      CAST(o.new_submit_time_qsl AS TIMESTAMP) AS new_submit_time_qsl,
      CAST(o.new_isneedcda AS TEXT) AS new_isneedcda,
      CAST(o.new_approvalstatus_acneed AS TEXT) AS new_approvalstatus_acneed,
      CAST(o.new_approvalstatus_projectassess AS TEXT) AS new_approvalstatus_projectassess,
      CAST(o.new_approvalstatus_techcon AS TEXT) AS new_approvalstatus_techcon,
      CAST(o.new_approvalstatus_qsl AS TEXT) AS new_approvalstatus_qsl,
      CAST(o.new_sampletestresult AS TEXT) AS new_sampletestresult,
      ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
        PARTITION BY o.opportunityid
        ORDER BY o.modifiedon DESC NULLS LAST, o.createdon DESC NULLS LAST
      ) AS rn
    FROM (
      SELECT
        __x360_raw.*,
        CASE
          WHEN CAST(__x360_raw.new_stage1enddate AS TIMESTAMP) IS NULL
          OR CAST(__x360_raw.new_stage1enddate AS TIMESTAMP) >= __x360_ctx.as_of_exclusive
          THEN '11'
          WHEN CAST(__x360_raw.new_stage2enddate AS TIMESTAMP) IS NULL
          OR CAST(__x360_raw.new_stage2enddate AS TIMESTAMP) >= __x360_ctx.as_of_exclusive
          THEN '12'
          WHEN CAST(__x360_raw.new_stage3enddate AS TIMESTAMP) IS NULL
          OR CAST(__x360_raw.new_stage3enddate AS TIMESTAMP) >= __x360_ctx.as_of_exclusive
          THEN '13'
          WHEN CAST(__x360_raw.new_stage4enddate AS TIMESTAMP) IS NULL
          OR CAST(__x360_raw.new_stage4enddate AS TIMESTAMP) >= __x360_ctx.as_of_exclusive
          THEN '14'
          WHEN CAST(__x360_raw.new_stage5enddate AS TIMESTAMP) IS NULL
          OR CAST(__x360_raw.new_stage5enddate AS TIMESTAMP) >= __x360_ctx.as_of_exclusive
          THEN '15'
          ELSE 'completed'
        END AS __x360_asof_process_stage
      FROM ded_public.p_fm_edw_v_ods_crm_opportunity_esb AS __x360_raw
      CROSS JOIN context AS __x360_ctx
    ) AS o
    WHERE
      NULLIF(TRIM(CAST(o.opportunityid AS TEXT)), '') IS NOT NULL
  ) AS ranked
  CROSS JOIN context AS p
  WHERE
    ranked.created_at < p.as_of_exclusive
), orders AS MATERIALIZED (
  SELECT DISTINCT
    CAST(salesorderid AS TEXT) AS order_id
  FROM ded_public.p_fm_edw_v_ods_crm_salesorder_esb
  WHERE
    NULLIF(TRIM(CAST(salesorderid AS TEXT)), '') IS NOT NULL
), order_line_links AS MATERIALIZED (
  SELECT DISTINCT
    CAST(l.new_opportunity_id AS TEXT) AS opportunity_id,
    CAST(l.salesorderid AS TEXT) AS order_id
  FROM ded_public.p_fm_edw_v_ods_crm_salesorderdetail_esb AS l
  WHERE
    NULLIF(TRIM(CAST(l.new_opportunity_id AS TEXT)), '') IS NOT NULL
    AND NULLIF(TRIM(CAST(l.salesorderid AS TEXT)), '') IS NOT NULL
), signed_orders AS MATERIALIZED (
  SELECT
    l.opportunity_id,
    COUNT(DISTINCT l.order_id) AS order_count
  FROM order_line_links AS l
  JOIN orders AS o
    USING (order_id)
  GROUP BY
    l.opportunity_id
), asof_signing_flags AS MATERIALIZED (
  SELECT
    o.opportunity_id,
    CASE
      WHEN COALESCE(s.order_count, 0) = 0
      THEN FALSE
      WHEN o.s4 IS NULL
      THEN FALSE
      ELSE o.s4 < p.as_of_exclusive
    END AS signed,
    (
      COALESCE(s.order_count, 0) > 0 AND o.s4 IS NULL
    ) AS missing_p3_end
  FROM opportunity_rows AS o
  LEFT JOIN signed_orders AS s
    USING (opportunity_id)
  CROSS JOIN context AS p
  WHERE
    o.rn = 1
), strategic_p0_missing_p3_end AS MATERIALIZED (
  WITH storage_customer_ids AS MATERIALIZED (
    WITH storage_opportunity_owners AS MATERIALIZED (
      SELECT DISTINCT
        owner_id
      FROM (
        SELECT
          CAST(o.ownerid AS TEXT) AS owner_id,
          ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
            PARTITION BY o.opportunityid
            ORDER BY o.modifiedon DESC NULLS LAST, o.createdon DESC NULLS LAST
          ) AS rn
        FROM ded_public.p_fm_edw_v_ods_crm_opportunity_esb AS o
        WHERE
          NULLIF(TRIM(CAST(o.opportunityid AS TEXT)), '') IS NOT NULL
      ) AS ranked
      WHERE
        rn = 1 AND NULLIF(TRIM(owner_id), '') IS NOT NULL
    ), storage_team_ids AS MATERIALIZED (
      SELECT DISTINCT
        CAST(tm.teamid AS TEXT) AS team_id
      FROM ded_public.p_fm_edw_v_ods_crm_teammembership_esb AS tm
      JOIN ded_public.p_fm_edw_v_ods_crm_team_esb AS t
        ON t.teamid = tm.teamid
      WHERE
        CAST(tm.systemuserid AS TEXT) IN (
          SELECT
            owner_id
          FROM storage_opportunity_owners
        )
        AND NULLIF(TRIM(CAST(tm.teamid AS TEXT)), '') IS NOT NULL
    ), storage_user_ids AS MATERIALIZED (
      SELECT DISTINCT
        CAST(tm.systemuserid AS TEXT) AS user_id
      FROM ded_public.p_fm_edw_v_ods_crm_teammembership_esb AS tm
      WHERE
        CAST(tm.teamid AS TEXT) IN (
          SELECT
            team_id
          FROM storage_team_ids
        )
        AND NULLIF(TRIM(CAST(tm.systemuserid AS TEXT)), '') IS NOT NULL
    ), customer_latest AS MATERIALIZED (
      SELECT
        CAST(a.accountid AS TEXT) AS account_id,
        CAST(a.owninguser AS TEXT) AS owning_user,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
          PARTITION BY a.accountid
          ORDER BY a.modifiedon DESC NULLS LAST, a.createdon DESC NULLS LAST
        ) AS rn
      FROM ded_public.p_fm_edw_v_ods_crm_account_esb AS a
      WHERE
        NULLIF(TRIM(CAST(a.accountid AS TEXT)), '') IS NOT NULL
    )
    SELECT
      account_id
    FROM customer_latest
    WHERE
      rn = 1 AND owning_user IN (
        SELECT
          user_id
        FROM storage_user_ids
      )
  )
  SELECT
    o.opportunity_id,
    o.product_type,
    a.account_id
  FROM opportunity_rows AS o
  JOIN accounts AS a
    ON a.account_id = o.account_id
  LEFT JOIN asof_signing_flags AS s
    ON s.opportunity_id = o.opportunity_id
  CROSS JOIN context AS p
  WHERE
    (
      o.rn = 1
      AND o.process_stage = '11'
      AND o.system_state = '0'
      AND a.level_code = ANY(
        p.strategic_levels
      )
      AND s.missing_p3_end IS TRUE
    )
    AND a.account_id IN (
      SELECT
        account_id
      FROM storage_customer_ids
    )
), strategic_p0_unsigned AS MATERIALIZED (
  WITH storage_customer_ids AS MATERIALIZED (
    WITH storage_opportunity_owners AS MATERIALIZED (
      SELECT DISTINCT
        owner_id
      FROM (
        SELECT
          CAST(o.ownerid AS TEXT) AS owner_id,
          ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
            PARTITION BY o.opportunityid
            ORDER BY o.modifiedon DESC NULLS LAST, o.createdon DESC NULLS LAST
          ) AS rn
        FROM ded_public.p_fm_edw_v_ods_crm_opportunity_esb AS o
        WHERE
          NULLIF(TRIM(CAST(o.opportunityid AS TEXT)), '') IS NOT NULL
      ) AS ranked
      WHERE
        rn = 1 AND NULLIF(TRIM(owner_id), '') IS NOT NULL
    ), storage_team_ids AS MATERIALIZED (
      SELECT DISTINCT
        CAST(tm.teamid AS TEXT) AS team_id
      FROM ded_public.p_fm_edw_v_ods_crm_teammembership_esb AS tm
      JOIN ded_public.p_fm_edw_v_ods_crm_team_esb AS t
        ON t.teamid = tm.teamid
      WHERE
        CAST(tm.systemuserid AS TEXT) IN (
          SELECT
            owner_id
          FROM storage_opportunity_owners
        )
        AND NULLIF(TRIM(CAST(tm.teamid AS TEXT)), '') IS NOT NULL
    ), storage_user_ids AS MATERIALIZED (
      SELECT DISTINCT
        CAST(tm.systemuserid AS TEXT) AS user_id
      FROM ded_public.p_fm_edw_v_ods_crm_teammembership_esb AS tm
      WHERE
        CAST(tm.teamid AS TEXT) IN (
          SELECT
            team_id
          FROM storage_team_ids
        )
        AND NULLIF(TRIM(CAST(tm.systemuserid AS TEXT)), '') IS NOT NULL
    ), customer_latest AS MATERIALIZED (
      SELECT
        CAST(a.accountid AS TEXT) AS account_id,
        CAST(a.owninguser AS TEXT) AS owning_user,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
          PARTITION BY a.accountid
          ORDER BY a.modifiedon DESC NULLS LAST, a.createdon DESC NULLS LAST
        ) AS rn
      FROM ded_public.p_fm_edw_v_ods_crm_account_esb AS a
      WHERE
        NULLIF(TRIM(CAST(a.accountid AS TEXT)), '') IS NOT NULL
    )
    SELECT
      account_id
    FROM customer_latest
    WHERE
      rn = 1 AND owning_user IN (
        SELECT
          user_id
        FROM storage_user_ids
      )
  )
  SELECT
    o.opportunity_id,
    o.product_type,
    a.account_id
  FROM opportunity_rows AS o
  JOIN accounts AS a
    ON a.account_id = o.account_id
  LEFT JOIN asof_signing_flags AS s
    ON s.opportunity_id = o.opportunity_id
  CROSS JOIN context AS p
  WHERE
    (
      o.rn = 1
      AND o.process_stage = '11'
      AND o.system_state = '0'
      AND a.level_code = ANY(
        p.strategic_levels
      )
      AND s.signed IS FALSE
    )
    AND a.account_id IN (
      SELECT
        account_id
      FROM storage_customer_ids
    )
), strategic_p0_values AS MATERIALIZED (
  SELECT
    CASE WHEN GROUPING(c.product_type) = 1 THEN '全部' ELSE c.product_type END AS product_type,
    COUNT(DISTINCT c.opportunity_id) AS opportunity_count,
    CASE
      WHEN COUNT(DISTINCT c.opportunity_id) = 0
      THEN 0
      ELSE SUM(f.amount_yuan) / CAST(100000000 AS DECIMAL)
    END AS amount_yi,
    CASE
      WHEN COUNT(DISTINCT c.opportunity_id) = 0
      THEN 0
      ELSE SUM(f.amount_yuan / NULLIF(f.wh_price, 0)) / CAST(1000000000 AS DECIMAL)
    END AS energy_gwh,
    COUNT(f.forecast_id) AS forecast_rows,
    COUNT(DISTINCT c.opportunity_id) FILTER(WHERE
      f.forecast_id IS NULL) AS opportunities_without_period_forecast,
    COUNT(f.forecast_id) FILTER(WHERE
      f.amount_yuan IS NULL) AS missing_amount_rows,
    COUNT(f.forecast_id) FILTER(WHERE
      f.amount_yuan IS NULL OR f.wh_price IS NULL OR f.wh_price = 0) AS missing_energy_input_rows
  FROM strategic_p0_unsigned AS c
  LEFT JOIN forecast_rows AS f
    ON f.opportunity_id = c.opportunity_id AND f.rn = 1
  GROUP BY
    GROUPING SETS (
      (),
      (
        c.product_type
      )
    )
), metric_results AS MATERIALIZED (
  SELECT
    13 AS sort_no,
    CAST('C01' AS TEXT) AS code,
    CAST('处于 P0 阶段的战略客户未签单商机数及预测量' AS TEXT) AS metric_name,
    CAST(NULL AS TEXT) AS product_team,
    amount_yi,
    energy_gwh,
    CAST(opportunity_count AS BIGINT) AS item_count,
    CAST(NULL AS DECIMAL) AS ratio_value,
    CAST(NULL AS DECIMAL) AS days_value,
    CAST('已实现；P0有效战略未签集合，数量与预测分开计算' AS TEXT) AS status,
    CAST('客户须在储能名单且等级1；最新商机new_processstage=11、statecode=0，经订单明细未关联到真实订单。数量按商机ID去重，预测金额/电量按本文件原所选期间最新预测规则汇总；缺预测不影响商机数量。' AS TEXT) AS note,
    (
      SELECT
        JSONB_AGG(
          TO_JSONB(x) || JSONB_BUILD_OBJECT(
            '有订单但P3结束缺失候选商机数（按未签处理）',
            (
              SELECT
                COUNT(DISTINCT u.opportunity_id)
              FROM strategic_p0_missing_p3_end AS u
              WHERE
                x.product_type = '全部' OR u.product_type = x.product_type
            )
          )
        )
      FROM strategic_p0_values AS x
    ) AS detail
  FROM strategic_p0_values
  WHERE
    product_type = '全部'
)
SELECT
  r.code AS "指标序号",
  r.metric_name AS "指标名称",
  r.product_team AS "产品团队",
  p.start_date AS "期间开始",
  p.end_exclusive AS "期间结束不含",
  p.cutoff AS "周期观察截止",
  r.amount_yi AS "金额_亿元",
  r.energy_gwh AS "电量_GWh",
  r.item_count AS "数量",
  r.ratio_value AS "比率_原始小数",
  r.days_value AS "平均周期_天",
  CASE
    WHEN r.status = '查询已实现；缺失输入及部分合计见明细'
    THEN CASE
      WHEN r.amount_yi IS NOT NULL
      OR r.energy_gwh IS NOT NULL
      OR r.item_count IS NOT NULL
      OR r.ratio_value IS NOT NULL
      OR r.days_value IS NOT NULL
      THEN '已有查询结果；完整性与适用列见明细'
      ELSE '没有可计算结果；检查输入、时间及关联范围'
    END
    ELSE r.status
  END AS "计算说明状态",
  r.note AS "取值说明",
  r.detail AS "分组明细及缺口"
FROM metric_results AS r
CROSS JOIN context AS p
ORDER BY
  r.sort_no,
  r.product_team;

C07.name: 方案推动超静态基线 50% 的未签单商机
C07.definition: 所选期间内P2已真实结束，且截至观察日明确未签单（signed IS FALSE）的商机；P2周期＝new_stage3enddate－new_stage2enddate，周期严格大于0且严格大于P2静态基线7.2天的1.5倍，汇总数量及期间预测。已签/未签统一执行BR-Q02：真实订单关联且商机P3结束new_stage4enddate早于观察日次日为已签；无订单、P3结束空或截至后结束均按未签。
C07.formula: P2结束时间须落所选期间且早于观察日次日，起点可早于期初；不要求当前仍在P2，不使用在途时长。P2同一阶段统一使用静态基线7.2天，严格>10.8天才触发，等于不触发；0天、缺值及逆序排除。该指标作为AI原因分析证据，AI结论仍待核实。已签/未签统一执行BR-Q02：真实订单关联且商机P3结束new_stage4enddate早于观察日次日为已签；无订单、P3结束空或截至后结束均按未签。
C07.attributes:
LE01-A0100 商机管理.阶段三结束日期（new_stage3enddate，空 74.35%）
LE01-A0243 商机管理.阶段二结束日期（new_stage2enddate，空 66.19%）
LE01-A0451 商机管理.项目阶段（new_processstage，空 0%）
LE02-A0043 项目月度销售预测.项目（new_opportunity_id，空 0%）
LE07-A0001 订单.主键（salesorderid，空 0%）
LE08-A0025 订单产品.项目（new_opportunity_id，空 53.23%）
LE08-A0109 订单产品.订单（salesorderid，空 0%）
C07.physicalFields:
商机.new_processstage/new_stage2enddate/new_stage3enddate
截至日签单还读取商机.new_stage4enddate；明细.new_opportunity_id/salesorderid连接真实订单.salesorderid。
C07.notes:
本体按P2固定7.2天的1.5倍比较，不再依赖P2-01实际样本均值；签单按BR-Q02二态判断，超期集合按P2结束时间归期。
本体截至日签单仅设观察日次日上限，不加本期期初下限；只有专门统计本期新增签单时才另加start_date下限。签单判定不使用订单OA审批日期、订单createdon或合同确认枚举。 P3结束为空统一计未签；已签与未签按该二态互斥划分。金额、电量字段本身的缺值处理保持原口径。
C07.sqlStatus: 查询已实现；缺失输入及部分合计见明细
C07.role: 独立基础周期诊断；不单独生成最终风险或根因
C07.ctes: parameters → context → account_rows → accounts → opportunity_rows → opportunities → orders → order_line_links → signed_orders → opportunity_flags → forecast_rows → forecast_facts → opportunity_forecast → stage_facts → stage_means → stage_overdue
C07.sql:
WITH parameters AS MATERIALIZED (
  SELECT
    CAST(%s AS DATE) AS start_date,
    CAST(%s AS DATE) AS end_exclusive,
    CAST(%s AS TIMESTAMP) AS observed_at,
    CAST(ARRAY['1'] AS TEXT[]) AS strategic_levels,
    CAST(ARRAY['1', '2'] AS TEXT[]) AS focus_levels,
    CAST(1000000 AS DECIMAL) AS target_power_units_per_gwh
), context AS MATERIALIZED (
  SELECT
    p.*,
    CAST((
      DATE_TRUNC('DAY', observed_at) + INTERVAL '1 DAY'
    ) AS TIMESTAMP) AS as_of_exclusive,
    LEAST(
      CAST(end_exclusive AS TIMESTAMP),
      DATE_TRUNC('DAY', observed_at) + INTERVAL '1 DAY'
    ) AS effective_end_exclusive,
    LEAST(
      CAST(end_exclusive AS TIMESTAMP),
      DATE_TRUNC('DAY', observed_at) + INTERVAL '1 DAY'
    ) - INTERVAL '1 MICROSECOND' AS cutoff,
    MAKE_DATE(CAST(EXTRACT(YEAR FROM start_date) AS INT), 1, 1) AS year_start,
    MAKE_DATE(CAST(EXTRACT(YEAR FROM start_date) AS INT) + 1, 1, 1) AS next_year_start,
    GREATEST(
      CAST(0 AS DECIMAL),
      LEAST(
        CAST(1 AS DECIMAL),
        CAST((
          CAST(LEAST(
            CAST(end_exclusive AS TIMESTAMP),
            DATE_TRUNC('DAY', observed_at) + INTERVAL '1 DAY'
          ) AS DATE) - MAKE_DATE(CAST(EXTRACT(YEAR FROM start_date) AS INT), 1, 1)
        ) AS DECIMAL) / (
          MAKE_DATE(CAST(EXTRACT(YEAR FROM start_date) AS INT) + 1, 1, 1) - MAKE_DATE(CAST(EXTRACT(YEAR FROM start_date) AS INT), 1, 1)
        )
      )
    ) AS time_progress
  FROM parameters AS p
), account_rows AS MATERIALIZED (
  SELECT
    CAST(a.accountid AS TEXT) AS account_id,
    CAST(a.name AS TEXT) AS account_name,
    CAST(a.new_accountlevel AS TEXT) AS level_code,
    CAST(a.new_sapdate AS TIMESTAMP) AS sap_created_at,
    CAST(a.new_sapsubmitdate AS TIMESTAMP) AS sap_submitted_at,
    CAST(a.new_approved_time_facreview AS TIMESTAMP) AS account_factory_approved_at,
    CAST(a.new_submit_time_facreview AS TIMESTAMP) AS account_factory_submitted_at,
    CAST(a.new_sinosurestartdate AS TIMESTAMP) AS account_sinosure_start,
    CAST(a.new_sinosureenddate AS TIMESTAMP) AS account_sinosure_end,
    CAST(a.new_submit_time_accredit AS TIMESTAMP) AS account_credit_submitted_at,
    CAST(a.new_approvaltime_accredit AS TIMESTAMP) AS account_credit_approved_at,
    CAST(a.new_cdastartdate AS TIMESTAMP) AS account_cda_start,
    CAST(a.new_cdaenddate AS TIMESTAMP) AS account_cda_end,
    CAST(a.new_cda_submittime AS TIMESTAMP) AS account_cda_submitted_at,
    CAST(a.new_cda_approved_time AS TIMESTAMP) AS account_cda_approved_at,
    CAST(a.new_approvalstatus_facreview AS TEXT) AS account_factory_approval_status,
    CAST(a.new_sapcode AS TEXT) AS sap_code,
    CAST(a.new_issap AS TEXT) AS sap_registered,
    CAST(a.new_issapnew AS TEXT) AS sap_registration_kind,
    ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
      PARTITION BY a.accountid
      ORDER BY a.modifiedon DESC NULLS LAST, a.createdon DESC NULLS LAST
    ) AS rn
  FROM (
    SELECT
      __x360_raw.*
    FROM ded_public.p_fm_edw_v_ods_crm_account_esb AS __x360_raw
    CROSS JOIN context AS __x360_ctx
    WHERE
      CAST(__x360_raw.createdon AS TIMESTAMP) < __x360_ctx.as_of_exclusive
  ) AS a
  WHERE
    NULLIF(TRIM(CAST(a.accountid AS TEXT)), '') IS NOT NULL
), accounts AS MATERIALIZED (
  SELECT
    account_id,
    account_name,
    level_code,
    sap_created_at,
    sap_submitted_at,
    account_factory_approved_at,
    account_factory_submitted_at,
    account_sinosure_start,
    account_sinosure_end,
    account_credit_submitted_at,
    account_credit_approved_at,
    account_cda_start,
    account_cda_end,
    account_cda_submitted_at,
    account_cda_approved_at,
    account_factory_approval_status,
    sap_code,
    sap_registered,
    sap_registration_kind
  FROM account_rows
  WHERE
    rn = 1
), opportunity_rows AS MATERIALIZED (
  SELECT
    ranked.*
  FROM (
    SELECT
      CAST(o.opportunityid AS TEXT) AS opportunity_id,
      CAST(o.parentaccountid AS TEXT) AS account_id,
      CAST(o.name AS TEXT) AS project_name,
      CAST(o.ownerid AS TEXT) AS owner_id,
      CASE
        WHEN CAST(o.new_accproducttype AS TEXT) IN ('1', '电芯')
        THEN '电芯'
        WHEN CAST(o.new_accproducttype AS TEXT) IN ('2', 'PACK')
        THEN 'PACK'
        ELSE '其他'
      END AS product_type,
      o.__x360_asof_process_stage AS process_stage,
      CAST(o.statecode AS TEXT) AS system_state,
      CAST(o.new_demandinput AS TEXT) AS demand_status,
      CAST(o.createdon AS TIMESTAMP) AS created_at,
      CAST(o.new_stage1enddate AS TIMESTAMP) AS s1,
      CAST(o.new_stage2enddate AS TIMESTAMP) AS s2,
      CAST(o.new_stage3enddate AS TIMESTAMP) AS s3,
      CAST(o.new_stage4enddate AS TIMESTAMP) AS s4,
      CAST(o.new_stage5enddate AS TIMESTAMP) AS s5,
      CAST(o.new_cdastartdate AS TIMESTAMP) AS new_cdastartdate,
      CAST(o.new_cdaenddate AS TIMESTAMP) AS new_cdaenddate,
      CAST(o.new_approved_time_acneed AS TIMESTAMP) AS new_approved_time_acneed,
      CAST(o.new_submit_time_acneed AS TIMESTAMP) AS new_submit_time_acneed,
      CAST(o.new_approved_time_projectassess AS TIMESTAMP) AS new_approved_time_projectassess,
      CAST(o.new_submit_time_projectassess AS TIMESTAMP) AS new_submit_time_projectassess,
      CAST(o.new_sampletestpass_time AS TIMESTAMP) AS new_sampletestpass_time,
      CAST(o.new_sampletime AS TIMESTAMP) AS new_sampletime,
      CAST(o.new_technicalsigningdate AS TIMESTAMP) AS new_technicalsigningdate,
      CAST(o.new_submit_time_techcon AS TIMESTAMP) AS new_submit_time_techcon,
      CAST(o.new_warrantysigningdate AS TIMESTAMP) AS new_warrantysigningdate,
      CAST(o.new_submit_time_qsl AS TIMESTAMP) AS new_submit_time_qsl,
      CAST(o.new_isneedcda AS TEXT) AS new_isneedcda,
      CAST(o.new_approvalstatus_acneed AS TEXT) AS new_approvalstatus_acneed,
      CAST(o.new_approvalstatus_projectassess AS TEXT) AS new_approvalstatus_projectassess,
      CAST(o.new_approvalstatus_techcon AS TEXT) AS new_approvalstatus_techcon,
      CAST(o.new_approvalstatus_qsl AS TEXT) AS new_approvalstatus_qsl,
      CAST(o.new_sampletestresult AS TEXT) AS new_sampletestresult,
      ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
        PARTITION BY o.opportunityid
        ORDER BY o.modifiedon DESC NULLS LAST, o.createdon DESC NULLS LAST
      ) AS rn
    FROM (
      SELECT
        __x360_raw.*,
        CASE
          WHEN CAST(__x360_raw.new_stage1enddate AS TIMESTAMP) IS NULL
          OR CAST(__x360_raw.new_stage1enddate AS TIMESTAMP) >= __x360_ctx.as_of_exclusive
          THEN '11'
          WHEN CAST(__x360_raw.new_stage2enddate AS TIMESTAMP) IS NULL
          OR CAST(__x360_raw.new_stage2enddate AS TIMESTAMP) >= __x360_ctx.as_of_exclusive
          THEN '12'
          WHEN CAST(__x360_raw.new_stage3enddate AS TIMESTAMP) IS NULL
          OR CAST(__x360_raw.new_stage3enddate AS TIMESTAMP) >= __x360_ctx.as_of_exclusive
          THEN '13'
          WHEN CAST(__x360_raw.new_stage4enddate AS TIMESTAMP) IS NULL
          OR CAST(__x360_raw.new_stage4enddate AS TIMESTAMP) >= __x360_ctx.as_of_exclusive
          THEN '14'
          WHEN CAST(__x360_raw.new_stage5enddate AS TIMESTAMP) IS NULL
          OR CAST(__x360_raw.new_stage5enddate AS TIMESTAMP) >= __x360_ctx.as_of_exclusive
          THEN '15'
          ELSE 'completed'
        END AS __x360_asof_process_stage
      FROM ded_public.p_fm_edw_v_ods_crm_opportunity_esb AS __x360_raw
      CROSS JOIN context AS __x360_ctx
    ) AS o
    WHERE
      NULLIF(TRIM(CAST(o.opportunityid AS TEXT)), '') IS NOT NULL
  ) AS ranked
  CROSS JOIN context AS p
  WHERE
    ranked.created_at < p.as_of_exclusive
), opportunities AS MATERIALIZED (
  SELECT
    o.opportunity_id,
    o.account_id,
    o.project_name,
    o.owner_id,
    o.product_type,
    o.process_stage,
    o.demand_status,
    o.created_at,
    o.s1,
    o.s2,
    o.s3,
    o.s4,
    o.s5,
    a.account_name,
    a.level_code,
    o.new_cdastartdate,
    o.new_cdaenddate,
    o.new_approved_time_acneed,
    o.new_submit_time_acneed,
    o.new_approved_time_projectassess,
    o.new_submit_time_projectassess,
    o.new_sampletestpass_time,
    o.new_sampletime,
    o.new_technicalsigningdate,
    o.new_submit_time_techcon,
    o.new_warrantysigningdate,
    o.new_submit_time_qsl,
    o.new_isneedcda,
    o.new_approvalstatus_acneed,
    o.new_approvalstatus_projectassess,
    o.new_approvalstatus_techcon,
    o.new_approvalstatus_qsl,
    o.new_sampletestresult,
    a.sap_created_at,
    a.sap_submitted_at,
    a.sap_code,
    a.account_factory_approved_at,
    a.account_factory_submitted_at,
    a.account_sinosure_start,
    a.account_sinosure_end,
    a.account_credit_submitted_at,
    a.account_credit_approved_at,
    a.account_cda_start,
    a.account_cda_end,
    a.account_cda_submitted_at,
    a.account_cda_approved_at,
    a.account_factory_approval_status
  FROM opportunity_rows AS o
  LEFT JOIN accounts AS a
    USING (account_id)
  CROSS JOIN context AS p
  WHERE
    o.rn = 1 AND (
      o.created_at < p.as_of_exclusive
    )
), orders AS MATERIALIZED (
  SELECT DISTINCT
    CAST(salesorderid AS TEXT) AS order_id
  FROM ded_public.p_fm_edw_v_ods_crm_salesorder_esb
  WHERE
    NULLIF(TRIM(CAST(salesorderid AS TEXT)), '') IS NOT NULL
), order_line_links AS MATERIALIZED (
  SELECT DISTINCT
    CAST(l.new_opportunity_id AS TEXT) AS opportunity_id,
    CAST(l.salesorderid AS TEXT) AS order_id
  FROM ded_public.p_fm_edw_v_ods_crm_salesorderdetail_esb AS l
  WHERE
    NULLIF(TRIM(CAST(l.new_opportunity_id AS TEXT)), '') IS NOT NULL
    AND NULLIF(TRIM(CAST(l.salesorderid AS TEXT)), '') IS NOT NULL
), signed_orders AS MATERIALIZED (
  SELECT
    l.opportunity_id,
    COUNT(DISTINCT l.order_id) AS order_count
  FROM order_line_links AS l
  JOIN orders AS o
    USING (order_id)
  GROUP BY
    l.opportunity_id
), opportunity_flags AS MATERIALIZED (
  SELECT
    o.*,
    COALESCE(s.order_count, 0) AS order_count,
    CASE
      WHEN COALESCE(s.order_count, 0) = 0
      THEN FALSE
      WHEN o.s4 IS NULL
      THEN FALSE
      ELSE o.s4 < p.as_of_exclusive
    END AS signed,
    (
      COALESCE(s.order_count, 0) > 0 AND o.s4 IS NULL
    ) AS missing_p3_end
  FROM opportunities AS o
  LEFT JOIN signed_orders AS s
    USING (opportunity_id)
  CROSS JOIN context AS p
), forecast_rows AS MATERIALIZED (
  SELECT
    CAST(m.new_oppmonthid AS TEXT) AS forecast_id,
    CAST(m.new_opportunity_id AS TEXT) AS opportunity_id,
    CAST(m.new_accountdate AS TIMESTAMP) AS forecast_month,
    CAST(m.new_forecast_amt_rmb AS DECIMAL) AS amount_yuan,
    CAST(m.new_whprice AS DECIMAL) AS wh_price,
    ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
      PARTITION BY m.new_opportunity_id, DATE_TRUNC('MONTH', CAST(m.new_accountdate AS TIMESTAMP))
      ORDER BY m.createdon DESC NULLS LAST, m.modifiedon DESC NULLS LAST, m.new_oppmonthid DESC NULLS LAST
    ) AS rn
  FROM (
    SELECT
      __x360_raw.*
    FROM ded_public.p_fm_edw_v_ods_crm_new_oppmonth_esb AS __x360_raw
    CROSS JOIN context AS __x360_ctx
    WHERE
      CAST(__x360_raw.createdon AS TIMESTAMP) < __x360_ctx.as_of_exclusive
  ) AS m
  CROSS JOIN context AS p
  WHERE
    NULLIF(TRIM(CAST(m.new_oppmonthid AS TEXT)), '') IS NOT NULL
    AND NULLIF(TRIM(CAST(m.new_opportunity_id AS TEXT)), '') IS NOT NULL
    AND CAST(m.new_accountdate AS TIMESTAMP) >= p.start_date
    AND CAST(m.new_accountdate AS TIMESTAMP) < p.end_exclusive
), forecast_facts AS MATERIALIZED (
  SELECT
    f.forecast_id,
    f.forecast_month,
    o.*,
    f.amount_yuan / CAST(100000000 AS DECIMAL) AS amount_yi,
    f.amount_yuan / NULLIF(f.wh_price, 0) / CAST(1000000000 AS DECIMAL) AS energy_gwh
  FROM forecast_rows AS f
  JOIN opportunity_flags AS o
    USING (opportunity_id)
  WHERE
    f.rn = 1
), opportunity_forecast AS MATERIALIZED (
  SELECT
    opportunity_id,
    COUNT(*) AS forecast_rows,
    SUM(amount_yi) AS amount_yi,
    SUM(energy_gwh) AS energy_gwh,
    COUNT(*) FILTER(WHERE
      amount_yi IS NULL) AS missing_amount_rows,
    COUNT(*) FILTER(WHERE
      energy_gwh IS NULL) AS missing_energy_rows
  FROM forecast_facts
  GROUP BY
    opportunity_id
), stage_facts AS MATERIALIZED (
SELECT
    o.*,
    v.stage_code,
    v.started_at,
    v.finished_at,
    CASE
      WHEN v.started_at IS NOT NULL AND v.finished_at > v.started_at
      THEN EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM (
        v.finished_at - v.started_at
      )) / CAST(86400 AS DECIMAL)
    END AS elapsed_days,
    (
      v.finished_at >= p.start_date AND v.finished_at < p.effective_end_exclusive
    ) AS in_window,
    FALSE AS inflight,
    (
      v.started_at IS NULL OR v.finished_at IS NULL OR v.finished_at <= v.started_at
    ) AS invalid_dates
  FROM opportunity_flags AS o
  CROSS JOIN context AS p
  CROSS JOIN LATERAL (
    VALUES
      (CAST('P0' AS TEXT), o.created_at, o.s1),
      (CAST('P1' AS TEXT), o.s1, o.s2),
      (CAST('P2' AS TEXT), o.s2, o.s3),
      (CAST('P3' AS TEXT), o.s3, o.s4),
      (CAST('P4' AS TEXT), o.s4, o.s5)
  ) AS v(stage_code, started_at, finished_at)
  WHERE
    v.finished_at IS NOT NULL
    AND v.finished_at >= p.start_date
    AND v.finished_at < p.effective_end_exclusive
), stage_means AS MATERIALIZED (
SELECT stage_code, product_type,
    AVG(elapsed_days) FILTER (WHERE NOT invalid_dates) AS mean_days,
    CASE stage_code
      WHEN 'P0' THEN 32.6::numeric
      WHEN 'P1' THEN 21.8::numeric
      WHEN 'P2' THEN 7.2::numeric
      WHEN 'P3' THEN 57.2::numeric
      WHEN 'P4' THEN 15.3::numeric
    END AS baseline_days,
    COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE NOT invalid_dates) AS sample_count,
    COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE invalid_dates) AS invalid_count,
    COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE finished_at = started_at) AS zero_duration_count,
    0::bigint AS inflight_count
  FROM stage_facts WHERE in_window
  GROUP BY stage_code, product_type
), stage_overdue AS MATERIALIZED (
SELECT f.*,m.mean_days,m.baseline_days,
    (f.elapsed_days-m.baseline_days) AS excess_days,
    (f.elapsed_days-m.baseline_days)/NULLIF(m.baseline_days,0) AS excess_ratio,
    ofc.amount_yi,ofc.energy_gwh,
    (m.baseline_days > 0 AND f.elapsed_days > 1.5::numeric*m.baseline_days) AS overdue
  FROM stage_facts f JOIN stage_means m USING(stage_code,product_type)
  LEFT JOIN opportunity_forecast ofc USING(opportunity_id)
  WHERE f.in_window AND NOT f.invalid_dates
), metric_results AS MATERIALIZED (
SELECT
    15 AS sort_no,
    CAST('C07' AS TEXT) AS code,
    CAST('方案推动超静态基线 50%% 的未签单商机' AS TEXT) AS metric_name,
    CAST(NULL AS TEXT) AS product_team,
    CAST((
      SUM(amount_yi)
    ) AS DECIMAL) AS amount_yi,
    CAST((
      SUM(energy_gwh)
    ) AS DECIMAL) AS energy_gwh,
    CAST((
      COUNT(DISTINCT opportunity_id)
    ) AS BIGINT) AS item_count,
    CAST((
      NULL
    ) AS DECIMAL) AS ratio_value,
    CAST((
      NULL
    ) AS DECIMAL) AS days_value,
    CAST('查询已实现；缺失输入及部分合计见明细' AS TEXT) AS status,
    CAST('所选期间已结束P2且截至日未签；实际完整周期严格大于本阶段静态基线1.5倍；不要求当前仍P2，不含在途。' AS TEXT) AS note,
    CAST((
      JSONB_AGG(
        JSONB_BUILD_OBJECT(
          '商机ID',
          opportunity_id,
          '产品',
          product_type,
          '实际周期天数',
          elapsed_days,
          '静态基线天', baseline_days, '超出基线天数', excess_days, '超出基线比例_原始小数', excess_ratio, '超出基线百分比数值', excess_ratio*100,
          '预测金额亿元',
          amount_yi,
          '预测电量GWh',
          energy_gwh
        )
      )
    ) AS JSONB) AS detail
  FROM stage_overdue AS f
  WHERE
    stage_code = 'P2' AND in_window AND NOT signed AND overdue
)
SELECT
  r.code AS "指标序号",
  r.metric_name AS "指标名称",
  r.product_team AS "产品团队",
  p.start_date AS "期间开始",
  p.end_exclusive AS "期间结束不含",
  p.cutoff AS "周期观察截止",
  r.amount_yi AS "金额_亿元",
  r.energy_gwh AS "电量_GWh",
  r.item_count AS "数量",
  r.ratio_value AS "比率_原始小数",
  r.days_value AS "平均周期_天",
  CASE
    WHEN r.status = '查询已实现；缺失输入及部分合计见明细'
    THEN CASE
      WHEN r.amount_yi IS NOT NULL
      OR r.energy_gwh IS NOT NULL
      OR r.item_count IS NOT NULL
      OR r.ratio_value IS NOT NULL
      OR r.days_value IS NOT NULL
      THEN '已有查询结果；完整性与适用列见明细'
      ELSE '没有可计算结果；检查输入、时间及关联范围'
    END
    ELSE r.status
  END AS "计算说明状态",
  r.note AS "取值说明",
  r.detail AS "分组明细及缺口"
FROM metric_results AS r
CROSS JOIN context AS p
ORDER BY
  r.sort_no,
  r.product_team;

C03.name: 产品部年度销售目标
C03.definition: 产品部年度销售目标：先筛年度→按商机ID＋年度排列目标版本→仅保留rn=1→展开该版本12个月→按客户、产品或团队汇总。按目标归属团队汇总全年12个月金额与power；同一团队一行，仅列目标事实有记录的团队。
C03.formula:
同商机同年度按createdon DESC NULLS LAST、new_targetid DESC NULLS LAST取一条；空商机ID用new_targetid独立保留。客户、产品和团队仅作汇总维度，不作版本去重键；不同商机即使客户或产品相同也分别保留。与C04按同一团队比较，C05计算实际－目标。金额new_month1～12按元÷10^8转亿元；电量new_month1_power～12_power按kWh÷10^6转GWh。
目标createdon先限制观察日次日之前，再按原商机＋年度版本键取最新并展开全年12个月。
C03.caliber: 按产品团队分解年度目标；目标先按商机＋年取最新版本，金额使用月金额，电量使用月power。团队空值行过滤。
C03.attributes:
LE01-A0486 商机管理.负责人（ownerid，空 0%）
LE06-A0016 销售目标管理.负责人（ownerid，空 0%）
LE06-A0022 销售目标管理.负责团队（owningteam，空 100%）
LE06-A0041 销售目标管理.1月金额（new_month1，空 0%）
LE06-A0072 销售目标管理.1月电量（new_month1_power，空 0%）
C03.physicalFields: 目标.new_opportunity_id/new_year/createdon/new_targetid用于版本去重；owningteam/ownerid及团队成员关系用于团队归属；new_month1～12及new_month1_power～12_power用于计算。
C03.dashboardSql: 按产品团队分解年度目标；目标先按商机＋年取最新版本，金额使用月金额，电量使用月power。团队空值行过滤。
C03.notes: C0专项增加来源记录数、非空计数与团队归属路径诊断。C03仅目标有记录团队，C04仅实绩有记录团队，C05明确未查到哪一侧；不把未出现的团队误报为核心字段全空，不强行补0。
C03.sqlStatus: 按结果动态判定（见 SQL 中 status 的 CASE）
C03.v3Change: 保留基础计算；不供最终风险或根因判断
C03.role: 独立基础查询；不参与最终风险、根因或行动链路
C03.ctes: parameters → context → product_types → teams → team_members → owner_teams → target_rows → target_facts → target_teams → shipment_headers → product_codes → opportunity_rows → order_line_links → order_teams → shipment_rows → shipment_facts → actual_teams → team_gaps → c0_owner_team_sizes → c0_target_assignment → c0_team_assignment_audit
C03.sql:
WITH parameters AS MATERIALIZED (
  SELECT
    CAST(%s AS DATE) AS start_date,
    CAST(%s AS DATE) AS end_exclusive,
    CAST(%s AS TIMESTAMP) AS observed_at,
    CAST(ARRAY['1'] AS TEXT[]) AS strategic_levels,
    CAST(ARRAY['1', '2'] AS TEXT[]) AS focus_levels,
    CAST(1000000 AS DECIMAL) AS target_power_units_per_gwh
), context AS MATERIALIZED (
  SELECT
    p.*,
    CAST((
      DATE_TRUNC('DAY', observed_at) + INTERVAL '1 DAY'
    ) AS TIMESTAMP) AS as_of_exclusive,
    LEAST(
      CAST(end_exclusive AS TIMESTAMP),
      DATE_TRUNC('DAY', observed_at) + INTERVAL '1 DAY'
    ) AS effective_end_exclusive,
    LEAST(
      CAST(end_exclusive AS TIMESTAMP),
      DATE_TRUNC('DAY', observed_at) + INTERVAL '1 DAY'
    ) - INTERVAL '1 MICROSECOND' AS cutoff,
    MAKE_DATE(CAST(EXTRACT(YEAR FROM start_date) AS INT), 1, 1) AS year_start,
    MAKE_DATE(CAST(EXTRACT(YEAR FROM start_date) AS INT) + 1, 1, 1) AS next_year_start,
    GREATEST(
      CAST(0 AS DECIMAL),
      LEAST(
        CAST(1 AS DECIMAL),
        CAST((
          CAST(LEAST(
            CAST(end_exclusive AS TIMESTAMP),
            DATE_TRUNC('DAY', observed_at) + INTERVAL '1 DAY'
          ) AS DATE) - MAKE_DATE(CAST(EXTRACT(YEAR FROM start_date) AS INT), 1, 1)
        ) AS DECIMAL) / (
          MAKE_DATE(CAST(EXTRACT(YEAR FROM start_date) AS INT) + 1, 1, 1) - MAKE_DATE(CAST(EXTRACT(YEAR FROM start_date) AS INT), 1, 1)
        )
      )
    ) AS time_progress
  FROM parameters AS p
), product_types AS MATERIALIZED (
  SELECT
    CAST(new_product_typeid AS TEXT) AS product_type_id,
    CASE
      WHEN COUNT(DISTINCT CAST(new_accproducttype AS TEXT)) = 1
      THEN MIN(CAST(new_accproducttype AS TEXT))
    END AS type_code
  FROM ded_public.p_fm_edw_v_ods_crm_new_product_type_esb
  GROUP BY
    CAST(new_product_typeid AS TEXT)
), teams AS MATERIALIZED (
  SELECT
    CAST(teamid AS TEXT) AS team_id,
    MAX(CAST(name AS TEXT)) AS team_name
  FROM ded_public.p_fm_edw_v_ods_crm_team_esb
  GROUP BY
    CAST(teamid AS TEXT)
), team_members AS MATERIALIZED (
  SELECT DISTINCT
    CAST(tm.systemuserid AS TEXT) AS owner_id,
    CAST(t.name AS TEXT) AS team_name
  FROM ded_public.p_fm_edw_v_ods_crm_teammembership_esb AS tm
  JOIN (
    SELECT
      team_id,
      team_name AS name
    FROM teams
  ) AS t
    ON t.team_id = CAST(tm.teamid AS TEXT)
  WHERE
    NULLIF(TRIM(CAST(t.name AS TEXT)), '') IS NOT NULL
), owner_teams AS MATERIALIZED (
  SELECT
    owner_id,
    CASE WHEN COUNT(DISTINCT team_name) = 1 THEN MIN(team_name) END AS team_name
  FROM team_members
  GROUP BY
    owner_id
), target_rows AS MATERIALIZED (
  SELECT
    CAST(t.new_targetid AS TEXT) AS target_id,
    CAST(t.new_opportunity_id AS TEXT) AS opportunity_id,
    CAST(t.new_year AS INT) AS year_no,
    CAST(t.new_account_id AS TEXT) AS account_id,
    CAST(t.ownerid AS TEXT) AS owner_id,
    CAST(t.owningteam AS TEXT) AS owning_team_id,
    CAST(t.new_producttype_id AS TEXT) AS product_type_id,
    t.new_month1,
    t.new_month2,
    t.new_month3,
    t.new_month4,
    t.new_month5,
    t.new_month6,
    t.new_month7,
    t.new_month8,
    t.new_month9,
    t.new_month10,
    t.new_month11,
    t.new_month12,
    t.new_month1_power,
    t.new_month2_power,
    t.new_month3_power,
    t.new_month4_power,
    t.new_month5_power,
    t.new_month6_power,
    t.new_month7_power,
    t.new_month8_power,
    t.new_month9_power,
    t.new_month10_power,
    t.new_month11_power,
    t.new_month12_power,
    ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
      PARTITION BY COALESCE(NULLIF(TRIM(CAST(t.new_opportunity_id AS TEXT)), ''), CAST(t.new_targetid AS TEXT)), t.new_year
      ORDER BY t.createdon DESC NULLS LAST, t.new_targetid DESC NULLS LAST
    ) AS rn
  FROM (
    SELECT
      __x360_raw.*
    FROM ded_public.p_fm_edw_v_ods_crm_new_target_esb AS __x360_raw
    CROSS JOIN context AS __x360_ctx
    WHERE
      CAST(__x360_raw.createdon AS TIMESTAMP) < __x360_ctx.as_of_exclusive
  ) AS t
  CROSS JOIN context AS p
  WHERE
    CAST(t.new_year AS INT) = CAST(EXTRACT(YEAR FROM p.start_date) AS INT)
    AND t.new_targetid IS NOT NULL
), target_facts AS MATERIALIZED (
  SELECT
    t.target_id,
    t.account_id,
    CASE
      WHEN pt.type_code IN ('1', '电芯')
      THEN '电芯'
      WHEN pt.type_code IN ('2', 'PACK')
      THEN 'PACK'
      ELSE '其他'
    END AS product_type,
    COALESCE(NULLIF(TRIM(owned.team_name), ''), ot.team_name) AS team_name,
    CAST(v.amount_yuan AS DECIMAL) / CAST(100000000 AS DECIMAL) AS amount_yi,
    CAST(v.power_value AS DECIMAL) / p.target_power_units_per_gwh AS energy_gwh
  FROM target_rows AS t
  CROSS JOIN context AS p
  CROSS JOIN LATERAL (
    VALUES
      (1, t.new_month1, t.new_month1_power),
      (2, t.new_month2, t.new_month2_power),
      (3, t.new_month3, t.new_month3_power),
      (4, t.new_month4, t.new_month4_power),
      (5, t.new_month5, t.new_month5_power),
      (6, t.new_month6, t.new_month6_power),
      (7, t.new_month7, t.new_month7_power),
      (8, t.new_month8, t.new_month8_power),
      (9, t.new_month9, t.new_month9_power),
      (10, t.new_month10, t.new_month10_power),
      (11, t.new_month11, t.new_month11_power),
      (12, t.new_month12, t.new_month12_power)
  ) AS v(month_no, amount_yuan, power_value)
  LEFT JOIN product_types AS pt
    USING (product_type_id)
  LEFT JOIN owner_teams AS ot
    USING (owner_id)
  LEFT JOIN teams AS owned
    ON owned.team_id = t.owning_team_id
  WHERE
    t.rn = 1
    AND MAKE_DATE(t.year_no, v.month_no, 1) >= p.year_start
    AND MAKE_DATE(t.year_no, v.month_no, 1) < p.next_year_start
), target_teams AS MATERIALIZED (
  SELECT
    team_name,
    SUM(amount_yi) AS target_amount,
    SUM(energy_gwh) AS target_energy,
    COUNT(DISTINCT target_id) AS target_record_count,
    COUNT(*) AS target_month_rows,
    COUNT(amount_yi) AS target_amount_nonnull_rows,
    COUNT(energy_gwh) AS target_energy_nonnull_rows,
    COUNT(*) FILTER(WHERE
      amount_yi IS NULL) AS target_missing_amount_rows,
    COUNT(*) FILTER(WHERE
      energy_gwh IS NULL) AS target_missing_energy_rows
  FROM target_facts
  GROUP BY
    team_name
), shipment_headers AS MATERIALIZED (
  SELECT DISTINCT
    CAST(new_ord_shipmentid AS TEXT) AS shipment_id,
    CAST(new_shipping2_date AS TIMESTAMP) AS shipped_at,
    statecode
  FROM ded_public.p_fm_edw_v_ods_crm_new_ord_shipment_esb AS s
  CROSS JOIN context AS p
  WHERE
    CAST(s.new_shipping2_date AS TIMESTAMP) >= p.start_date
    AND CAST(s.new_shipping2_date AS TIMESTAMP) < p.effective_end_exclusive
), product_codes AS MATERIALIZED (
  SELECT
    CAST(productnumber AS TEXT) AS product_code,
    CASE
      WHEN COUNT(DISTINCT new_system_energy) = 1
      THEN CAST(MAX(new_system_energy) AS DECIMAL)
    END AS energy_kwh
  FROM ded_public.p_fm_edw_v_ods_crm_product_esb
  WHERE
    NULLIF(TRIM(CAST(productnumber AS TEXT)), '') IS NOT NULL
  GROUP BY
    CAST(productnumber AS TEXT)
), opportunity_rows AS MATERIALIZED (
  SELECT
    ranked.*
  FROM (
    SELECT
      CAST(o.opportunityid AS TEXT) AS opportunity_id,
      CAST(o.parentaccountid AS TEXT) AS account_id,
      CAST(o.name AS TEXT) AS project_name,
      CAST(o.ownerid AS TEXT) AS owner_id,
      CASE
        WHEN CAST(o.new_accproducttype AS TEXT) IN ('1', '电芯')
        THEN '电芯'
        WHEN CAST(o.new_accproducttype AS TEXT) IN ('2', 'PACK')
        THEN 'PACK'
        ELSE '其他'
      END AS product_type,
      o.__x360_asof_process_stage AS process_stage,
      CAST(o.statecode AS TEXT) AS system_state,
      CAST(o.new_demandinput AS TEXT) AS demand_status,
      CAST(o.createdon AS TIMESTAMP) AS created_at,
      CAST(o.new_stage1enddate AS TIMESTAMP) AS s1,
      CAST(o.new_stage2enddate AS TIMESTAMP) AS s2,
      CAST(o.new_stage3enddate AS TIMESTAMP) AS s3,
      CAST(o.new_stage4enddate AS TIMESTAMP) AS s4,
      CAST(o.new_stage5enddate AS TIMESTAMP) AS s5,
      CAST(o.new_cdastartdate AS TIMESTAMP) AS new_cdastartdate,
      CAST(o.new_cdaenddate AS TIMESTAMP) AS new_cdaenddate,
      CAST(o.new_approved_time_acneed AS TIMESTAMP) AS new_approved_time_acneed,
      CAST(o.new_submit_time_acneed AS TIMESTAMP) AS new_submit_time_acneed,
      CAST(o.new_approved_time_projectassess AS TIMESTAMP) AS new_approved_time_projectassess,
      CAST(o.new_submit_time_projectassess AS TIMESTAMP) AS new_submit_time_projectassess,
      CAST(o.new_sampletestpass_time AS TIMESTAMP) AS new_sampletestpass_time,
      CAST(o.new_sampletime AS TIMESTAMP) AS new_sampletime,
      CAST(o.new_technicalsigningdate AS TIMESTAMP) AS new_technicalsigningdate,
      CAST(o.new_submit_time_techcon AS TIMESTAMP) AS new_submit_time_techcon,
      CAST(o.new_warrantysigningdate AS TIMESTAMP) AS new_warrantysigningdate,
      CAST(o.new_submit_time_qsl AS TIMESTAMP) AS new_submit_time_qsl,
      CAST(o.new_isneedcda AS TEXT) AS new_isneedcda,
      CAST(o.new_approvalstatus_acneed AS TEXT) AS new_approvalstatus_acneed,
      CAST(o.new_approvalstatus_projectassess AS TEXT) AS new_approvalstatus_projectassess,
      CAST(o.new_approvalstatus_techcon AS TEXT) AS new_approvalstatus_techcon,
      CAST(o.new_approvalstatus_qsl AS TEXT) AS new_approvalstatus_qsl,
      CAST(o.new_sampletestresult AS TEXT) AS new_sampletestresult,
      ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
        PARTITION BY o.opportunityid
        ORDER BY o.modifiedon DESC NULLS LAST, o.createdon DESC NULLS LAST
      ) AS rn
    FROM (
      SELECT
        __x360_raw.*,
        CASE
          WHEN CAST(__x360_raw.new_stage1enddate AS TIMESTAMP) IS NULL
          OR CAST(__x360_raw.new_stage1enddate AS TIMESTAMP) >= __x360_ctx.as_of_exclusive
          THEN '11'
          WHEN CAST(__x360_raw.new_stage2enddate AS TIMESTAMP) IS NULL
          OR CAST(__x360_raw.new_stage2enddate AS TIMESTAMP) >= __x360_ctx.as_of_exclusive
          THEN '12'
          WHEN CAST(__x360_raw.new_stage3enddate AS TIMESTAMP) IS NULL
          OR CAST(__x360_raw.new_stage3enddate AS TIMESTAMP) >= __x360_ctx.as_of_exclusive
          THEN '13'
          WHEN CAST(__x360_raw.new_stage4enddate AS TIMESTAMP) IS NULL
          OR CAST(__x360_raw.new_stage4enddate AS TIMESTAMP) >= __x360_ctx.as_of_exclusive
          THEN '14'
          WHEN CAST(__x360_raw.new_stage5enddate AS TIMESTAMP) IS NULL
          OR CAST(__x360_raw.new_stage5enddate AS TIMESTAMP) >= __x360_ctx.as_of_exclusive
          THEN '15'
          ELSE 'completed'
        END AS __x360_asof_process_stage
      FROM ded_public.p_fm_edw_v_ods_crm_opportunity_esb AS __x360_raw
      CROSS JOIN context AS __x360_ctx
    ) AS o
    WHERE
      NULLIF(TRIM(CAST(o.opportunityid AS TEXT)), '') IS NOT NULL
  ) AS ranked
  CROSS JOIN context AS p
  WHERE
    ranked.created_at < p.as_of_exclusive
), order_line_links AS MATERIALIZED (
  SELECT DISTINCT
    CAST(l.new_opportunity_id AS TEXT) AS opportunity_id,
    CAST(l.salesorderid AS TEXT) AS order_id
  FROM ded_public.p_fm_edw_v_ods_crm_salesorderdetail_esb AS l
  WHERE
    NULLIF(TRIM(CAST(l.new_opportunity_id AS TEXT)), '') IS NOT NULL
    AND NULLIF(TRIM(CAST(l.salesorderid AS TEXT)), '') IS NOT NULL
), order_teams AS MATERIALIZED (
  SELECT
    l.order_id,
    CASE
      WHEN COUNT(DISTINCT t.team_name) = 1
      AND COUNT(DISTINCT l.opportunity_id) = COUNT(DISTINCT l.opportunity_id) FILTER(WHERE
        t.team_name IS NOT NULL)
      THEN MIN(t.team_name)
    END AS team_name
  FROM order_line_links AS l
  LEFT JOIN opportunity_rows AS o
    ON o.opportunity_id = l.opportunity_id AND o.rn = 1
  LEFT JOIN owner_teams AS t
    ON t.owner_id = o.owner_id
  GROUP BY
    l.order_id
), shipment_rows AS MATERIALIZED (
  SELECT
    CAST(i.new_ord_shipmentitemid AS TEXT) AS line_id,
    CAST(i.new_ord_shipment_id AS TEXT) AS shipment_id,
    CAST(i.new_ord_salesorder_id AS TEXT) AS order_id,
    CAST(i.new_productcode AS TEXT) AS product_code,
    CAST(i.new_qty AS DECIMAL) AS qty,
    CAST(i.new_amount_base AS DECIMAL) / CAST(100000000 AS DECIMAL) AS amount_yi,
    ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
      PARTITION BY i.new_ord_shipmentitemid
      ORDER BY i.modifiedon DESC NULLS LAST, i.createdon DESC NULLS LAST
    ) AS rn
  FROM ded_public.p_fm_edw_v_ods_crm_new_ord_shipmentitem_esb AS i
  WHERE
    i.new_ord_shipmentitemid IS NOT NULL AND i.new_qty > 0
), shipment_facts AS MATERIALIZED (
  SELECT
    i.line_id,
    t.team_name,
    i.amount_yi,
    i.qty * pc.energy_kwh / CAST(1000000 AS DECIMAL) AS energy_gwh
  FROM shipment_rows AS i
  JOIN shipment_headers AS s
    USING (shipment_id)
  LEFT JOIN product_codes AS pc
    USING (product_code)
  LEFT JOIN order_teams AS t
    USING (order_id)
  WHERE
    i.rn = 1 AND s.statecode = 0
), actual_teams AS MATERIALIZED (
  SELECT
    team_name,
    SUM(amount_yi) AS actual_amount,
    SUM(energy_gwh) AS actual_energy,
    COUNT(DISTINCT line_id) AS actual_record_count,
    COUNT(amount_yi) AS actual_amount_nonnull_rows,
    COUNT(energy_gwh) AS actual_energy_nonnull_rows,
    COUNT(*) FILTER(WHERE
      amount_yi IS NULL) AS missing_amount_rows,
    COUNT(*) FILTER(WHERE
      energy_gwh IS NULL) AS missing_energy_rows
  FROM shipment_facts
  GROUP BY
    team_name
), team_gaps AS MATERIALIZED (
  SELECT
    COALESCE(v.team_name, '未能唯一分配团队') AS team_name,
    SUM(target_amount) AS target_amount,
    SUM(actual_amount) AS actual_amount,
    SUM(actual_amount) - SUM(target_amount) AS gap_amount,
    SUM(target_energy) AS target_energy,
    SUM(actual_energy) AS actual_energy,
    SUM(actual_energy) - SUM(target_energy) AS gap_energy,
    CAST(SUM(target_record_count) AS BIGINT) AS target_record_count,
    CAST(SUM(actual_record_count) AS BIGINT) AS actual_record_count,
    CAST(SUM(target_amount_nonnull_rows) AS BIGINT) AS target_amount_nonnull_rows,
    CAST(SUM(target_energy_nonnull_rows) AS BIGINT) AS target_energy_nonnull_rows,
    CAST(SUM(actual_amount_nonnull_rows) AS BIGINT) AS actual_amount_nonnull_rows,
    CAST(SUM(actual_energy_nonnull_rows) AS BIGINT) AS actual_energy_nonnull_rows,
    CAST(SUM(target_missing_amount_rows) AS BIGINT) AS target_missing_amount_rows,
    CAST(SUM(target_missing_energy_rows) AS BIGINT) AS target_missing_energy_rows,
    CAST(SUM(missing_amount_rows) AS BIGINT) AS missing_amount_rows,
    CAST(SUM(missing_energy_rows) AS BIGINT) AS missing_energy_rows,
    BOOL_OR(v.team_name IS NULL) AS unassigned_team
  FROM (
    SELECT
      team_name,
      target_amount,
      target_energy,
      CAST(NULL AS DECIMAL) AS actual_amount,
      CAST(NULL AS DECIMAL) AS actual_energy,
      target_record_count,
      CAST(0 AS BIGINT) AS actual_record_count,
      target_amount_nonnull_rows,
      target_energy_nonnull_rows,
      CAST(0 AS BIGINT) AS actual_amount_nonnull_rows,
      CAST(0 AS BIGINT) AS actual_energy_nonnull_rows,
      target_missing_amount_rows,
      target_missing_energy_rows,
      CAST(0 AS BIGINT) AS missing_amount_rows,
      CAST(0 AS BIGINT) AS missing_energy_rows
    FROM target_teams
    UNION ALL
    SELECT
      team_name,
      CAST(NULL AS DECIMAL),
      CAST(NULL AS DECIMAL),
      actual_amount,
      actual_energy,
      CAST(0 AS BIGINT),
      actual_record_count,
      CAST(0 AS BIGINT),
      CAST(0 AS BIGINT),
      actual_amount_nonnull_rows,
      actual_energy_nonnull_rows,
      CAST(0 AS BIGINT),
      CAST(0 AS BIGINT),
      missing_amount_rows,
      missing_energy_rows
    FROM actual_teams
  ) AS v
  GROUP BY
    v.team_name
), c0_owner_team_sizes AS MATERIALIZED (
  SELECT
    owner_id,
    COUNT(DISTINCT team_name) AS candidate_team_count
  FROM team_members
  GROUP BY
    owner_id
), c0_target_assignment AS MATERIALIZED (
  SELECT
    t.target_id,
    t.opportunity_id,
    COALESCE(NULLIF(TRIM(owned.team_name), ''), ot.team_name) AS current_target_team,
    linked.team_name AS team_via_linked_opportunity,
    sizes.candidate_team_count AS target_owner_team_candidates,
    linked_sizes.candidate_team_count AS opportunity_owner_team_candidates,
    (
      COALESCE(NULLIF(TRIM(owned.team_name), ''), ot.team_name) IS DISTINCT FROM linked.team_name
    )
    AND linked.team_name IS NOT NULL AS team_paths_differ
  FROM target_rows AS t
  LEFT JOIN teams AS owned
    ON owned.team_id = t.owning_team_id
  LEFT JOIN owner_teams AS ot
    ON ot.owner_id = t.owner_id
  LEFT JOIN c0_owner_team_sizes AS sizes
    ON sizes.owner_id = t.owner_id
  LEFT JOIN opportunity_rows AS o
    ON o.opportunity_id = t.opportunity_id AND o.rn = 1
  LEFT JOIN owner_teams AS linked
    ON linked.owner_id = o.owner_id
  LEFT JOIN c0_owner_team_sizes AS linked_sizes
    ON linked_sizes.owner_id = o.owner_id
  WHERE
    t.rn = 1
), c0_team_assignment_audit AS MATERIALIZED (
  SELECT
    (
      SELECT
        COUNT(*)
      FROM c0_target_assignment
      WHERE
        team_paths_differ
    ) AS target_opportunity_team_mismatch_records,
    (
      SELECT
        COUNT(*)
      FROM target_facts
      WHERE
        team_name IS NULL
    ) AS unassigned_target_month_rows,
    (
      SELECT
        COUNT(*)
      FROM shipment_facts
      WHERE
        team_name IS NULL
    ) AS unassigned_shipment_rows,
    (
      SELECT
        COUNT(*)
      FROM c0_owner_team_sizes
      WHERE
        candidate_team_count > 1
    ) AS owners_with_multiple_teams,
    (
      SELECT
        JSONB_AGG(TO_JSONB(x))
      FROM (
        SELECT
          *
        FROM c0_target_assignment
        WHERE
          team_paths_differ
        ORDER BY
          target_id
        LIMIT 50
      ) AS x
    ) AS target_assignment_difference_examples_limit50
), metric_results AS MATERIALIZED (
  SELECT
    16 AS sort_no,
    CAST('C03' AS TEXT) AS code,
    CAST('产品部年度销售目标' AS TEXT) AS metric_name,
    CAST(t.team_name AS TEXT) AS product_team,
    CAST(t.target_amount AS DECIMAL) AS amount_yi,
    CAST(t.target_energy AS DECIMAL) AS energy_gwh,
    CAST(NULL AS BIGINT) AS item_count,
    CAST(NULL AS DECIMAL) AS ratio_value,
    CAST(NULL AS DECIMAL) AS days_value,
    CAST((
      CASE
        WHEN target_amount_nonnull_rows = 0 AND target_energy_nonnull_rows = 0
        THEN '有目标记录，但核心计算字段全空'
        WHEN target_missing_amount_rows > 0 OR target_missing_energy_rows > 0
        THEN '目标字段部分缺失；当前为已知值合计'
        ELSE '已有目标记录并可计算'
      END
    ) AS TEXT) AS status,
    CAST('按团队分别保留来源记录计数；记录不存在与核心字段全空分别说明。目标owningteam/owner与实绩商机owner的归属对照在明细；不强行补0，不凭名称归并产品部。' AS TEXT) AS note,
    TO_JSONB(t) || JSONB_BUILD_OBJECT('团队归属核对', (
      SELECT
        TO_JSONB(q)
      FROM c0_team_assignment_audit AS q
    )) AS detail
  FROM team_gaps AS t
  WHERE
    target_record_count > 0
)
SELECT
  r.code AS "指标序号",
  r.metric_name AS "指标名称",
  r.product_team AS "产品团队",
  p.start_date AS "期间开始",
  p.end_exclusive AS "期间结束不含",
  p.cutoff AS "周期观察截止",
  r.amount_yi AS "金额_亿元",
  r.energy_gwh AS "电量_GWh",
  r.item_count AS "数量",
  r.ratio_value AS "比率_原始小数",
  r.days_value AS "平均周期_天",
  CASE
    WHEN r.status = '查询已实现；缺失输入及部分合计见明细'
    THEN CASE
      WHEN r.amount_yi IS NOT NULL
      OR r.energy_gwh IS NOT NULL
      OR r.item_count IS NOT NULL
      OR r.ratio_value IS NOT NULL
      OR r.days_value IS NOT NULL
      THEN '已有查询结果；完整性与适用列见明细'
      ELSE '没有可计算结果；检查输入、时间及关联范围'
    END
    ELSE r.status
  END AS "计算说明状态",
  r.note AS "取值说明",
  r.detail AS "分组明细及缺口"
FROM metric_results AS r
CROSS JOIN context AS p
ORDER BY
  r.sort_no,
  r.product_team;

C04.name: 产品部累计实际销售额／电量
C04.definition: 以产品团队为维度，汇总所选年度/期间截至观察日的实际销售额和实际销售电量。团队与C03保持同一名称范围，同一团队一行。 仅列出实际有实绩事实记录的团队。
C04.formula: 保留产品部累计实际销售的基础统计，与C03、C05的同年度、团队和期间口径保持。实绩沿所选发货期间及观察日次日上限筛选，金额、电量、团队归属与NULL保护沿原SQL；不作为最终风险或根因输入。
C04.caliber: 实际金额＝发货明细.new_amount_base÷10^8。当前实际电量单项按明细.new_productcode关联产品.productnumber，SUM(交货数量×new_system_energy)÷10^6；团队由订单明细关联商机后解析。
C04.attributes:
LE06-A0053 销售目标管理.项目号（new_opportunity_id，空 0%）
LE08-A0025 订单产品.项目（new_opportunity_id，空 53.23%）
LE16-A0017 发货单.实际发货日期（new_shipping2_date，空 0%）
LE17-A0008 发货单明细.交货数量（new_qty，空 0%）
LE17-A0012 发货单明细.物料编码（new_productcode，空 0%）
LE17-A0022 发货单明细.总金额(基础货币)（new_amount_base，空 0%）
LE18-A0031 产品物料.系统能量kWh（new_system_energy，空 38.81%）
LE18-A0095 产品物料.物料编码（productnumber，空 0%）
C04.dashboardSql: 实际金额＝发货明细.new_amount_base÷10^8。当前实际电量单项按明细.new_productcode关联产品.productnumber，SUM(交货数量×new_system_energy)÷10^6；团队由订单明细关联商机后解析。
C04.notes: C0专项增加来源记录数、非空计数与团队归属路径诊断。C03仅目标有记录团队，C04仅实绩有记录团队，C05明确未查到哪一侧；不把未出现的团队误报为核心字段全空，不强行补0。 团队维度查找不再额外按商机创建年份截断，实际销售事实仍按发货期间筛选；同一订单有归属不明商机时不强行分给已知团队。 引用ID未匹配到商机的明细也视为团队归属不明。
C04.sqlStatus: 按结果动态判定（见 SQL 中 status 的 CASE）
C04.v3Change: 保留基础计算；不供最终风险或根因判断
C04.role: 独立基础查询；不参与最终风险、根因或行动链路
C04.ctes: parameters → context → product_types → teams → team_members → owner_teams → target_rows → target_facts → target_teams → shipment_headers → product_codes → opportunity_rows → order_line_links → order_teams → shipment_rows → shipment_facts → actual_teams → team_gaps → c0_owner_team_sizes → c0_target_assignment → c0_team_assignment_audit
C04.sql:
WITH parameters AS MATERIALIZED (
  SELECT
    CAST(%s AS DATE) AS start_date,
    CAST(%s AS DATE) AS end_exclusive,
    CAST(%s AS TIMESTAMP) AS observed_at,
    CAST(ARRAY['1'] AS TEXT[]) AS strategic_levels,
    CAST(ARRAY['1', '2'] AS TEXT[]) AS focus_levels,
    CAST(1000000 AS DECIMAL) AS target_power_units_per_gwh
), context AS MATERIALIZED (
  SELECT
    p.*,
    CAST((
      DATE_TRUNC('DAY', observed_at) + INTERVAL '1 DAY'
    ) AS TIMESTAMP) AS as_of_exclusive,
    LEAST(
      CAST(end_exclusive AS TIMESTAMP),
      DATE_TRUNC('DAY', observed_at) + INTERVAL '1 DAY'
    ) AS effective_end_exclusive,
    LEAST(
      CAST(end_exclusive AS TIMESTAMP),
      DATE_TRUNC('DAY', observed_at) + INTERVAL '1 DAY'
    ) - INTERVAL '1 MICROSECOND' AS cutoff,
    MAKE_DATE(CAST(EXTRACT(YEAR FROM start_date) AS INT), 1, 1) AS year_start,
    MAKE_DATE(CAST(EXTRACT(YEAR FROM start_date) AS INT) + 1, 1, 1) AS next_year_start,
    GREATEST(
      CAST(0 AS DECIMAL),
      LEAST(
        CAST(1 AS DECIMAL),
        CAST((
          CAST(LEAST(
            CAST(end_exclusive AS TIMESTAMP),
            DATE_TRUNC('DAY', observed_at) + INTERVAL '1 DAY'
