      CAST(o.new_approved_time_acneed AS TIMESTAMP) AS new_approved_time_acneed,
      CAST(o.new_submit_time_acneed AS TIMESTAMP) AS new_submit_time_acneed,
      CAST(o.new_approved_time_projectassess AS TIMESTAMP) AS new_approved_time_projectassess,
      CAST(o.new_submit_time_projectassess AS TIMESTAMP) AS new_submit_time_projectassess,
      CAST(o.new_sampletestpass_time AS TIMESTAMP) AS new_sampletestpass_time,
      CAST(o.new_sampletime AS TIMESTAMP) AS new_sampletime,
      CAST(o.new_technicalsigningdate AS TIMESTAMP) AS new_technicalsigningdate,
      CAST(o.new_submit_time_techcon AS TIMESTAMP) AS new_submit_time_techcon,
      CAST(o.new_warrantysigningdate AS TIMESTAMP) AS new_warrantysigningdate,
      CAST(o.new_submit_time_qsl AS TIMESTAMP) AS new_submit_time_qsl,
      CAST(o.new_isneedcda AS TEXT) AS new_isneedcda,
      CAST(o.new_approvalstatus_acneed AS TEXT) AS new_approvalstatus_acneed,
      CAST(o.new_approvalstatus_projectassess AS TEXT) AS new_approvalstatus_projectassess,
      CAST(o.new_approvalstatus_techcon AS TEXT) AS new_approvalstatus_techcon,
      CAST(o.new_approvalstatus_qsl AS TEXT) AS new_approvalstatus_qsl,
      CAST(o.new_sampletestresult AS TEXT) AS new_sampletestresult,
      ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
        PARTITION BY o.opportunityid
        ORDER BY o.modifiedon DESC NULLS LAST, o.createdon DESC NULLS LAST
      ) AS rn
    FROM (
      SELECT
        __x360_raw.*,
        CASE
          WHEN CAST(__x360_raw.new_stage1enddate AS TIMESTAMP) IS NULL
          OR CAST(__x360_raw.new_stage1enddate AS TIMESTAMP) >= __x360_ctx.as_of_exclusive
          THEN '11'
          WHEN CAST(__x360_raw.new_stage2enddate AS TIMESTAMP) IS NULL
          OR CAST(__x360_raw.new_stage2enddate AS TIMESTAMP) >= __x360_ctx.as_of_exclusive
          THEN '12'
          WHEN CAST(__x360_raw.new_stage3enddate AS TIMESTAMP) IS NULL
          OR CAST(__x360_raw.new_stage3enddate AS TIMESTAMP) >= __x360_ctx.as_of_exclusive
          THEN '13'
          WHEN CAST(__x360_raw.new_stage4enddate AS TIMESTAMP) IS NULL
          OR CAST(__x360_raw.new_stage4enddate AS TIMESTAMP) >= __x360_ctx.as_of_exclusive
          THEN '14'
          WHEN CAST(__x360_raw.new_stage5enddate AS TIMESTAMP) IS NULL
          OR CAST(__x360_raw.new_stage5enddate AS TIMESTAMP) >= __x360_ctx.as_of_exclusive
          THEN '15'
          ELSE 'completed'
        END AS __x360_asof_process_stage
      FROM ded_public.p_fm_edw_v_ods_crm_opportunity_esb AS __x360_raw
      CROSS JOIN context AS __x360_ctx
    ) AS o
    WHERE
      NULLIF(TRIM(CAST(o.opportunityid AS TEXT)), '') IS NOT NULL
  ) AS ranked
  CROSS JOIN context AS p
  WHERE
    ranked.created_at < p.as_of_exclusive
), opportunities AS MATERIALIZED (
  SELECT
    o.opportunity_id,
    o.account_id,
    o.project_name,
    o.owner_id,
    o.product_type,
    o.process_stage,
    o.demand_status,
    o.created_at,
    o.s1,
    o.s2,
    o.s3,
    o.s4,
    o.s5,
    a.account_name,
    a.level_code,
    o.new_cdastartdate,
    o.new_cdaenddate,
    o.new_approved_time_acneed,
    o.new_submit_time_acneed,
    o.new_approved_time_projectassess,
    o.new_submit_time_projectassess,
    o.new_sampletestpass_time,
    o.new_sampletime,
    o.new_technicalsigningdate,
    o.new_submit_time_techcon,
    o.new_warrantysigningdate,
    o.new_submit_time_qsl,
    o.new_isneedcda,
    o.new_approvalstatus_acneed,
    o.new_approvalstatus_projectassess,
    o.new_approvalstatus_techcon,
    o.new_approvalstatus_qsl,
    o.new_sampletestresult,
    a.sap_created_at,
    a.sap_submitted_at,
    a.sap_code,
    a.account_factory_approved_at,
    a.account_factory_submitted_at,
    a.account_sinosure_start,
    a.account_sinosure_end,
    a.account_credit_submitted_at,
    a.account_credit_approved_at,
    a.account_cda_start,
    a.account_cda_end,
    a.account_cda_submitted_at,
    a.account_cda_approved_at,
    a.account_factory_approval_status
  FROM opportunity_rows AS o
  LEFT JOIN accounts AS a
    USING (account_id)
  CROSS JOIN context AS p
  WHERE
    o.rn = 1 AND (
      o.created_at < p.as_of_exclusive
    )
), orders AS MATERIALIZED (
  SELECT DISTINCT
    CAST(salesorderid AS TEXT) AS order_id
  FROM ded_public.p_fm_edw_v_ods_crm_salesorder_esb
  WHERE
    NULLIF(TRIM(CAST(salesorderid AS TEXT)), '') IS NOT NULL
), order_line_links AS MATERIALIZED (
  SELECT DISTINCT
    CAST(l.new_opportunity_id AS TEXT) AS opportunity_id,
    CAST(l.salesorderid AS TEXT) AS order_id
  FROM ded_public.p_fm_edw_v_ods_crm_salesorderdetail_esb AS l
  WHERE
    NULLIF(TRIM(CAST(l.new_opportunity_id AS TEXT)), '') IS NOT NULL
    AND NULLIF(TRIM(CAST(l.salesorderid AS TEXT)), '') IS NOT NULL
), signed_orders AS MATERIALIZED (
  SELECT
    l.opportunity_id,
    COUNT(DISTINCT l.order_id) AS order_count
  FROM order_line_links AS l
  JOIN orders AS o
    USING (order_id)
  GROUP BY
    l.opportunity_id
), opportunity_flags AS MATERIALIZED (
  SELECT
    o.*,
    COALESCE(s.order_count, 0) AS order_count,
    CASE
      WHEN COALESCE(s.order_count, 0) = 0
      THEN FALSE
      WHEN o.s4 IS NULL
      THEN FALSE
      ELSE o.s4 < p.as_of_exclusive
    END AS signed,
    (
      COALESCE(s.order_count, 0) > 0 AND o.s4 IS NULL
    ) AS missing_p3_end
  FROM opportunities AS o
  LEFT JOIN signed_orders AS s
    USING (opportunity_id)
  CROSS JOIN context AS p
), node_quote_headers AS MATERIALIZED (
  SELECT
    CAST(q.new_quoteapplyid AS TEXT) AS quote_id,
    CAST(q.createdon AS TIMESTAMP) AS created_at,
    CAST(q.new_oasubmitdate AS TIMESTAMP) AS submitted_at,
    CAST(q.new_approved_time AS TIMESTAMP) AS approved_at,
    CAST(q.new_approvalstatus AS TEXT) AS approval_status
  FROM ded_public.p_fm_edw_v_ods_crm_new_quoteapply_esb AS q
  WHERE
    q.new_quoteapplyid IS NOT NULL
), node_quote_links AS MATERIALIZED (
  SELECT DISTINCT
    CAST(d.new_opportunity_id AS TEXT) AS opportunity_id,
    CAST(d.new_quoteapply_id AS TEXT) AS quote_id
  FROM ded_public.p_fm_edw_v_ods_crm_new_quoteapplydetail_esb AS d
  WHERE
    NULLIF(TRIM(CAST(d.new_opportunity_id AS TEXT)), '') IS NOT NULL
    AND NULLIF(TRIM(CAST(d.new_quoteapply_id AS TEXT)), '') IS NOT NULL
), node_quote_latest AS MATERIALIZED (
  SELECT
    opportunity_id,
    quote_id,
    submitted_at,
    approved_at,
    approval_status
  FROM (
    SELECT
      o.opportunity_id,
      q.quote_id,
      q.submitted_at,
      q.approved_at,
      q.approval_status,
      ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
        PARTITION BY o.opportunity_id
        ORDER BY q.created_at DESC NULLS LAST, q.quote_id DESC
      ) AS rn
    FROM opportunity_flags AS o
    JOIN node_quote_links AS l
      USING (opportunity_id)
    JOIN node_quote_headers AS q
      USING (quote_id)
    CROSS JOIN context AS p
    WHERE
      q.created_at <= p.cutoff
  ) AS ranked
  WHERE
    rn = 1
), node_cycle_source AS MATERIALIZED (
  SELECT
    o.opportunity_id,
    o.product_type,
    n.metric_code,
    n.phase_code,
    n.started_at,
    n.finished_at,
    n.entered_at,
    n.active_flag,
    n.event_id,
    n.finished_at >= p.start_date AND n.finished_at < p.effective_end_exclusive AS in_window,
    p.cutoff
  FROM opportunity_flags AS o
  LEFT JOIN node_quote_latest AS q
    USING (opportunity_id)
  CROSS JOIN context AS p
  CROSS JOIN LATERAL (
    VALUES
      (
        CAST('P0-03' AS TEXT),
        CAST('P0' AS TEXT),
        o.new_cdastartdate,
        o.new_cdaenddate,
        o.new_cdastartdate,
        COALESCE((
          o.new_isneedcda = '2'
        ), FALSE),
        CAST((
          o.opportunity_id
        ) AS TEXT)
      ),
      (
        CAST('P0-04' AS TEXT),
        CAST('P0' AS TEXT),
        o.new_submit_time_acneed,
        o.new_approved_time_acneed,
        o.new_submit_time_acneed,
        COALESCE((
          o.new_approvalstatus_acneed = '2'
        ), FALSE),
        CAST((
          o.opportunity_id
        ) AS TEXT)
      ),
      (
        CAST('P0-06' AS TEXT),
        CAST('P0' AS TEXT),
        o.new_submit_time_acneed,
        o.new_approved_time_acneed,
        o.new_submit_time_acneed,
        COALESCE((
          o.new_approvalstatus_acneed = '2'
        ), FALSE),
        CAST((
          o.opportunity_id
        ) AS TEXT)
      ),
      (
        CAST('P1-03' AS TEXT),
        CAST('P1' AS TEXT),
        o.account_factory_submitted_at,
        o.account_factory_approved_at,
        o.account_factory_submitted_at,
        COALESCE((
          o.account_factory_approval_status = '2'
        ), FALSE),
        CAST((
          o.account_id
        ) AS TEXT)
      ),
      (
        CAST('P1-04' AS TEXT),
        CAST('P1' AS TEXT),
        o.new_submit_time_projectassess,
        o.new_approved_time_projectassess,
        o.new_submit_time_projectassess,
        COALESCE((
          o.new_approvalstatus_projectassess = '2'
        ), FALSE),
        CAST((
          o.opportunity_id
        ) AS TEXT)
      ),
      (
        CAST('P1-05' AS TEXT),
        CAST('P1' AS TEXT),
        o.new_sampletime,
        o.new_sampletestpass_time,
        o.new_sampletime,
        COALESCE((
          o.new_sampletestresult IS NULL
        ), FALSE),
        CAST((
          o.opportunity_id
        ) AS TEXT)
      ),
      (
        CAST('P1-07' AS TEXT),
        CAST('P1' AS TEXT),
        q.submitted_at,
        CASE WHEN q.approval_status = '3' THEN q.approved_at END,
        q.submitted_at,
        COALESCE((
          q.approval_status = '2'
        ), FALSE),
        CAST((
          q.quote_id
        ) AS TEXT)
      ),
      (
        CAST('P2-03' AS TEXT),
        CAST('P2' AS TEXT),
        o.new_submit_time_techcon,
        o.new_technicalsigningdate,
        o.new_submit_time_techcon,
        COALESCE((
          o.new_approvalstatus_techcon = '2'
        ), FALSE),
        CAST((
          o.opportunity_id
        ) AS TEXT)
      ),
      (
        CAST('P2-04' AS TEXT),
        CAST('P2' AS TEXT),
        o.new_submit_time_qsl,
        o.new_warrantysigningdate,
        o.new_submit_time_qsl,
        COALESCE((
          o.new_approvalstatus_qsl = '2'
        ), FALSE),
        CAST((
          o.opportunity_id
        ) AS TEXT)
      )
  ) AS n(metric_code, phase_code, started_at, finished_at, entered_at, active_flag, event_id)
), node_cycle_facts AS MATERIALIZED (
  SELECT
    f.*,
    CASE
      WHEN in_window
      AND event_id IS NOT NULL
      AND started_at IS NOT NULL
      AND finished_at >= started_at
      THEN EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM (
        finished_at - started_at
      )) / CAST(86400 AS DECIMAL)
    END AS duration_days,
    (
      in_window
      AND event_id IS NOT NULL
      AND started_at IS NOT NULL
      AND finished_at >= started_at
    ) AS completed_valid,
    FALSE AS inflight_valid
  FROM node_cycle_source AS f
), node_cycle_means AS MATERIALIZED (
  WITH event_samples AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT
      metric_code,
      product_type,
      event_id,
      duration_days,
      completed_valid,
      inflight_valid
    FROM node_cycle_facts
    WHERE
      duration_days IS NOT NULL
    UNION ALL
    SELECT DISTINCT
      metric_code,
      CAST('全部' AS TEXT) AS product_type,
      event_id,
      duration_days,
      completed_valid,
      inflight_valid
    FROM node_cycle_facts
    WHERE
      duration_days IS NOT NULL
  ), sample_stats AS (
    SELECT
      metric_code,
      product_type,
      COUNT(*) AS sample_count,
      AVG(duration_days) AS mean_days,
      COUNT(*) FILTER(WHERE
        completed_valid) AS completed_count,
      COUNT(*) FILTER(WHERE
        inflight_valid) AS inflight_count
    FROM event_samples
    GROUP BY
      metric_code,
      product_type
  ), quality AS (
    SELECT
      metric_code,
      CASE WHEN GROUPING(product_type) = 1 THEN '全部' ELSE product_type END AS product_type,
      COUNT(*) AS linked_source_rows,
      COUNT(*) FILTER(WHERE
        in_window) AS entry_window_rows,
      COUNT(DISTINCT event_id) FILTER(WHERE
        in_window) AS entered_event_count,
      COUNT(*) FILTER(WHERE
        in_window AND finished_at IS NULL) AS missing_end_rows,
      COUNT(*) FILTER(WHERE
        started_at IS NULL) AS missing_start_rows,
      COUNT(*) FILTER(WHERE
        event_id IS NULL) AS missing_event_id_rows,
      COUNT(*) FILTER(WHERE
        in_window AND finished_at < started_at) AS end_before_start_rows,
      COUNT(*) FILTER(WHERE
        in_window AND finished_at > cutoff AND NOT COALESCE(inflight_valid, FALSE)) AS future_end_without_entry_proof_rows,
      COUNT(*) FILTER(WHERE
        in_window AND finished_at IS NULL AND NOT COALESCE(inflight_valid, FALSE)) AS unknown_completion_rows
    FROM node_cycle_facts
    GROUP BY
      metric_code,
      GROUPING SETS (
        (),
        (
          product_type
        )
      )
  )
  SELECT
    q.*,
    COALESCE(s.sample_count, 0) AS sample_count,
    s.mean_days,
    COALESCE(s.completed_count, 0) AS completed_count,
    COALESCE(s.inflight_count, 0) AS inflight_count
  FROM quality AS q
  LEFT JOIN sample_stats AS s
    USING (metric_code, product_type)
), metric_results AS MATERIALIZED (
  SELECT
    32 AS sort_no,
    CAST('P1-03' AS TEXT) AS code,
    CAST('客户准入平均周期' AS TEXT) AS metric_name,
    CAST(NULL AS TEXT) AS product_team,
    CAST(NULL AS DECIMAL) AS amount_yi,
    CAST(NULL AS DECIMAL) AS energy_gwh,
    CAST(n.sample_count AS BIGINT) AS item_count,
    CAST(NULL AS DECIMAL) AS ratio_value,
    CAST(n.mean_days AS DECIMAL) AS days_value,
    CAST(CASE
      WHEN n.sample_count > 0
      THEN '自身起止已映射；按真实事件去重计算'
      WHEN COALESCE(n.entry_window_rows, 0) = 0
      THEN '已映射；起始时间缺失或不在所选窗口'
      ELSE '已映射；没有有效起止配对，原因见明细'
    END AS TEXT) AS status,
    CAST('客户.new_approved_time_facreview－客户.new_submit_time_facreview，换算天后取平均。仅完整有效已结束事件取真实结束减开始；以本环节结束时间归所选期间，未结束不计入平均。已进入后续阶段的记录也保留，不限定当前阶段枚举。 已按本次确认，将客户准入这一项落为客户审厂OA提交至通过的办理周期，不再只输出候选。按本次确认采用客户审厂OA审批办理周期，不用计划审核日期；经parentaccountid关联客户。 总体按真实事件去重；缺起止数据与缺字段映射分开列示。分组样本不可直接相加。' AS TEXT) AS note,
    (
      SELECT
        JSONB_AGG(TO_JSONB(x))
      FROM node_cycle_means AS x
      WHERE
        x.metric_code = 'P1-03'
    ) AS detail
  FROM context AS p
  LEFT JOIN node_cycle_means AS n
    ON n.metric_code = 'P1-03' AND n.product_type = '全部'
)
SELECT
  r.code AS "指标序号",
  r.metric_name AS "指标名称",
  r.product_team AS "产品团队",
  p.start_date AS "期间开始",
  p.end_exclusive AS "期间结束不含",
  p.cutoff AS "周期观察截止",
  r.amount_yi AS "金额_亿元",
  r.energy_gwh AS "电量_GWh",
  r.item_count AS "数量",
  r.ratio_value AS "比率_原始小数",
  r.days_value AS "平均周期_天",
  CASE
    WHEN r.status = '查询已实现；缺失输入及部分合计见明细'
    THEN CASE
      WHEN r.amount_yi IS NOT NULL
      OR r.energy_gwh IS NOT NULL
      OR r.item_count IS NOT NULL
      OR r.ratio_value IS NOT NULL
      OR r.days_value IS NOT NULL
      THEN '已有查询结果；完整性与适用列见明细'
      ELSE '没有可计算结果；检查输入、时间及关联范围'
    END
    ELSE r.status
  END AS "计算说明状态",
  r.note AS "取值说明",
  r.detail AS "分组明细及缺口"
FROM metric_results AS r
CROSS JOIN context AS p
ORDER BY
  r.sort_no,
  r.product_team;

P1-04.name: 是否需立项（P1-2-1）平均周期
P1-04.definition: 商机.new_approved_time_projectassess－商机.new_submit_time_projectassess，换算天后取平均。仅完整有效已结束事件取真实结束减开始；以本环节结束时间归所选期间，未结束不计入平均。已进入后续阶段的记录也保留，不限定当前阶段枚举。
P1-04.formula:
对已实际进入本环节的有效事件计算周期；不以当前阶段枚举排除已到后续阶段的历史事件。同一事件去重，按电芯/PACK计算动态均值；单笔周期严格大于同组均值1.5倍才判超期。
阶段及普通环节按各自真实结束时间归所选期间，结束须早于MIN(end_exclusive,观察日次日)；起点可早于期初，不计未结束在途。P0～P4阶段只计起止完整且周期严格大于0的样本；普通独立环节仍沿用各自完整非逆序规则。
P1-04.attributes:
LE01-A0038 商机管理.立项评审审批通过时间（new_approved_time_projectassess，空 89.7%）
LE01-A0404 商机管理.立项评审提交时间（new_submit_time_projectassess，空 89.72%）
P1-04.physicalFields:
开始：商机.new_submit_time_projectassess
结束：商机.new_approved_time_projectassess
样本去重：商机ID
P1-04.notes: 立项评审按提交至审批通过，不再减阶段一结束时间。 总体按真实事件去重；缺起止数据与缺字段映射分开列示。分组样本不可直接相加。
P1-04.sqlStatus: 按结果动态判定（见 SQL 中 status 的 CASE）
P1-04.role: 跨阶段参考（不参与本节点链路）
P1-04.ctes: parameters → context → account_rows → accounts → opportunity_rows → opportunities → orders → order_line_links → signed_orders → opportunity_flags → node_quote_headers → node_quote_links → node_quote_latest → node_cycle_source → node_cycle_facts → node_cycle_means → event_samples → sample_stats → quality
P1-04.sql:
WITH parameters AS MATERIALIZED (
  SELECT
    CAST(%s AS DATE) AS start_date,
    CAST(%s AS DATE) AS end_exclusive,
    CAST(%s AS TIMESTAMP) AS observed_at,
    CAST(ARRAY['1'] AS TEXT[]) AS strategic_levels,
    CAST(ARRAY['1', '2'] AS TEXT[]) AS focus_levels,
    CAST(1000000 AS DECIMAL) AS target_power_units_per_gwh
), context AS MATERIALIZED (
  SELECT
    p.*,
    CAST((
      DATE_TRUNC('DAY', observed_at) + INTERVAL '1 DAY'
    ) AS TIMESTAMP) AS as_of_exclusive,
    LEAST(
      CAST(end_exclusive AS TIMESTAMP),
      DATE_TRUNC('DAY', observed_at) + INTERVAL '1 DAY'
    ) AS effective_end_exclusive,
    LEAST(
      CAST(end_exclusive AS TIMESTAMP),
      DATE_TRUNC('DAY', observed_at) + INTERVAL '1 DAY'
    ) - INTERVAL '1 MICROSECOND' AS cutoff,
    MAKE_DATE(CAST(EXTRACT(YEAR FROM start_date) AS INT), 1, 1) AS year_start,
    MAKE_DATE(CAST(EXTRACT(YEAR FROM start_date) AS INT) + 1, 1, 1) AS next_year_start,
    GREATEST(
      CAST(0 AS DECIMAL),
      LEAST(
        CAST(1 AS DECIMAL),
        CAST((
          CAST(LEAST(
            CAST(end_exclusive AS TIMESTAMP),
            DATE_TRUNC('DAY', observed_at) + INTERVAL '1 DAY'
          ) AS DATE) - MAKE_DATE(CAST(EXTRACT(YEAR FROM start_date) AS INT), 1, 1)
        ) AS DECIMAL) / (
          MAKE_DATE(CAST(EXTRACT(YEAR FROM start_date) AS INT) + 1, 1, 1) - MAKE_DATE(CAST(EXTRACT(YEAR FROM start_date) AS INT), 1, 1)
        )
      )
    ) AS time_progress
  FROM parameters AS p
), account_rows AS MATERIALIZED (
  SELECT
    CAST(a.accountid AS TEXT) AS account_id,
    CAST(a.name AS TEXT) AS account_name,
    CAST(a.new_accountlevel AS TEXT) AS level_code,
    CAST(a.new_sapdate AS TIMESTAMP) AS sap_created_at,
    CAST(a.new_sapsubmitdate AS TIMESTAMP) AS sap_submitted_at,
    CAST(a.new_approved_time_facreview AS TIMESTAMP) AS account_factory_approved_at,
    CAST(a.new_submit_time_facreview AS TIMESTAMP) AS account_factory_submitted_at,
    CAST(a.new_sinosurestartdate AS TIMESTAMP) AS account_sinosure_start,
    CAST(a.new_sinosureenddate AS TIMESTAMP) AS account_sinosure_end,
    CAST(a.new_submit_time_accredit AS TIMESTAMP) AS account_credit_submitted_at,
    CAST(a.new_approvaltime_accredit AS TIMESTAMP) AS account_credit_approved_at,
    CAST(a.new_cdastartdate AS TIMESTAMP) AS account_cda_start,
    CAST(a.new_cdaenddate AS TIMESTAMP) AS account_cda_end,
    CAST(a.new_cda_submittime AS TIMESTAMP) AS account_cda_submitted_at,
    CAST(a.new_cda_approved_time AS TIMESTAMP) AS account_cda_approved_at,
    CAST(a.new_approvalstatus_facreview AS TEXT) AS account_factory_approval_status,
    CAST(a.new_sapcode AS TEXT) AS sap_code,
    CAST(a.new_issap AS TEXT) AS sap_registered,
    CAST(a.new_issapnew AS TEXT) AS sap_registration_kind,
    ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
      PARTITION BY a.accountid
      ORDER BY a.modifiedon DESC NULLS LAST, a.createdon DESC NULLS LAST
    ) AS rn
  FROM (
    SELECT
      __x360_raw.*
    FROM ded_public.p_fm_edw_v_ods_crm_account_esb AS __x360_raw
    CROSS JOIN context AS __x360_ctx
    WHERE
      CAST(__x360_raw.createdon AS TIMESTAMP) < __x360_ctx.as_of_exclusive
  ) AS a
  WHERE
    NULLIF(TRIM(CAST(a.accountid AS TEXT)), '') IS NOT NULL
), accounts AS MATERIALIZED (
  SELECT
    account_id,
    account_name,
    level_code,
    sap_created_at,
    sap_submitted_at,
    account_factory_approved_at,
    account_factory_submitted_at,
    account_sinosure_start,
    account_sinosure_end,
    account_credit_submitted_at,
    account_credit_approved_at,
    account_cda_start,
    account_cda_end,
    account_cda_submitted_at,
    account_cda_approved_at,
    account_factory_approval_status,
    sap_code,
    sap_registered,
    sap_registration_kind
  FROM account_rows
  WHERE
    rn = 1
), opportunity_rows AS MATERIALIZED (
  SELECT
    ranked.*
  FROM (
    SELECT
      CAST(o.opportunityid AS TEXT) AS opportunity_id,
      CAST(o.parentaccountid AS TEXT) AS account_id,
      CAST(o.name AS TEXT) AS project_name,
      CAST(o.ownerid AS TEXT) AS owner_id,
      CASE
        WHEN CAST(o.new_accproducttype AS TEXT) IN ('1', '电芯')
        THEN '电芯'
        WHEN CAST(o.new_accproducttype AS TEXT) IN ('2', 'PACK')
        THEN 'PACK'
        ELSE '其他'
      END AS product_type,
      o.__x360_asof_process_stage AS process_stage,
      CAST(o.statecode AS TEXT) AS system_state,
      CAST(o.new_demandinput AS TEXT) AS demand_status,
      CAST(o.createdon AS TIMESTAMP) AS created_at,
      CAST(o.new_stage1enddate AS TIMESTAMP) AS s1,
      CAST(o.new_stage2enddate AS TIMESTAMP) AS s2,
      CAST(o.new_stage3enddate AS TIMESTAMP) AS s3,
      CAST(o.new_stage4enddate AS TIMESTAMP) AS s4,
      CAST(o.new_stage5enddate AS TIMESTAMP) AS s5,
      CAST(o.new_cdastartdate AS TIMESTAMP) AS new_cdastartdate,
      CAST(o.new_cdaenddate AS TIMESTAMP) AS new_cdaenddate,
      CAST(o.new_approved_time_acneed AS TIMESTAMP) AS new_approved_time_acneed,
      CAST(o.new_submit_time_acneed AS TIMESTAMP) AS new_submit_time_acneed,
      CAST(o.new_approved_time_projectassess AS TIMESTAMP) AS new_approved_time_projectassess,
      CAST(o.new_submit_time_projectassess AS TIMESTAMP) AS new_submit_time_projectassess,
      CAST(o.new_sampletestpass_time AS TIMESTAMP) AS new_sampletestpass_time,
      CAST(o.new_sampletime AS TIMESTAMP) AS new_sampletime,
      CAST(o.new_technicalsigningdate AS TIMESTAMP) AS new_technicalsigningdate,
      CAST(o.new_submit_time_techcon AS TIMESTAMP) AS new_submit_time_techcon,
      CAST(o.new_warrantysigningdate AS TIMESTAMP) AS new_warrantysigningdate,
      CAST(o.new_submit_time_qsl AS TIMESTAMP) AS new_submit_time_qsl,
      CAST(o.new_isneedcda AS TEXT) AS new_isneedcda,
      CAST(o.new_approvalstatus_acneed AS TEXT) AS new_approvalstatus_acneed,
      CAST(o.new_approvalstatus_projectassess AS TEXT) AS new_approvalstatus_projectassess,
      CAST(o.new_approvalstatus_techcon AS TEXT) AS new_approvalstatus_techcon,
      CAST(o.new_approvalstatus_qsl AS TEXT) AS new_approvalstatus_qsl,
      CAST(o.new_sampletestresult AS TEXT) AS new_sampletestresult,
      ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
        PARTITION BY o.opportunityid
        ORDER BY o.modifiedon DESC NULLS LAST, o.createdon DESC NULLS LAST
      ) AS rn
    FROM (
      SELECT
        __x360_raw.*,
        CASE
          WHEN CAST(__x360_raw.new_stage1enddate AS TIMESTAMP) IS NULL
          OR CAST(__x360_raw.new_stage1enddate AS TIMESTAMP) >= __x360_ctx.as_of_exclusive
          THEN '11'
          WHEN CAST(__x360_raw.new_stage2enddate AS TIMESTAMP) IS NULL
          OR CAST(__x360_raw.new_stage2enddate AS TIMESTAMP) >= __x360_ctx.as_of_exclusive
          THEN '12'
          WHEN CAST(__x360_raw.new_stage3enddate AS TIMESTAMP) IS NULL
          OR CAST(__x360_raw.new_stage3enddate AS TIMESTAMP) >= __x360_ctx.as_of_exclusive
          THEN '13'
          WHEN CAST(__x360_raw.new_stage4enddate AS TIMESTAMP) IS NULL
          OR CAST(__x360_raw.new_stage4enddate AS TIMESTAMP) >= __x360_ctx.as_of_exclusive
          THEN '14'
          WHEN CAST(__x360_raw.new_stage5enddate AS TIMESTAMP) IS NULL
          OR CAST(__x360_raw.new_stage5enddate AS TIMESTAMP) >= __x360_ctx.as_of_exclusive
          THEN '15'
          ELSE 'completed'
        END AS __x360_asof_process_stage
      FROM ded_public.p_fm_edw_v_ods_crm_opportunity_esb AS __x360_raw
      CROSS JOIN context AS __x360_ctx
    ) AS o
    WHERE
      NULLIF(TRIM(CAST(o.opportunityid AS TEXT)), '') IS NOT NULL
  ) AS ranked
  CROSS JOIN context AS p
  WHERE
    ranked.created_at < p.as_of_exclusive
), opportunities AS MATERIALIZED (
  SELECT
    o.opportunity_id,
    o.account_id,
    o.project_name,
    o.owner_id,
    o.product_type,
    o.process_stage,
    o.demand_status,
    o.created_at,
    o.s1,
    o.s2,
    o.s3,
    o.s4,
    o.s5,
    a.account_name,
    a.level_code,
    o.new_cdastartdate,
    o.new_cdaenddate,
    o.new_approved_time_acneed,
    o.new_submit_time_acneed,
    o.new_approved_time_projectassess,
    o.new_submit_time_projectassess,
    o.new_sampletestpass_time,
    o.new_sampletime,
    o.new_technicalsigningdate,
    o.new_submit_time_techcon,
    o.new_warrantysigningdate,
    o.new_submit_time_qsl,
    o.new_isneedcda,
    o.new_approvalstatus_acneed,
    o.new_approvalstatus_projectassess,
    o.new_approvalstatus_techcon,
    o.new_approvalstatus_qsl,
    o.new_sampletestresult,
    a.sap_created_at,
    a.sap_submitted_at,
    a.sap_code,
    a.account_factory_approved_at,
    a.account_factory_submitted_at,
    a.account_sinosure_start,
    a.account_sinosure_end,
    a.account_credit_submitted_at,
    a.account_credit_approved_at,
    a.account_cda_start,
    a.account_cda_end,
    a.account_cda_submitted_at,
    a.account_cda_approved_at,
    a.account_factory_approval_status
  FROM opportunity_rows AS o
  LEFT JOIN accounts AS a
    USING (account_id)
  CROSS JOIN context AS p
  WHERE
    o.rn = 1 AND (
      o.created_at < p.as_of_exclusive
    )
), orders AS MATERIALIZED (
  SELECT DISTINCT
    CAST(salesorderid AS TEXT) AS order_id
  FROM ded_public.p_fm_edw_v_ods_crm_salesorder_esb
  WHERE
    NULLIF(TRIM(CAST(salesorderid AS TEXT)), '') IS NOT NULL
), order_line_links AS MATERIALIZED (
  SELECT DISTINCT
    CAST(l.new_opportunity_id AS TEXT) AS opportunity_id,
    CAST(l.salesorderid AS TEXT) AS order_id
  FROM ded_public.p_fm_edw_v_ods_crm_salesorderdetail_esb AS l
  WHERE
    NULLIF(TRIM(CAST(l.new_opportunity_id AS TEXT)), '') IS NOT NULL
    AND NULLIF(TRIM(CAST(l.salesorderid AS TEXT)), '') IS NOT NULL
), signed_orders AS MATERIALIZED (
  SELECT
    l.opportunity_id,
    COUNT(DISTINCT l.order_id) AS order_count
  FROM order_line_links AS l
  JOIN orders AS o
    USING (order_id)
  GROUP BY
    l.opportunity_id
), opportunity_flags AS MATERIALIZED (
  SELECT
    o.*,
    COALESCE(s.order_count, 0) AS order_count,
    CASE
      WHEN COALESCE(s.order_count, 0) = 0
      THEN FALSE
      WHEN o.s4 IS NULL
      THEN FALSE
      ELSE o.s4 < p.as_of_exclusive
    END AS signed,
    (
      COALESCE(s.order_count, 0) > 0 AND o.s4 IS NULL
    ) AS missing_p3_end
  FROM opportunities AS o
  LEFT JOIN signed_orders AS s
    USING (opportunity_id)
  CROSS JOIN context AS p
), node_quote_headers AS MATERIALIZED (
  SELECT
    CAST(q.new_quoteapplyid AS TEXT) AS quote_id,
    CAST(q.createdon AS TIMESTAMP) AS created_at,
    CAST(q.new_oasubmitdate AS TIMESTAMP) AS submitted_at,
    CAST(q.new_approved_time AS TIMESTAMP) AS approved_at,
    CAST(q.new_approvalstatus AS TEXT) AS approval_status
  FROM ded_public.p_fm_edw_v_ods_crm_new_quoteapply_esb AS q
  WHERE
    q.new_quoteapplyid IS NOT NULL
), node_quote_links AS MATERIALIZED (
  SELECT DISTINCT
    CAST(d.new_opportunity_id AS TEXT) AS opportunity_id,
    CAST(d.new_quoteapply_id AS TEXT) AS quote_id
  FROM ded_public.p_fm_edw_v_ods_crm_new_quoteapplydetail_esb AS d
  WHERE
    NULLIF(TRIM(CAST(d.new_opportunity_id AS TEXT)), '') IS NOT NULL
    AND NULLIF(TRIM(CAST(d.new_quoteapply_id AS TEXT)), '') IS NOT NULL
), node_quote_latest AS MATERIALIZED (
  SELECT
    opportunity_id,
    quote_id,
    submitted_at,
    approved_at,
    approval_status
  FROM (
    SELECT
      o.opportunity_id,
      q.quote_id,
      q.submitted_at,
      q.approved_at,
      q.approval_status,
      ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
        PARTITION BY o.opportunity_id
        ORDER BY q.created_at DESC NULLS LAST, q.quote_id DESC
      ) AS rn
    FROM opportunity_flags AS o
    JOIN node_quote_links AS l
      USING (opportunity_id)
    JOIN node_quote_headers AS q
      USING (quote_id)
    CROSS JOIN context AS p
    WHERE
      q.created_at <= p.cutoff
  ) AS ranked
  WHERE
    rn = 1
), node_cycle_source AS MATERIALIZED (
  SELECT
    o.opportunity_id,
    o.product_type,
    n.metric_code,
    n.phase_code,
    n.started_at,
    n.finished_at,
    n.entered_at,
    n.active_flag,
    n.event_id,
    n.finished_at >= p.start_date AND n.finished_at < p.effective_end_exclusive AS in_window,
    p.cutoff
  FROM opportunity_flags AS o
  LEFT JOIN node_quote_latest AS q
    USING (opportunity_id)
  CROSS JOIN context AS p
  CROSS JOIN LATERAL (
    VALUES
      (
        CAST('P0-03' AS TEXT),
        CAST('P0' AS TEXT),
        o.new_cdastartdate,
        o.new_cdaenddate,
        o.new_cdastartdate,
        COALESCE((
          o.new_isneedcda = '2'
        ), FALSE),
        CAST((
          o.opportunity_id
        ) AS TEXT)
      ),
      (
        CAST('P0-04' AS TEXT),
        CAST('P0' AS TEXT),
        o.new_submit_time_acneed,
        o.new_approved_time_acneed,
        o.new_submit_time_acneed,
        COALESCE((
          o.new_approvalstatus_acneed = '2'
        ), FALSE),
        CAST((
          o.opportunity_id
        ) AS TEXT)
      ),
      (
        CAST('P0-06' AS TEXT),
        CAST('P0' AS TEXT),
        o.new_submit_time_acneed,
        o.new_approved_time_acneed,
        o.new_submit_time_acneed,
        COALESCE((
          o.new_approvalstatus_acneed = '2'
        ), FALSE),
        CAST((
          o.opportunity_id
        ) AS TEXT)
      ),
      (
        CAST('P1-03' AS TEXT),
        CAST('P1' AS TEXT),
        o.account_factory_submitted_at,
        o.account_factory_approved_at,
        o.account_factory_submitted_at,
        COALESCE((
          o.account_factory_approval_status = '2'
        ), FALSE),
        CAST((
          o.account_id
        ) AS TEXT)
      ),
      (
        CAST('P1-04' AS TEXT),
        CAST('P1' AS TEXT),
        o.new_submit_time_projectassess,
        o.new_approved_time_projectassess,
        o.new_submit_time_projectassess,
        COALESCE((
          o.new_approvalstatus_projectassess = '2'
        ), FALSE),
        CAST((
          o.opportunity_id
        ) AS TEXT)
      ),
      (
        CAST('P1-05' AS TEXT),
        CAST('P1' AS TEXT),
        o.new_sampletime,
        o.new_sampletestpass_time,
        o.new_sampletime,
        COALESCE((
          o.new_sampletestresult IS NULL
        ), FALSE),
        CAST((
          o.opportunity_id
        ) AS TEXT)
      ),
      (
        CAST('P1-07' AS TEXT),
        CAST('P1' AS TEXT),
        q.submitted_at,
        CASE WHEN q.approval_status = '3' THEN q.approved_at END,
        q.submitted_at,
        COALESCE((
          q.approval_status = '2'
        ), FALSE),
        CAST((
          q.quote_id
        ) AS TEXT)
      ),
      (
        CAST('P2-03' AS TEXT),
        CAST('P2' AS TEXT),
        o.new_submit_time_techcon,
        o.new_technicalsigningdate,
        o.new_submit_time_techcon,
        COALESCE((
          o.new_approvalstatus_techcon = '2'
        ), FALSE),
        CAST((
          o.opportunity_id
        ) AS TEXT)
      ),
      (
        CAST('P2-04' AS TEXT),
        CAST('P2' AS TEXT),
        o.new_submit_time_qsl,
        o.new_warrantysigningdate,
        o.new_submit_time_qsl,
        COALESCE((
          o.new_approvalstatus_qsl = '2'
        ), FALSE),
        CAST((
          o.opportunity_id
        ) AS TEXT)
      )
  ) AS n(metric_code, phase_code, started_at, finished_at, entered_at, active_flag, event_id)
), node_cycle_facts AS MATERIALIZED (
  SELECT
    f.*,
    CASE
      WHEN in_window
      AND event_id IS NOT NULL
      AND started_at IS NOT NULL
      AND finished_at >= started_at
      THEN EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM (
        finished_at - started_at
      )) / CAST(86400 AS DECIMAL)
    END AS duration_days,
    (
      in_window
      AND event_id IS NOT NULL
      AND started_at IS NOT NULL
      AND finished_at >= started_at
    ) AS completed_valid,
    FALSE AS inflight_valid
  FROM node_cycle_source AS f
), node_cycle_means AS MATERIALIZED (
  WITH event_samples AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT
      metric_code,
      product_type,
      event_id,
      duration_days,
      completed_valid,
      inflight_valid
    FROM node_cycle_facts
    WHERE
      duration_days IS NOT NULL
    UNION ALL
    SELECT DISTINCT
      metric_code,
      CAST('全部' AS TEXT) AS product_type,
      event_id,
      duration_days,
      completed_valid,
      inflight_valid
    FROM node_cycle_facts
    WHERE
      duration_days IS NOT NULL
  ), sample_stats AS (
    SELECT
      metric_code,
      product_type,
      COUNT(*) AS sample_count,
      AVG(duration_days) AS mean_days,
      COUNT(*) FILTER(WHERE
        completed_valid) AS completed_count,
      COUNT(*) FILTER(WHERE
        inflight_valid) AS inflight_count
    FROM event_samples
    GROUP BY
      metric_code,
      product_type
  ), quality AS (
    SELECT
      metric_code,
      CASE WHEN GROUPING(product_type) = 1 THEN '全部' ELSE product_type END AS product_type,
      COUNT(*) AS linked_source_rows,
      COUNT(*) FILTER(WHERE
        in_window) AS entry_window_rows,
      COUNT(DISTINCT event_id) FILTER(WHERE
        in_window) AS entered_event_count,
      COUNT(*) FILTER(WHERE
        in_window AND finished_at IS NULL) AS missing_end_rows,
      COUNT(*) FILTER(WHERE
        started_at IS NULL) AS missing_start_rows,
      COUNT(*) FILTER(WHERE
        event_id IS NULL) AS missing_event_id_rows,
      COUNT(*) FILTER(WHERE
        in_window AND finished_at < started_at) AS end_before_start_rows,
      COUNT(*) FILTER(WHERE
        in_window AND finished_at > cutoff AND NOT COALESCE(inflight_valid, FALSE)) AS future_end_without_entry_proof_rows,
      COUNT(*) FILTER(WHERE
        in_window AND finished_at IS NULL AND NOT COALESCE(inflight_valid, FALSE)) AS unknown_completion_rows
    FROM node_cycle_facts
    GROUP BY
      metric_code,
      GROUPING SETS (
        (),
        (
          product_type
        )
      )
  )
  SELECT
    q.*,
    COALESCE(s.sample_count, 0) AS sample_count,
    s.mean_days,
    COALESCE(s.completed_count, 0) AS completed_count,
    COALESCE(s.inflight_count, 0) AS inflight_count
  FROM quality AS q
  LEFT JOIN sample_stats AS s
    USING (metric_code, product_type)
), metric_results AS MATERIALIZED (
  SELECT
    33 AS sort_no,
    CAST('P1-04' AS TEXT) AS code,
    CAST('是否需立项（P1-2-1）平均周期' AS TEXT) AS metric_name,
    CAST(NULL AS TEXT) AS product_team,
    CAST(NULL AS DECIMAL) AS amount_yi,
    CAST(NULL AS DECIMAL) AS energy_gwh,
    CAST(n.sample_count AS BIGINT) AS item_count,
    CAST(NULL AS DECIMAL) AS ratio_value,
    CAST(n.mean_days AS DECIMAL) AS days_value,
    CAST(CASE
      WHEN n.sample_count > 0
      THEN '自身起止已映射；按真实事件去重计算'
      WHEN COALESCE(n.entry_window_rows, 0) = 0
      THEN '已映射；起始时间缺失或不在所选窗口'
      ELSE '已映射；没有有效起止配对，原因见明细'
    END AS TEXT) AS status,
    CAST('商机.new_approved_time_projectassess－商机.new_submit_time_projectassess，换算天后取平均。仅完整有效已结束事件取真实结束减开始；以本环节结束时间归所选期间，未结束不计入平均。已进入后续阶段的记录也保留，不限定当前阶段枚举。 立项评审按提交至审批通过，不再减阶段一结束时间。 总体按真实事件去重；缺起止数据与缺字段映射分开列示。分组样本不可直接相加。' AS TEXT) AS note,
    (
      SELECT
        JSONB_AGG(TO_JSONB(x))
      FROM node_cycle_means AS x
      WHERE
        x.metric_code = 'P1-04'
    ) AS detail
  FROM context AS p
  LEFT JOIN node_cycle_means AS n
    ON n.metric_code = 'P1-04' AND n.product_type = '全部'
)
SELECT
  r.code AS "指标序号",
  r.metric_name AS "指标名称",
  r.product_team AS "产品团队",
  p.start_date AS "期间开始",
  p.end_exclusive AS "期间结束不含",
  p.cutoff AS "周期观察截止",
  r.amount_yi AS "金额_亿元",
  r.energy_gwh AS "电量_GWh",
  r.item_count AS "数量",
  r.ratio_value AS "比率_原始小数",
  r.days_value AS "平均周期_天",
  CASE
    WHEN r.status = '查询已实现；缺失输入及部分合计见明细'
    THEN CASE
      WHEN r.amount_yi IS NOT NULL
      OR r.energy_gwh IS NOT NULL
      OR r.item_count IS NOT NULL
      OR r.ratio_value IS NOT NULL
      OR r.days_value IS NOT NULL
      THEN '已有查询结果；完整性与适用列见明细'
      ELSE '没有可计算结果；检查输入、时间及关联范围'
    END
    ELSE r.status
  END AS "计算说明状态",
  r.note AS "取值说明",
  r.detail AS "分组明细及缺口"
FROM metric_results AS r
CROSS JOIN context AS p
ORDER BY
  r.sort_no,
  r.product_team;

P1-05.name: 送样评审平均周期
P1-05.definition: 商机.new_sampletestpass_time－商机.new_sampletime，换算天后取平均。仅完整有效已结束事件取真实结束减开始；以本环节结束时间归所选期间，未结束不计入平均。已进入后续阶段的记录也保留，不限定当前阶段枚举。
P1-05.formula:
对已实际进入本环节的有效事件计算周期；不以当前阶段枚举排除已到后续阶段的历史事件。同一事件去重，按电芯/PACK计算动态均值；单笔周期严格大于同组均值1.5倍才判超期。
阶段及普通环节按各自真实结束时间归所选期间，结束须早于MIN(end_exclusive,观察日次日)；起点可早于期初，不计未结束在途。P0～P4阶段只计起止完整且周期严格大于0的样本；普通独立环节仍沿用各自完整非逆序规则。
P1-05.attributes:
LE01-A0055 商机管理.样品测试通过时间（new_sampletestpass_time，空 100%）
LE01-A0434 商机管理.送样时间（new_sampletime，空 100%）
P1-05.physicalFields:
开始：商机.new_sampletime
结束：商机.new_sampletestpass_time
样本去重：商机ID
P1-05.notes: 按送样至测试通过；未通过的独立评审结束事件仍未提供，不能以修改时间补造。 总体按真实事件去重；缺起止数据与缺字段映射分开列示。分组样本不可直接相加。
P1-05.sqlStatus: 按结果动态判定（见 SQL 中 status 的 CASE）
P1-05.role: 跨阶段参考（不参与本节点链路）
P1-05.ctes: parameters → context → account_rows → accounts → opportunity_rows → opportunities → orders → order_line_links → signed_orders → opportunity_flags → node_quote_headers → node_quote_links → node_quote_latest → node_cycle_source → node_cycle_facts → node_cycle_means → event_samples → sample_stats → quality
P1-05.sql:
WITH parameters AS MATERIALIZED (
  SELECT
    CAST(%s AS DATE) AS start_date,
    CAST(%s AS DATE) AS end_exclusive,
    CAST(%s AS TIMESTAMP) AS observed_at,
    CAST(ARRAY['1'] AS TEXT[]) AS strategic_levels,
    CAST(ARRAY['1', '2'] AS TEXT[]) AS focus_levels,
    CAST(1000000 AS DECIMAL) AS target_power_units_per_gwh
), context AS MATERIALIZED (
  SELECT
    p.*,
    CAST((
      DATE_TRUNC('DAY', observed_at) + INTERVAL '1 DAY'
    ) AS TIMESTAMP) AS as_of_exclusive,
    LEAST(
      CAST(end_exclusive AS TIMESTAMP),
      DATE_TRUNC('DAY', observed_at) + INTERVAL '1 DAY'
    ) AS effective_end_exclusive,
    LEAST(
      CAST(end_exclusive AS TIMESTAMP),
      DATE_TRUNC('DAY', observed_at) + INTERVAL '1 DAY'
    ) - INTERVAL '1 MICROSECOND' AS cutoff,
    MAKE_DATE(CAST(EXTRACT(YEAR FROM start_date) AS INT), 1, 1) AS year_start,
    MAKE_DATE(CAST(EXTRACT(YEAR FROM start_date) AS INT) + 1, 1, 1) AS next_year_start,
    GREATEST(
      CAST(0 AS DECIMAL),
      LEAST(
        CAST(1 AS DECIMAL),
        CAST((
          CAST(LEAST(
            CAST(end_exclusive AS TIMESTAMP),
            DATE_TRUNC('DAY', observed_at) + INTERVAL '1 DAY'
          ) AS DATE) - MAKE_DATE(CAST(EXTRACT(YEAR FROM start_date) AS INT), 1, 1)
        ) AS DECIMAL) / (
          MAKE_DATE(CAST(EXTRACT(YEAR FROM start_date) AS INT) + 1, 1, 1) - MAKE_DATE(CAST(EXTRACT(YEAR FROM start_date) AS INT), 1, 1)
        )
      )
    ) AS time_progress
  FROM parameters AS p
), account_rows AS MATERIALIZED (
  SELECT
    CAST(a.accountid AS TEXT) AS account_id,
    CAST(a.name AS TEXT) AS account_name,
    CAST(a.new_accountlevel AS TEXT) AS level_code,
    CAST(a.new_sapdate AS TIMESTAMP) AS sap_created_at,
    CAST(a.new_sapsubmitdate AS TIMESTAMP) AS sap_submitted_at,
    CAST(a.new_approved_time_facreview AS TIMESTAMP) AS account_factory_approved_at,
    CAST(a.new_submit_time_facreview AS TIMESTAMP) AS account_factory_submitted_at,
    CAST(a.new_sinosurestartdate AS TIMESTAMP) AS account_sinosure_start,
    CAST(a.new_sinosureenddate AS TIMESTAMP) AS account_sinosure_end,
    CAST(a.new_submit_time_accredit AS TIMESTAMP) AS account_credit_submitted_at,
    CAST(a.new_approvaltime_accredit AS TIMESTAMP) AS account_credit_approved_at,
    CAST(a.new_cdastartdate AS TIMESTAMP) AS account_cda_start,
    CAST(a.new_cdaenddate AS TIMESTAMP) AS account_cda_end,
    CAST(a.new_cda_submittime AS TIMESTAMP) AS account_cda_submitted_at,
    CAST(a.new_cda_approved_time AS TIMESTAMP) AS account_cda_approved_at,
    CAST(a.new_approvalstatus_facreview AS TEXT) AS account_factory_approval_status,
    CAST(a.new_sapcode AS TEXT) AS sap_code,
    CAST(a.new_issap AS TEXT) AS sap_registered,
    CAST(a.new_issapnew AS TEXT) AS sap_registration_kind,
    ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
      PARTITION BY a.accountid
      ORDER BY a.modifiedon DESC NULLS LAST, a.createdon DESC NULLS LAST
    ) AS rn
  FROM (
    SELECT
      __x360_raw.*
    FROM ded_public.p_fm_edw_v_ods_crm_account_esb AS __x360_raw
    CROSS JOIN context AS __x360_ctx
    WHERE
      CAST(__x360_raw.createdon AS TIMESTAMP) < __x360_ctx.as_of_exclusive
  ) AS a
  WHERE
    NULLIF(TRIM(CAST(a.accountid AS TEXT)), '') IS NOT NULL
), accounts AS MATERIALIZED (
  SELECT
    account_id,
    account_name,
    level_code,
    sap_created_at,
    sap_submitted_at,
    account_factory_approved_at,
    account_factory_submitted_at,
    account_sinosure_start,
    account_sinosure_end,
    account_credit_submitted_at,
    account_credit_approved_at,
    account_cda_start,
    account_cda_end,
    account_cda_submitted_at,
    account_cda_approved_at,
    account_factory_approval_status,
    sap_code,
    sap_registered,
    sap_registration_kind
  FROM account_rows
  WHERE
    rn = 1
), opportunity_rows AS MATERIALIZED (
  SELECT
    ranked.*
  FROM (
    SELECT
      CAST(o.opportunityid AS TEXT) AS opportunity_id,
      CAST(o.parentaccountid AS TEXT) AS account_id,
      CAST(o.name AS TEXT) AS project_name,
      CAST(o.ownerid AS TEXT) AS owner_id,
      CASE
        WHEN CAST(o.new_accproducttype AS TEXT) IN ('1', '电芯')
        THEN '电芯'
        WHEN CAST(o.new_accproducttype AS TEXT) IN ('2', 'PACK')
        THEN 'PACK'
        ELSE '其他'
      END AS product_type,
      o.__x360_asof_process_stage AS process_stage,
      CAST(o.statecode AS TEXT) AS system_state,
      CAST(o.new_demandinput AS TEXT) AS demand_status,
      CAST(o.createdon AS TIMESTAMP) AS created_at,
      CAST(o.new_stage1enddate AS TIMESTAMP) AS s1,
      CAST(o.new_stage2enddate AS TIMESTAMP) AS s2,
      CAST(o.new_stage3enddate AS TIMESTAMP) AS s3,
      CAST(o.new_stage4enddate AS TIMESTAMP) AS s4,
      CAST(o.new_stage5enddate AS TIMESTAMP) AS s5,
      CAST(o.new_cdastartdate AS TIMESTAMP) AS new_cdastartdate,
      CAST(o.new_cdaenddate AS TIMESTAMP) AS new_cdaenddate,
      CAST(o.new_approved_time_acneed AS TIMESTAMP) AS new_approved_time_acneed,
      CAST(o.new_submit_time_acneed AS TIMESTAMP) AS new_submit_time_acneed,
      CAST(o.new_approved_time_projectassess AS TIMESTAMP) AS new_approved_time_projectassess,
      CAST(o.new_submit_time_projectassess AS TIMESTAMP) AS new_submit_time_projectassess,
      CAST(o.new_sampletestpass_time AS TIMESTAMP) AS new_sampletestpass_time,
      CAST(o.new_sampletime AS TIMESTAMP) AS new_sampletime,
      CAST(o.new_technicalsigningdate AS TIMESTAMP) AS new_technicalsigningdate,
      CAST(o.new_submit_time_techcon AS TIMESTAMP) AS new_submit_time_techcon,
      CAST(o.new_warrantysigningdate AS TIMESTAMP) AS new_warrantysigningdate,
      CAST(o.new_submit_time_qsl AS TIMESTAMP) AS new_submit_time_qsl,
      CAST(o.new_isneedcda AS TEXT) AS new_isneedcda,
      CAST(o.new_approvalstatus_acneed AS TEXT) AS new_approvalstatus_acneed,
      CAST(o.new_approvalstatus_projectassess AS TEXT) AS new_approvalstatus_projectassess,
      CAST(o.new_approvalstatus_techcon AS TEXT) AS new_approvalstatus_techcon,
      CAST(o.new_approvalstatus_qsl AS TEXT) AS new_approvalstatus_qsl,
      CAST(o.new_sampletestresult AS TEXT) AS new_sampletestresult,
      ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
        PARTITION BY o.opportunityid
        ORDER BY o.modifiedon DESC NULLS LAST, o.createdon DESC NULLS LAST
      ) AS rn
    FROM (
      SELECT
        __x360_raw.*,
        CASE
          WHEN CAST(__x360_raw.new_stage1enddate AS TIMESTAMP) IS NULL
          OR CAST(__x360_raw.new_stage1enddate AS TIMESTAMP) >= __x360_ctx.as_of_exclusive
          THEN '11'
          WHEN CAST(__x360_raw.new_stage2enddate AS TIMESTAMP) IS NULL
          OR CAST(__x360_raw.new_stage2enddate AS TIMESTAMP) >= __x360_ctx.as_of_exclusive
          THEN '12'
          WHEN CAST(__x360_raw.new_stage3enddate AS TIMESTAMP) IS NULL
          OR CAST(__x360_raw.new_stage3enddate AS TIMESTAMP) >= __x360_ctx.as_of_exclusive
          THEN '13'
          WHEN CAST(__x360_raw.new_stage4enddate AS TIMESTAMP) IS NULL
          OR CAST(__x360_raw.new_stage4enddate AS TIMESTAMP) >= __x360_ctx.as_of_exclusive
          THEN '14'
          WHEN CAST(__x360_raw.new_stage5enddate AS TIMESTAMP) IS NULL
          OR CAST(__x360_raw.new_stage5enddate AS TIMESTAMP) >= __x360_ctx.as_of_exclusive
          THEN '15'
          ELSE 'completed'
        END AS __x360_asof_process_stage
      FROM ded_public.p_fm_edw_v_ods_crm_opportunity_esb AS __x360_raw
      CROSS JOIN context AS __x360_ctx
    ) AS o
    WHERE
      NULLIF(TRIM(CAST(o.opportunityid AS TEXT)), '') IS NOT NULL
  ) AS ranked
  CROSS JOIN context AS p
  WHERE
    ranked.created_at < p.as_of_exclusive
), opportunities AS MATERIALIZED (
  SELECT
    o.opportunity_id,
    o.account_id,
    o.project_name,
    o.owner_id,
    o.product_type,
    o.process_stage,
    o.demand_status,
    o.created_at,
    o.s1,
    o.s2,
    o.s3,
    o.s4,
    o.s5,
    a.account_name,
    a.level_code,
    o.new_cdastartdate,
    o.new_cdaenddate,
    o.new_approved_time_acneed,
    o.new_submit_time_acneed,
    o.new_approved_time_projectassess,
    o.new_submit_time_projectassess,
    o.new_sampletestpass_time,
    o.new_sampletime,
    o.new_technicalsigningdate,
    o.new_submit_time_techcon,
    o.new_warrantysigningdate,
    o.new_submit_time_qsl,
    o.new_isneedcda,
    o.new_approvalstatus_acneed,
    o.new_approvalstatus_projectassess,
    o.new_approvalstatus_techcon,
    o.new_approvalstatus_qsl,
    o.new_sampletestresult,
    a.sap_created_at,
    a.sap_submitted_at,
    a.sap_code,
    a.account_factory_approved_at,
    a.account_factory_submitted_at,
    a.account_sinosure_start,
    a.account_sinosure_end,
    a.account_credit_submitted_at,
    a.account_credit_approved_at,
    a.account_cda_start,
    a.account_cda_end,
    a.account_cda_submitted_at,
    a.account_cda_approved_at,
    a.account_factory_approval_status
  FROM opportunity_rows AS o
  LEFT JOIN accounts AS a
    USING (account_id)
  CROSS JOIN context AS p
  WHERE
    o.rn = 1 AND (
      o.created_at < p.as_of_exclusive
    )
), orders AS MATERIALIZED (
  SELECT DISTINCT
    CAST(salesorderid AS TEXT) AS order_id
  FROM ded_public.p_fm_edw_v_ods_crm_salesorder_esb
  WHERE
    NULLIF(TRIM(CAST(salesorderid AS TEXT)), '') IS NOT NULL
), order_line_links AS MATERIALIZED (
  SELECT DISTINCT
    CAST(l.new_opportunity_id AS TEXT) AS opportunity_id,
    CAST(l.salesorderid AS TEXT) AS order_id
  FROM ded_public.p_fm_edw_v_ods_crm_salesorderdetail_esb AS l
  WHERE
    NULLIF(TRIM(CAST(l.new_opportunity_id AS TEXT)), '') IS NOT NULL
    AND NULLIF(TRIM(CAST(l.salesorderid AS TEXT)), '') IS NOT NULL
), signed_orders AS MATERIALIZED (
  SELECT
    l.opportunity_id,
    COUNT(DISTINCT l.order_id) AS order_count
  FROM order_line_links AS l
  JOIN orders AS o
    USING (order_id)
  GROUP BY
    l.opportunity_id
), opportunity_flags AS MATERIALIZED (
  SELECT
    o.*,
    COALESCE(s.order_count, 0) AS order_count,
    CASE
      WHEN COALESCE(s.order_count, 0) = 0
      THEN FALSE
      WHEN o.s4 IS NULL
      THEN FALSE
      ELSE o.s4 < p.as_of_exclusive
    END AS signed,
    (
      COALESCE(s.order_count, 0) > 0 AND o.s4 IS NULL
    ) AS missing_p3_end
  FROM opportunities AS o
  LEFT JOIN signed_orders AS s
    USING (opportunity_id)
  CROSS JOIN context AS p
), node_quote_headers AS MATERIALIZED (
  SELECT
    CAST(q.new_quoteapplyid AS TEXT) AS quote_id,
    CAST(q.createdon AS TIMESTAMP) AS created_at,
    CAST(q.new_oasubmitdate AS TIMESTAMP) AS submitted_at,
    CAST(q.new_approved_time AS TIMESTAMP) AS approved_at,
    CAST(q.new_approvalstatus AS TEXT) AS approval_status
  FROM ded_public.p_fm_edw_v_ods_crm_new_quoteapply_esb AS q
  WHERE
    q.new_quoteapplyid IS NOT NULL
), node_quote_links AS MATERIALIZED (
  SELECT DISTINCT
    CAST(d.new_opportunity_id AS TEXT) AS opportunity_id,
    CAST(d.new_quoteapply_id AS TEXT) AS quote_id
  FROM ded_public.p_fm_edw_v_ods_crm_new_quoteapplydetail_esb AS d
  WHERE
    NULLIF(TRIM(CAST(d.new_opportunity_id AS TEXT)), '') IS NOT NULL
    AND NULLIF(TRIM(CAST(d.new_quoteapply_id AS TEXT)), '') IS NOT NULL
), node_quote_latest AS MATERIALIZED (
  SELECT
    opportunity_id,
    quote_id,
    submitted_at,
    approved_at,
    approval_status
  FROM (
    SELECT
      o.opportunity_id,
      q.quote_id,
      q.submitted_at,
      q.approved_at,
      q.approval_status,
      ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
        PARTITION BY o.opportunity_id
        ORDER BY q.created_at DESC NULLS LAST, q.quote_id DESC
      ) AS rn
    FROM opportunity_flags AS o
    JOIN node_quote_links AS l
      USING (opportunity_id)
    JOIN node_quote_headers AS q
      USING (quote_id)
    CROSS JOIN context AS p
    WHERE
      q.created_at <= p.cutoff
  ) AS ranked
  WHERE
    rn = 1
), node_cycle_source AS MATERIALIZED (
  SELECT
    o.opportunity_id,
    o.product_type,
    n.metric_code,
    n.phase_code,
    n.started_at,
    n.finished_at,
    n.entered_at,
    n.active_flag,
    n.event_id,
    n.finished_at >= p.start_date AND n.finished_at < p.effective_end_exclusive AS in_window,
    p.cutoff
  FROM opportunity_flags AS o
  LEFT JOIN node_quote_latest AS q
    USING (opportunity_id)
  CROSS JOIN context AS p
  CROSS JOIN LATERAL (
    VALUES
      (
        CAST('P0-03' AS TEXT),
        CAST('P0' AS TEXT),
        o.new_cdastartdate,
        o.new_cdaenddate,
        o.new_cdastartdate,
        COALESCE((
          o.new_isneedcda = '2'
        ), FALSE),
        CAST((
          o.opportunity_id
        ) AS TEXT)
      ),
      (
        CAST('P0-04' AS TEXT),
        CAST('P0' AS TEXT),
        o.new_submit_time_acneed,
        o.new_approved_time_acneed,
        o.new_submit_time_acneed,
        COALESCE((
          o.new_approvalstatus_acneed = '2'
        ), FALSE),
        CAST((
          o.opportunity_id
        ) AS TEXT)
      ),
      (
        CAST('P0-06' AS TEXT),
        CAST('P0' AS TEXT),
        o.new_submit_time_acneed,
        o.new_approved_time_acneed,
        o.new_submit_time_acneed,
        COALESCE((
          o.new_approvalstatus_acneed = '2'
        ), FALSE),
        CAST((
          o.opportunity_id
        ) AS TEXT)
      ),
      (
        CAST('P1-03' AS TEXT),
        CAST('P1' AS TEXT),
        o.account_factory_submitted_at,
        o.account_factory_approved_at,
        o.account_factory_submitted_at,
        COALESCE((
          o.account_factory_approval_status = '2'
        ), FALSE),
        CAST((
          o.account_id
        ) AS TEXT)
      ),
      (
        CAST('P1-04' AS TEXT),
        CAST('P1' AS TEXT),
        o.new_submit_time_projectassess,
        o.new_approved_time_projectassess,
        o.new_submit_time_projectassess,
        COALESCE((
          o.new_approvalstatus_projectassess = '2'
        ), FALSE),
        CAST((
          o.opportunity_id
        ) AS TEXT)
      ),
      (
        CAST('P1-05' AS TEXT),
        CAST('P1' AS TEXT),
        o.new_sampletime,
        o.new_sampletestpass_time,
        o.new_sampletime,
        COALESCE((
          o.new_sampletestresult IS NULL
        ), FALSE),
        CAST((
          o.opportunity_id
        ) AS TEXT)
      ),
      (
        CAST('P1-07' AS TEXT),
        CAST('P1' AS TEXT),
        q.submitted_at,
        CASE WHEN q.approval_status = '3' THEN q.approved_at END,
        q.submitted_at,
        COALESCE((
          q.approval_status = '2'
        ), FALSE),
        CAST((
          q.quote_id
        ) AS TEXT)
      ),
      (
        CAST('P2-03' AS TEXT),
        CAST('P2' AS TEXT),
        o.new_submit_time_techcon,
        o.new_technicalsigningdate,
        o.new_submit_time_techcon,
        COALESCE((
          o.new_approvalstatus_techcon = '2'
        ), FALSE),
        CAST((
          o.opportunity_id
        ) AS TEXT)
      ),
      (
        CAST('P2-04' AS TEXT),
        CAST('P2' AS TEXT),
        o.new_submit_time_qsl,
        o.new_warrantysigningdate,
        o.new_submit_time_qsl,
        COALESCE((
          o.new_approvalstatus_qsl = '2'
        ), FALSE),
        CAST((
          o.opportunity_id
        ) AS TEXT)
      )
  ) AS n(metric_code, phase_code, started_at, finished_at, entered_at, active_flag, event_id)
), node_cycle_facts AS MATERIALIZED (
  SELECT
    f.*,
    CASE
      WHEN in_window
      AND event_id IS NOT NULL
      AND started_at IS NOT NULL
      AND finished_at >= started_at
      THEN EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM (
        finished_at - started_at
      )) / CAST(86400 AS DECIMAL)
    END AS duration_days,
    (
      in_window
      AND event_id IS NOT NULL
      AND started_at IS NOT NULL
      AND finished_at >= started_at
    ) AS completed_valid,
    FALSE AS inflight_valid
  FROM node_cycle_source AS f
), node_cycle_means AS MATERIALIZED (
  WITH event_samples AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT
      metric_code,
      product_type,
      event_id,
      duration_days,
      completed_valid,
      inflight_valid
    FROM node_cycle_facts
    WHERE
      duration_days IS NOT NULL
    UNION ALL
    SELECT DISTINCT
      metric_code,
      CAST('全部' AS TEXT) AS product_type,
      event_id,
      duration_days,
      completed_valid,
      inflight_valid
    FROM node_cycle_facts
    WHERE
      duration_days IS NOT NULL
  ), sample_stats AS (
    SELECT
      metric_code,
      product_type,
      COUNT(*) AS sample_count,
      AVG(duration_days) AS mean_days,
      COUNT(*) FILTER(WHERE
        completed_valid) AS completed_count,
      COUNT(*) FILTER(WHERE
        inflight_valid) AS inflight_count
    FROM event_samples
    GROUP BY
      metric_code,
      product_type
  ), quality AS (
    SELECT
      metric_code,
      CASE WHEN GROUPING(product_type) = 1 THEN '全部' ELSE product_type END AS product_type,
      COUNT(*) AS linked_source_rows,
      COUNT(*) FILTER(WHERE
        in_window) AS entry_window_rows,
      COUNT(DISTINCT event_id) FILTER(WHERE
        in_window) AS entered_event_count,
      COUNT(*) FILTER(WHERE
        in_window AND finished_at IS NULL) AS missing_end_rows,
      COUNT(*) FILTER(WHERE
        started_at IS NULL) AS missing_start_rows,
      COUNT(*) FILTER(WHERE
        event_id IS NULL) AS missing_event_id_rows,
      COUNT(*) FILTER(WHERE
        in_window AND finished_at < started_at) AS end_before_start_rows,
      COUNT(*) FILTER(WHERE
        in_window AND finished_at > cutoff AND NOT COALESCE(inflight_valid, FALSE)) AS future_end_without_entry_proof_rows,
      COUNT(*) FILTER(WHERE
        in_window AND finished_at IS NULL AND NOT COALESCE(inflight_valid, FALSE)) AS unknown_completion_rows
    FROM node_cycle_facts
    GROUP BY
      metric_code,
      GROUPING SETS (
        (),
        (
          product_type
        )
      )
  )
  SELECT
    q.*,
    COALESCE(s.sample_count, 0) AS sample_count,
    s.mean_days,
    COALESCE(s.completed_count, 0) AS completed_count,
    COALESCE(s.inflight_count, 0) AS inflight_count
  FROM quality AS q
  LEFT JOIN sample_stats AS s
    USING (metric_code, product_type)
), metric_results AS MATERIALIZED (
  SELECT
    34 AS sort_no,
    CAST('P1-05' AS TEXT) AS code,
    CAST('送样评审平均周期' AS TEXT) AS metric_name,
    CAST(NULL AS TEXT) AS product_team,
    CAST(NULL AS DECIMAL) AS amount_yi,
    CAST(NULL AS DECIMAL) AS energy_gwh,
    CAST(n.sample_count AS BIGINT) AS item_count,
    CAST(NULL AS DECIMAL) AS ratio_value,
    CAST(n.mean_days AS DECIMAL) AS days_value,
    CAST(CASE
      WHEN n.sample_count > 0
      THEN '自身起止已映射；按真实事件去重计算'
      WHEN COALESCE(n.entry_window_rows, 0) = 0
      THEN '已映射；起始时间缺失或不在所选窗口'
      ELSE '已映射；没有有效起止配对，原因见明细'
    END AS TEXT) AS status,
    CAST('商机.new_sampletestpass_time－商机.new_sampletime，换算天后取平均。仅完整有效已结束事件取真实结束减开始；以本环节结束时间归所选期间，未结束不计入平均。已进入后续阶段的记录也保留，不限定当前阶段枚举。 按送样至测试通过；未通过的独立评审结束事件仍未提供，不能以修改时间补造。 总体按真实事件去重；缺起止数据与缺字段映射分开列示。分组样本不可直接相加。' AS TEXT) AS note,
    (
      SELECT
        JSONB_AGG(TO_JSONB(x))
      FROM node_cycle_means AS x
      WHERE
        x.metric_code = 'P1-05'
    ) AS detail
  FROM context AS p
  LEFT JOIN node_cycle_means AS n
    ON n.metric_code = 'P1-05' AND n.product_type = '全部'
)
SELECT
  r.code AS "指标序号",
  r.metric_name AS "指标名称",
  r.product_team AS "产品团队",
  p.start_date AS "期间开始",
  p.end_exclusive AS "期间结束不含",
  p.cutoff AS "周期观察截止",
  r.amount_yi AS "金额_亿元",
  r.energy_gwh AS "电量_GWh",
  r.item_count AS "数量",
  r.ratio_value AS "比率_原始小数",
  r.days_value AS "平均周期_天",
  CASE
    WHEN r.status = '查询已实现；缺失输入及部分合计见明细'
    THEN CASE
      WHEN r.amount_yi IS NOT NULL
      OR r.energy_gwh IS NOT NULL
      OR r.item_count IS NOT NULL
      OR r.ratio_value IS NOT NULL
      OR r.days_value IS NOT NULL
      THEN '已有查询结果；完整性与适用列见明细'
      ELSE '没有可计算结果；检查输入、时间及关联范围'
    END
    ELSE r.status
  END AS "计算说明状态",
  r.note AS "取值说明",
  r.detail AS "分组明细及缺口"
FROM metric_results AS r
CROSS JOIN context AS p
ORDER BY
  r.sort_no,
  r.product_team;

P1-06.name: 报价管理平均周期
P1-06.definition: 报价申请单.new_approved_time－new_oasubmitdate，按报价申请ID去重后取平均，换算天。
P1-06.formula:
通过报价申请明细关联商机，沿用当前最新关联报价申请；按OA审批时间归年/月。必须有真实提交和审批时间，不额外添加审核枚举过滤。
阶段及普通环节按各自真实结束时间归所选期间，结束须早于MIN(end_exclusive,观察日次日)；起点可早于期初，不计未结束在途。P0～P4阶段只计起止完整且周期严格大于0的样本；普通独立环节仍沿用各自完整非逆序规则。
P1-06.attributes: LE05-A0001 accountid、LE05-A0295 createdon、LE05-A0297 modifiedon、LE05-A0277 name、LE05-A0244 new_accountlevel、LE05-A0191 new_approvalstatus_facreview、LE05-A0057 new_approvaltime_accredit、LE05-A0217 new_approved_time_facreview、LE05-A0167 new_cda_approved_time、LE05-A0088 new_cda_submittime、LE05-A0208 new_cdaenddate、LE05-A0229 new_cdastartdate、LE05-A0016 new_issap、LE05-A0042 new_issapnew、LE05-A0099 new_sapcode、LE05-A0258 new_sapdate、LE05-A0061 new_sapsubmitdate、LE05-A0070 new_sinosureenddate、LE05-A0083 new_sinosurestartdate、LE05-A0197 new_submit_time_accredit、LE05-A0235 new_submit_time_facreview、LE01-A0490 createdon、LE01-A0492 modifiedon、LE01-A0477 name、LE01-A0044 new_accproducttype、LE01-A0430 new_approvalstatus_acneed、LE01-A0431 new_approvalstatus_projectassess、LE01-A0022 new_approvalstatus_qsl、LE01-A0052 new_approvalstatus_techcon、LE01-A0386 new_approved_time_acneed、LE01-A0038 new_approved_time_projectassess、LE01-A0115 new_cdaenddate、LE01-A0153 new_cdastartdate、LE01-A0185 new_demandinput、LE01-A0145 new_isneedcda、LE01-A0451 new_processstage、LE01-A0055 new_sampletestpass_time、LE01-A0143 new_sampletestresult、LE01-A0434 new_sampletime、LE01-A0101 new_stage1enddate、LE01-A0243 new_stage2enddate、LE01-A0100 new_stage3enddate、LE01-A0007 new_stage4enddate、LE01-A0151 new_stage5enddate、LE01-A0290 new_submit_time_acneed、LE01-A0404 new_submit_time_projectassess、LE01-A0147 new_submit_time_qsl、LE01-A0096 new_submit_time_techcon、LE01-A0062 new_technicalsigningdate、LE01-A0441 new_warrantysigningdate、LE01-A0001 opportunityid、LE01-A0486 ownerid、LE01-A0476 parentaccountid、LE01-A0488 statecode、LE07-A0001 salesorderid、LE08-A0025 new_opportunity_id、LE08-A0109 salesorderid、LE14-A0021 createdon、LE14-A0007 new_approvalstatus、LE14-A0003 new_approved_time、LE14-A0005 new_oasubmitdate、LE14-A0001 new_quoteapplyid、LE15-A0012 new_opportunity_id、LE15-A0008 new_quoteapply_id
P1-06.physicalFields: 报价申请单.new_quoteapplyid/new_oasubmitdate/new_approved_time/createdon；报价申请明细.new_opportunity_id/new_quoteapply_id；商机.opportunityid。
P1-06.notes:
用户红字：报价申请单时间进行计算，oa提交-oa审批
处理：红字“OA提交－OA审批”按办理耗时解释为审批时间减提交时间。P1-06和P3-03采用同一报价OA口径，数值相同属预期，不应相加作两份审批耗时。
P1-06.sqlStatus: 按结果动态判定（见调用SQL）；已同步红字口径
P1-06.v3Change: 按红字修订同步：实际调用SQL及计算步骤已更新；待确认项保持NULL。
P1-06.role: 跨阶段参考（不参与本节点链路）
P1-06.ctes: parameters → context → account_rows → accounts → opportunity_rows → opportunities → orders → order_line_links → signed_orders → opportunity_flags → node_quote_headers → node_quote_links → node_quote_latest → review_quote_cycle_events → review_quote_cycle_facts → review_quote_cycle_samples → review_quote_cycle_stats → review_quote_cycle_quality
P1-06.sql:
WITH parameters AS MATERIALIZED (
  SELECT
    CAST(%s AS DATE) AS start_date,
    CAST(%s AS DATE) AS end_exclusive,
    CAST(%s AS TIMESTAMP) AS observed_at,
    CAST(ARRAY['1'] AS TEXT[]) AS strategic_levels,
    CAST(ARRAY['1', '2'] AS TEXT[]) AS focus_levels,
    CAST(1000000 AS DECIMAL) AS target_power_units_per_gwh
), context AS MATERIALIZED (
  SELECT
    p.*,
    CAST((
      DATE_TRUNC('DAY', observed_at) + INTERVAL '1 DAY'
    ) AS TIMESTAMP) AS as_of_exclusive,
    LEAST(
      CAST(end_exclusive AS TIMESTAMP),
      DATE_TRUNC('DAY', observed_at) + INTERVAL '1 DAY'
    ) AS effective_end_exclusive,
    LEAST(
      CAST(end_exclusive AS TIMESTAMP),
      DATE_TRUNC('DAY', observed_at) + INTERVAL '1 DAY'
    ) - INTERVAL '1 MICROSECOND' AS cutoff,
    MAKE_DATE(CAST(EXTRACT(YEAR FROM start_date) AS INT), 1, 1) AS year_start,
    MAKE_DATE(CAST(EXTRACT(YEAR FROM start_date) AS INT) + 1, 1, 1) AS next_year_start,
    GREATEST(
      CAST(0 AS DECIMAL),
      LEAST(
        CAST(1 AS DECIMAL),
        CAST((
          CAST(LEAST(
            CAST(end_exclusive AS TIMESTAMP),
            DATE_TRUNC('DAY', observed_at) + INTERVAL '1 DAY'
          ) AS DATE) - MAKE_DATE(CAST(EXTRACT(YEAR FROM start_date) AS INT), 1, 1)
        ) AS DECIMAL) / (
          MAKE_DATE(CAST(EXTRACT(YEAR FROM start_date) AS INT) + 1, 1, 1) - MAKE_DATE(CAST(EXTRACT(YEAR FROM start_date) AS INT), 1, 1)
        )
      )
    ) AS time_progress
  FROM parameters AS p
), account_rows AS MATERIALIZED (
  SELECT
    CAST(a.accountid AS TEXT) AS account_id,
    CAST(a.name AS TEXT) AS account_name,
    CAST(a.new_accountlevel AS TEXT) AS level_code,
    CAST(a.new_sapdate AS TIMESTAMP) AS sap_created_at,
    CAST(a.new_sapsubmitdate AS TIMESTAMP) AS sap_submitted_at,
    CAST(a.new_approved_time_facreview AS TIMESTAMP) AS account_factory_approved_at,
    CAST(a.new_submit_time_facreview AS TIMESTAMP) AS account_factory_submitted_at,
    CAST(a.new_sinosurestartdate AS TIMESTAMP) AS account_sinosure_start,
    CAST(a.new_sinosureenddate AS TIMESTAMP) AS account_sinosure_end,
    CAST(a.new_submit_time_accredit AS TIMESTAMP) AS account_credit_submitted_at,
    CAST(a.new_approvaltime_accredit AS TIMESTAMP) AS account_credit_approved_at,
    CAST(a.new_cdastartdate AS TIMESTAMP) AS account_cda_start,
    CAST(a.new_cdaenddate AS TIMESTAMP) AS account_cda_end,
    CAST(a.new_cda_submittime AS TIMESTAMP) AS account_cda_submitted_at,
    CAST(a.new_cda_approved_time AS TIMESTAMP) AS account_cda_approved_at,
    CAST(a.new_approvalstatus_facreview AS TEXT) AS account_factory_approval_status,
    CAST(a.new_sapcode AS TEXT) AS sap_code,
    CAST(a.new_issap AS TEXT) AS sap_registered,
    CAST(a.new_issapnew AS TEXT) AS sap_registration_kind,
    ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
      PARTITION BY a.accountid
      ORDER BY a.modifiedon DESC NULLS LAST, a.createdon DESC NULLS LAST
    ) AS rn
  FROM (
    SELECT
      __x360_raw.*
    FROM ded_public.p_fm_edw_v_ods_crm_account_esb AS __x360_raw
    CROSS JOIN context AS __x360_ctx
    WHERE
      CAST(__x360_raw.createdon AS TIMESTAMP) < __x360_ctx.as_of_exclusive
  ) AS a
  WHERE
    NULLIF(TRIM(CAST(a.accountid AS TEXT)), '') IS NOT NULL
), accounts AS MATERIALIZED (
  SELECT
    account_id,
    account_name,
    level_code,
    sap_created_at,
    sap_submitted_at,
    account_factory_approved_at,
    account_factory_submitted_at,
    account_sinosure_start,
    account_sinosure_end,
    account_credit_submitted_at,
    account_credit_approved_at,
    account_cda_start,
    account_cda_end,
    account_cda_submitted_at,
    account_cda_approved_at,
    account_factory_approval_status,
    sap_code,
    sap_registered,
    sap_registration_kind
  FROM account_rows
  WHERE
    rn = 1
), opportunity_rows AS MATERIALIZED (
  SELECT
    ranked.*
  FROM (
    SELECT
      CAST(o.opportunityid AS TEXT) AS opportunity_id,
      CAST(o.parentaccountid AS TEXT) AS account_id,
      CAST(o.name AS TEXT) AS project_name,
      CAST(o.ownerid AS TEXT) AS owner_id,
      CASE
        WHEN CAST(o.new_accproducttype AS TEXT) IN ('1', '电芯')
        THEN '电芯'
        WHEN CAST(o.new_accproducttype AS TEXT) IN ('2', 'PACK')
        THEN 'PACK'
        ELSE '其他'
      END AS product_type,
      o.__x360_asof_process_stage AS process_stage,
      CAST(o.statecode AS TEXT) AS system_state,
      CAST(o.new_demandinput AS TEXT) AS demand_status,
      CAST(o.createdon AS TIMESTAMP) AS created_at,
      CAST(o.new_stage1enddate AS TIMESTAMP) AS s1,
      CAST(o.new_stage2enddate AS TIMESTAMP) AS s2,
      CAST(o.new_stage3enddate AS TIMESTAMP) AS s3,
      CAST(o.new_stage4enddate AS TIMESTAMP) AS s4,
      CAST(o.new_stage5enddate AS TIMESTAMP) AS s5,
      CAST(o.new_cdastartdate AS TIMESTAMP) AS new_cdastartdate,
      CAST(o.new_cdaenddate AS TIMESTAMP) AS new_cdaenddate,
      CAST(o.new_approved_time_acneed AS TIMESTAMP) AS new_approved_time_acneed,
      CAST(o.new_submit_time_acneed AS TIMESTAMP) AS new_submit_time_acneed,
      CAST(o.new_approved_time_projectassess AS TIMESTAMP) AS new_approved_time_projectassess,
      CAST(o.new_submit_time_projectassess AS TIMESTAMP) AS new_submit_time_projectassess,
      CAST(o.new_sampletestpass_time AS TIMESTAMP) AS new_sampletestpass_time,
      CAST(o.new_sampletime AS TIMESTAMP) AS new_sampletime,
      CAST(o.new_technicalsigningdate AS TIMESTAMP) AS new_technicalsigningdate,
      CAST(o.new_submit_time_techcon AS TIMESTAMP) AS new_submit_time_techcon,
      CAST(o.new_warrantysigningdate AS TIMESTAMP) AS new_warrantysigningdate,
      CAST(o.new_submit_time_qsl AS TIMESTAMP) AS new_submit_time_qsl,
      CAST(o.new_isneedcda AS TEXT) AS new_isneedcda,
      CAST(o.new_approvalstatus_acneed AS TEXT) AS new_approvalstatus_acneed,
      CAST(o.new_approvalstatus_projectassess AS TEXT) AS new_approvalstatus_projectassess,
      CAST(o.new_approvalstatus_techcon AS TEXT) AS new_approvalstatus_techcon,
      CAST(o.new_approvalstatus_qsl AS TEXT) AS new_approvalstatus_qsl,
      CAST(o.new_sampletestresult AS TEXT) AS new_sampletestresult,
      ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
        PARTITION BY o.opportunityid
        ORDER BY o.modifiedon DESC NULLS LAST, o.createdon DESC NULLS LAST
      ) AS rn
    FROM (
      SELECT
        __x360_raw.*,
        CASE
          WHEN CAST(__x360_raw.new_stage1enddate AS TIMESTAMP) IS NULL
          OR CAST(__x360_raw.new_stage1enddate AS TIMESTAMP) >= __x360_ctx.as_of_exclusive
          THEN '11'
          WHEN CAST(__x360_raw.new_stage2enddate AS TIMESTAMP) IS NULL
          OR CAST(__x360_raw.new_stage2enddate AS TIMESTAMP) >= __x360_ctx.as_of_exclusive
          THEN '12'
          WHEN CAST(__x360_raw.new_stage3enddate AS TIMESTAMP) IS NULL
          OR CAST(__x360_raw.new_stage3enddate AS TIMESTAMP) >= __x360_ctx.as_of_exclusive
          THEN '13'
          WHEN CAST(__x360_raw.new_stage4enddate AS TIMESTAMP) IS NULL
          OR CAST(__x360_raw.new_stage4enddate AS TIMESTAMP) >= __x360_ctx.as_of_exclusive
          THEN '14'
          WHEN CAST(__x360_raw.new_stage5enddate AS TIMESTAMP) IS NULL
          OR CAST(__x360_raw.new_stage5enddate AS TIMESTAMP) >= __x360_ctx.as_of_exclusive
          THEN '15'
          ELSE 'completed'
        END AS __x360_asof_process_stage
      FROM ded_public.p_fm_edw_v_ods_crm_opportunity_esb AS __x360_raw
      CROSS JOIN context AS __x360_ctx
    ) AS o
    WHERE
      NULLIF(TRIM(CAST(o.opportunityid AS TEXT)), '') IS NOT NULL
  ) AS ranked
  CROSS JOIN context AS p
  WHERE
    ranked.created_at < p.as_of_exclusive
), opportunities AS MATERIALIZED (
  SELECT
    o.opportunity_id,
    o.account_id,
    o.project_name,
    o.owner_id,
    o.product_type,
    o.process_stage,
    o.demand_status,
    o.created_at,
    o.s1,
    o.s2,
    o.s3,
    o.s4,
    o.s5,
    a.account_name,
    a.level_code,
    o.new_cdastartdate,
    o.new_cdaenddate,
    o.new_approved_time_acneed,
    o.new_submit_time_acneed,
    o.new_approved_time_projectassess,
    o.new_submit_time_projectassess,
    o.new_sampletestpass_time,
    o.new_sampletime,
    o.new_technicalsigningdate,
    o.new_submit_time_techcon,
    o.new_warrantysigningdate,
    o.new_submit_time_qsl,
    o.new_isneedcda,
    o.new_approvalstatus_acneed,
    o.new_approvalstatus_projectassess,
    o.new_approvalstatus_techcon,
    o.new_approvalstatus_qsl,
    o.new_sampletestresult,
    a.sap_created_at,
    a.sap_submitted_at,
    a.sap_code,
    a.account_factory_approved_at,
    a.account_factory_submitted_at,
    a.account_sinosure_start,
    a.account_sinosure_end,
    a.account_credit_submitted_at,
    a.account_credit_approved_at,
    a.account_cda_start,
    a.account_cda_end,
    a.account_cda_submitted_at,
    a.account_cda_approved_at,
    a.account_factory_approval_status
  FROM opportunity_rows AS o
  LEFT JOIN accounts AS a
    USING (account_id)
  CROSS JOIN context AS p
  WHERE
    o.rn = 1 AND (
      o.created_at < p.as_of_exclusive
    )
), orders AS MATERIALIZED (
  SELECT DISTINCT
    CAST(salesorderid AS TEXT) AS order_id
  FROM ded_public.p_fm_edw_v_ods_crm_salesorder_esb
  WHERE
    NULLIF(TRIM(CAST(salesorderid AS TEXT)), '') IS NOT NULL
), order_line_links AS MATERIALIZED (
  SELECT DISTINCT
    CAST(l.new_opportunity_id AS TEXT) AS opportunity_id,
    CAST(l.salesorderid AS TEXT) AS order_id
  FROM ded_public.p_fm_edw_v_ods_crm_salesorderdetail_esb AS l
  WHERE
    NULLIF(TRIM(CAST(l.new_opportunity_id AS TEXT)), '') IS NOT NULL
    AND NULLIF(TRIM(CAST(l.salesorderid AS TEXT)), '') IS NOT NULL
), signed_orders AS MATERIALIZED (
  SELECT
    l.opportunity_id,
    COUNT(DISTINCT l.order_id) AS order_count
  FROM order_line_links AS l
  JOIN orders AS o
    USING (order_id)
  GROUP BY
    l.opportunity_id
), opportunity_flags AS MATERIALIZED (
  SELECT
    o.*,
    COALESCE(s.order_count, 0) AS order_count,
    CASE
      WHEN COALESCE(s.order_count, 0) = 0
      THEN FALSE
      WHEN o.s4 IS NULL
      THEN FALSE
      ELSE o.s4 < p.as_of_exclusive
    END AS signed,
    (
      COALESCE(s.order_count, 0) > 0 AND o.s4 IS NULL
    ) AS missing_p3_end
  FROM opportunities AS o
  LEFT JOIN signed_orders AS s
    USING (opportunity_id)
  CROSS JOIN context AS p
), node_quote_headers AS MATERIALIZED (
  SELECT
    CAST(q.new_quoteapplyid AS TEXT) AS quote_id,
    CAST(q.createdon AS TIMESTAMP) AS created_at,
    CAST(q.new_oasubmitdate AS TIMESTAMP) AS submitted_at,
    CAST(q.new_approved_time AS TIMESTAMP) AS approved_at,
    CAST(q.new_approvalstatus AS TEXT) AS approval_status
  FROM ded_public.p_fm_edw_v_ods_crm_new_quoteapply_esb AS q
  WHERE
    q.new_quoteapplyid IS NOT NULL
), node_quote_links AS MATERIALIZED (
  SELECT DISTINCT
    CAST(d.new_opportunity_id AS TEXT) AS opportunity_id,
    CAST(d.new_quoteapply_id AS TEXT) AS quote_id
  FROM ded_public.p_fm_edw_v_ods_crm_new_quoteapplydetail_esb AS d
  WHERE
    NULLIF(TRIM(CAST(d.new_opportunity_id AS TEXT)), '') IS NOT NULL
    AND NULLIF(TRIM(CAST(d.new_quoteapply_id AS TEXT)), '') IS NOT NULL
), node_quote_latest AS MATERIALIZED (
  SELECT
    opportunity_id,
    quote_id,
    submitted_at,
    approved_at,
    approval_status
  FROM (
    SELECT
      o.opportunity_id,
      q.quote_id,
      q.submitted_at,
      q.approved_at,
      q.approval_status,
      ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
        PARTITION BY o.opportunity_id
        ORDER BY q.created_at DESC NULLS LAST, q.quote_id DESC
      ) AS rn
    FROM opportunity_flags AS o
    JOIN node_quote_links AS l
      USING (opportunity_id)
    JOIN node_quote_headers AS q
      USING (quote_id)
    CROSS JOIN context AS p
    WHERE
      q.created_at <= p.cutoff
  ) AS ranked
  WHERE
    rn = 1
), review_quote_cycle_events AS MATERIALIZED (
  SELECT
    CAST('QUOTE_OA' AS TEXT) AS kind,
    q.quote_id AS event_id,
    o.product_type,
    q.submitted_at AS started_at,
    q.approved_at AS finished_at,
    q.approved_at AS period_at
  FROM opportunity_flags AS o
  JOIN node_quote_latest AS q
    USING (opportunity_id)
), review_quote_cycle_facts AS MATERIALIZED (
  SELECT
    r.*,
    p.cutoff,
    CASE
      WHEN r.finished_at >= p.start_date
      AND r.finished_at < p.effective_end_exclusive
      AND r.event_id IS NOT NULL
      AND r.started_at IS NOT NULL
      AND r.finished_at >= r.started_at
      THEN EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM (
        r.finished_at - r.started_at
      )) / CAST(86400 AS DECIMAL)
    END AS duration_days
  FROM review_quote_cycle_events AS r
  CROSS JOIN context AS p
), review_quote_cycle_samples AS MATERIALIZED (
  SELECT DISTINCT
    kind,
    event_id,
    product_type,
    duration_days
  FROM review_quote_cycle_facts
  WHERE
    duration_days IS NOT NULL
  UNION ALL
  SELECT DISTINCT
    kind,
    event_id,
    '全部',
    duration_days
  FROM review_quote_cycle_facts
  WHERE
    duration_days IS NOT NULL
), review_quote_cycle_stats AS MATERIALIZED (
  SELECT
    kind,
    product_type,
    COUNT(*) AS sample_count,
    AVG(duration_days) AS mean_days
  FROM review_quote_cycle_samples
  GROUP BY
    kind,
    product_type
), review_quote_cycle_quality AS MATERIALIZED (
  SELECT
    kind,
    COUNT(*) AS source_rows,
    COUNT(*) FILTER(WHERE
      started_at IS NULL) AS missing_start_rows,
    COUNT(*) FILTER(WHERE
      finished_at IS NULL) AS missing_end_rows,
    COUNT(*) FILTER(WHERE
      finished_at < started_at) AS reversed_rows,
    COUNT(*) FILTER(WHERE
      duration_days IS NOT NULL) AS valid_linked_rows
  FROM review_quote_cycle_facts
  GROUP BY
    kind
), metric_results AS MATERIALIZED (
  SELECT
    35 AS sort_no,
    CAST('P1-06' AS TEXT) AS code,
    CAST('报价管理平均周期' AS TEXT) AS metric_name,
    CAST(NULL AS TEXT) AS product_team,
    CAST(NULL AS DECIMAL) AS amount_yi,
    CAST(NULL AS DECIMAL) AS energy_gwh,
    CAST(COALESCE(s.sample_count, 0) AS BIGINT) AS item_count,
    CAST(NULL AS DECIMAL) AS ratio_value,
    CAST(s.mean_days AS DECIMAL) AS days_value,
    CAST(CASE WHEN s.sample_count > 0 THEN '已按用户红字口径计算' ELSE '口径已修改；所选期间无有效起止配对' END AS TEXT) AS status,
    CAST('报价申请单.new_approved_time－new_oasubmitdate，按报价申请ID去重后取平均，换算天。 通过报价申请明细关联商机，沿用当前最新关联报价申请；按OA审批时间归年/月。必须有真实提交和审批时间，不额外添加审核枚举过滤。 红字“OA提交－OA审批”按办理耗时解释为审批时间减提交时间。P1-06和P3-03采用同一报价OA口径，数值相同属预期，不应相加作两份审批耗时。' AS TEXT) AS note,
    JSONB_BUILD_OBJECT(
      '产品分组',
      (
        SELECT
          JSONB_AGG(TO_JSONB(v))
        FROM review_quote_cycle_stats AS v
        WHERE
          v.kind = 'QUOTE_OA'
      ),
      '输入质量',
      (
        SELECT
          TO_JSONB(q)
        FROM review_quote_cycle_quality AS q
        WHERE
          q.kind = 'QUOTE_OA'
      ),
      '阶段回退',
      '已停用'
    ) AS detail
  FROM context AS p
  LEFT JOIN review_quote_cycle_stats AS s
    ON s.kind = 'QUOTE_OA' AND s.product_type = '全部'
)
SELECT
  r.code AS "指标序号",
  r.metric_name AS "指标名称",
  r.product_team AS "产品团队",
  p.start_date AS "期间开始",
  p.end_exclusive AS "期间结束不含",
  p.cutoff AS "周期观察截止",
  r.amount_yi AS "金额_亿元",
  r.energy_gwh AS "电量_GWh",
  r.item_count AS "数量",
  r.ratio_value AS "比率_原始小数",
  r.days_value AS "平均周期_天",
  CASE
    WHEN r.status = '查询已实现；缺失输入及部分合计见明细'
    THEN CASE
      WHEN r.amount_yi IS NOT NULL
      OR r.energy_gwh IS NOT NULL
      OR r.item_count IS NOT NULL
      OR r.ratio_value IS NOT NULL
      OR r.days_value IS NOT NULL
      THEN '已有查询结果；完整性与适用列见明细'
      ELSE '没有可计算结果；检查输入、时间及关联范围'
    END
    ELSE r.status
  END AS "计算说明状态",
  r.note AS "取值说明",
  r.detail AS "分组明细及缺口"
FROM metric_results AS r
CROSS JOIN context AS p
ORDER BY
  r.sort_no,
  r.product_team;

P1-07.name: 申请报价（P1-4-1）平均周期
P1-07.definition: 报价申请单.new_approved_time－报价申请单.new_oasubmitdate，换算天后取平均。仅完整有效已结束事件取真实结束减开始；以本环节结束时间归所选期间，未结束不计入平均。已进入后续阶段的记录也保留，不限定当前阶段枚举。
P1-07.formula:
对已实际进入本环节的有效事件计算周期；不以当前阶段枚举排除已到后续阶段的历史事件。同一事件去重，按电芯/PACK计算动态均值；单笔周期严格大于同组均值1.5倍才判超期。
阶段及普通环节按各自真实结束时间归所选期间，结束须早于MIN(end_exclusive,观察日次日)；起点可早于期初，不计未结束在途。P0～P4阶段只计起止完整且周期严格大于0的样本；普通独立环节仍沿用各自完整非逆序规则。
P1-07.attributes:
LE14-A0003 报价申请单.OA审批时间（new_approved_time，空 12.68%）
LE14-A0005 报价申请单.提交OA审核时间（new_oasubmitdate，空 12.68%）
P1-07.physicalFields:
开始：报价申请单.new_oasubmitdate
结束：报价申请单.new_approved_time
样本去重：报价申请单ID
P1-07.notes: 通过报价明细关联商机，沿用每商机截至观察日最新申请选择；同一申请关联多商机时总体只计一次。无需审批的完成事件未定义，不用创建时间冒充完成时间。 总体按真实事件去重；缺起止数据与缺字段映射分开列示。分组样本不可直接相加。
P1-07.sqlStatus: 按结果动态判定（见 SQL 中 status 的 CASE）
P1-07.role: 跨阶段参考（不参与本节点链路）
P1-07.ctes: parameters → context → account_rows → accounts → opportunity_rows → opportunities → orders → order_line_links → signed_orders → opportunity_flags → node_quote_headers → node_quote_links → node_quote_latest → node_cycle_source → node_cycle_facts → node_cycle_means → event_samples → sample_stats → quality
P1-07.sql:
WITH parameters AS MATERIALIZED (
  SELECT
    CAST(%s AS DATE) AS start_date,
    CAST(%s AS DATE) AS end_exclusive,
    CAST(%s AS TIMESTAMP) AS observed_at,
    CAST(ARRAY['1'] AS TEXT[]) AS strategic_levels,
    CAST(ARRAY['1', '2'] AS TEXT[]) AS focus_levels,
    CAST(1000000 AS DECIMAL) AS target_power_units_per_gwh
), context AS MATERIALIZED (
  SELECT
    p.*,
    CAST((
      DATE_TRUNC('DAY', observed_at) + INTERVAL '1 DAY'
    ) AS TIMESTAMP) AS as_of_exclusive,
    LEAST(
      CAST(end_exclusive AS TIMESTAMP),
      DATE_TRUNC('DAY', observed_at) + INTERVAL '1 DAY'
    ) AS effective_end_exclusive,
    LEAST(
      CAST(end_exclusive AS TIMESTAMP),
      DATE_TRUNC('DAY', observed_at) + INTERVAL '1 DAY'
    ) - INTERVAL '1 MICROSECOND' AS cutoff,
    MAKE_DATE(CAST(EXTRACT(YEAR FROM start_date) AS INT), 1, 1) AS year_start,
    MAKE_DATE(CAST(EXTRACT(YEAR FROM start_date) AS INT) + 1, 1, 1) AS next_year_start,
    GREATEST(
      CAST(0 AS DECIMAL),
      LEAST(
        CAST(1 AS DECIMAL),
        CAST((
          CAST(LEAST(
            CAST(end_exclusive AS TIMESTAMP),
            DATE_TRUNC('DAY', observed_at) + INTERVAL '1 DAY'
          ) AS DATE) - MAKE_DATE(CAST(EXTRACT(YEAR FROM start_date) AS INT), 1, 1)
        ) AS DECIMAL) / (
          MAKE_DATE(CAST(EXTRACT(YEAR FROM start_date) AS INT) + 1, 1, 1) - MAKE_DATE(CAST(EXTRACT(YEAR FROM start_date) AS INT), 1, 1)
        )
      )
    ) AS time_progress
  FROM parameters AS p
), account_rows AS MATERIALIZED (
  SELECT
    CAST(a.accountid AS TEXT) AS account_id,
    CAST(a.name AS TEXT) AS account_name,
    CAST(a.new_accountlevel AS TEXT) AS level_code,
    CAST(a.new_sapdate AS TIMESTAMP) AS sap_created_at,
    CAST(a.new_sapsubmitdate AS TIMESTAMP) AS sap_submitted_at,
    CAST(a.new_approved_time_facreview AS TIMESTAMP) AS account_factory_approved_at,
    CAST(a.new_submit_time_facreview AS TIMESTAMP) AS account_factory_submitted_at,
    CAST(a.new_sinosurestartdate AS TIMESTAMP) AS account_sinosure_start,
    CAST(a.new_sinosureenddate AS TIMESTAMP) AS account_sinosure_end,
    CAST(a.new_submit_time_accredit AS TIMESTAMP) AS account_credit_submitted_at,
    CAST(a.new_approvaltime_accredit AS TIMESTAMP) AS account_credit_approved_at,
    CAST(a.new_cdastartdate AS TIMESTAMP) AS account_cda_start,
    CAST(a.new_cdaenddate AS TIMESTAMP) AS account_cda_end,
    CAST(a.new_cda_submittime AS TIMESTAMP) AS account_cda_submitted_at,
    CAST(a.new_cda_approved_time AS TIMESTAMP) AS account_cda_approved_at,
    CAST(a.new_approvalstatus_facreview AS TEXT) AS account_factory_approval_status,
    CAST(a.new_sapcode AS TEXT) AS sap_code,
    CAST(a.new_issap AS TEXT) AS sap_registered,
    CAST(a.new_issapnew AS TEXT) AS sap_registration_kind,
    ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
      PARTITION BY a.accountid
      ORDER BY a.modifiedon DESC NULLS LAST, a.createdon DESC NULLS LAST
    ) AS rn
  FROM (
    SELECT
      __x360_raw.*
    FROM ded_public.p_fm_edw_v_ods_crm_account_esb AS __x360_raw
    CROSS JOIN context AS __x360_ctx
    WHERE
      CAST(__x360_raw.createdon AS TIMESTAMP) < __x360_ctx.as_of_exclusive
  ) AS a
  WHERE
    NULLIF(TRIM(CAST(a.accountid AS TEXT)), '') IS NOT NULL
), accounts AS MATERIALIZED (
  SELECT
    account_id,
    account_name,
    level_code,
    sap_created_at,
    sap_submitted_at,
    account_factory_approved_at,
    account_factory_submitted_at,
    account_sinosure_start,
