    account_sinosure_end,
    account_credit_submitted_at,
    account_credit_approved_at,
    account_cda_start,
    account_cda_end,
    account_cda_submitted_at,
    account_cda_approved_at,
    account_factory_approval_status,
    sap_code,
    sap_registered,
    sap_registration_kind
  FROM account_rows
  WHERE
    rn = 1
), opportunity_rows AS MATERIALIZED (
  SELECT
    ranked.*
  FROM (
    SELECT
      CAST(o.opportunityid AS TEXT) AS opportunity_id,
      CAST(o.parentaccountid AS TEXT) AS account_id,
      CAST(o.name AS TEXT) AS project_name,
      CAST(o.ownerid AS TEXT) AS owner_id,
      CASE
        WHEN CAST(o.new_accproducttype AS TEXT) IN ('1', '电芯')
        THEN '电芯'
        WHEN CAST(o.new_accproducttype AS TEXT) IN ('2', 'PACK')
        THEN 'PACK'
        ELSE '其他'
      END AS product_type,
      o.__x360_asof_process_stage AS process_stage,
      CAST(o.statecode AS TEXT) AS system_state,
      CAST(o.new_demandinput AS TEXT) AS demand_status,
      CAST(o.createdon AS TIMESTAMP) AS created_at,
      CAST(o.new_stage1enddate AS TIMESTAMP) AS s1,
      CAST(o.new_stage2enddate AS TIMESTAMP) AS s2,
      CAST(o.new_stage3enddate AS TIMESTAMP) AS s3,
      CAST(o.new_stage4enddate AS TIMESTAMP) AS s4,
      CAST(o.new_stage5enddate AS TIMESTAMP) AS s5,
      CAST(o.new_cdastartdate AS TIMESTAMP) AS new_cdastartdate,
      CAST(o.new_cdaenddate AS TIMESTAMP) AS new_cdaenddate,
      CAST(o.new_approved_time_acneed AS TIMESTAMP) AS new_approved_time_acneed,
      CAST(o.new_submit_time_acneed AS TIMESTAMP) AS new_submit_time_acneed,
      CAST(o.new_approved_time_projectassess AS TIMESTAMP) AS new_approved_time_projectassess,
      CAST(o.new_submit_time_projectassess AS TIMESTAMP) AS new_submit_time_projectassess,
      CAST(o.new_sampletestpass_time AS TIMESTAMP) AS new_sampletestpass_time,
      CAST(o.new_sampletime AS TIMESTAMP) AS new_sampletime,
      CAST(o.new_technicalsigningdate AS TIMESTAMP) AS new_technicalsigningdate,
      CAST(o.new_submit_time_techcon AS TIMESTAMP) AS new_submit_time_techcon,
      CAST(o.new_warrantysigningdate AS TIMESTAMP) AS new_warrantysigningdate,
      CAST(o.new_submit_time_qsl AS TIMESTAMP) AS new_submit_time_qsl,
      CAST(o.new_isneedcda AS TEXT) AS new_isneedcda,
      CAST(o.new_approvalstatus_acneed AS TEXT) AS new_approvalstatus_acneed,
      CAST(o.new_approvalstatus_projectassess AS TEXT) AS new_approvalstatus_projectassess,
      CAST(o.new_approvalstatus_techcon AS TEXT) AS new_approvalstatus_techcon,
      CAST(o.new_approvalstatus_qsl AS TEXT) AS new_approvalstatus_qsl,
      CAST(o.new_sampletestresult AS TEXT) AS new_sampletestresult,
      ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
        PARTITION BY o.opportunityid
        ORDER BY o.modifiedon DESC NULLS LAST, o.createdon DESC NULLS LAST
      ) AS rn
    FROM (
      SELECT
        __x360_raw.*,
        CASE
          WHEN CAST(__x360_raw.new_stage1enddate AS TIMESTAMP) IS NULL
          OR CAST(__x360_raw.new_stage1enddate AS TIMESTAMP) >= __x360_ctx.as_of_exclusive
          THEN '11'
          WHEN CAST(__x360_raw.new_stage2enddate AS TIMESTAMP) IS NULL
          OR CAST(__x360_raw.new_stage2enddate AS TIMESTAMP) >= __x360_ctx.as_of_exclusive
          THEN '12'
          WHEN CAST(__x360_raw.new_stage3enddate AS TIMESTAMP) IS NULL
          OR CAST(__x360_raw.new_stage3enddate AS TIMESTAMP) >= __x360_ctx.as_of_exclusive
          THEN '13'
          WHEN CAST(__x360_raw.new_stage4enddate AS TIMESTAMP) IS NULL
          OR CAST(__x360_raw.new_stage4enddate AS TIMESTAMP) >= __x360_ctx.as_of_exclusive
          THEN '14'
          WHEN CAST(__x360_raw.new_stage5enddate AS TIMESTAMP) IS NULL
          OR CAST(__x360_raw.new_stage5enddate AS TIMESTAMP) >= __x360_ctx.as_of_exclusive
          THEN '15'
          ELSE 'completed'
        END AS __x360_asof_process_stage
      FROM ded_public.p_fm_edw_v_ods_crm_opportunity_esb AS __x360_raw
      CROSS JOIN context AS __x360_ctx
    ) AS o
    WHERE
      NULLIF(TRIM(CAST(o.opportunityid AS TEXT)), '') IS NOT NULL
  ) AS ranked
  CROSS JOIN context AS p
  WHERE
    ranked.created_at < p.as_of_exclusive
), opportunities AS MATERIALIZED (
  SELECT
    o.opportunity_id,
    o.account_id,
    o.project_name,
    o.owner_id,
    o.product_type,
    o.process_stage,
    o.demand_status,
    o.created_at,
    o.s1,
    o.s2,
    o.s3,
    o.s4,
    o.s5,
    a.account_name,
    a.level_code,
    o.new_cdastartdate,
    o.new_cdaenddate,
    o.new_approved_time_acneed,
    o.new_submit_time_acneed,
    o.new_approved_time_projectassess,
    o.new_submit_time_projectassess,
    o.new_sampletestpass_time,
    o.new_sampletime,
    o.new_technicalsigningdate,
    o.new_submit_time_techcon,
    o.new_warrantysigningdate,
    o.new_submit_time_qsl,
    o.new_isneedcda,
    o.new_approvalstatus_acneed,
    o.new_approvalstatus_projectassess,
    o.new_approvalstatus_techcon,
    o.new_approvalstatus_qsl,
    o.new_sampletestresult,
    a.sap_created_at,
    a.sap_submitted_at,
    a.sap_code,
    a.account_factory_approved_at,
    a.account_factory_submitted_at,
    a.account_sinosure_start,
    a.account_sinosure_end,
    a.account_credit_submitted_at,
    a.account_credit_approved_at,
    a.account_cda_start,
    a.account_cda_end,
    a.account_cda_submitted_at,
    a.account_cda_approved_at,
    a.account_factory_approval_status
  FROM opportunity_rows AS o
  LEFT JOIN accounts AS a
    USING (account_id)
  CROSS JOIN context AS p
  WHERE
    o.rn = 1 AND (
      o.created_at < p.as_of_exclusive
    )
), orders AS MATERIALIZED (
  SELECT DISTINCT
    CAST(salesorderid AS TEXT) AS order_id
  FROM ded_public.p_fm_edw_v_ods_crm_salesorder_esb
  WHERE
    NULLIF(TRIM(CAST(salesorderid AS TEXT)), '') IS NOT NULL
), order_line_links AS MATERIALIZED (
  SELECT DISTINCT
    CAST(l.new_opportunity_id AS TEXT) AS opportunity_id,
    CAST(l.salesorderid AS TEXT) AS order_id
  FROM ded_public.p_fm_edw_v_ods_crm_salesorderdetail_esb AS l
  WHERE
    NULLIF(TRIM(CAST(l.new_opportunity_id AS TEXT)), '') IS NOT NULL
    AND NULLIF(TRIM(CAST(l.salesorderid AS TEXT)), '') IS NOT NULL
), signed_orders AS MATERIALIZED (
  SELECT
    l.opportunity_id,
    COUNT(DISTINCT l.order_id) AS order_count
  FROM order_line_links AS l
  JOIN orders AS o
    USING (order_id)
  GROUP BY
    l.opportunity_id
), opportunity_flags AS MATERIALIZED (
  SELECT
    o.*,
    COALESCE(s.order_count, 0) AS order_count,
    CASE
      WHEN COALESCE(s.order_count, 0) = 0
      THEN FALSE
      WHEN o.s4 IS NULL
      THEN FALSE
      ELSE o.s4 < p.as_of_exclusive
    END AS signed,
    (
      COALESCE(s.order_count, 0) > 0 AND o.s4 IS NULL
    ) AS missing_p3_end
  FROM opportunities AS o
  LEFT JOIN signed_orders AS s
    USING (opportunity_id)
  CROSS JOIN context AS p
), node_quote_headers AS MATERIALIZED (
  SELECT
    CAST(q.new_quoteapplyid AS TEXT) AS quote_id,
    CAST(q.createdon AS TIMESTAMP) AS created_at,
    CAST(q.new_oasubmitdate AS TIMESTAMP) AS submitted_at,
    CAST(q.new_approved_time AS TIMESTAMP) AS approved_at,
    CAST(q.new_approvalstatus AS TEXT) AS approval_status
  FROM ded_public.p_fm_edw_v_ods_crm_new_quoteapply_esb AS q
  WHERE
    q.new_quoteapplyid IS NOT NULL
), node_quote_links AS MATERIALIZED (
  SELECT DISTINCT
    CAST(d.new_opportunity_id AS TEXT) AS opportunity_id,
    CAST(d.new_quoteapply_id AS TEXT) AS quote_id
  FROM ded_public.p_fm_edw_v_ods_crm_new_quoteapplydetail_esb AS d
  WHERE
    NULLIF(TRIM(CAST(d.new_opportunity_id AS TEXT)), '') IS NOT NULL
    AND NULLIF(TRIM(CAST(d.new_quoteapply_id AS TEXT)), '') IS NOT NULL
), node_quote_latest AS MATERIALIZED (
  SELECT
    opportunity_id,
    quote_id,
    submitted_at,
    approved_at,
    approval_status
  FROM (
    SELECT
      o.opportunity_id,
      q.quote_id,
      q.submitted_at,
      q.approved_at,
      q.approval_status,
      ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
        PARTITION BY o.opportunity_id
        ORDER BY q.created_at DESC NULLS LAST, q.quote_id DESC
      ) AS rn
    FROM opportunity_flags AS o
    JOIN node_quote_links AS l
      USING (opportunity_id)
    JOIN node_quote_headers AS q
      USING (quote_id)
    CROSS JOIN context AS p
    WHERE
      q.created_at <= p.cutoff
  ) AS ranked
  WHERE
    rn = 1
), node_cycle_source AS MATERIALIZED (
  SELECT
    o.opportunity_id,
    o.product_type,
    n.metric_code,
    n.phase_code,
    n.started_at,
    n.finished_at,
    n.entered_at,
    n.active_flag,
    n.event_id,
    n.finished_at >= p.start_date AND n.finished_at < p.effective_end_exclusive AS in_window,
    p.cutoff
  FROM opportunity_flags AS o
  LEFT JOIN node_quote_latest AS q
    USING (opportunity_id)
  CROSS JOIN context AS p
  CROSS JOIN LATERAL (
    VALUES
      (
        CAST('P0-03' AS TEXT),
        CAST('P0' AS TEXT),
        o.new_cdastartdate,
        o.new_cdaenddate,
        o.new_cdastartdate,
        COALESCE((
          o.new_isneedcda = '2'
        ), FALSE),
        CAST((
          o.opportunity_id
        ) AS TEXT)
      ),
      (
        CAST('P0-04' AS TEXT),
        CAST('P0' AS TEXT),
        o.new_submit_time_acneed,
        o.new_approved_time_acneed,
        o.new_submit_time_acneed,
        COALESCE((
          o.new_approvalstatus_acneed = '2'
        ), FALSE),
        CAST((
          o.opportunity_id
        ) AS TEXT)
      ),
      (
        CAST('P0-06' AS TEXT),
        CAST('P0' AS TEXT),
        o.new_submit_time_acneed,
        o.new_approved_time_acneed,
        o.new_submit_time_acneed,
        COALESCE((
          o.new_approvalstatus_acneed = '2'
        ), FALSE),
        CAST((
          o.opportunity_id
        ) AS TEXT)
      ),
      (
        CAST('P1-03' AS TEXT),
        CAST('P1' AS TEXT),
        o.account_factory_submitted_at,
        o.account_factory_approved_at,
        o.account_factory_submitted_at,
        COALESCE((
          o.account_factory_approval_status = '2'
        ), FALSE),
        CAST((
          o.account_id
        ) AS TEXT)
      ),
      (
        CAST('P1-04' AS TEXT),
        CAST('P1' AS TEXT),
        o.new_submit_time_projectassess,
        o.new_approved_time_projectassess,
        o.new_submit_time_projectassess,
        COALESCE((
          o.new_approvalstatus_projectassess = '2'
        ), FALSE),
        CAST((
          o.opportunity_id
        ) AS TEXT)
      ),
      (
        CAST('P1-05' AS TEXT),
        CAST('P1' AS TEXT),
        o.new_sampletime,
        o.new_sampletestpass_time,
        o.new_sampletime,
        COALESCE((
          o.new_sampletestresult IS NULL
        ), FALSE),
        CAST((
          o.opportunity_id
        ) AS TEXT)
      ),
      (
        CAST('P1-07' AS TEXT),
        CAST('P1' AS TEXT),
        q.submitted_at,
        CASE WHEN q.approval_status = '3' THEN q.approved_at END,
        q.submitted_at,
        COALESCE((
          q.approval_status = '2'
        ), FALSE),
        CAST((
          q.quote_id
        ) AS TEXT)
      ),
      (
        CAST('P2-03' AS TEXT),
        CAST('P2' AS TEXT),
        o.new_submit_time_techcon,
        o.new_technicalsigningdate,
        o.new_submit_time_techcon,
        COALESCE((
          o.new_approvalstatus_techcon = '2'
        ), FALSE),
        CAST((
          o.opportunity_id
        ) AS TEXT)
      ),
      (
        CAST('P2-04' AS TEXT),
        CAST('P2' AS TEXT),
        o.new_submit_time_qsl,
        o.new_warrantysigningdate,
        o.new_submit_time_qsl,
        COALESCE((
          o.new_approvalstatus_qsl = '2'
        ), FALSE),
        CAST((
          o.opportunity_id
        ) AS TEXT)
      )
  ) AS n(metric_code, phase_code, started_at, finished_at, entered_at, active_flag, event_id)
), node_cycle_facts AS MATERIALIZED (
  SELECT
    f.*,
    CASE
      WHEN in_window
      AND event_id IS NOT NULL
      AND started_at IS NOT NULL
      AND finished_at >= started_at
      THEN EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM (
        finished_at - started_at
      )) / CAST(86400 AS DECIMAL)
    END AS duration_days,
    (
      in_window
      AND event_id IS NOT NULL
      AND started_at IS NOT NULL
      AND finished_at >= started_at
    ) AS completed_valid,
    FALSE AS inflight_valid
  FROM node_cycle_source AS f
), node_cycle_means AS MATERIALIZED (
  WITH event_samples AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT
      metric_code,
      product_type,
      event_id,
      duration_days,
      completed_valid,
      inflight_valid
    FROM node_cycle_facts
    WHERE
      duration_days IS NOT NULL
    UNION ALL
    SELECT DISTINCT
      metric_code,
      CAST('全部' AS TEXT) AS product_type,
      event_id,
      duration_days,
      completed_valid,
      inflight_valid
    FROM node_cycle_facts
    WHERE
      duration_days IS NOT NULL
  ), sample_stats AS (
    SELECT
      metric_code,
      product_type,
      COUNT(*) AS sample_count,
      AVG(duration_days) AS mean_days,
      COUNT(*) FILTER(WHERE
        completed_valid) AS completed_count,
      COUNT(*) FILTER(WHERE
        inflight_valid) AS inflight_count
    FROM event_samples
    GROUP BY
      metric_code,
      product_type
  ), quality AS (
    SELECT
      metric_code,
      CASE WHEN GROUPING(product_type) = 1 THEN '全部' ELSE product_type END AS product_type,
      COUNT(*) AS linked_source_rows,
      COUNT(*) FILTER(WHERE
        in_window) AS entry_window_rows,
      COUNT(DISTINCT event_id) FILTER(WHERE
        in_window) AS entered_event_count,
      COUNT(*) FILTER(WHERE
        in_window AND finished_at IS NULL) AS missing_end_rows,
      COUNT(*) FILTER(WHERE
        started_at IS NULL) AS missing_start_rows,
      COUNT(*) FILTER(WHERE
        event_id IS NULL) AS missing_event_id_rows,
      COUNT(*) FILTER(WHERE
        in_window AND finished_at < started_at) AS end_before_start_rows,
      COUNT(*) FILTER(WHERE
        in_window AND finished_at > cutoff AND NOT COALESCE(inflight_valid, FALSE)) AS future_end_without_entry_proof_rows,
      COUNT(*) FILTER(WHERE
        in_window AND finished_at IS NULL AND NOT COALESCE(inflight_valid, FALSE)) AS unknown_completion_rows
    FROM node_cycle_facts
    GROUP BY
      metric_code,
      GROUPING SETS (
        (),
        (
          product_type
        )
      )
  )
  SELECT
    q.*,
    COALESCE(s.sample_count, 0) AS sample_count,
    s.mean_days,
    COALESCE(s.completed_count, 0) AS completed_count,
    COALESCE(s.inflight_count, 0) AS inflight_count
  FROM quality AS q
  LEFT JOIN sample_stats AS s
    USING (metric_code, product_type)
), metric_results AS MATERIALIZED (
  SELECT
    36 AS sort_no,
    CAST('P1-07' AS TEXT) AS code,
    CAST('申请报价（P1-4-1）平均周期' AS TEXT) AS metric_name,
    CAST(NULL AS TEXT) AS product_team,
    CAST(NULL AS DECIMAL) AS amount_yi,
    CAST(NULL AS DECIMAL) AS energy_gwh,
    CAST(n.sample_count AS BIGINT) AS item_count,
    CAST(NULL AS DECIMAL) AS ratio_value,
    CAST(n.mean_days AS DECIMAL) AS days_value,
    CAST(CASE
      WHEN n.sample_count > 0
      THEN '自身起止已映射；按真实事件去重计算'
      WHEN COALESCE(n.entry_window_rows, 0) = 0
      THEN '已映射；起始时间缺失或不在所选窗口'
      ELSE '已映射；没有有效起止配对，原因见明细'
    END AS TEXT) AS status,
    CAST('报价申请单.new_approved_time－报价申请单.new_oasubmitdate，换算天后取平均。仅完整有效已结束事件取真实结束减开始；以本环节结束时间归所选期间，未结束不计入平均。已进入后续阶段的记录也保留，不限定当前阶段枚举。 通过报价明细关联商机，沿用每商机截至观察日最新申请选择；同一申请关联多商机时总体只计一次。无需审批的完成事件未定义，不用创建时间冒充完成时间。 总体按真实事件去重；缺起止数据与缺字段映射分开列示。分组样本不可直接相加。' AS TEXT) AS note,
    (
      SELECT
        JSONB_AGG(TO_JSONB(x))
      FROM node_cycle_means AS x
      WHERE
        x.metric_code = 'P1-07'
    ) AS detail
  FROM context AS p
  LEFT JOIN node_cycle_means AS n
    ON n.metric_code = 'P1-07' AND n.product_type = '全部'
)
SELECT
  r.code AS "指标序号",
  r.metric_name AS "指标名称",
  r.product_team AS "产品团队",
  p.start_date AS "期间开始",
  p.end_exclusive AS "期间结束不含",
  p.cutoff AS "周期观察截止",
  r.amount_yi AS "金额_亿元",
  r.energy_gwh AS "电量_GWh",
  r.item_count AS "数量",
  r.ratio_value AS "比率_原始小数",
  r.days_value AS "平均周期_天",
  CASE
    WHEN r.status = '查询已实现；缺失输入及部分合计见明细'
    THEN CASE
      WHEN r.amount_yi IS NOT NULL
      OR r.energy_gwh IS NOT NULL
      OR r.item_count IS NOT NULL
      OR r.ratio_value IS NOT NULL
      OR r.days_value IS NOT NULL
      THEN '已有查询结果；完整性与适用列见明细'
      ELSE '没有可计算结果；检查输入、时间及关联范围'
    END
    ELSE r.status
  END AS "计算说明状态",
  r.note AS "取值说明",
  r.detail AS "分组明细及缺口"
FROM metric_results AS r
CROSS JOIN context AS p
ORDER BY
  r.sort_no,
  r.product_team;

P2-01.name: 方案推动阶段平均周期
P2-01.definition: P2周期＝new_stage2enddate→new_stage3enddate。仅本阶段结束时间落所选期间且截止前已结束、起止完整且周期严格大于0的商机参与平均；开始可以在2024年或更早，不按当前阶段枚举排除历史经历。
P2-01.formula: 实际平均周期仍按有效明细AVG(结束－开始)计算，总体直接按明细平均，电芯/PACK/其他分别展示；仅完整已结束且周期严格大于0的样本参与，0天、缺值及逆序不参与。不按当前阶段枚举筛样本，缺预测不排除周期样本。超期比较基线固定为P2=7.2天，同阶段所有产品共用，不随所选期间或样本均值变化；单笔周期严格>7.2×1.5天时命中对应P*-02，等于不触发。结束须落所选期间且早于观察日次日，起点可跨年，不计在途。
P2-01.attributes:
LE01-A0100 商机管理.阶段三结束日期（new_stage3enddate，空 74.35%）
LE01-A0243 商机管理.阶段二结束日期（new_stage2enddate，空 66.19%）
LE01-A0451 商机管理.项目阶段（new_processstage，空 0%）
P2-01.node: 方案推动（原因 2 引用）
P2-01.physicalFields: 商机.new_stage2enddate→new_stage3enddate；不要求当前new_processstage为本阶段枚举
P2-01.notes: 数量列＝参与实际平均周期的严格正周期样本数。缺结束只影响该阶段，不整条商机剔除；已结束的其他阶段仍可计算。实际均值仅作展示，不用作本次阶段超期/分档基线。
P2-01.sqlStatus: 查询已实现；缺失输入及部分合计见明细
P2-01.role: 总体P2周期/事件根因参考；最终分析按BR-V12取值
P2-01.ctes: parameters → context → account_rows → accounts → opportunity_rows → opportunities → orders → order_line_links → signed_orders → opportunity_flags → stage_facts → stage_means
P2-01.sql:
WITH parameters AS MATERIALIZED (
  SELECT
    CAST(%s AS DATE) AS start_date,
    CAST(%s AS DATE) AS end_exclusive,
    CAST(%s AS TIMESTAMP) AS observed_at,
    CAST(ARRAY['1'] AS TEXT[]) AS strategic_levels,
    CAST(ARRAY['1', '2'] AS TEXT[]) AS focus_levels,
    CAST(1000000 AS DECIMAL) AS target_power_units_per_gwh
), context AS MATERIALIZED (
  SELECT
    p.*,
    CAST((
      DATE_TRUNC('DAY', observed_at) + INTERVAL '1 DAY'
    ) AS TIMESTAMP) AS as_of_exclusive,
    LEAST(
      CAST(end_exclusive AS TIMESTAMP),
      DATE_TRUNC('DAY', observed_at) + INTERVAL '1 DAY'
    ) AS effective_end_exclusive,
    LEAST(
      CAST(end_exclusive AS TIMESTAMP),
      DATE_TRUNC('DAY', observed_at) + INTERVAL '1 DAY'
    ) - INTERVAL '1 MICROSECOND' AS cutoff,
    MAKE_DATE(CAST(EXTRACT(YEAR FROM start_date) AS INT), 1, 1) AS year_start,
    MAKE_DATE(CAST(EXTRACT(YEAR FROM start_date) AS INT) + 1, 1, 1) AS next_year_start,
    GREATEST(
      CAST(0 AS DECIMAL),
      LEAST(
        CAST(1 AS DECIMAL),
        CAST((
          CAST(LEAST(
            CAST(end_exclusive AS TIMESTAMP),
            DATE_TRUNC('DAY', observed_at) + INTERVAL '1 DAY'
          ) AS DATE) - MAKE_DATE(CAST(EXTRACT(YEAR FROM start_date) AS INT), 1, 1)
        ) AS DECIMAL) / (
          MAKE_DATE(CAST(EXTRACT(YEAR FROM start_date) AS INT) + 1, 1, 1) - MAKE_DATE(CAST(EXTRACT(YEAR FROM start_date) AS INT), 1, 1)
        )
      )
    ) AS time_progress
  FROM parameters AS p
), account_rows AS MATERIALIZED (
  SELECT
    CAST(a.accountid AS TEXT) AS account_id,
    CAST(a.name AS TEXT) AS account_name,
    CAST(a.new_accountlevel AS TEXT) AS level_code,
    CAST(a.new_sapdate AS TIMESTAMP) AS sap_created_at,
    CAST(a.new_sapsubmitdate AS TIMESTAMP) AS sap_submitted_at,
    CAST(a.new_approved_time_facreview AS TIMESTAMP) AS account_factory_approved_at,
    CAST(a.new_submit_time_facreview AS TIMESTAMP) AS account_factory_submitted_at,
    CAST(a.new_sinosurestartdate AS TIMESTAMP) AS account_sinosure_start,
    CAST(a.new_sinosureenddate AS TIMESTAMP) AS account_sinosure_end,
    CAST(a.new_submit_time_accredit AS TIMESTAMP) AS account_credit_submitted_at,
    CAST(a.new_approvaltime_accredit AS TIMESTAMP) AS account_credit_approved_at,
    CAST(a.new_cdastartdate AS TIMESTAMP) AS account_cda_start,
    CAST(a.new_cdaenddate AS TIMESTAMP) AS account_cda_end,
    CAST(a.new_cda_submittime AS TIMESTAMP) AS account_cda_submitted_at,
    CAST(a.new_cda_approved_time AS TIMESTAMP) AS account_cda_approved_at,
    CAST(a.new_approvalstatus_facreview AS TEXT) AS account_factory_approval_status,
    CAST(a.new_sapcode AS TEXT) AS sap_code,
    CAST(a.new_issap AS TEXT) AS sap_registered,
    CAST(a.new_issapnew AS TEXT) AS sap_registration_kind,
    ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
      PARTITION BY a.accountid
      ORDER BY a.modifiedon DESC NULLS LAST, a.createdon DESC NULLS LAST
    ) AS rn
  FROM (
    SELECT
      __x360_raw.*
    FROM ded_public.p_fm_edw_v_ods_crm_account_esb AS __x360_raw
    CROSS JOIN context AS __x360_ctx
    WHERE
      CAST(__x360_raw.createdon AS TIMESTAMP) < __x360_ctx.as_of_exclusive
  ) AS a
  WHERE
    NULLIF(TRIM(CAST(a.accountid AS TEXT)), '') IS NOT NULL
), accounts AS MATERIALIZED (
  SELECT
    account_id,
    account_name,
    level_code,
    sap_created_at,
    sap_submitted_at,
    account_factory_approved_at,
    account_factory_submitted_at,
    account_sinosure_start,
    account_sinosure_end,
    account_credit_submitted_at,
    account_credit_approved_at,
    account_cda_start,
    account_cda_end,
    account_cda_submitted_at,
    account_cda_approved_at,
    account_factory_approval_status,
    sap_code,
    sap_registered,
    sap_registration_kind
  FROM account_rows
  WHERE
    rn = 1
), opportunity_rows AS MATERIALIZED (
  SELECT
    ranked.*
  FROM (
    SELECT
      CAST(o.opportunityid AS TEXT) AS opportunity_id,
      CAST(o.parentaccountid AS TEXT) AS account_id,
      CAST(o.name AS TEXT) AS project_name,
      CAST(o.ownerid AS TEXT) AS owner_id,
      CASE
        WHEN CAST(o.new_accproducttype AS TEXT) IN ('1', '电芯')
        THEN '电芯'
        WHEN CAST(o.new_accproducttype AS TEXT) IN ('2', 'PACK')
        THEN 'PACK'
        ELSE '其他'
      END AS product_type,
      o.__x360_asof_process_stage AS process_stage,
      CAST(o.statecode AS TEXT) AS system_state,
      CAST(o.new_demandinput AS TEXT) AS demand_status,
      CAST(o.createdon AS TIMESTAMP) AS created_at,
      CAST(o.new_stage1enddate AS TIMESTAMP) AS s1,
      CAST(o.new_stage2enddate AS TIMESTAMP) AS s2,
      CAST(o.new_stage3enddate AS TIMESTAMP) AS s3,
      CAST(o.new_stage4enddate AS TIMESTAMP) AS s4,
      CAST(o.new_stage5enddate AS TIMESTAMP) AS s5,
      CAST(o.new_cdastartdate AS TIMESTAMP) AS new_cdastartdate,
      CAST(o.new_cdaenddate AS TIMESTAMP) AS new_cdaenddate,
      CAST(o.new_approved_time_acneed AS TIMESTAMP) AS new_approved_time_acneed,
      CAST(o.new_submit_time_acneed AS TIMESTAMP) AS new_submit_time_acneed,
      CAST(o.new_approved_time_projectassess AS TIMESTAMP) AS new_approved_time_projectassess,
      CAST(o.new_submit_time_projectassess AS TIMESTAMP) AS new_submit_time_projectassess,
      CAST(o.new_sampletestpass_time AS TIMESTAMP) AS new_sampletestpass_time,
      CAST(o.new_sampletime AS TIMESTAMP) AS new_sampletime,
      CAST(o.new_technicalsigningdate AS TIMESTAMP) AS new_technicalsigningdate,
      CAST(o.new_submit_time_techcon AS TIMESTAMP) AS new_submit_time_techcon,
      CAST(o.new_warrantysigningdate AS TIMESTAMP) AS new_warrantysigningdate,
      CAST(o.new_submit_time_qsl AS TIMESTAMP) AS new_submit_time_qsl,
      CAST(o.new_isneedcda AS TEXT) AS new_isneedcda,
      CAST(o.new_approvalstatus_acneed AS TEXT) AS new_approvalstatus_acneed,
      CAST(o.new_approvalstatus_projectassess AS TEXT) AS new_approvalstatus_projectassess,
      CAST(o.new_approvalstatus_techcon AS TEXT) AS new_approvalstatus_techcon,
      CAST(o.new_approvalstatus_qsl AS TEXT) AS new_approvalstatus_qsl,
      CAST(o.new_sampletestresult AS TEXT) AS new_sampletestresult,
      ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
        PARTITION BY o.opportunityid
        ORDER BY o.modifiedon DESC NULLS LAST, o.createdon DESC NULLS LAST
      ) AS rn
    FROM (
      SELECT
        __x360_raw.*,
        CASE
          WHEN CAST(__x360_raw.new_stage1enddate AS TIMESTAMP) IS NULL
          OR CAST(__x360_raw.new_stage1enddate AS TIMESTAMP) >= __x360_ctx.as_of_exclusive
          THEN '11'
          WHEN CAST(__x360_raw.new_stage2enddate AS TIMESTAMP) IS NULL
          OR CAST(__x360_raw.new_stage2enddate AS TIMESTAMP) >= __x360_ctx.as_of_exclusive
          THEN '12'
          WHEN CAST(__x360_raw.new_stage3enddate AS TIMESTAMP) IS NULL
          OR CAST(__x360_raw.new_stage3enddate AS TIMESTAMP) >= __x360_ctx.as_of_exclusive
          THEN '13'
          WHEN CAST(__x360_raw.new_stage4enddate AS TIMESTAMP) IS NULL
          OR CAST(__x360_raw.new_stage4enddate AS TIMESTAMP) >= __x360_ctx.as_of_exclusive
          THEN '14'
          WHEN CAST(__x360_raw.new_stage5enddate AS TIMESTAMP) IS NULL
          OR CAST(__x360_raw.new_stage5enddate AS TIMESTAMP) >= __x360_ctx.as_of_exclusive
          THEN '15'
          ELSE 'completed'
        END AS __x360_asof_process_stage
      FROM ded_public.p_fm_edw_v_ods_crm_opportunity_esb AS __x360_raw
      CROSS JOIN context AS __x360_ctx
    ) AS o
    WHERE
      NULLIF(TRIM(CAST(o.opportunityid AS TEXT)), '') IS NOT NULL
  ) AS ranked
  CROSS JOIN context AS p
  WHERE
    ranked.created_at < p.as_of_exclusive
), opportunities AS MATERIALIZED (
  SELECT
    o.opportunity_id,
    o.account_id,
    o.project_name,
    o.owner_id,
    o.product_type,
    o.process_stage,
    o.demand_status,
    o.created_at,
    o.s1,
    o.s2,
    o.s3,
    o.s4,
    o.s5,
    a.account_name,
    a.level_code,
    o.new_cdastartdate,
    o.new_cdaenddate,
    o.new_approved_time_acneed,
    o.new_submit_time_acneed,
    o.new_approved_time_projectassess,
    o.new_submit_time_projectassess,
    o.new_sampletestpass_time,
    o.new_sampletime,
    o.new_technicalsigningdate,
    o.new_submit_time_techcon,
    o.new_warrantysigningdate,
    o.new_submit_time_qsl,
    o.new_isneedcda,
    o.new_approvalstatus_acneed,
    o.new_approvalstatus_projectassess,
    o.new_approvalstatus_techcon,
    o.new_approvalstatus_qsl,
    o.new_sampletestresult,
    a.sap_created_at,
    a.sap_submitted_at,
    a.sap_code,
    a.account_factory_approved_at,
    a.account_factory_submitted_at,
    a.account_sinosure_start,
    a.account_sinosure_end,
    a.account_credit_submitted_at,
    a.account_credit_approved_at,
    a.account_cda_start,
    a.account_cda_end,
    a.account_cda_submitted_at,
    a.account_cda_approved_at,
    a.account_factory_approval_status
  FROM opportunity_rows AS o
  LEFT JOIN accounts AS a
    USING (account_id)
  CROSS JOIN context AS p
  WHERE
    o.rn = 1 AND (
      o.created_at < p.as_of_exclusive
    )
), orders AS MATERIALIZED (
  SELECT DISTINCT
    CAST(salesorderid AS TEXT) AS order_id
  FROM ded_public.p_fm_edw_v_ods_crm_salesorder_esb
  WHERE
    NULLIF(TRIM(CAST(salesorderid AS TEXT)), '') IS NOT NULL
), order_line_links AS MATERIALIZED (
  SELECT DISTINCT
    CAST(l.new_opportunity_id AS TEXT) AS opportunity_id,
    CAST(l.salesorderid AS TEXT) AS order_id
  FROM ded_public.p_fm_edw_v_ods_crm_salesorderdetail_esb AS l
  WHERE
    NULLIF(TRIM(CAST(l.new_opportunity_id AS TEXT)), '') IS NOT NULL
    AND NULLIF(TRIM(CAST(l.salesorderid AS TEXT)), '') IS NOT NULL
), signed_orders AS MATERIALIZED (
  SELECT
    l.opportunity_id,
    COUNT(DISTINCT l.order_id) AS order_count
  FROM order_line_links AS l
  JOIN orders AS o
    USING (order_id)
  GROUP BY
    l.opportunity_id
), opportunity_flags AS MATERIALIZED (
  SELECT
    o.*,
    COALESCE(s.order_count, 0) AS order_count,
    CASE
      WHEN COALESCE(s.order_count, 0) = 0
      THEN FALSE
      WHEN o.s4 IS NULL
      THEN FALSE
      ELSE o.s4 < p.as_of_exclusive
    END AS signed,
    (
      COALESCE(s.order_count, 0) > 0 AND o.s4 IS NULL
    ) AS missing_p3_end
  FROM opportunities AS o
  LEFT JOIN signed_orders AS s
    USING (opportunity_id)
  CROSS JOIN context AS p
), stage_facts AS MATERIALIZED (
SELECT
    o.*,
    v.stage_code,
    v.started_at,
    v.finished_at,
    CASE
      WHEN v.started_at IS NOT NULL AND v.finished_at > v.started_at
      THEN EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM (
        v.finished_at - v.started_at
      )) / CAST(86400 AS DECIMAL)
    END AS elapsed_days,
    (
      v.finished_at >= p.start_date AND v.finished_at < p.effective_end_exclusive
    ) AS in_window,
    FALSE AS inflight,
    (
      v.started_at IS NULL OR v.finished_at IS NULL OR v.finished_at <= v.started_at
    ) AS invalid_dates
  FROM opportunity_flags AS o
  CROSS JOIN context AS p
  CROSS JOIN LATERAL (
    VALUES
      (CAST('P0' AS TEXT), o.created_at, o.s1),
      (CAST('P1' AS TEXT), o.s1, o.s2),
      (CAST('P2' AS TEXT), o.s2, o.s3),
      (CAST('P3' AS TEXT), o.s3, o.s4),
      (CAST('P4' AS TEXT), o.s4, o.s5)
  ) AS v(stage_code, started_at, finished_at)
  WHERE
    v.finished_at IS NOT NULL
    AND v.finished_at >= p.start_date
    AND v.finished_at < p.effective_end_exclusive
), stage_means AS MATERIALIZED (
SELECT stage_code, product_type,
    AVG(elapsed_days) FILTER (WHERE NOT invalid_dates) AS mean_days,
    CASE stage_code
      WHEN 'P0' THEN 32.6::numeric
      WHEN 'P1' THEN 21.8::numeric
      WHEN 'P2' THEN 7.2::numeric
      WHEN 'P3' THEN 57.2::numeric
      WHEN 'P4' THEN 15.3::numeric
    END AS baseline_days,
    COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE NOT invalid_dates) AS sample_count,
    COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE invalid_dates) AS invalid_count,
    COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE finished_at = started_at) AS zero_duration_count,
    0::bigint AS inflight_count
  FROM stage_facts WHERE in_window
  GROUP BY stage_code, product_type
), metric_results AS MATERIALIZED (
SELECT
    37 AS sort_no,
    CAST('P2-01' AS TEXT) AS code,
    CAST('方案推动阶段平均周期' AS TEXT) AS metric_name,
    CAST(NULL AS TEXT) AS product_team,
    CAST((
      NULL
    ) AS DECIMAL) AS amount_yi,
    CAST((
      NULL
    ) AS DECIMAL) AS energy_gwh,
    CAST(COUNT(f.elapsed_days) AS BIGINT) AS item_count,
    CAST((
      NULL
    ) AS DECIMAL) AS ratio_value,
    CAST(AVG(f.elapsed_days) AS DECIMAL) AS days_value,
    CAST('查询已实现；缺失输入及部分合计见明细' AS TEXT) AS status,
    CAST('new_stage2enddate→new_stage3enddate；仅完整起止且周期严格大于0的样本参与均值及数量；各阶段单独判断，缺结束不以观察截止补齐；按本阶段结束时间归期，开始可以早于期初，按实际完整周期计算；不限制当前阶段枚举。' AS TEXT) AS note,
    CAST((
      (
        SELECT
          JSONB_AGG(TO_JSONB(t))
        FROM stage_means AS t
        WHERE
          stage_code = 'P2'
      )
    ) AS JSONB) AS detail
  FROM stage_facts AS f
  WHERE
    stage_code = 'P2' AND in_window
)
SELECT
  r.code AS "指标序号",
  r.metric_name AS "指标名称",
  r.product_team AS "产品团队",
  p.start_date AS "期间开始",
  p.end_exclusive AS "期间结束不含",
  p.cutoff AS "周期观察截止",
  r.amount_yi AS "金额_亿元",
  r.energy_gwh AS "电量_GWh",
  r.item_count AS "数量",
  r.ratio_value AS "比率_原始小数",
  r.days_value AS "平均周期_天",
  CASE
    WHEN r.status = '查询已实现；缺失输入及部分合计见明细'
    THEN CASE
      WHEN r.amount_yi IS NOT NULL
      OR r.energy_gwh IS NOT NULL
      OR r.item_count IS NOT NULL
      OR r.ratio_value IS NOT NULL
      OR r.days_value IS NOT NULL
      THEN '已有查询结果；完整性与适用列见明细'
      ELSE '没有可计算结果；检查输入、时间及关联范围'
    END
    ELSE r.status
  END AS "计算说明状态",
  r.note AS "取值说明",
  r.detail AS "分组明细及缺口"
FROM metric_results AS r
CROSS JOIN context AS p
ORDER BY
  r.sort_no,
  r.product_team;

P2-02.name: 方案推动阶段超过静态基线 50% 的商机预测总量
P2-02.definition: 本阶段结束时间在所选期间、截至前已结束且周期严格大于0的商机中，实际周期严格>P2静态基线7.2天×1.5，按商机ID去重后汇总期间预测。
P2-02.formula: 超期基线固定为P2=7.2天，同阶段电芯/PACK/其他共用；不按所选样本重新计算。仅完整有效已结束且周期严格大于0的记录参与，0天、缺值及逆序排除。严格大于1.5倍才触发，等于不触发；预测先聚合到商机，缺预测不阻断命中数量。结束须落所选期间且早于观察日次日，起点无期初下限，当前阶段枚举不作过滤。
P2-02.attributes:
LE01-A0100 商机管理.阶段三结束日期（new_stage3enddate，空 74.35%）
LE01-A0243 商机管理.阶段二结束日期（new_stage2enddate，空 66.19%）
LE01-A0451 商机管理.项目阶段（new_processstage，空 0%）
P2-02.node: 方案推动（原因 2 引用）
P2-02.physicalFields: 商机.new_stage2enddate→new_stage3enddate；opportunityid/modifiedon用于去重；产品new_accproducttype用于产品分组展示，超期基线按阶段固定；预测new_accountdate、createdon及金额/Wh单价用于期间预测。当前new_processstage枚举不作周期过滤。
P2-02.notes: 采用P2静态基线7.2天，不随产品或统计期间变化；超期与实际均值样本均按阶段真实结束时间归期、完整且周期严格大于0。开始可跨年，不计在途，不按当前阶段排除历史经历；预测缺失不挡命中数量。
P2-02.sqlStatus: 查询已实现；缺失输入及部分合计见明细
P2-02.role: 独立基础周期诊断；不单独生成最终风险或根因
P2-02.ctes: parameters → context → account_rows → accounts → opportunity_rows → opportunities → orders → order_line_links → signed_orders → opportunity_flags → forecast_rows → forecast_facts → opportunity_forecast → stage_facts → stage_means → stage_overdue
P2-02.sql:
WITH parameters AS MATERIALIZED (
  SELECT
    CAST(%s AS DATE) AS start_date,
    CAST(%s AS DATE) AS end_exclusive,
    CAST(%s AS TIMESTAMP) AS observed_at,
    CAST(ARRAY['1'] AS TEXT[]) AS strategic_levels,
    CAST(ARRAY['1', '2'] AS TEXT[]) AS focus_levels,
    CAST(1000000 AS DECIMAL) AS target_power_units_per_gwh
), context AS MATERIALIZED (
  SELECT
    p.*,
    CAST((
      DATE_TRUNC('DAY', observed_at) + INTERVAL '1 DAY'
    ) AS TIMESTAMP) AS as_of_exclusive,
    LEAST(
      CAST(end_exclusive AS TIMESTAMP),
      DATE_TRUNC('DAY', observed_at) + INTERVAL '1 DAY'
    ) AS effective_end_exclusive,
    LEAST(
      CAST(end_exclusive AS TIMESTAMP),
      DATE_TRUNC('DAY', observed_at) + INTERVAL '1 DAY'
    ) - INTERVAL '1 MICROSECOND' AS cutoff,
    MAKE_DATE(CAST(EXTRACT(YEAR FROM start_date) AS INT), 1, 1) AS year_start,
    MAKE_DATE(CAST(EXTRACT(YEAR FROM start_date) AS INT) + 1, 1, 1) AS next_year_start,
    GREATEST(
      CAST(0 AS DECIMAL),
      LEAST(
        CAST(1 AS DECIMAL),
        CAST((
          CAST(LEAST(
            CAST(end_exclusive AS TIMESTAMP),
            DATE_TRUNC('DAY', observed_at) + INTERVAL '1 DAY'
          ) AS DATE) - MAKE_DATE(CAST(EXTRACT(YEAR FROM start_date) AS INT), 1, 1)
        ) AS DECIMAL) / (
          MAKE_DATE(CAST(EXTRACT(YEAR FROM start_date) AS INT) + 1, 1, 1) - MAKE_DATE(CAST(EXTRACT(YEAR FROM start_date) AS INT), 1, 1)
        )
      )
    ) AS time_progress
  FROM parameters AS p
), account_rows AS MATERIALIZED (
  SELECT
    CAST(a.accountid AS TEXT) AS account_id,
    CAST(a.name AS TEXT) AS account_name,
    CAST(a.new_accountlevel AS TEXT) AS level_code,
    CAST(a.new_sapdate AS TIMESTAMP) AS sap_created_at,
    CAST(a.new_sapsubmitdate AS TIMESTAMP) AS sap_submitted_at,
    CAST(a.new_approved_time_facreview AS TIMESTAMP) AS account_factory_approved_at,
    CAST(a.new_submit_time_facreview AS TIMESTAMP) AS account_factory_submitted_at,
    CAST(a.new_sinosurestartdate AS TIMESTAMP) AS account_sinosure_start,
    CAST(a.new_sinosureenddate AS TIMESTAMP) AS account_sinosure_end,
    CAST(a.new_submit_time_accredit AS TIMESTAMP) AS account_credit_submitted_at,
    CAST(a.new_approvaltime_accredit AS TIMESTAMP) AS account_credit_approved_at,
    CAST(a.new_cdastartdate AS TIMESTAMP) AS account_cda_start,
    CAST(a.new_cdaenddate AS TIMESTAMP) AS account_cda_end,
    CAST(a.new_cda_submittime AS TIMESTAMP) AS account_cda_submitted_at,
    CAST(a.new_cda_approved_time AS TIMESTAMP) AS account_cda_approved_at,
    CAST(a.new_approvalstatus_facreview AS TEXT) AS account_factory_approval_status,
    CAST(a.new_sapcode AS TEXT) AS sap_code,
    CAST(a.new_issap AS TEXT) AS sap_registered,
    CAST(a.new_issapnew AS TEXT) AS sap_registration_kind,
    ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
      PARTITION BY a.accountid
      ORDER BY a.modifiedon DESC NULLS LAST, a.createdon DESC NULLS LAST
    ) AS rn
  FROM (
    SELECT
      __x360_raw.*
    FROM ded_public.p_fm_edw_v_ods_crm_account_esb AS __x360_raw
    CROSS JOIN context AS __x360_ctx
    WHERE
      CAST(__x360_raw.createdon AS TIMESTAMP) < __x360_ctx.as_of_exclusive
  ) AS a
  WHERE
    NULLIF(TRIM(CAST(a.accountid AS TEXT)), '') IS NOT NULL
), accounts AS MATERIALIZED (
  SELECT
    account_id,
    account_name,
    level_code,
    sap_created_at,
    sap_submitted_at,
    account_factory_approved_at,
    account_factory_submitted_at,
    account_sinosure_start,
    account_sinosure_end,
    account_credit_submitted_at,
    account_credit_approved_at,
    account_cda_start,
    account_cda_end,
    account_cda_submitted_at,
    account_cda_approved_at,
    account_factory_approval_status,
    sap_code,
    sap_registered,
    sap_registration_kind
  FROM account_rows
  WHERE
    rn = 1
), opportunity_rows AS MATERIALIZED (
  SELECT
    ranked.*
  FROM (
    SELECT
      CAST(o.opportunityid AS TEXT) AS opportunity_id,
      CAST(o.parentaccountid AS TEXT) AS account_id,
      CAST(o.name AS TEXT) AS project_name,
      CAST(o.ownerid AS TEXT) AS owner_id,
      CASE
        WHEN CAST(o.new_accproducttype AS TEXT) IN ('1', '电芯')
        THEN '电芯'
        WHEN CAST(o.new_accproducttype AS TEXT) IN ('2', 'PACK')
        THEN 'PACK'
        ELSE '其他'
      END AS product_type,
      o.__x360_asof_process_stage AS process_stage,
      CAST(o.statecode AS TEXT) AS system_state,
      CAST(o.new_demandinput AS TEXT) AS demand_status,
      CAST(o.createdon AS TIMESTAMP) AS created_at,
      CAST(o.new_stage1enddate AS TIMESTAMP) AS s1,
      CAST(o.new_stage2enddate AS TIMESTAMP) AS s2,
      CAST(o.new_stage3enddate AS TIMESTAMP) AS s3,
      CAST(o.new_stage4enddate AS TIMESTAMP) AS s4,
      CAST(o.new_stage5enddate AS TIMESTAMP) AS s5,
      CAST(o.new_cdastartdate AS TIMESTAMP) AS new_cdastartdate,
      CAST(o.new_cdaenddate AS TIMESTAMP) AS new_cdaenddate,
      CAST(o.new_approved_time_acneed AS TIMESTAMP) AS new_approved_time_acneed,
      CAST(o.new_submit_time_acneed AS TIMESTAMP) AS new_submit_time_acneed,
      CAST(o.new_approved_time_projectassess AS TIMESTAMP) AS new_approved_time_projectassess,
      CAST(o.new_submit_time_projectassess AS TIMESTAMP) AS new_submit_time_projectassess,
      CAST(o.new_sampletestpass_time AS TIMESTAMP) AS new_sampletestpass_time,
      CAST(o.new_sampletime AS TIMESTAMP) AS new_sampletime,
      CAST(o.new_technicalsigningdate AS TIMESTAMP) AS new_technicalsigningdate,
      CAST(o.new_submit_time_techcon AS TIMESTAMP) AS new_submit_time_techcon,
      CAST(o.new_warrantysigningdate AS TIMESTAMP) AS new_warrantysigningdate,
      CAST(o.new_submit_time_qsl AS TIMESTAMP) AS new_submit_time_qsl,
      CAST(o.new_isneedcda AS TEXT) AS new_isneedcda,
      CAST(o.new_approvalstatus_acneed AS TEXT) AS new_approvalstatus_acneed,
      CAST(o.new_approvalstatus_projectassess AS TEXT) AS new_approvalstatus_projectassess,
      CAST(o.new_approvalstatus_techcon AS TEXT) AS new_approvalstatus_techcon,
      CAST(o.new_approvalstatus_qsl AS TEXT) AS new_approvalstatus_qsl,
      CAST(o.new_sampletestresult AS TEXT) AS new_sampletestresult,
      ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
        PARTITION BY o.opportunityid
        ORDER BY o.modifiedon DESC NULLS LAST, o.createdon DESC NULLS LAST
      ) AS rn
    FROM (
      SELECT
        __x360_raw.*,
        CASE
          WHEN CAST(__x360_raw.new_stage1enddate AS TIMESTAMP) IS NULL
          OR CAST(__x360_raw.new_stage1enddate AS TIMESTAMP) >= __x360_ctx.as_of_exclusive
          THEN '11'
          WHEN CAST(__x360_raw.new_stage2enddate AS TIMESTAMP) IS NULL
          OR CAST(__x360_raw.new_stage2enddate AS TIMESTAMP) >= __x360_ctx.as_of_exclusive
          THEN '12'
          WHEN CAST(__x360_raw.new_stage3enddate AS TIMESTAMP) IS NULL
          OR CAST(__x360_raw.new_stage3enddate AS TIMESTAMP) >= __x360_ctx.as_of_exclusive
          THEN '13'
          WHEN CAST(__x360_raw.new_stage4enddate AS TIMESTAMP) IS NULL
          OR CAST(__x360_raw.new_stage4enddate AS TIMESTAMP) >= __x360_ctx.as_of_exclusive
          THEN '14'
          WHEN CAST(__x360_raw.new_stage5enddate AS TIMESTAMP) IS NULL
          OR CAST(__x360_raw.new_stage5enddate AS TIMESTAMP) >= __x360_ctx.as_of_exclusive
          THEN '15'
          ELSE 'completed'
        END AS __x360_asof_process_stage
      FROM ded_public.p_fm_edw_v_ods_crm_opportunity_esb AS __x360_raw
      CROSS JOIN context AS __x360_ctx
    ) AS o
    WHERE
      NULLIF(TRIM(CAST(o.opportunityid AS TEXT)), '') IS NOT NULL
  ) AS ranked
  CROSS JOIN context AS p
  WHERE
    ranked.created_at < p.as_of_exclusive
), opportunities AS MATERIALIZED (
  SELECT
    o.opportunity_id,
    o.account_id,
    o.project_name,
    o.owner_id,
    o.product_type,
    o.process_stage,
    o.demand_status,
    o.created_at,
    o.s1,
    o.s2,
    o.s3,
    o.s4,
    o.s5,
    a.account_name,
    a.level_code,
    o.new_cdastartdate,
    o.new_cdaenddate,
    o.new_approved_time_acneed,
    o.new_submit_time_acneed,
    o.new_approved_time_projectassess,
    o.new_submit_time_projectassess,
    o.new_sampletestpass_time,
    o.new_sampletime,
    o.new_technicalsigningdate,
    o.new_submit_time_techcon,
    o.new_warrantysigningdate,
    o.new_submit_time_qsl,
    o.new_isneedcda,
    o.new_approvalstatus_acneed,
    o.new_approvalstatus_projectassess,
    o.new_approvalstatus_techcon,
    o.new_approvalstatus_qsl,
    o.new_sampletestresult,
    a.sap_created_at,
    a.sap_submitted_at,
    a.sap_code,
    a.account_factory_approved_at,
    a.account_factory_submitted_at,
    a.account_sinosure_start,
    a.account_sinosure_end,
    a.account_credit_submitted_at,
    a.account_credit_approved_at,
    a.account_cda_start,
    a.account_cda_end,
    a.account_cda_submitted_at,
    a.account_cda_approved_at,
    a.account_factory_approval_status
  FROM opportunity_rows AS o
  LEFT JOIN accounts AS a
    USING (account_id)
  CROSS JOIN context AS p
  WHERE
    o.rn = 1 AND (
      o.created_at < p.as_of_exclusive
    )
), orders AS MATERIALIZED (
  SELECT DISTINCT
    CAST(salesorderid AS TEXT) AS order_id
  FROM ded_public.p_fm_edw_v_ods_crm_salesorder_esb
  WHERE
    NULLIF(TRIM(CAST(salesorderid AS TEXT)), '') IS NOT NULL
), order_line_links AS MATERIALIZED (
  SELECT DISTINCT
    CAST(l.new_opportunity_id AS TEXT) AS opportunity_id,
    CAST(l.salesorderid AS TEXT) AS order_id
  FROM ded_public.p_fm_edw_v_ods_crm_salesorderdetail_esb AS l
  WHERE
    NULLIF(TRIM(CAST(l.new_opportunity_id AS TEXT)), '') IS NOT NULL
    AND NULLIF(TRIM(CAST(l.salesorderid AS TEXT)), '') IS NOT NULL
), signed_orders AS MATERIALIZED (
  SELECT
    l.opportunity_id,
    COUNT(DISTINCT l.order_id) AS order_count
  FROM order_line_links AS l
  JOIN orders AS o
    USING (order_id)
  GROUP BY
    l.opportunity_id
), opportunity_flags AS MATERIALIZED (
  SELECT
    o.*,
    COALESCE(s.order_count, 0) AS order_count,
    CASE
      WHEN COALESCE(s.order_count, 0) = 0
      THEN FALSE
      WHEN o.s4 IS NULL
      THEN FALSE
      ELSE o.s4 < p.as_of_exclusive
    END AS signed,
    (
      COALESCE(s.order_count, 0) > 0 AND o.s4 IS NULL
    ) AS missing_p3_end
  FROM opportunities AS o
  LEFT JOIN signed_orders AS s
    USING (opportunity_id)
  CROSS JOIN context AS p
), forecast_rows AS MATERIALIZED (
  SELECT
    CAST(m.new_oppmonthid AS TEXT) AS forecast_id,
    CAST(m.new_opportunity_id AS TEXT) AS opportunity_id,
    CAST(m.new_accountdate AS TIMESTAMP) AS forecast_month,
    CAST(m.new_forecast_amt_rmb AS DECIMAL) AS amount_yuan,
    CAST(m.new_whprice AS DECIMAL) AS wh_price,
    ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
      PARTITION BY m.new_opportunity_id, DATE_TRUNC('MONTH', CAST(m.new_accountdate AS TIMESTAMP))
      ORDER BY m.createdon DESC NULLS LAST, m.modifiedon DESC NULLS LAST, m.new_oppmonthid DESC NULLS LAST
    ) AS rn
  FROM (
    SELECT
      __x360_raw.*
    FROM ded_public.p_fm_edw_v_ods_crm_new_oppmonth_esb AS __x360_raw
    CROSS JOIN context AS __x360_ctx
    WHERE
      CAST(__x360_raw.createdon AS TIMESTAMP) < __x360_ctx.as_of_exclusive
  ) AS m
  CROSS JOIN context AS p
  WHERE
    NULLIF(TRIM(CAST(m.new_oppmonthid AS TEXT)), '') IS NOT NULL
    AND NULLIF(TRIM(CAST(m.new_opportunity_id AS TEXT)), '') IS NOT NULL
    AND CAST(m.new_accountdate AS TIMESTAMP) >= p.start_date
    AND CAST(m.new_accountdate AS TIMESTAMP) < p.end_exclusive
), forecast_facts AS MATERIALIZED (
  SELECT
    f.forecast_id,
    f.forecast_month,
    o.*,
    f.amount_yuan / CAST(100000000 AS DECIMAL) AS amount_yi,
    f.amount_yuan / NULLIF(f.wh_price, 0) / CAST(1000000000 AS DECIMAL) AS energy_gwh
  FROM forecast_rows AS f
  JOIN opportunity_flags AS o
    USING (opportunity_id)
  WHERE
    f.rn = 1
), opportunity_forecast AS MATERIALIZED (
  SELECT
    opportunity_id,
    COUNT(*) AS forecast_rows,
    SUM(amount_yi) AS amount_yi,
    SUM(energy_gwh) AS energy_gwh,
    COUNT(*) FILTER(WHERE
      amount_yi IS NULL) AS missing_amount_rows,
    COUNT(*) FILTER(WHERE
      energy_gwh IS NULL) AS missing_energy_rows
  FROM forecast_facts
  GROUP BY
    opportunity_id
), stage_facts AS MATERIALIZED (
SELECT
    o.*,
    v.stage_code,
    v.started_at,
    v.finished_at,
    CASE
      WHEN v.started_at IS NOT NULL AND v.finished_at > v.started_at
      THEN EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM (
        v.finished_at - v.started_at
      )) / CAST(86400 AS DECIMAL)
    END AS elapsed_days,
    (
      v.finished_at >= p.start_date AND v.finished_at < p.effective_end_exclusive
    ) AS in_window,
    FALSE AS inflight,
    (
      v.started_at IS NULL OR v.finished_at IS NULL OR v.finished_at <= v.started_at
    ) AS invalid_dates
  FROM opportunity_flags AS o
  CROSS JOIN context AS p
  CROSS JOIN LATERAL (
    VALUES
      (CAST('P0' AS TEXT), o.created_at, o.s1),
      (CAST('P1' AS TEXT), o.s1, o.s2),
      (CAST('P2' AS TEXT), o.s2, o.s3),
      (CAST('P3' AS TEXT), o.s3, o.s4),
      (CAST('P4' AS TEXT), o.s4, o.s5)
  ) AS v(stage_code, started_at, finished_at)
  WHERE
    v.finished_at IS NOT NULL
    AND v.finished_at >= p.start_date
    AND v.finished_at < p.effective_end_exclusive
), stage_means AS MATERIALIZED (
SELECT stage_code, product_type,
    AVG(elapsed_days) FILTER (WHERE NOT invalid_dates) AS mean_days,
    CASE stage_code
      WHEN 'P0' THEN 32.6::numeric
      WHEN 'P1' THEN 21.8::numeric
      WHEN 'P2' THEN 7.2::numeric
      WHEN 'P3' THEN 57.2::numeric
      WHEN 'P4' THEN 15.3::numeric
    END AS baseline_days,
    COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE NOT invalid_dates) AS sample_count,
    COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE invalid_dates) AS invalid_count,
    COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE finished_at = started_at) AS zero_duration_count,
    0::bigint AS inflight_count
  FROM stage_facts WHERE in_window
  GROUP BY stage_code, product_type
), stage_overdue AS MATERIALIZED (
SELECT f.*,m.mean_days,m.baseline_days,
    (f.elapsed_days-m.baseline_days) AS excess_days,
    (f.elapsed_days-m.baseline_days)/NULLIF(m.baseline_days,0) AS excess_ratio,
    ofc.amount_yi,ofc.energy_gwh,
    (m.baseline_days > 0 AND f.elapsed_days > 1.5::numeric*m.baseline_days) AS overdue
  FROM stage_facts f JOIN stage_means m USING(stage_code,product_type)
  LEFT JOIN opportunity_forecast ofc USING(opportunity_id)
  WHERE f.in_window AND NOT f.invalid_dates
), metric_results AS MATERIALIZED (
SELECT
    38 AS sort_no,
    CAST('P2-02' AS TEXT) AS code,
    CAST('方案推动阶段超过静态基线 50%% 的商机预测总量' AS TEXT) AS metric_name,
    CAST(NULL AS TEXT) AS product_team,
    CAST((
      SUM(amount_yi)
    ) AS DECIMAL) AS amount_yi,
    CAST((
      SUM(energy_gwh)
    ) AS DECIMAL) AS energy_gwh,
    CAST((
      COUNT(DISTINCT opportunity_id)
    ) AS BIGINT) AS item_count,
    CAST((
      NULL
    ) AS DECIMAL) AS ratio_value,
    CAST((
      NULL
    ) AS DECIMAL) AS days_value,
    CAST('查询已实现；缺失输入及部分合计见明细' AS TEXT) AS status,
    CAST('超过本阶段静态基线1.5倍；同商机每阶段只计一次；该商机期间预测先聚合后关联，不因订单或预测行重复累计。' AS TEXT) AS note,
    CAST((
      JSONB_AGG(
        JSONB_BUILD_OBJECT('商机ID', opportunity_id, '产品', product_type, '周期天', elapsed_days, '静态基线天', baseline_days, '超出基线天数', excess_days, '超出基线比例_原始小数', excess_ratio, '超出基线百分比数值', excess_ratio*100)
      )
    ) AS JSONB) AS detail
  FROM stage_overdue AS f
  WHERE
    stage_code = 'P2' AND in_window AND overdue
)
SELECT
  r.code AS "指标序号",
  r.metric_name AS "指标名称",
  r.product_team AS "产品团队",
  p.start_date AS "期间开始",
  p.end_exclusive AS "期间结束不含",
  p.cutoff AS "周期观察截止",
  r.amount_yi AS "金额_亿元",
  r.energy_gwh AS "电量_GWh",
  r.item_count AS "数量",
  r.ratio_value AS "比率_原始小数",
  r.days_value AS "平均周期_天",
  CASE
    WHEN r.status = '查询已实现；缺失输入及部分合计见明细'
    THEN CASE
      WHEN r.amount_yi IS NOT NULL
      OR r.energy_gwh IS NOT NULL
      OR r.item_count IS NOT NULL
      OR r.ratio_value IS NOT NULL
      OR r.days_value IS NOT NULL
      THEN '已有查询结果；完整性与适用列见明细'
      ELSE '没有可计算结果；检查输入、时间及关联范围'
    END
    ELSE r.status
  END AS "计算说明状态",
  r.note AS "取值说明",
  r.detail AS "分组明细及缺口"
FROM metric_results AS r
CROSS JOIN context AS p
ORDER BY
  r.sort_no,
  r.product_team;

P2-03.name: 签署技术协议或规格书平均周期
P2-03.definition: 商机.new_technicalsigningdate－商机.new_submit_time_techcon，换算天后取平均。仅完整有效已结束事件取真实结束减开始；以本环节结束时间归所选期间，未结束不计入平均。已进入后续阶段的记录也保留，不限定当前阶段枚举。
P2-03.formula:
对已实际进入本环节的有效事件计算周期；不以当前阶段枚举排除已到后续阶段的历史事件。同一事件去重，按电芯/PACK计算动态均值；单笔周期严格大于同组均值1.5倍才判超期。
阶段及普通环节按各自真实结束时间归所选期间，结束须早于MIN(end_exclusive,观察日次日)；起点可早于期初，不计未结束在途。P0～P4阶段只计起止完整且周期严格大于0的样本；普通独立环节仍沿用各自完整非逆序规则。
P2-03.attributes:
LE01-A0062 商机管理.技术协议签署日期（new_technicalsigningdate，空 97.54%）
LE01-A0096 商机管理.技术协议提交时间（new_submit_time_techcon，空 95.24%）
P2-03.node: 方案推动（原因 2 引用）
P2-03.physicalFields:
开始：商机.new_submit_time_techcon
结束：商机.new_technicalsigningdate
样本去重：商机ID
P2-03.notes: 技术协议提交至签署；不与协议有效期起止或变更、补充协议流程混用。 总体按真实事件去重；缺起止数据与缺字段映射分开列示。分组样本不可直接相加。
P2-03.sqlStatus: 按结果动态判定（见 SQL 中 status 的 CASE）
P2-03.role: 总体P2周期/事件根因参考；最终分析按BR-V12取值
P2-03.ctes: parameters → context → account_rows → accounts → opportunity_rows → opportunities → orders → order_line_links → signed_orders → opportunity_flags → node_quote_headers → node_quote_links → node_quote_latest → node_cycle_source → node_cycle_facts → node_cycle_means → event_samples → sample_stats → quality
P2-03.sql:
WITH parameters AS MATERIALIZED (
  SELECT
    CAST(%s AS DATE) AS start_date,
    CAST(%s AS DATE) AS end_exclusive,
    CAST(%s AS TIMESTAMP) AS observed_at,
    CAST(ARRAY['1'] AS TEXT[]) AS strategic_levels,
    CAST(ARRAY['1', '2'] AS TEXT[]) AS focus_levels,
    CAST(1000000 AS DECIMAL) AS target_power_units_per_gwh
), context AS MATERIALIZED (
  SELECT
    p.*,
    CAST((
      DATE_TRUNC('DAY', observed_at) + INTERVAL '1 DAY'
    ) AS TIMESTAMP) AS as_of_exclusive,
    LEAST(
      CAST(end_exclusive AS TIMESTAMP),
      DATE_TRUNC('DAY', observed_at) + INTERVAL '1 DAY'
    ) AS effective_end_exclusive,
    LEAST(
      CAST(end_exclusive AS TIMESTAMP),
      DATE_TRUNC('DAY', observed_at) + INTERVAL '1 DAY'
    ) - INTERVAL '1 MICROSECOND' AS cutoff,
    MAKE_DATE(CAST(EXTRACT(YEAR FROM start_date) AS INT), 1, 1) AS year_start,
    MAKE_DATE(CAST(EXTRACT(YEAR FROM start_date) AS INT) + 1, 1, 1) AS next_year_start,
    GREATEST(
      CAST(0 AS DECIMAL),
      LEAST(
        CAST(1 AS DECIMAL),
        CAST((
          CAST(LEAST(
            CAST(end_exclusive AS TIMESTAMP),
            DATE_TRUNC('DAY', observed_at) + INTERVAL '1 DAY'
          ) AS DATE) - MAKE_DATE(CAST(EXTRACT(YEAR FROM start_date) AS INT), 1, 1)
        ) AS DECIMAL) / (
          MAKE_DATE(CAST(EXTRACT(YEAR FROM start_date) AS INT) + 1, 1, 1) - MAKE_DATE(CAST(EXTRACT(YEAR FROM start_date) AS INT), 1, 1)
        )
      )
    ) AS time_progress
  FROM parameters AS p
), account_rows AS MATERIALIZED (
  SELECT
    CAST(a.accountid AS TEXT) AS account_id,
    CAST(a.name AS TEXT) AS account_name,
    CAST(a.new_accountlevel AS TEXT) AS level_code,
    CAST(a.new_sapdate AS TIMESTAMP) AS sap_created_at,
    CAST(a.new_sapsubmitdate AS TIMESTAMP) AS sap_submitted_at,
    CAST(a.new_approved_time_facreview AS TIMESTAMP) AS account_factory_approved_at,
    CAST(a.new_submit_time_facreview AS TIMESTAMP) AS account_factory_submitted_at,
    CAST(a.new_sinosurestartdate AS TIMESTAMP) AS account_sinosure_start,
    CAST(a.new_sinosureenddate AS TIMESTAMP) AS account_sinosure_end,
    CAST(a.new_submit_time_accredit AS TIMESTAMP) AS account_credit_submitted_at,
    CAST(a.new_approvaltime_accredit AS TIMESTAMP) AS account_credit_approved_at,
    CAST(a.new_cdastartdate AS TIMESTAMP) AS account_cda_start,
    CAST(a.new_cdaenddate AS TIMESTAMP) AS account_cda_end,
    CAST(a.new_cda_submittime AS TIMESTAMP) AS account_cda_submitted_at,
    CAST(a.new_cda_approved_time AS TIMESTAMP) AS account_cda_approved_at,
    CAST(a.new_approvalstatus_facreview AS TEXT) AS account_factory_approval_status,
    CAST(a.new_sapcode AS TEXT) AS sap_code,
    CAST(a.new_issap AS TEXT) AS sap_registered,
    CAST(a.new_issapnew AS TEXT) AS sap_registration_kind,
    ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
      PARTITION BY a.accountid
      ORDER BY a.modifiedon DESC NULLS LAST, a.createdon DESC NULLS LAST
    ) AS rn
  FROM (
    SELECT
      __x360_raw.*
    FROM ded_public.p_fm_edw_v_ods_crm_account_esb AS __x360_raw
    CROSS JOIN context AS __x360_ctx
    WHERE
      CAST(__x360_raw.createdon AS TIMESTAMP) < __x360_ctx.as_of_exclusive
  ) AS a
  WHERE
    NULLIF(TRIM(CAST(a.accountid AS TEXT)), '') IS NOT NULL
), accounts AS MATERIALIZED (
  SELECT
    account_id,
    account_name,
    level_code,
    sap_created_at,
    sap_submitted_at,
    account_factory_approved_at,
    account_factory_submitted_at,
    account_sinosure_start,
    account_sinosure_end,
    account_credit_submitted_at,
    account_credit_approved_at,
    account_cda_start,
    account_cda_end,
    account_cda_submitted_at,
    account_cda_approved_at,
    account_factory_approval_status,
    sap_code,
    sap_registered,
    sap_registration_kind
  FROM account_rows
  WHERE
    rn = 1
), opportunity_rows AS MATERIALIZED (
  SELECT
    ranked.*
  FROM (
    SELECT
      CAST(o.opportunityid AS TEXT) AS opportunity_id,
      CAST(o.parentaccountid AS TEXT) AS account_id,
      CAST(o.name AS TEXT) AS project_name,
      CAST(o.ownerid AS TEXT) AS owner_id,
      CASE
        WHEN CAST(o.new_accproducttype AS TEXT) IN ('1', '电芯')
        THEN '电芯'
        WHEN CAST(o.new_accproducttype AS TEXT) IN ('2', 'PACK')
        THEN 'PACK'
        ELSE '其他'
      END AS product_type,
      o.__x360_asof_process_stage AS process_stage,
      CAST(o.statecode AS TEXT) AS system_state,
      CAST(o.new_demandinput AS TEXT) AS demand_status,
      CAST(o.createdon AS TIMESTAMP) AS created_at,
      CAST(o.new_stage1enddate AS TIMESTAMP) AS s1,
      CAST(o.new_stage2enddate AS TIMESTAMP) AS s2,
      CAST(o.new_stage3enddate AS TIMESTAMP) AS s3,
      CAST(o.new_stage4enddate AS TIMESTAMP) AS s4,
      CAST(o.new_stage5enddate AS TIMESTAMP) AS s5,
      CAST(o.new_cdastartdate AS TIMESTAMP) AS new_cdastartdate,
      CAST(o.new_cdaenddate AS TIMESTAMP) AS new_cdaenddate,
      CAST(o.new_approved_time_acneed AS TIMESTAMP) AS new_approved_time_acneed,
      CAST(o.new_submit_time_acneed AS TIMESTAMP) AS new_submit_time_acneed,
      CAST(o.new_approved_time_projectassess AS TIMESTAMP) AS new_approved_time_projectassess,
      CAST(o.new_submit_time_projectassess AS TIMESTAMP) AS new_submit_time_projectassess,
      CAST(o.new_sampletestpass_time AS TIMESTAMP) AS new_sampletestpass_time,
      CAST(o.new_sampletime AS TIMESTAMP) AS new_sampletime,
      CAST(o.new_technicalsigningdate AS TIMESTAMP) AS new_technicalsigningdate,
      CAST(o.new_submit_time_techcon AS TIMESTAMP) AS new_submit_time_techcon,
      CAST(o.new_warrantysigningdate AS TIMESTAMP) AS new_warrantysigningdate,
      CAST(o.new_submit_time_qsl AS TIMESTAMP) AS new_submit_time_qsl,
      CAST(o.new_isneedcda AS TEXT) AS new_isneedcda,
      CAST(o.new_approvalstatus_acneed AS TEXT) AS new_approvalstatus_acneed,
      CAST(o.new_approvalstatus_projectassess AS TEXT) AS new_approvalstatus_projectassess,
      CAST(o.new_approvalstatus_techcon AS TEXT) AS new_approvalstatus_techcon,
      CAST(o.new_approvalstatus_qsl AS TEXT) AS new_approvalstatus_qsl,
      CAST(o.new_sampletestresult AS TEXT) AS new_sampletestresult,
      ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
        PARTITION BY o.opportunityid
        ORDER BY o.modifiedon DESC NULLS LAST, o.createdon DESC NULLS LAST
      ) AS rn
    FROM (
      SELECT
        __x360_raw.*,
        CASE
          WHEN CAST(__x360_raw.new_stage1enddate AS TIMESTAMP) IS NULL
          OR CAST(__x360_raw.new_stage1enddate AS TIMESTAMP) >= __x360_ctx.as_of_exclusive
          THEN '11'
          WHEN CAST(__x360_raw.new_stage2enddate AS TIMESTAMP) IS NULL
          OR CAST(__x360_raw.new_stage2enddate AS TIMESTAMP) >= __x360_ctx.as_of_exclusive
          THEN '12'
          WHEN CAST(__x360_raw.new_stage3enddate AS TIMESTAMP) IS NULL
          OR CAST(__x360_raw.new_stage3enddate AS TIMESTAMP) >= __x360_ctx.as_of_exclusive
          THEN '13'
          WHEN CAST(__x360_raw.new_stage4enddate AS TIMESTAMP) IS NULL
          OR CAST(__x360_raw.new_stage4enddate AS TIMESTAMP) >= __x360_ctx.as_of_exclusive
          THEN '14'
          WHEN CAST(__x360_raw.new_stage5enddate AS TIMESTAMP) IS NULL
          OR CAST(__x360_raw.new_stage5enddate AS TIMESTAMP) >= __x360_ctx.as_of_exclusive
          THEN '15'
          ELSE 'completed'
        END AS __x360_asof_process_stage
      FROM ded_public.p_fm_edw_v_ods_crm_opportunity_esb AS __x360_raw
      CROSS JOIN context AS __x360_ctx
    ) AS o
    WHERE
      NULLIF(TRIM(CAST(o.opportunityid AS TEXT)), '') IS NOT NULL
  ) AS ranked
  CROSS JOIN context AS p
  WHERE
    ranked.created_at < p.as_of_exclusive
), opportunities AS MATERIALIZED (
  SELECT
    o.opportunity_id,
    o.account_id,
    o.project_name,
    o.owner_id,
    o.product_type,
    o.process_stage,
    o.demand_status,
    o.created_at,
    o.s1,
    o.s2,
    o.s3,
    o.s4,
    o.s5,
    a.account_name,
    a.level_code,
    o.new_cdastartdate,
    o.new_cdaenddate,
    o.new_approved_time_acneed,
    o.new_submit_time_acneed,
    o.new_approved_time_projectassess,
    o.new_submit_time_projectassess,
    o.new_sampletestpass_time,
    o.new_sampletime,
    o.new_technicalsigningdate,
    o.new_submit_time_techcon,
    o.new_warrantysigningdate,
    o.new_submit_time_qsl,
    o.new_isneedcda,
    o.new_approvalstatus_acneed,
    o.new_approvalstatus_projectassess,
    o.new_approvalstatus_techcon,
    o.new_approvalstatus_qsl,
    o.new_sampletestresult,
    a.sap_created_at,
    a.sap_submitted_at,
    a.sap_code,
    a.account_factory_approved_at,
    a.account_factory_submitted_at,
    a.account_sinosure_start,
    a.account_sinosure_end,
    a.account_credit_submitted_at,
    a.account_credit_approved_at,
    a.account_cda_start,
    a.account_cda_end,
    a.account_cda_submitted_at,
    a.account_cda_approved_at,
    a.account_factory_approval_status
  FROM opportunity_rows AS o
  LEFT JOIN accounts AS a
    USING (account_id)
  CROSS JOIN context AS p
  WHERE
    o.rn = 1 AND (
      o.created_at < p.as_of_exclusive
    )
), orders AS MATERIALIZED (
  SELECT DISTINCT
    CAST(salesorderid AS TEXT) AS order_id
  FROM ded_public.p_fm_edw_v_ods_crm_salesorder_esb
  WHERE
    NULLIF(TRIM(CAST(salesorderid AS TEXT)), '') IS NOT NULL
), order_line_links AS MATERIALIZED (
  SELECT DISTINCT
    CAST(l.new_opportunity_id AS TEXT) AS opportunity_id,
    CAST(l.salesorderid AS TEXT) AS order_id
  FROM ded_public.p_fm_edw_v_ods_crm_salesorderdetail_esb AS l
  WHERE
    NULLIF(TRIM(CAST(l.new_opportunity_id AS TEXT)), '') IS NOT NULL
    AND NULLIF(TRIM(CAST(l.salesorderid AS TEXT)), '') IS NOT NULL
), signed_orders AS MATERIALIZED (
  SELECT
    l.opportunity_id,
    COUNT(DISTINCT l.order_id) AS order_count
  FROM order_line_links AS l
  JOIN orders AS o
    USING (order_id)
  GROUP BY
    l.opportunity_id
), opportunity_flags AS MATERIALIZED (
  SELECT
    o.*,
    COALESCE(s.order_count, 0) AS order_count,
    CASE
      WHEN COALESCE(s.order_count, 0) = 0
      THEN FALSE
      WHEN o.s4 IS NULL
      THEN FALSE
      ELSE o.s4 < p.as_of_exclusive
    END AS signed,
    (
      COALESCE(s.order_count, 0) > 0 AND o.s4 IS NULL
    ) AS missing_p3_end
  FROM opportunities AS o
  LEFT JOIN signed_orders AS s
    USING (opportunity_id)
  CROSS JOIN context AS p
), node_quote_headers AS MATERIALIZED (
  SELECT
    CAST(q.new_quoteapplyid AS TEXT) AS quote_id,
    CAST(q.createdon AS TIMESTAMP) AS created_at,
    CAST(q.new_oasubmitdate AS TIMESTAMP) AS submitted_at,
    CAST(q.new_approved_time AS TIMESTAMP) AS approved_at,
    CAST(q.new_approvalstatus AS TEXT) AS approval_status
  FROM ded_public.p_fm_edw_v_ods_crm_new_quoteapply_esb AS q
  WHERE
    q.new_quoteapplyid IS NOT NULL
), node_quote_links AS MATERIALIZED (
  SELECT DISTINCT
    CAST(d.new_opportunity_id AS TEXT) AS opportunity_id,
    CAST(d.new_quoteapply_id AS TEXT) AS quote_id
  FROM ded_public.p_fm_edw_v_ods_crm_new_quoteapplydetail_esb AS d
  WHERE
    NULLIF(TRIM(CAST(d.new_opportunity_id AS TEXT)), '') IS NOT NULL
    AND NULLIF(TRIM(CAST(d.new_quoteapply_id AS TEXT)), '') IS NOT NULL
), node_quote_latest AS MATERIALIZED (
  SELECT
    opportunity_id,
    quote_id,
    submitted_at,
    approved_at,
    approval_status
  FROM (
    SELECT
      o.opportunity_id,
      q.quote_id,
      q.submitted_at,
      q.approved_at,
      q.approval_status,
      ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
        PARTITION BY o.opportunity_id
        ORDER BY q.created_at DESC NULLS LAST, q.quote_id DESC
      ) AS rn
    FROM opportunity_flags AS o
    JOIN node_quote_links AS l
      USING (opportunity_id)
    JOIN node_quote_headers AS q
      USING (quote_id)
    CROSS JOIN context AS p
    WHERE
      q.created_at <= p.cutoff
  ) AS ranked
  WHERE
    rn = 1
), node_cycle_source AS MATERIALIZED (
  SELECT
    o.opportunity_id,
    o.product_type,
    n.metric_code,
    n.phase_code,
    n.started_at,
    n.finished_at,
    n.entered_at,
    n.active_flag,
    n.event_id,
    n.finished_at >= p.start_date AND n.finished_at < p.effective_end_exclusive AS in_window,
    p.cutoff
  FROM opportunity_flags AS o
  LEFT JOIN node_quote_latest AS q
    USING (opportunity_id)
  CROSS JOIN context AS p
  CROSS JOIN LATERAL (
    VALUES
      (
        CAST('P0-03' AS TEXT),
        CAST('P0' AS TEXT),
        o.new_cdastartdate,
        o.new_cdaenddate,
        o.new_cdastartdate,
        COALESCE((
          o.new_isneedcda = '2'
        ), FALSE),
        CAST((
          o.opportunity_id
        ) AS TEXT)
      ),
      (
        CAST('P0-04' AS TEXT),
        CAST('P0' AS TEXT),
        o.new_submit_time_acneed,
        o.new_approved_time_acneed,
        o.new_submit_time_acneed,
        COALESCE((
          o.new_approvalstatus_acneed = '2'
        ), FALSE),
        CAST((
          o.opportunity_id
        ) AS TEXT)
      ),
      (
        CAST('P0-06' AS TEXT),
        CAST('P0' AS TEXT),
        o.new_submit_time_acneed,
        o.new_approved_time_acneed,
        o.new_submit_time_acneed,
        COALESCE((
          o.new_approvalstatus_acneed = '2'
        ), FALSE),
        CAST((
          o.opportunity_id
        ) AS TEXT)
      ),
      (
        CAST('P1-03' AS TEXT),
        CAST('P1' AS TEXT),
        o.account_factory_submitted_at,
        o.account_factory_approved_at,
        o.account_factory_submitted_at,
        COALESCE((
          o.account_factory_approval_status = '2'
        ), FALSE),
        CAST((
          o.account_id
        ) AS TEXT)
      ),
      (
        CAST('P1-04' AS TEXT),
        CAST('P1' AS TEXT),
        o.new_submit_time_projectassess,
        o.new_approved_time_projectassess,
        o.new_submit_time_projectassess,
        COALESCE((
          o.new_approvalstatus_projectassess = '2'
        ), FALSE),
        CAST((
          o.opportunity_id
        ) AS TEXT)
      ),
      (
        CAST('P1-05' AS TEXT),
        CAST('P1' AS TEXT),
        o.new_sampletime,
        o.new_sampletestpass_time,
        o.new_sampletime,
        COALESCE((
          o.new_sampletestresult IS NULL
        ), FALSE),
        CAST((
          o.opportunity_id
        ) AS TEXT)
      ),
      (
        CAST('P1-07' AS TEXT),
        CAST('P1' AS TEXT),
        q.submitted_at,
        CASE WHEN q.approval_status = '3' THEN q.approved_at END,
        q.submitted_at,
        COALESCE((
          q.approval_status = '2'
        ), FALSE),
        CAST((
          q.quote_id
        ) AS TEXT)
      ),
      (
        CAST('P2-03' AS TEXT),
        CAST('P2' AS TEXT),
        o.new_submit_time_techcon,
        o.new_technicalsigningdate,
        o.new_submit_time_techcon,
        COALESCE((
          o.new_approvalstatus_techcon = '2'
        ), FALSE),
        CAST((
          o.opportunity_id
        ) AS TEXT)
      ),
      (
        CAST('P2-04' AS TEXT),
        CAST('P2' AS TEXT),
        o.new_submit_time_qsl,
        o.new_warrantysigningdate,
        o.new_submit_time_qsl,
        COALESCE((
          o.new_approvalstatus_qsl = '2'
        ), FALSE),
        CAST((
          o.opportunity_id
        ) AS TEXT)
      )
  ) AS n(metric_code, phase_code, started_at, finished_at, entered_at, active_flag, event_id)
), node_cycle_facts AS MATERIALIZED (
  SELECT
    f.*,
    CASE
      WHEN in_window
      AND event_id IS NOT NULL
      AND started_at IS NOT NULL
      AND finished_at >= started_at
      THEN EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM (
        finished_at - started_at
      )) / CAST(86400 AS DECIMAL)
    END AS duration_days,
    (
      in_window
      AND event_id IS NOT NULL
      AND started_at IS NOT NULL
      AND finished_at >= started_at
    ) AS completed_valid,
    FALSE AS inflight_valid
  FROM node_cycle_source AS f
), node_cycle_means AS MATERIALIZED (
  WITH event_samples AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT
      metric_code,
      product_type,
      event_id,
      duration_days,
      completed_valid,
      inflight_valid
    FROM node_cycle_facts
    WHERE
      duration_days IS NOT NULL
    UNION ALL
    SELECT DISTINCT
      metric_code,
      CAST('全部' AS TEXT) AS product_type,
      event_id,
      duration_days,
      completed_valid,
      inflight_valid
    FROM node_cycle_facts
    WHERE
      duration_days IS NOT NULL
  ), sample_stats AS (
    SELECT
      metric_code,
      product_type,
      COUNT(*) AS sample_count,
      AVG(duration_days) AS mean_days,
      COUNT(*) FILTER(WHERE
        completed_valid) AS completed_count,
      COUNT(*) FILTER(WHERE
        inflight_valid) AS inflight_count
    FROM event_samples
    GROUP BY
      metric_code,
      product_type
  ), quality AS (
    SELECT
      metric_code,
      CASE WHEN GROUPING(product_type) = 1 THEN '全部' ELSE product_type END AS product_type,
      COUNT(*) AS linked_source_rows,
      COUNT(*) FILTER(WHERE
        in_window) AS entry_window_rows,
      COUNT(DISTINCT event_id) FILTER(WHERE
        in_window) AS entered_event_count,
      COUNT(*) FILTER(WHERE
        in_window AND finished_at IS NULL) AS missing_end_rows,
      COUNT(*) FILTER(WHERE
        started_at IS NULL) AS missing_start_rows,
      COUNT(*) FILTER(WHERE
        event_id IS NULL) AS missing_event_id_rows,
      COUNT(*) FILTER(WHERE
        in_window AND finished_at < started_at) AS end_before_start_rows,
      COUNT(*) FILTER(WHERE
        in_window AND finished_at > cutoff AND NOT COALESCE(inflight_valid, FALSE)) AS future_end_without_entry_proof_rows,
      COUNT(*) FILTER(WHERE
        in_window AND finished_at IS NULL AND NOT COALESCE(inflight_valid, FALSE)) AS unknown_completion_rows
    FROM node_cycle_facts
    GROUP BY
      metric_code,
      GROUPING SETS (
        (),
        (
          product_type
        )
      )
  )
  SELECT
    q.*,
    COALESCE(s.sample_count, 0) AS sample_count,
    s.mean_days,
    COALESCE(s.completed_count, 0) AS completed_count,
    COALESCE(s.inflight_count, 0) AS inflight_count
  FROM quality AS q
  LEFT JOIN sample_stats AS s
    USING (metric_code, product_type)
), metric_results AS MATERIALIZED (
  SELECT
    39 AS sort_no,
    CAST('P2-03' AS TEXT) AS code,
    CAST('签署技术协议或规格书平均周期' AS TEXT) AS metric_name,
    CAST(NULL AS TEXT) AS product_team,
    CAST(NULL AS DECIMAL) AS amount_yi,
    CAST(NULL AS DECIMAL) AS energy_gwh,
    CAST(n.sample_count AS BIGINT) AS item_count,
    CAST(NULL AS DECIMAL) AS ratio_value,
    CAST(n.mean_days AS DECIMAL) AS days_value,
    CAST(CASE
      WHEN n.sample_count > 0
      THEN '自身起止已映射；按真实事件去重计算'
      WHEN COALESCE(n.entry_window_rows, 0) = 0
      THEN '已映射；起始时间缺失或不在所选窗口'
      ELSE '已映射；没有有效起止配对，原因见明细'
    END AS TEXT) AS status,
    CAST('商机.new_technicalsigningdate－商机.new_submit_time_techcon，换算天后取平均。仅完整有效已结束事件取真实结束减开始；以本环节结束时间归所选期间，未结束不计入平均。已进入后续阶段的记录也保留，不限定当前阶段枚举。 技术协议提交至签署；不与协议有效期起止或变更、补充协议流程混用。 总体按真实事件去重；缺起止数据与缺字段映射分开列示。分组样本不可直接相加。' AS TEXT) AS note,
    (
      SELECT
        JSONB_AGG(TO_JSONB(x))
      FROM node_cycle_means AS x
      WHERE
        x.metric_code = 'P2-03'
    ) AS detail
  FROM context AS p
  LEFT JOIN node_cycle_means AS n
    ON n.metric_code = 'P2-03' AND n.product_type = '全部'
)
SELECT
  r.code AS "指标序号",
  r.metric_name AS "指标名称",
  r.product_team AS "产品团队",
  p.start_date AS "期间开始",
  p.end_exclusive AS "期间结束不含",
  p.cutoff AS "周期观察截止",
  r.amount_yi AS "金额_亿元",
  r.energy_gwh AS "电量_GWh",
  r.item_count AS "数量",
  r.ratio_value AS "比率_原始小数",
  r.days_value AS "平均周期_天",
  CASE
    WHEN r.status = '查询已实现；缺失输入及部分合计见明细'
    THEN CASE
      WHEN r.amount_yi IS NOT NULL
      OR r.energy_gwh IS NOT NULL
      OR r.item_count IS NOT NULL
      OR r.ratio_value IS NOT NULL
      OR r.days_value IS NOT NULL
      THEN '已有查询结果；完整性与适用列见明细'
      ELSE '没有可计算结果；检查输入、时间及关联范围'
    END
    ELSE r.status
  END AS "计算说明状态",
  r.note AS "取值说明",
  r.detail AS "分组明细及缺口"
FROM metric_results AS r
CROSS JOIN context AS p
ORDER BY
  r.sort_no,
  r.product_team;

P2-04.name: 质保协议平均周期
P2-04.definition: 商机.new_warrantysigningdate－商机.new_submit_time_qsl，换算天后取平均。仅完整有效已结束事件取真实结束减开始；以本环节结束时间归所选期间，未结束不计入平均。已进入后续阶段的记录也保留，不限定当前阶段枚举。
P2-04.formula:
对已实际进入本环节的有效事件计算周期；不以当前阶段枚举排除已到后续阶段的历史事件。同一事件去重，按电芯/PACK计算动态均值；单笔周期严格大于同组均值1.5倍才判超期。
阶段及普通环节按各自真实结束时间归所选期间，结束须早于MIN(end_exclusive,观察日次日)；起点可早于期初，不计未结束在途。P0～P4阶段只计起止完整且周期严格大于0的样本；普通独立环节仍沿用各自完整非逆序规则。
P2-04.attributes:
LE01-A0147 商机管理.质保协议提交时间（new_submit_time_qsl，空 97.94%）
LE01-A0441 商机管理.质保协议签署日期（new_warrantysigningdate，空 99.05%）
P2-04.node: 方案推动（原因 2 引用）
P2-04.physicalFields:
开始：商机.new_submit_time_qsl
结束：商机.new_warrantysigningdate
样本去重：商机ID
P2-04.notes: 质保协议提交至签署，不用质保开始/到期日期。 总体按真实事件去重；缺起止数据与缺字段映射分开列示。分组样本不可直接相加。
P2-04.sqlStatus: 按结果动态判定（见 SQL 中 status 的 CASE）
P2-04.role: 总体P2周期/事件根因参考；最终分析按BR-V12取值
P2-04.ctes: parameters → context → account_rows → accounts → opportunity_rows → opportunities → orders → order_line_links → signed_orders → opportunity_flags → node_quote_headers → node_quote_links → node_quote_latest → node_cycle_source → node_cycle_facts → node_cycle_means → event_samples → sample_stats → quality
P2-04.sql:
WITH parameters AS MATERIALIZED (
  SELECT
    CAST(%s AS DATE) AS start_date,
    CAST(%s AS DATE) AS end_exclusive,
    CAST(%s AS TIMESTAMP) AS observed_at,
    CAST(ARRAY['1'] AS TEXT[]) AS strategic_levels,
    CAST(ARRAY['1', '2'] AS TEXT[]) AS focus_levels,
    CAST(1000000 AS DECIMAL) AS target_power_units_per_gwh
), context AS MATERIALIZED (
  SELECT
    p.*,
    CAST((
      DATE_TRUNC('DAY', observed_at) + INTERVAL '1 DAY'
    ) AS TIMESTAMP) AS as_of_exclusive,
    LEAST(
      CAST(end_exclusive AS TIMESTAMP),
      DATE_TRUNC('DAY', observed_at) + INTERVAL '1 DAY'
    ) AS effective_end_exclusive,
    LEAST(
      CAST(end_exclusive AS TIMESTAMP),
      DATE_TRUNC('DAY', observed_at) + INTERVAL '1 DAY'
    ) - INTERVAL '1 MICROSECOND' AS cutoff,
    MAKE_DATE(CAST(EXTRACT(YEAR FROM start_date) AS INT), 1, 1) AS year_start,
    MAKE_DATE(CAST(EXTRACT(YEAR FROM start_date) AS INT) + 1, 1, 1) AS next_year_start,
    GREATEST(
      CAST(0 AS DECIMAL),
      LEAST(
        CAST(1 AS DECIMAL),
        CAST((
          CAST(LEAST(
            CAST(end_exclusive AS TIMESTAMP),
            DATE_TRUNC('DAY', observed_at) + INTERVAL '1 DAY'
          ) AS DATE) - MAKE_DATE(CAST(EXTRACT(YEAR FROM start_date) AS INT), 1, 1)
        ) AS DECIMAL) / (
          MAKE_DATE(CAST(EXTRACT(YEAR FROM start_date) AS INT) + 1, 1, 1) - MAKE_DATE(CAST(EXTRACT(YEAR FROM start_date) AS INT), 1, 1)
        )
      )
    ) AS time_progress
  FROM parameters AS p
), account_rows AS MATERIALIZED (
  SELECT
    CAST(a.accountid AS TEXT) AS account_id,
    CAST(a.name AS TEXT) AS account_name,
    CAST(a.new_accountlevel AS TEXT) AS level_code,
    CAST(a.new_sapdate AS TIMESTAMP) AS sap_created_at,
    CAST(a.new_sapsubmitdate AS TIMESTAMP) AS sap_submitted_at,
    CAST(a.new_approved_time_facreview AS TIMESTAMP) AS account_factory_approved_at,
    CAST(a.new_submit_time_facreview AS TIMESTAMP) AS account_factory_submitted_at,
    CAST(a.new_sinosurestartdate AS TIMESTAMP) AS account_sinosure_start,
    CAST(a.new_sinosureenddate AS TIMESTAMP) AS account_sinosure_end,
    CAST(a.new_submit_time_accredit AS TIMESTAMP) AS account_credit_submitted_at,
    CAST(a.new_approvaltime_accredit AS TIMESTAMP) AS account_credit_approved_at,
    CAST(a.new_cdastartdate AS TIMESTAMP) AS account_cda_start,
    CAST(a.new_cdaenddate AS TIMESTAMP) AS account_cda_end,
    CAST(a.new_cda_submittime AS TIMESTAMP) AS account_cda_submitted_at,
    CAST(a.new_cda_approved_time AS TIMESTAMP) AS account_cda_approved_at,
    CAST(a.new_approvalstatus_facreview AS TEXT) AS account_factory_approval_status,
    CAST(a.new_sapcode AS TEXT) AS sap_code,
    CAST(a.new_issap AS TEXT) AS sap_registered,
    CAST(a.new_issapnew AS TEXT) AS sap_registration_kind,
    ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
      PARTITION BY a.accountid
      ORDER BY a.modifiedon DESC NULLS LAST, a.createdon DESC NULLS LAST
    ) AS rn
  FROM (
    SELECT
      __x360_raw.*
    FROM ded_public.p_fm_edw_v_ods_crm_account_esb AS __x360_raw
    CROSS JOIN context AS __x360_ctx
    WHERE
      CAST(__x360_raw.createdon AS TIMESTAMP) < __x360_ctx.as_of_exclusive
  ) AS a
  WHERE
    NULLIF(TRIM(CAST(a.accountid AS TEXT)), '') IS NOT NULL
), accounts AS MATERIALIZED (
  SELECT
    account_id,
    account_name,
    level_code,
    sap_created_at,
    sap_submitted_at,
    account_factory_approved_at,
    account_factory_submitted_at,
    account_sinosure_start,
    account_sinosure_end,
    account_credit_submitted_at,
    account_credit_approved_at,
    account_cda_start,
    account_cda_end,
    account_cda_submitted_at,
    account_cda_approved_at,
    account_factory_approval_status,
    sap_code,
    sap_registered,
    sap_registration_kind
  FROM account_rows
  WHERE
    rn = 1
), opportunity_rows AS MATERIALIZED (
  SELECT
    ranked.*
  FROM (
    SELECT
      CAST(o.opportunityid AS TEXT) AS opportunity_id,
      CAST(o.parentaccountid AS TEXT) AS account_id,
      CAST(o.name AS TEXT) AS project_name,
      CAST(o.ownerid AS TEXT) AS owner_id,
      CASE
        WHEN CAST(o.new_accproducttype AS TEXT) IN ('1', '电芯')
        THEN '电芯'
        WHEN CAST(o.new_accproducttype AS TEXT) IN ('2', 'PACK')
        THEN 'PACK'
        ELSE '其他'
      END AS product_type,
      o.__x360_asof_process_stage AS process_stage,
      CAST(o.statecode AS TEXT) AS system_state,
      CAST(o.new_demandinput AS TEXT) AS demand_status,
      CAST(o.createdon AS TIMESTAMP) AS created_at,
      CAST(o.new_stage1enddate AS TIMESTAMP) AS s1,
      CAST(o.new_stage2enddate AS TIMESTAMP) AS s2,
      CAST(o.new_stage3enddate AS TIMESTAMP) AS s3,
      CAST(o.new_stage4enddate AS TIMESTAMP) AS s4,
      CAST(o.new_stage5enddate AS TIMESTAMP) AS s5,
      CAST(o.new_cdastartdate AS TIMESTAMP) AS new_cdastartdate,
      CAST(o.new_cdaenddate AS TIMESTAMP) AS new_cdaenddate,
      CAST(o.new_approved_time_acneed AS TIMESTAMP) AS new_approved_time_acneed,
      CAST(o.new_submit_time_acneed AS TIMESTAMP) AS new_submit_time_acneed,
      CAST(o.new_approved_time_projectassess AS TIMESTAMP) AS new_approved_time_projectassess,
      CAST(o.new_submit_time_projectassess AS TIMESTAMP) AS new_submit_time_projectassess,
      CAST(o.new_sampletestpass_time AS TIMESTAMP) AS new_sampletestpass_time,
      CAST(o.new_sampletime AS TIMESTAMP) AS new_sampletime,
      CAST(o.new_technicalsigningdate AS TIMESTAMP) AS new_technicalsigningdate,
      CAST(o.new_submit_time_techcon AS TIMESTAMP) AS new_submit_time_techcon,
      CAST(o.new_warrantysigningdate AS TIMESTAMP) AS new_warrantysigningdate,
      CAST(o.new_submit_time_qsl AS TIMESTAMP) AS new_submit_time_qsl,
      CAST(o.new_isneedcda AS TEXT) AS new_isneedcda,
      CAST(o.new_approvalstatus_acneed AS TEXT) AS new_approvalstatus_acneed,
      CAST(o.new_approvalstatus_projectassess AS TEXT) AS new_approvalstatus_projectassess,
      CAST(o.new_approvalstatus_techcon AS TEXT) AS new_approvalstatus_techcon,
      CAST(o.new_approvalstatus_qsl AS TEXT) AS new_approvalstatus_qsl,
      CAST(o.new_sampletestresult AS TEXT) AS new_sampletestresult,
      ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
        PARTITION BY o.opportunityid
        ORDER BY o.modifiedon DESC NULLS LAST, o.createdon DESC NULLS LAST
      ) AS rn
    FROM (
      SELECT
        __x360_raw.*,
        CASE
          WHEN CAST(__x360_raw.new_stage1enddate AS TIMESTAMP) IS NULL
          OR CAST(__x360_raw.new_stage1enddate AS TIMESTAMP) >= __x360_ctx.as_of_exclusive
          THEN '11'
          WHEN CAST(__x360_raw.new_stage2enddate AS TIMESTAMP) IS NULL
          OR CAST(__x360_raw.new_stage2enddate AS TIMESTAMP) >= __x360_ctx.as_of_exclusive
          THEN '12'
          WHEN CAST(__x360_raw.new_stage3enddate AS TIMESTAMP) IS NULL
          OR CAST(__x360_raw.new_stage3enddate AS TIMESTAMP) >= __x360_ctx.as_of_exclusive
          THEN '13'
          WHEN CAST(__x360_raw.new_stage4enddate AS TIMESTAMP) IS NULL
          OR CAST(__x360_raw.new_stage4enddate AS TIMESTAMP) >= __x360_ctx.as_of_exclusive
          THEN '14'
          WHEN CAST(__x360_raw.new_stage5enddate AS TIMESTAMP) IS NULL
          OR CAST(__x360_raw.new_stage5enddate AS TIMESTAMP) >= __x360_ctx.as_of_exclusive
          THEN '15'
          ELSE 'completed'
        END AS __x360_asof_process_stage
      FROM ded_public.p_fm_edw_v_ods_crm_opportunity_esb AS __x360_raw
      CROSS JOIN context AS __x360_ctx
    ) AS o
    WHERE
      NULLIF(TRIM(CAST(o.opportunityid AS TEXT)), '') IS NOT NULL
  ) AS ranked
  CROSS JOIN context AS p
  WHERE
    ranked.created_at < p.as_of_exclusive
), opportunities AS MATERIALIZED (
  SELECT
    o.opportunity_id,
    o.account_id,
    o.project_name,
    o.owner_id,
    o.product_type,
    o.process_stage,
    o.demand_status,
    o.created_at,
    o.s1,
    o.s2,
    o.s3,
    o.s4,
    o.s5,
    a.account_name,
    a.level_code,
    o.new_cdastartdate,
    o.new_cdaenddate,
    o.new_approved_time_acneed,
    o.new_submit_time_acneed,
    o.new_approved_time_projectassess,
    o.new_submit_time_projectassess,
    o.new_sampletestpass_time,
    o.new_sampletime,
    o.new_technicalsigningdate,
    o.new_submit_time_techcon,
    o.new_warrantysigningdate,
    o.new_submit_time_qsl,
    o.new_isneedcda,
    o.new_approvalstatus_acneed,
    o.new_approvalstatus_projectassess,
    o.new_approvalstatus_techcon,
    o.new_approvalstatus_qsl,
    o.new_sampletestresult,
    a.sap_created_at,
    a.sap_submitted_at,
    a.sap_code,
    a.account_factory_approved_at,
    a.account_factory_submitted_at,
    a.account_sinosure_start,
    a.account_sinosure_end,
    a.account_credit_submitted_at,
    a.account_credit_approved_at,
    a.account_cda_start,
    a.account_cda_end,
    a.account_cda_submitted_at,
    a.account_cda_approved_at,
    a.account_factory_approval_status
  FROM opportunity_rows AS o
  LEFT JOIN accounts AS a
    USING (account_id)
  CROSS JOIN context AS p
  WHERE
    o.rn = 1 AND (
      o.created_at < p.as_of_exclusive
    )
), orders AS MATERIALIZED (
  SELECT DISTINCT
    CAST(salesorderid AS TEXT) AS order_id
  FROM ded_public.p_fm_edw_v_ods_crm_salesorder_esb
  WHERE
    NULLIF(TRIM(CAST(salesorderid AS TEXT)), '') IS NOT NULL
), order_line_links AS MATERIALIZED (
  SELECT DISTINCT
    CAST(l.new_opportunity_id AS TEXT) AS opportunity_id,
    CAST(l.salesorderid AS TEXT) AS order_id
  FROM ded_public.p_fm_edw_v_ods_crm_salesorderdetail_esb AS l
  WHERE
    NULLIF(TRIM(CAST(l.new_opportunity_id AS TEXT)), '') IS NOT NULL
    AND NULLIF(TRIM(CAST(l.salesorderid AS TEXT)), '') IS NOT NULL
), signed_orders AS MATERIALIZED (
  SELECT
    l.opportunity_id,
    COUNT(DISTINCT l.order_id) AS order_count
  FROM order_line_links AS l
