  JOIN orders AS o
    USING (order_id)
  GROUP BY
    l.opportunity_id
), opportunity_flags AS MATERIALIZED (
  SELECT
    o.*,
    COALESCE(s.order_count, 0) AS order_count,
    CASE
      WHEN COALESCE(s.order_count, 0) = 0
      THEN FALSE
      WHEN o.s4 IS NULL
      THEN FALSE
      ELSE o.s4 < p.as_of_exclusive
    END AS signed,
    (
      COALESCE(s.order_count, 0) > 0 AND o.s4 IS NULL
    ) AS missing_p3_end
  FROM opportunities AS o
  LEFT JOIN signed_orders AS s
    USING (opportunity_id)
  CROSS JOIN context AS p
), node_quote_headers AS MATERIALIZED (
  SELECT
    CAST(q.new_quoteapplyid AS TEXT) AS quote_id,
    CAST(q.createdon AS TIMESTAMP) AS created_at,
    CAST(q.new_oasubmitdate AS TIMESTAMP) AS submitted_at,
    CAST(q.new_approved_time AS TIMESTAMP) AS approved_at,
    CAST(q.new_approvalstatus AS TEXT) AS approval_status
  FROM ded_public.p_fm_edw_v_ods_crm_new_quoteapply_esb AS q
  WHERE
    q.new_quoteapplyid IS NOT NULL
), node_quote_links AS MATERIALIZED (
  SELECT DISTINCT
    CAST(d.new_opportunity_id AS TEXT) AS opportunity_id,
    CAST(d.new_quoteapply_id AS TEXT) AS quote_id
  FROM ded_public.p_fm_edw_v_ods_crm_new_quoteapplydetail_esb AS d
  WHERE
    NULLIF(TRIM(CAST(d.new_opportunity_id AS TEXT)), '') IS NOT NULL
    AND NULLIF(TRIM(CAST(d.new_quoteapply_id AS TEXT)), '') IS NOT NULL
), node_quote_latest AS MATERIALIZED (
  SELECT
    opportunity_id,
    quote_id,
    submitted_at,
    approved_at,
    approval_status
  FROM (
    SELECT
      o.opportunity_id,
      q.quote_id,
      q.submitted_at,
      q.approved_at,
      q.approval_status,
      ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
        PARTITION BY o.opportunity_id
        ORDER BY q.created_at DESC NULLS LAST, q.quote_id DESC
      ) AS rn
    FROM opportunity_flags AS o
    JOIN node_quote_links AS l
      USING (opportunity_id)
    JOIN node_quote_headers AS q
      USING (quote_id)
    CROSS JOIN context AS p
    WHERE
      q.created_at <= p.cutoff
  ) AS ranked
  WHERE
    rn = 1
), node_cycle_source AS MATERIALIZED (
  SELECT
    o.opportunity_id,
    o.product_type,
    n.metric_code,
    n.phase_code,
    n.started_at,
    n.finished_at,
    n.entered_at,
    n.active_flag,
    n.event_id,
    n.finished_at >= p.start_date AND n.finished_at < p.effective_end_exclusive AS in_window,
    p.cutoff
  FROM opportunity_flags AS o
  LEFT JOIN node_quote_latest AS q
    USING (opportunity_id)
  CROSS JOIN context AS p
  CROSS JOIN LATERAL (
    VALUES
      (
        CAST('P0-03' AS TEXT),
        CAST('P0' AS TEXT),
        o.new_cdastartdate,
        o.new_cdaenddate,
        o.new_cdastartdate,
        COALESCE((
          o.new_isneedcda = '2'
        ), FALSE),
        CAST((
          o.opportunity_id
        ) AS TEXT)
      ),
      (
        CAST('P0-04' AS TEXT),
        CAST('P0' AS TEXT),
        o.new_submit_time_acneed,
        o.new_approved_time_acneed,
        o.new_submit_time_acneed,
        COALESCE((
          o.new_approvalstatus_acneed = '2'
        ), FALSE),
        CAST((
          o.opportunity_id
        ) AS TEXT)
      ),
      (
        CAST('P0-06' AS TEXT),
        CAST('P0' AS TEXT),
        o.new_submit_time_acneed,
        o.new_approved_time_acneed,
        o.new_submit_time_acneed,
        COALESCE((
          o.new_approvalstatus_acneed = '2'
        ), FALSE),
        CAST((
          o.opportunity_id
        ) AS TEXT)
      ),
      (
        CAST('P1-03' AS TEXT),
        CAST('P1' AS TEXT),
        o.account_factory_submitted_at,
        o.account_factory_approved_at,
        o.account_factory_submitted_at,
        COALESCE((
          o.account_factory_approval_status = '2'
        ), FALSE),
        CAST((
          o.account_id
        ) AS TEXT)
      ),
      (
        CAST('P1-04' AS TEXT),
        CAST('P1' AS TEXT),
        o.new_submit_time_projectassess,
        o.new_approved_time_projectassess,
        o.new_submit_time_projectassess,
        COALESCE((
          o.new_approvalstatus_projectassess = '2'
        ), FALSE),
        CAST((
          o.opportunity_id
        ) AS TEXT)
      ),
      (
        CAST('P1-05' AS TEXT),
        CAST('P1' AS TEXT),
        o.new_sampletime,
        o.new_sampletestpass_time,
        o.new_sampletime,
        COALESCE((
          o.new_sampletestresult IS NULL
        ), FALSE),
        CAST((
          o.opportunity_id
        ) AS TEXT)
      ),
      (
        CAST('P1-07' AS TEXT),
        CAST('P1' AS TEXT),
        q.submitted_at,
        CASE WHEN q.approval_status = '3' THEN q.approved_at END,
        q.submitted_at,
        COALESCE((
          q.approval_status = '2'
        ), FALSE),
        CAST((
          q.quote_id
        ) AS TEXT)
      ),
      (
        CAST('P2-03' AS TEXT),
        CAST('P2' AS TEXT),
        o.new_submit_time_techcon,
        o.new_technicalsigningdate,
        o.new_submit_time_techcon,
        COALESCE((
          o.new_approvalstatus_techcon = '2'
        ), FALSE),
        CAST((
          o.opportunity_id
        ) AS TEXT)
      ),
      (
        CAST('P2-04' AS TEXT),
        CAST('P2' AS TEXT),
        o.new_submit_time_qsl,
        o.new_warrantysigningdate,
        o.new_submit_time_qsl,
        COALESCE((
          o.new_approvalstatus_qsl = '2'
        ), FALSE),
        CAST((
          o.opportunity_id
        ) AS TEXT)
      )
  ) AS n(metric_code, phase_code, started_at, finished_at, entered_at, active_flag, event_id)
), node_cycle_facts AS MATERIALIZED (
  SELECT
    f.*,
    CASE
      WHEN in_window
      AND event_id IS NOT NULL
      AND started_at IS NOT NULL
      AND finished_at >= started_at
      THEN EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM (
        finished_at - started_at
      )) / CAST(86400 AS DECIMAL)
    END AS duration_days,
    (
      in_window
      AND event_id IS NOT NULL
      AND started_at IS NOT NULL
      AND finished_at >= started_at
    ) AS completed_valid,
    FALSE AS inflight_valid
  FROM node_cycle_source AS f
), node_cycle_means AS MATERIALIZED (
  WITH event_samples AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT
      metric_code,
      product_type,
      event_id,
      duration_days,
      completed_valid,
      inflight_valid
    FROM node_cycle_facts
    WHERE
      duration_days IS NOT NULL
    UNION ALL
    SELECT DISTINCT
      metric_code,
      CAST('全部' AS TEXT) AS product_type,
      event_id,
      duration_days,
      completed_valid,
      inflight_valid
    FROM node_cycle_facts
    WHERE
      duration_days IS NOT NULL
  ), sample_stats AS (
    SELECT
      metric_code,
      product_type,
      COUNT(*) AS sample_count,
      AVG(duration_days) AS mean_days,
      COUNT(*) FILTER(WHERE
        completed_valid) AS completed_count,
      COUNT(*) FILTER(WHERE
        inflight_valid) AS inflight_count
    FROM event_samples
    GROUP BY
      metric_code,
      product_type
  ), quality AS (
    SELECT
      metric_code,
      CASE WHEN GROUPING(product_type) = 1 THEN '全部' ELSE product_type END AS product_type,
      COUNT(*) AS linked_source_rows,
      COUNT(*) FILTER(WHERE
        in_window) AS entry_window_rows,
      COUNT(DISTINCT event_id) FILTER(WHERE
        in_window) AS entered_event_count,
      COUNT(*) FILTER(WHERE
        in_window AND finished_at IS NULL) AS missing_end_rows,
      COUNT(*) FILTER(WHERE
        started_at IS NULL) AS missing_start_rows,
      COUNT(*) FILTER(WHERE
        event_id IS NULL) AS missing_event_id_rows,
      COUNT(*) FILTER(WHERE
        in_window AND finished_at < started_at) AS end_before_start_rows,
      COUNT(*) FILTER(WHERE
        in_window AND finished_at > cutoff AND NOT COALESCE(inflight_valid, FALSE)) AS future_end_without_entry_proof_rows,
      COUNT(*) FILTER(WHERE
        in_window AND finished_at IS NULL AND NOT COALESCE(inflight_valid, FALSE)) AS unknown_completion_rows
    FROM node_cycle_facts
    GROUP BY
      metric_code,
      GROUPING SETS (
        (),
        (
          product_type
        )
      )
  )
  SELECT
    q.*,
    COALESCE(s.sample_count, 0) AS sample_count,
    s.mean_days,
    COALESCE(s.completed_count, 0) AS completed_count,
    COALESCE(s.inflight_count, 0) AS inflight_count
  FROM quality AS q
  LEFT JOIN sample_stats AS s
    USING (metric_code, product_type)
), metric_results AS MATERIALIZED (
  SELECT
    40 AS sort_no,
    CAST('P2-04' AS TEXT) AS code,
    CAST('质保协议平均周期' AS TEXT) AS metric_name,
    CAST(NULL AS TEXT) AS product_team,
    CAST(NULL AS DECIMAL) AS amount_yi,
    CAST(NULL AS DECIMAL) AS energy_gwh,
    CAST(n.sample_count AS BIGINT) AS item_count,
    CAST(NULL AS DECIMAL) AS ratio_value,
    CAST(n.mean_days AS DECIMAL) AS days_value,
    CAST(CASE
      WHEN n.sample_count > 0
      THEN '自身起止已映射；按真实事件去重计算'
      WHEN COALESCE(n.entry_window_rows, 0) = 0
      THEN '已映射；起始时间缺失或不在所选窗口'
      ELSE '已映射；没有有效起止配对，原因见明细'
    END AS TEXT) AS status,
    CAST('商机.new_warrantysigningdate－商机.new_submit_time_qsl，换算天后取平均。仅完整有效已结束事件取真实结束减开始；以本环节结束时间归所选期间，未结束不计入平均。已进入后续阶段的记录也保留，不限定当前阶段枚举。 质保协议提交至签署，不用质保开始/到期日期。 总体按真实事件去重；缺起止数据与缺字段映射分开列示。分组样本不可直接相加。' AS TEXT) AS note,
    (
      SELECT
        JSONB_AGG(TO_JSONB(x))
      FROM node_cycle_means AS x
      WHERE
        x.metric_code = 'P2-04'
    ) AS detail
  FROM context AS p
  LEFT JOIN node_cycle_means AS n
    ON n.metric_code = 'P2-04' AND n.product_type = '全部'
)
SELECT
  r.code AS "指标序号",
  r.metric_name AS "指标名称",
  r.product_team AS "产品团队",
  p.start_date AS "期间开始",
  p.end_exclusive AS "期间结束不含",
  p.cutoff AS "周期观察截止",
  r.amount_yi AS "金额_亿元",
  r.energy_gwh AS "电量_GWh",
  r.item_count AS "数量",
  r.ratio_value AS "比率_原始小数",
  r.days_value AS "平均周期_天",
  CASE
    WHEN r.status = '查询已实现；缺失输入及部分合计见明细'
    THEN CASE
      WHEN r.amount_yi IS NOT NULL
      OR r.energy_gwh IS NOT NULL
      OR r.item_count IS NOT NULL
      OR r.ratio_value IS NOT NULL
      OR r.days_value IS NOT NULL
      THEN '已有查询结果；完整性与适用列见明细'
      ELSE '没有可计算结果；检查输入、时间及关联范围'
    END
    ELSE r.status
  END AS "计算说明状态",
  r.note AS "取值说明",
  r.detail AS "分组明细及缺口"
FROM metric_results AS r
CROSS JOIN context AS p
ORDER BY
  r.sort_no,
  r.product_team;

P2-05.name: 申请中信保限额平均周期
P2-05.definition: 本次补齐采用相关流程/阶段替代。客户.new_approvaltime_accredit－new_submit_time_accredit；否则P2阶段二结束至阶段三实际结束（缺结束不计）。 对所选方法的有效事件取平均，换算天。
P2-05.formula:
所选期间优先使用有效资信申请至批准配对；有样本时只用该方法，否则统一回退P2阶段周期。总体及产品分组使用同一种方法，不混合均值；相关流程仅使用已完成配对，阶段替代也只计完整已结束样本。
阶段及普通环节按各自真实结束时间归所选期间，结束须早于MIN(end_exclusive,观察日次日)；起点可早于期初，不计未结束在途。P0～P4阶段只计起止完整且周期严格大于0的样本；普通独立环节仍沿用各自完整非逆序规则。 P2阶段替代样本同步仅计结束严格晚于开始的正周期；独立资信审批事件仍沿用原有规则。
P2-05.attributes: LE05-A0001 accountid、LE05-A0295 createdon、LE05-A0297 modifiedon、LE05-A0277 name、LE05-A0244 new_accountlevel、LE05-A0191 new_approvalstatus_facreview、LE05-A0057 new_approvaltime_accredit、LE05-A0217 new_approved_time_facreview、LE05-A0167 new_cda_approved_time、LE05-A0088 new_cda_submittime、LE05-A0208 new_cdaenddate、LE05-A0229 new_cdastartdate、LE05-A0016 new_issap、LE05-A0042 new_issapnew、LE05-A0099 new_sapcode、LE05-A0258 new_sapdate、LE05-A0061 new_sapsubmitdate、LE05-A0070 new_sinosureenddate、LE05-A0083 new_sinosurestartdate、LE05-A0197 new_submit_time_accredit、LE05-A0235 new_submit_time_facreview、LE01-A0490 createdon、LE01-A0492 modifiedon、LE01-A0477 name、LE01-A0044 new_accproducttype、LE01-A0430 new_approvalstatus_acneed、LE01-A0431 new_approvalstatus_projectassess、LE01-A0022 new_approvalstatus_qsl、LE01-A0052 new_approvalstatus_techcon、LE01-A0386 new_approved_time_acneed、LE01-A0038 new_approved_time_projectassess、LE01-A0115 new_cdaenddate、LE01-A0153 new_cdastartdate、LE01-A0185 new_demandinput、LE01-A0145 new_isneedcda、LE01-A0451 new_processstage、LE01-A0055 new_sampletestpass_time、LE01-A0143 new_sampletestresult、LE01-A0434 new_sampletime、LE01-A0101 new_stage1enddate、LE01-A0243 new_stage2enddate、LE01-A0100 new_stage3enddate、LE01-A0007 new_stage4enddate、LE01-A0151 new_stage5enddate、LE01-A0290 new_submit_time_acneed、LE01-A0404 new_submit_time_projectassess、LE01-A0147 new_submit_time_qsl、LE01-A0096 new_submit_time_techcon、LE01-A0062 new_technicalsigningdate、LE01-A0441 new_warrantysigningdate、LE01-A0001 opportunityid、LE01-A0486 ownerid、LE01-A0476 parentaccountid、LE01-A0488 statecode、LE07-A0001 salesorderid、LE08-A0025 new_opportunity_id、LE08-A0109 salesorderid

共同字段：商机opportunityid/parentaccountid及各阶段结束日期；相关流程按客户/报价/订单/线索/进展记录ID去重。
P2-05.notes: 资信审批为相关流程替代，不把保险有效期当申请办理耗时。 已按本次“不要留空、全部补上”补齐具体算法；该值是替代口径，输出明确方法和样本，不冒充本环节独立真实耗时。没有任何有效样本时仍保留数据缺失事实，不硬造0。

P2-05.ctes: parameters → context → account_rows → accounts → opportunity_rows → opportunities → orders → order_line_links → signed_orders → opportunity_flags → stage_facts → supplement_cycle_candidates → supplement_cycle_facts → supplement_event_samples → supplement_method_stats → supplement_method_risks → supplement_method_choice → supplement_chosen_stats → supplement_quality
P2-05.sql:
WITH parameters AS MATERIALIZED (
  SELECT
    CAST(%s AS DATE) AS start_date,
    CAST(%s AS DATE) AS end_exclusive,
    CAST(%s AS TIMESTAMP) AS observed_at,
    CAST(ARRAY['1'] AS TEXT[]) AS strategic_levels,
    CAST(ARRAY['1', '2'] AS TEXT[]) AS focus_levels,
    CAST(1000000 AS DECIMAL) AS target_power_units_per_gwh
), context AS MATERIALIZED (
  SELECT
    p.*,
    CAST((
      DATE_TRUNC('DAY', observed_at) + INTERVAL '1 DAY'
    ) AS TIMESTAMP) AS as_of_exclusive,
    LEAST(
      CAST(end_exclusive AS TIMESTAMP),
      DATE_TRUNC('DAY', observed_at) + INTERVAL '1 DAY'
    ) AS effective_end_exclusive,
    LEAST(
      CAST(end_exclusive AS TIMESTAMP),
      DATE_TRUNC('DAY', observed_at) + INTERVAL '1 DAY'
    ) - INTERVAL '1 MICROSECOND' AS cutoff,
    MAKE_DATE(CAST(EXTRACT(YEAR FROM start_date) AS INT), 1, 1) AS year_start,
    MAKE_DATE(CAST(EXTRACT(YEAR FROM start_date) AS INT) + 1, 1, 1) AS next_year_start,
    GREATEST(
      CAST(0 AS DECIMAL),
      LEAST(
        CAST(1 AS DECIMAL),
        CAST((
          CAST(LEAST(
            CAST(end_exclusive AS TIMESTAMP),
            DATE_TRUNC('DAY', observed_at) + INTERVAL '1 DAY'
          ) AS DATE) - MAKE_DATE(CAST(EXTRACT(YEAR FROM start_date) AS INT), 1, 1)
        ) AS DECIMAL) / (
          MAKE_DATE(CAST(EXTRACT(YEAR FROM start_date) AS INT) + 1, 1, 1) - MAKE_DATE(CAST(EXTRACT(YEAR FROM start_date) AS INT), 1, 1)
        )
      )
    ) AS time_progress
  FROM parameters AS p
), account_rows AS MATERIALIZED (
  SELECT
    CAST(a.accountid AS TEXT) AS account_id,
    CAST(a.name AS TEXT) AS account_name,
    CAST(a.new_accountlevel AS TEXT) AS level_code,
    CAST(a.new_sapdate AS TIMESTAMP) AS sap_created_at,
    CAST(a.new_sapsubmitdate AS TIMESTAMP) AS sap_submitted_at,
    CAST(a.new_approved_time_facreview AS TIMESTAMP) AS account_factory_approved_at,
    CAST(a.new_submit_time_facreview AS TIMESTAMP) AS account_factory_submitted_at,
    CAST(a.new_sinosurestartdate AS TIMESTAMP) AS account_sinosure_start,
    CAST(a.new_sinosureenddate AS TIMESTAMP) AS account_sinosure_end,
    CAST(a.new_submit_time_accredit AS TIMESTAMP) AS account_credit_submitted_at,
    CAST(a.new_approvaltime_accredit AS TIMESTAMP) AS account_credit_approved_at,
    CAST(a.new_cdastartdate AS TIMESTAMP) AS account_cda_start,
    CAST(a.new_cdaenddate AS TIMESTAMP) AS account_cda_end,
    CAST(a.new_cda_submittime AS TIMESTAMP) AS account_cda_submitted_at,
    CAST(a.new_cda_approved_time AS TIMESTAMP) AS account_cda_approved_at,
    CAST(a.new_approvalstatus_facreview AS TEXT) AS account_factory_approval_status,
    CAST(a.new_sapcode AS TEXT) AS sap_code,
    CAST(a.new_issap AS TEXT) AS sap_registered,
    CAST(a.new_issapnew AS TEXT) AS sap_registration_kind,
    ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
      PARTITION BY a.accountid
      ORDER BY a.modifiedon DESC NULLS LAST, a.createdon DESC NULLS LAST
    ) AS rn
  FROM (
    SELECT
      __x360_raw.*
    FROM ded_public.p_fm_edw_v_ods_crm_account_esb AS __x360_raw
    CROSS JOIN context AS __x360_ctx
    WHERE
      CAST(__x360_raw.createdon AS TIMESTAMP) < __x360_ctx.as_of_exclusive
  ) AS a
  WHERE
    NULLIF(TRIM(CAST(a.accountid AS TEXT)), '') IS NOT NULL
), accounts AS MATERIALIZED (
  SELECT
    account_id,
    account_name,
    level_code,
    sap_created_at,
    sap_submitted_at,
    account_factory_approved_at,
    account_factory_submitted_at,
    account_sinosure_start,
    account_sinosure_end,
    account_credit_submitted_at,
    account_credit_approved_at,
    account_cda_start,
    account_cda_end,
    account_cda_submitted_at,
    account_cda_approved_at,
    account_factory_approval_status,
    sap_code,
    sap_registered,
    sap_registration_kind
  FROM account_rows
  WHERE
    rn = 1
), opportunity_rows AS MATERIALIZED (
  SELECT
    ranked.*
  FROM (
    SELECT
      CAST(o.opportunityid AS TEXT) AS opportunity_id,
      CAST(o.parentaccountid AS TEXT) AS account_id,
      CAST(o.name AS TEXT) AS project_name,
      CAST(o.ownerid AS TEXT) AS owner_id,
      CASE
        WHEN CAST(o.new_accproducttype AS TEXT) IN ('1', '电芯')
        THEN '电芯'
        WHEN CAST(o.new_accproducttype AS TEXT) IN ('2', 'PACK')
        THEN 'PACK'
        ELSE '其他'
      END AS product_type,
      o.__x360_asof_process_stage AS process_stage,
      CAST(o.statecode AS TEXT) AS system_state,
      CAST(o.new_demandinput AS TEXT) AS demand_status,
      CAST(o.createdon AS TIMESTAMP) AS created_at,
      CAST(o.new_stage1enddate AS TIMESTAMP) AS s1,
      CAST(o.new_stage2enddate AS TIMESTAMP) AS s2,
      CAST(o.new_stage3enddate AS TIMESTAMP) AS s3,
      CAST(o.new_stage4enddate AS TIMESTAMP) AS s4,
      CAST(o.new_stage5enddate AS TIMESTAMP) AS s5,
      CAST(o.new_cdastartdate AS TIMESTAMP) AS new_cdastartdate,
      CAST(o.new_cdaenddate AS TIMESTAMP) AS new_cdaenddate,
      CAST(o.new_approved_time_acneed AS TIMESTAMP) AS new_approved_time_acneed,
      CAST(o.new_submit_time_acneed AS TIMESTAMP) AS new_submit_time_acneed,
      CAST(o.new_approved_time_projectassess AS TIMESTAMP) AS new_approved_time_projectassess,
      CAST(o.new_submit_time_projectassess AS TIMESTAMP) AS new_submit_time_projectassess,
      CAST(o.new_sampletestpass_time AS TIMESTAMP) AS new_sampletestpass_time,
      CAST(o.new_sampletime AS TIMESTAMP) AS new_sampletime,
      CAST(o.new_technicalsigningdate AS TIMESTAMP) AS new_technicalsigningdate,
      CAST(o.new_submit_time_techcon AS TIMESTAMP) AS new_submit_time_techcon,
      CAST(o.new_warrantysigningdate AS TIMESTAMP) AS new_warrantysigningdate,
      CAST(o.new_submit_time_qsl AS TIMESTAMP) AS new_submit_time_qsl,
      CAST(o.new_isneedcda AS TEXT) AS new_isneedcda,
      CAST(o.new_approvalstatus_acneed AS TEXT) AS new_approvalstatus_acneed,
      CAST(o.new_approvalstatus_projectassess AS TEXT) AS new_approvalstatus_projectassess,
      CAST(o.new_approvalstatus_techcon AS TEXT) AS new_approvalstatus_techcon,
      CAST(o.new_approvalstatus_qsl AS TEXT) AS new_approvalstatus_qsl,
      CAST(o.new_sampletestresult AS TEXT) AS new_sampletestresult,
      ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
        PARTITION BY o.opportunityid
        ORDER BY o.modifiedon DESC NULLS LAST, o.createdon DESC NULLS LAST
      ) AS rn
    FROM (
      SELECT
        __x360_raw.*,
        CASE
          WHEN CAST(__x360_raw.new_stage1enddate AS TIMESTAMP) IS NULL
          OR CAST(__x360_raw.new_stage1enddate AS TIMESTAMP) >= __x360_ctx.as_of_exclusive
          THEN '11'
          WHEN CAST(__x360_raw.new_stage2enddate AS TIMESTAMP) IS NULL
          OR CAST(__x360_raw.new_stage2enddate AS TIMESTAMP) >= __x360_ctx.as_of_exclusive
          THEN '12'
          WHEN CAST(__x360_raw.new_stage3enddate AS TIMESTAMP) IS NULL
          OR CAST(__x360_raw.new_stage3enddate AS TIMESTAMP) >= __x360_ctx.as_of_exclusive
          THEN '13'
          WHEN CAST(__x360_raw.new_stage4enddate AS TIMESTAMP) IS NULL
          OR CAST(__x360_raw.new_stage4enddate AS TIMESTAMP) >= __x360_ctx.as_of_exclusive
          THEN '14'
          WHEN CAST(__x360_raw.new_stage5enddate AS TIMESTAMP) IS NULL
          OR CAST(__x360_raw.new_stage5enddate AS TIMESTAMP) >= __x360_ctx.as_of_exclusive
          THEN '15'
          ELSE 'completed'
        END AS __x360_asof_process_stage
      FROM ded_public.p_fm_edw_v_ods_crm_opportunity_esb AS __x360_raw
      CROSS JOIN context AS __x360_ctx
    ) AS o
    WHERE
      NULLIF(TRIM(CAST(o.opportunityid AS TEXT)), '') IS NOT NULL
  ) AS ranked
  CROSS JOIN context AS p
  WHERE
    ranked.created_at < p.as_of_exclusive
), opportunities AS MATERIALIZED (
  SELECT
    o.opportunity_id,
    o.account_id,
    o.project_name,
    o.owner_id,
    o.product_type,
    o.process_stage,
    o.demand_status,
    o.created_at,
    o.s1,
    o.s2,
    o.s3,
    o.s4,
    o.s5,
    a.account_name,
    a.level_code,
    o.new_cdastartdate,
    o.new_cdaenddate,
    o.new_approved_time_acneed,
    o.new_submit_time_acneed,
    o.new_approved_time_projectassess,
    o.new_submit_time_projectassess,
    o.new_sampletestpass_time,
    o.new_sampletime,
    o.new_technicalsigningdate,
    o.new_submit_time_techcon,
    o.new_warrantysigningdate,
    o.new_submit_time_qsl,
    o.new_isneedcda,
    o.new_approvalstatus_acneed,
    o.new_approvalstatus_projectassess,
    o.new_approvalstatus_techcon,
    o.new_approvalstatus_qsl,
    o.new_sampletestresult,
    a.sap_created_at,
    a.sap_submitted_at,
    a.sap_code,
    a.account_factory_approved_at,
    a.account_factory_submitted_at,
    a.account_sinosure_start,
    a.account_sinosure_end,
    a.account_credit_submitted_at,
    a.account_credit_approved_at,
    a.account_cda_start,
    a.account_cda_end,
    a.account_cda_submitted_at,
    a.account_cda_approved_at,
    a.account_factory_approval_status
  FROM opportunity_rows AS o
  LEFT JOIN accounts AS a
    USING (account_id)
  CROSS JOIN context AS p
  WHERE
    o.rn = 1 AND (
      o.created_at < p.as_of_exclusive
    )
), orders AS MATERIALIZED (
  SELECT DISTINCT
    CAST(salesorderid AS TEXT) AS order_id
  FROM ded_public.p_fm_edw_v_ods_crm_salesorder_esb
  WHERE
    NULLIF(TRIM(CAST(salesorderid AS TEXT)), '') IS NOT NULL
), order_line_links AS MATERIALIZED (
  SELECT DISTINCT
    CAST(l.new_opportunity_id AS TEXT) AS opportunity_id,
    CAST(l.salesorderid AS TEXT) AS order_id
  FROM ded_public.p_fm_edw_v_ods_crm_salesorderdetail_esb AS l
  WHERE
    NULLIF(TRIM(CAST(l.new_opportunity_id AS TEXT)), '') IS NOT NULL
    AND NULLIF(TRIM(CAST(l.salesorderid AS TEXT)), '') IS NOT NULL
), signed_orders AS MATERIALIZED (
  SELECT
    l.opportunity_id,
    COUNT(DISTINCT l.order_id) AS order_count
  FROM order_line_links AS l
  JOIN orders AS o
    USING (order_id)
  GROUP BY
    l.opportunity_id
), opportunity_flags AS MATERIALIZED (
  SELECT
    o.*,
    COALESCE(s.order_count, 0) AS order_count,
    CASE
      WHEN COALESCE(s.order_count, 0) = 0
      THEN FALSE
      WHEN o.s4 IS NULL
      THEN FALSE
      ELSE o.s4 < p.as_of_exclusive
    END AS signed,
    (
      COALESCE(s.order_count, 0) > 0 AND o.s4 IS NULL
    ) AS missing_p3_end
  FROM opportunities AS o
  LEFT JOIN signed_orders AS s
    USING (opportunity_id)
  CROSS JOIN context AS p
), stage_facts AS MATERIALIZED (
SELECT
    o.*,
    v.stage_code,
    v.started_at,
    v.finished_at,
    CASE
      WHEN v.started_at IS NOT NULL AND v.finished_at > v.started_at
      THEN EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM (
        v.finished_at - v.started_at
      )) / CAST(86400 AS DECIMAL)
    END AS elapsed_days,
    (
      v.finished_at >= p.start_date AND v.finished_at < p.effective_end_exclusive
    ) AS in_window,
    FALSE AS inflight,
    (
      v.started_at IS NULL OR v.finished_at IS NULL OR v.finished_at <= v.started_at
    ) AS invalid_dates
  FROM opportunity_flags AS o
  CROSS JOIN context AS p
  CROSS JOIN LATERAL (
    VALUES
      (CAST('P0' AS TEXT), o.created_at, o.s1),
      (CAST('P1' AS TEXT), o.s1, o.s2),
      (CAST('P2' AS TEXT), o.s2, o.s3),
      (CAST('P3' AS TEXT), o.s3, o.s4),
      (CAST('P4' AS TEXT), o.s4, o.s5)
  ) AS v(stage_code, started_at, finished_at)
  WHERE
    v.finished_at IS NOT NULL
    AND v.finished_at >= p.start_date
    AND v.finished_at < p.effective_end_exclusive
), supplement_cycle_candidates AS MATERIALIZED (
  SELECT
    CAST('P2-05' AS TEXT) AS metric_code,
    CAST('CUSTOMER_CREDIT' AS TEXT) AS method,
    10 AS priority,
    CAST('客户资信申请审批（相关流程替代）' AS TEXT) AS method_name,
    CAST(o.account_id AS TEXT) AS event_id,
    o.product_type,
    o.account_credit_submitted_at AS started_at,
    o.account_credit_approved_at AS finished_at,
    FALSE AS allow_inflight
  FROM opportunity_flags AS o
  UNION ALL
  SELECT
    'P2-05',
    'PHASE_P2',
    100,
    'P2所属阶段周期（阶段替代）',
    f.opportunity_id,
    f.product_type,
    f.started_at,
    f.finished_at,
    FALSE
  FROM stage_facts AS f
  WHERE
    f.stage_code = 'P2'
), supplement_cycle_facts AS MATERIALIZED (
  SELECT
    c.*,
    p.cutoff,
    (
      c.finished_at >= p.start_date AND c.finished_at < p.effective_end_exclusive
    ) AS in_window,
    CASE
      WHEN c.event_id IS NOT NULL
      AND c.started_at IS NOT NULL
      AND c.finished_at >= p.start_date
      AND c.finished_at < p.effective_end_exclusive
      AND c.finished_at >= c.started_at
      THEN EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM (
        c.finished_at - c.started_at
      )) / CAST(86400 AS DECIMAL)
    END AS duration_days,
    FALSE AS inflight
  FROM supplement_cycle_candidates AS c
  CROSS JOIN context AS p
), supplement_event_samples AS MATERIALIZED (
  SELECT DISTINCT
    metric_code,
    method,
    priority,
    method_name,
    event_id,
    product_type,
    duration_days,
    inflight
  FROM supplement_cycle_facts
  WHERE
    duration_days IS NOT NULL
  UNION ALL
  SELECT DISTINCT
    metric_code,
    method,
    priority,
    method_name,
    event_id,
    '全部',
    duration_days,
    inflight
  FROM supplement_cycle_facts
  WHERE
    duration_days IS NOT NULL
), supplement_method_stats AS MATERIALIZED (
  SELECT
    metric_code,
    method,
    priority,
    method_name,
    product_type,
    COUNT(*) AS sample_count,
    AVG(duration_days) AS mean_days,
    COUNT(*) FILTER(WHERE
      inflight) AS inflight_count
  FROM supplement_event_samples
  GROUP BY
    metric_code,
    method,
    priority,
    method_name,
    product_type
), supplement_method_risks AS MATERIALIZED (
  SELECT
    e.metric_code,
    e.method,
    e.product_type,
    COUNT(DISTINCT e.event_id) FILTER(WHERE
      e.duration_days > s.mean_days * 1.5) AS over_1_5_mean_events
  FROM supplement_event_samples AS e
  JOIN supplement_method_stats AS s
    USING (metric_code, method, product_type)
  GROUP BY
    e.metric_code,
    e.method,
    e.product_type
), supplement_method_choice AS MATERIALIZED (
  SELECT
    metric_code,
    method
  FROM (
    SELECT
      metric_code,
      method,
      ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY metric_code ORDER BY priority, method) AS rn
    FROM supplement_method_stats
    WHERE
      product_type = '全部' AND sample_count > 0
  ) AS x
  WHERE
    rn = 1
), supplement_chosen_stats AS MATERIALIZED (
  SELECT
    s.*,
    r.over_1_5_mean_events
  FROM supplement_method_stats AS s
  JOIN supplement_method_choice AS k
    USING (metric_code, method)
  LEFT JOIN supplement_method_risks AS r
    USING (metric_code, method, product_type)
), supplement_quality AS MATERIALIZED (
  SELECT
    metric_code,
    method,
    method_name,
    priority,
    COUNT(*) AS linked_source_rows,
    COUNT(*) FILTER(WHERE
      in_window) AS start_in_window_rows,
    COUNT(*) FILTER(WHERE
      started_at IS NULL) AS missing_start_all_source_rows,
    COUNT(*) FILTER(WHERE
      in_window AND finished_at IS NULL) AS missing_end_window_rows,
    COUNT(*) FILTER(WHERE
      in_window AND finished_at < started_at) AS reversed_window_rows,
    COUNT(DISTINCT event_id) FILTER(WHERE
      duration_days IS NOT NULL) AS valid_events
  FROM supplement_cycle_facts
  GROUP BY
    metric_code,
    method,
    method_name,
    priority
), metric_results AS MATERIALIZED (
  SELECT
    41 AS sort_no,
    CAST('P2-05' AS TEXT) AS code,
    CAST('申请中信保限额平均周期' AS TEXT) AS metric_name,
    CAST(NULL AS TEXT) AS product_team,
    CAST(NULL AS DECIMAL) AS amount_yi,
    CAST(NULL AS DECIMAL) AS energy_gwh,
    CAST(COALESCE(s.sample_count, 0) AS BIGINT) AS item_count,
    CAST(NULL AS DECIMAL) AS ratio_value,
    CAST(s.mean_days AS DECIMAL) AS days_value,
    CAST(CASE
      WHEN s.method LIKE 'PHASE_%%'
      THEN '已补齐：所属阶段周期替代'
      WHEN s.sample_count > 0
      THEN '已补齐：相关流程或记录区间替代'
      ELSE '已配置计算及回退算法；所选期间无有效样本'
    END AS TEXT) AS status,
    CAST('客户.new_approvaltime_accredit－new_submit_time_accredit；否则P2阶段二结束至阶段三实际结束（缺结束不计）。 资信审批为相关流程替代，不把保险有效期当申请办理耗时。 同一指标按整体样本选一种方法，不混算；所选方法、样本数、备选方法及缺失计数见明细。' AS TEXT) AS note,
    JSONB_BUILD_OBJECT(
      '本次所选方法',
      s.method_name,
      '替代口径限制',
      '资信审批为相关流程替代，不把保险有效期当申请办理耗时。',
      '所选方法产品分组',
      (
        SELECT
          JSONB_AGG(TO_JSONB(x))
        FROM supplement_chosen_stats AS x
        WHERE
          x.metric_code = 'P2-05'
      ),
      '全部方法与样本',
      (
        SELECT
          JSONB_AGG(TO_JSONB(x))
        FROM supplement_method_stats AS x
        WHERE
          x.metric_code = 'P2-05'
      ),
      '缺失与逆序',
      (
        SELECT
          JSONB_AGG(TO_JSONB(x))
        FROM supplement_quality AS x
        WHERE
          x.metric_code = 'P2-05'
      )
    ) AS detail
  FROM context AS p
  LEFT JOIN supplement_chosen_stats AS s
    ON s.metric_code = 'P2-05' AND s.product_type = '全部'
)
SELECT
  r.code AS "指标序号",
  r.metric_name AS "指标名称",
  r.product_team AS "产品团队",
  p.start_date AS "期间开始",
  p.end_exclusive AS "期间结束不含",
  p.cutoff AS "周期观察截止",
  r.amount_yi AS "金额_亿元",
  r.energy_gwh AS "电量_GWh",
  r.item_count AS "数量",
  r.ratio_value AS "比率_原始小数",
  r.days_value AS "平均周期_天",
  CASE
    WHEN r.status = '查询已实现；缺失输入及部分合计见明细'
    THEN CASE
      WHEN r.amount_yi IS NOT NULL
      OR r.energy_gwh IS NOT NULL
      OR r.item_count IS NOT NULL
      OR r.ratio_value IS NOT NULL
      OR r.days_value IS NOT NULL
      THEN '已有查询结果；完整性与适用列见明细'
      ELSE '没有可计算结果；检查输入、时间及关联范围'
    END
    ELSE r.status
  END AS "计算说明状态",
  r.note AS "取值说明",
  r.detail AS "分组明细及缺口"
FROM metric_results AS r
CROSS JOIN context AS p
ORDER BY
  r.sort_no,
  r.product_team;

P3-01.name: 合同签订阶段平均周期
P3-01.definition: P3周期＝new_stage3enddate→new_stage4enddate。仅本阶段结束时间落所选期间且截止前已结束、起止完整且周期严格大于0的商机参与平均；开始可以在2024年或更早，不按当前阶段枚举排除历史经历。
P3-01.formula: 实际平均周期仍按有效明细AVG(结束－开始)计算，总体直接按明细平均，电芯/PACK/其他分别展示；仅完整已结束且周期严格大于0的样本参与，0天、缺值及逆序不参与。不按当前阶段枚举筛样本，缺预测不排除周期样本。超期比较基线固定为P3=57.2天，同阶段所有产品共用，不随所选期间或样本均值变化；单笔周期严格>57.2×1.5天时命中对应P*-02，等于不触发。结束须落所选期间且早于观察日次日，起点可跨年，不计在途。
P3-01.attributes:
LE01-A0007 商机管理.阶段四结束日期（new_stage4enddate，空 87.73%）
LE01-A0100 商机管理.阶段三结束日期（new_stage3enddate，空 74.35%）
LE01-A0451 商机管理.项目阶段（new_processstage，空 0%）
P3-01.physicalFields: 商机.new_stage3enddate→new_stage4enddate；不要求当前new_processstage为本阶段枚举
P3-01.notes: 数量列＝参与实际平均周期的严格正周期样本数。缺结束只影响该阶段，不整条商机剔除；已结束的其他阶段仍可计算。实际均值仅作展示，不用作本次阶段超期/分档基线。
P3-01.sqlStatus: 查询已实现；缺失输入及部分合计见明细
P3-01.role: 跨阶段参考（不参与本节点链路）
P3-01.ctes: parameters → context → account_rows → accounts → opportunity_rows → opportunities → orders → order_line_links → signed_orders → opportunity_flags → stage_facts → stage_means
P3-01.sql:
WITH parameters AS MATERIALIZED (
  SELECT
    CAST(%s AS DATE) AS start_date,
    CAST(%s AS DATE) AS end_exclusive,
    CAST(%s AS TIMESTAMP) AS observed_at,
    CAST(ARRAY['1'] AS TEXT[]) AS strategic_levels,
    CAST(ARRAY['1', '2'] AS TEXT[]) AS focus_levels,
    CAST(1000000 AS DECIMAL) AS target_power_units_per_gwh
), context AS MATERIALIZED (
  SELECT
    p.*,
    CAST((
      DATE_TRUNC('DAY', observed_at) + INTERVAL '1 DAY'
    ) AS TIMESTAMP) AS as_of_exclusive,
    LEAST(
      CAST(end_exclusive AS TIMESTAMP),
      DATE_TRUNC('DAY', observed_at) + INTERVAL '1 DAY'
    ) AS effective_end_exclusive,
    LEAST(
      CAST(end_exclusive AS TIMESTAMP),
      DATE_TRUNC('DAY', observed_at) + INTERVAL '1 DAY'
    ) - INTERVAL '1 MICROSECOND' AS cutoff,
    MAKE_DATE(CAST(EXTRACT(YEAR FROM start_date) AS INT), 1, 1) AS year_start,
    MAKE_DATE(CAST(EXTRACT(YEAR FROM start_date) AS INT) + 1, 1, 1) AS next_year_start,
    GREATEST(
      CAST(0 AS DECIMAL),
      LEAST(
        CAST(1 AS DECIMAL),
        CAST((
          CAST(LEAST(
            CAST(end_exclusive AS TIMESTAMP),
            DATE_TRUNC('DAY', observed_at) + INTERVAL '1 DAY'
          ) AS DATE) - MAKE_DATE(CAST(EXTRACT(YEAR FROM start_date) AS INT), 1, 1)
        ) AS DECIMAL) / (
          MAKE_DATE(CAST(EXTRACT(YEAR FROM start_date) AS INT) + 1, 1, 1) - MAKE_DATE(CAST(EXTRACT(YEAR FROM start_date) AS INT), 1, 1)
        )
      )
    ) AS time_progress
  FROM parameters AS p
), account_rows AS MATERIALIZED (
  SELECT
    CAST(a.accountid AS TEXT) AS account_id,
    CAST(a.name AS TEXT) AS account_name,
    CAST(a.new_accountlevel AS TEXT) AS level_code,
    CAST(a.new_sapdate AS TIMESTAMP) AS sap_created_at,
    CAST(a.new_sapsubmitdate AS TIMESTAMP) AS sap_submitted_at,
    CAST(a.new_approved_time_facreview AS TIMESTAMP) AS account_factory_approved_at,
    CAST(a.new_submit_time_facreview AS TIMESTAMP) AS account_factory_submitted_at,
    CAST(a.new_sinosurestartdate AS TIMESTAMP) AS account_sinosure_start,
    CAST(a.new_sinosureenddate AS TIMESTAMP) AS account_sinosure_end,
    CAST(a.new_submit_time_accredit AS TIMESTAMP) AS account_credit_submitted_at,
    CAST(a.new_approvaltime_accredit AS TIMESTAMP) AS account_credit_approved_at,
    CAST(a.new_cdastartdate AS TIMESTAMP) AS account_cda_start,
    CAST(a.new_cdaenddate AS TIMESTAMP) AS account_cda_end,
    CAST(a.new_cda_submittime AS TIMESTAMP) AS account_cda_submitted_at,
    CAST(a.new_cda_approved_time AS TIMESTAMP) AS account_cda_approved_at,
    CAST(a.new_approvalstatus_facreview AS TEXT) AS account_factory_approval_status,
    CAST(a.new_sapcode AS TEXT) AS sap_code,
    CAST(a.new_issap AS TEXT) AS sap_registered,
    CAST(a.new_issapnew AS TEXT) AS sap_registration_kind,
    ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
      PARTITION BY a.accountid
      ORDER BY a.modifiedon DESC NULLS LAST, a.createdon DESC NULLS LAST
    ) AS rn
  FROM (
    SELECT
      __x360_raw.*
    FROM ded_public.p_fm_edw_v_ods_crm_account_esb AS __x360_raw
    CROSS JOIN context AS __x360_ctx
    WHERE
      CAST(__x360_raw.createdon AS TIMESTAMP) < __x360_ctx.as_of_exclusive
  ) AS a
  WHERE
    NULLIF(TRIM(CAST(a.accountid AS TEXT)), '') IS NOT NULL
), accounts AS MATERIALIZED (
  SELECT
    account_id,
    account_name,
    level_code,
    sap_created_at,
    sap_submitted_at,
    account_factory_approved_at,
    account_factory_submitted_at,
    account_sinosure_start,
    account_sinosure_end,
    account_credit_submitted_at,
    account_credit_approved_at,
    account_cda_start,
    account_cda_end,
    account_cda_submitted_at,
    account_cda_approved_at,
    account_factory_approval_status,
    sap_code,
    sap_registered,
    sap_registration_kind
  FROM account_rows
  WHERE
    rn = 1
), opportunity_rows AS MATERIALIZED (
  SELECT
    ranked.*
  FROM (
    SELECT
      CAST(o.opportunityid AS TEXT) AS opportunity_id,
      CAST(o.parentaccountid AS TEXT) AS account_id,
      CAST(o.name AS TEXT) AS project_name,
      CAST(o.ownerid AS TEXT) AS owner_id,
      CASE
        WHEN CAST(o.new_accproducttype AS TEXT) IN ('1', '电芯')
        THEN '电芯'
        WHEN CAST(o.new_accproducttype AS TEXT) IN ('2', 'PACK')
        THEN 'PACK'
        ELSE '其他'
      END AS product_type,
      o.__x360_asof_process_stage AS process_stage,
      CAST(o.statecode AS TEXT) AS system_state,
      CAST(o.new_demandinput AS TEXT) AS demand_status,
      CAST(o.createdon AS TIMESTAMP) AS created_at,
      CAST(o.new_stage1enddate AS TIMESTAMP) AS s1,
      CAST(o.new_stage2enddate AS TIMESTAMP) AS s2,
      CAST(o.new_stage3enddate AS TIMESTAMP) AS s3,
      CAST(o.new_stage4enddate AS TIMESTAMP) AS s4,
      CAST(o.new_stage5enddate AS TIMESTAMP) AS s5,
      CAST(o.new_cdastartdate AS TIMESTAMP) AS new_cdastartdate,
      CAST(o.new_cdaenddate AS TIMESTAMP) AS new_cdaenddate,
      CAST(o.new_approved_time_acneed AS TIMESTAMP) AS new_approved_time_acneed,
      CAST(o.new_submit_time_acneed AS TIMESTAMP) AS new_submit_time_acneed,
      CAST(o.new_approved_time_projectassess AS TIMESTAMP) AS new_approved_time_projectassess,
      CAST(o.new_submit_time_projectassess AS TIMESTAMP) AS new_submit_time_projectassess,
      CAST(o.new_sampletestpass_time AS TIMESTAMP) AS new_sampletestpass_time,
      CAST(o.new_sampletime AS TIMESTAMP) AS new_sampletime,
      CAST(o.new_technicalsigningdate AS TIMESTAMP) AS new_technicalsigningdate,
      CAST(o.new_submit_time_techcon AS TIMESTAMP) AS new_submit_time_techcon,
      CAST(o.new_warrantysigningdate AS TIMESTAMP) AS new_warrantysigningdate,
      CAST(o.new_submit_time_qsl AS TIMESTAMP) AS new_submit_time_qsl,
      CAST(o.new_isneedcda AS TEXT) AS new_isneedcda,
      CAST(o.new_approvalstatus_acneed AS TEXT) AS new_approvalstatus_acneed,
      CAST(o.new_approvalstatus_projectassess AS TEXT) AS new_approvalstatus_projectassess,
      CAST(o.new_approvalstatus_techcon AS TEXT) AS new_approvalstatus_techcon,
      CAST(o.new_approvalstatus_qsl AS TEXT) AS new_approvalstatus_qsl,
      CAST(o.new_sampletestresult AS TEXT) AS new_sampletestresult,
      ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
        PARTITION BY o.opportunityid
        ORDER BY o.modifiedon DESC NULLS LAST, o.createdon DESC NULLS LAST
      ) AS rn
    FROM (
      SELECT
        __x360_raw.*,
        CASE
          WHEN CAST(__x360_raw.new_stage1enddate AS TIMESTAMP) IS NULL
          OR CAST(__x360_raw.new_stage1enddate AS TIMESTAMP) >= __x360_ctx.as_of_exclusive
          THEN '11'
          WHEN CAST(__x360_raw.new_stage2enddate AS TIMESTAMP) IS NULL
          OR CAST(__x360_raw.new_stage2enddate AS TIMESTAMP) >= __x360_ctx.as_of_exclusive
          THEN '12'
          WHEN CAST(__x360_raw.new_stage3enddate AS TIMESTAMP) IS NULL
          OR CAST(__x360_raw.new_stage3enddate AS TIMESTAMP) >= __x360_ctx.as_of_exclusive
          THEN '13'
          WHEN CAST(__x360_raw.new_stage4enddate AS TIMESTAMP) IS NULL
          OR CAST(__x360_raw.new_stage4enddate AS TIMESTAMP) >= __x360_ctx.as_of_exclusive
          THEN '14'
          WHEN CAST(__x360_raw.new_stage5enddate AS TIMESTAMP) IS NULL
          OR CAST(__x360_raw.new_stage5enddate AS TIMESTAMP) >= __x360_ctx.as_of_exclusive
          THEN '15'
          ELSE 'completed'
        END AS __x360_asof_process_stage
      FROM ded_public.p_fm_edw_v_ods_crm_opportunity_esb AS __x360_raw
      CROSS JOIN context AS __x360_ctx
    ) AS o
    WHERE
      NULLIF(TRIM(CAST(o.opportunityid AS TEXT)), '') IS NOT NULL
  ) AS ranked
  CROSS JOIN context AS p
  WHERE
    ranked.created_at < p.as_of_exclusive
), opportunities AS MATERIALIZED (
  SELECT
    o.opportunity_id,
    o.account_id,
    o.project_name,
    o.owner_id,
    o.product_type,
    o.process_stage,
    o.demand_status,
    o.created_at,
    o.s1,
    o.s2,
    o.s3,
    o.s4,
    o.s5,
    a.account_name,
    a.level_code,
    o.new_cdastartdate,
    o.new_cdaenddate,
    o.new_approved_time_acneed,
    o.new_submit_time_acneed,
    o.new_approved_time_projectassess,
    o.new_submit_time_projectassess,
    o.new_sampletestpass_time,
    o.new_sampletime,
    o.new_technicalsigningdate,
    o.new_submit_time_techcon,
    o.new_warrantysigningdate,
    o.new_submit_time_qsl,
    o.new_isneedcda,
    o.new_approvalstatus_acneed,
    o.new_approvalstatus_projectassess,
    o.new_approvalstatus_techcon,
    o.new_approvalstatus_qsl,
    o.new_sampletestresult,
    a.sap_created_at,
    a.sap_submitted_at,
    a.sap_code,
    a.account_factory_approved_at,
    a.account_factory_submitted_at,
    a.account_sinosure_start,
    a.account_sinosure_end,
    a.account_credit_submitted_at,
    a.account_credit_approved_at,
    a.account_cda_start,
    a.account_cda_end,
    a.account_cda_submitted_at,
    a.account_cda_approved_at,
    a.account_factory_approval_status
  FROM opportunity_rows AS o
  LEFT JOIN accounts AS a
    USING (account_id)
  CROSS JOIN context AS p
  WHERE
    o.rn = 1 AND (
      o.created_at < p.as_of_exclusive
    )
), orders AS MATERIALIZED (
  SELECT DISTINCT
    CAST(salesorderid AS TEXT) AS order_id
  FROM ded_public.p_fm_edw_v_ods_crm_salesorder_esb
  WHERE
    NULLIF(TRIM(CAST(salesorderid AS TEXT)), '') IS NOT NULL
), order_line_links AS MATERIALIZED (
  SELECT DISTINCT
    CAST(l.new_opportunity_id AS TEXT) AS opportunity_id,
    CAST(l.salesorderid AS TEXT) AS order_id
  FROM ded_public.p_fm_edw_v_ods_crm_salesorderdetail_esb AS l
  WHERE
    NULLIF(TRIM(CAST(l.new_opportunity_id AS TEXT)), '') IS NOT NULL
    AND NULLIF(TRIM(CAST(l.salesorderid AS TEXT)), '') IS NOT NULL
), signed_orders AS MATERIALIZED (
  SELECT
    l.opportunity_id,
    COUNT(DISTINCT l.order_id) AS order_count
  FROM order_line_links AS l
  JOIN orders AS o
    USING (order_id)
  GROUP BY
    l.opportunity_id
), opportunity_flags AS MATERIALIZED (
  SELECT
    o.*,
    COALESCE(s.order_count, 0) AS order_count,
    CASE
      WHEN COALESCE(s.order_count, 0) = 0
      THEN FALSE
      WHEN o.s4 IS NULL
      THEN FALSE
      ELSE o.s4 < p.as_of_exclusive
    END AS signed,
    (
      COALESCE(s.order_count, 0) > 0 AND o.s4 IS NULL
    ) AS missing_p3_end
  FROM opportunities AS o
  LEFT JOIN signed_orders AS s
    USING (opportunity_id)
  CROSS JOIN context AS p
), stage_facts AS MATERIALIZED (
SELECT
    o.*,
    v.stage_code,
    v.started_at,
    v.finished_at,
    CASE
      WHEN v.started_at IS NOT NULL AND v.finished_at > v.started_at
      THEN EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM (
        v.finished_at - v.started_at
      )) / CAST(86400 AS DECIMAL)
    END AS elapsed_days,
    (
      v.finished_at >= p.start_date AND v.finished_at < p.effective_end_exclusive
    ) AS in_window,
    FALSE AS inflight,
    (
      v.started_at IS NULL OR v.finished_at IS NULL OR v.finished_at <= v.started_at
    ) AS invalid_dates
  FROM opportunity_flags AS o
  CROSS JOIN context AS p
  CROSS JOIN LATERAL (
    VALUES
      (CAST('P0' AS TEXT), o.created_at, o.s1),
      (CAST('P1' AS TEXT), o.s1, o.s2),
      (CAST('P2' AS TEXT), o.s2, o.s3),
      (CAST('P3' AS TEXT), o.s3, o.s4),
      (CAST('P4' AS TEXT), o.s4, o.s5)
  ) AS v(stage_code, started_at, finished_at)
  WHERE
    v.finished_at IS NOT NULL
    AND v.finished_at >= p.start_date
    AND v.finished_at < p.effective_end_exclusive
), stage_means AS MATERIALIZED (
SELECT stage_code, product_type,
    AVG(elapsed_days) FILTER (WHERE NOT invalid_dates) AS mean_days,
    CASE stage_code
      WHEN 'P0' THEN 32.6::numeric
      WHEN 'P1' THEN 21.8::numeric
      WHEN 'P2' THEN 7.2::numeric
      WHEN 'P3' THEN 57.2::numeric
      WHEN 'P4' THEN 15.3::numeric
    END AS baseline_days,
    COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE NOT invalid_dates) AS sample_count,
    COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE invalid_dates) AS invalid_count,
    COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE finished_at = started_at) AS zero_duration_count,
    0::bigint AS inflight_count
  FROM stage_facts WHERE in_window
  GROUP BY stage_code, product_type
), metric_results AS MATERIALIZED (
SELECT
    42 AS sort_no,
    CAST('P3-01' AS TEXT) AS code,
    CAST('合同签订阶段平均周期' AS TEXT) AS metric_name,
    CAST(NULL AS TEXT) AS product_team,
    CAST((
      NULL
    ) AS DECIMAL) AS amount_yi,
    CAST((
      NULL
    ) AS DECIMAL) AS energy_gwh,
    CAST(COUNT(f.elapsed_days) AS BIGINT) AS item_count,
    CAST((
      NULL
    ) AS DECIMAL) AS ratio_value,
    CAST(AVG(f.elapsed_days) AS DECIMAL) AS days_value,
    CAST('查询已实现；缺失输入及部分合计见明细' AS TEXT) AS status,
    CAST('new_stage3enddate→new_stage4enddate；仅完整起止且周期严格大于0的样本参与均值及数量；各阶段单独判断，缺结束不以观察截止补齐；按本阶段结束时间归期，开始可以早于期初，按实际完整周期计算；不限制当前阶段枚举。' AS TEXT) AS note,
    CAST((
      (
        SELECT
          JSONB_AGG(TO_JSONB(t))
        FROM stage_means AS t
        WHERE
          stage_code = 'P3'
      )
    ) AS JSONB) AS detail
  FROM stage_facts AS f
  WHERE
    stage_code = 'P3' AND in_window
)
SELECT
  r.code AS "指标序号",
  r.metric_name AS "指标名称",
  r.product_team AS "产品团队",
  p.start_date AS "期间开始",
  p.end_exclusive AS "期间结束不含",
  p.cutoff AS "周期观察截止",
  r.amount_yi AS "金额_亿元",
  r.energy_gwh AS "电量_GWh",
  r.item_count AS "数量",
  r.ratio_value AS "比率_原始小数",
  r.days_value AS "平均周期_天",
  CASE
    WHEN r.status = '查询已实现；缺失输入及部分合计见明细'
    THEN CASE
      WHEN r.amount_yi IS NOT NULL
      OR r.energy_gwh IS NOT NULL
      OR r.item_count IS NOT NULL
      OR r.ratio_value IS NOT NULL
      OR r.days_value IS NOT NULL
      THEN '已有查询结果；完整性与适用列见明细'
      ELSE '没有可计算结果；检查输入、时间及关联范围'
    END
    ELSE r.status
  END AS "计算说明状态",
  r.note AS "取值说明",
  r.detail AS "分组明细及缺口"
FROM metric_results AS r
CROSS JOIN context AS p
ORDER BY
  r.sort_no,
  r.product_team;

P3-02.name: 合同签订阶段超过静态基线 50% 的商机预测总量
P3-02.definition: 本阶段结束时间在所选期间、截至前已结束且周期严格大于0的商机中，实际周期严格>P3静态基线57.2天×1.5，按商机ID去重后汇总期间预测。
P3-02.formula: 超期基线固定为P3=57.2天，同阶段电芯/PACK/其他共用；不按所选样本重新计算。仅完整有效已结束且周期严格大于0的记录参与，0天、缺值及逆序排除。严格大于1.5倍才触发，等于不触发；预测先聚合到商机，缺预测不阻断命中数量。结束须落所选期间且早于观察日次日，起点无期初下限，当前阶段枚举不作过滤。
P3-02.attributes:
LE01-A0007 商机管理.阶段四结束日期（new_stage4enddate，空 87.73%）
LE01-A0100 商机管理.阶段三结束日期（new_stage3enddate，空 74.35%）
LE01-A0451 商机管理.项目阶段（new_processstage，空 0%）
P3-02.physicalFields: 商机.new_stage3enddate→new_stage4enddate；opportunityid/modifiedon用于去重；产品new_accproducttype用于产品分组展示，超期基线按阶段固定；预测new_accountdate、createdon及金额/Wh单价用于期间预测。当前new_processstage枚举不作周期过滤。
P3-02.notes: 采用P3静态基线57.2天，不随产品或统计期间变化；超期与实际均值样本均按阶段真实结束时间归期、完整且周期严格大于0。开始可跨年，不计在途，不按当前阶段排除历史经历；预测缺失不挡命中数量。
P3-02.sqlStatus: 查询已实现；缺失输入及部分合计见明细
P3-02.role: 跨阶段参考（不参与本节点链路）
P3-02.ctes: parameters → context → account_rows → accounts → opportunity_rows → opportunities → orders → order_line_links → signed_orders → opportunity_flags → forecast_rows → forecast_facts → opportunity_forecast → stage_facts → stage_means → stage_overdue
P3-02.sql:
WITH parameters AS MATERIALIZED (
  SELECT
    CAST(%s AS DATE) AS start_date,
    CAST(%s AS DATE) AS end_exclusive,
    CAST(%s AS TIMESTAMP) AS observed_at,
    CAST(ARRAY['1'] AS TEXT[]) AS strategic_levels,
    CAST(ARRAY['1', '2'] AS TEXT[]) AS focus_levels,
    CAST(1000000 AS DECIMAL) AS target_power_units_per_gwh
), context AS MATERIALIZED (
  SELECT
    p.*,
    CAST((
      DATE_TRUNC('DAY', observed_at) + INTERVAL '1 DAY'
    ) AS TIMESTAMP) AS as_of_exclusive,
    LEAST(
      CAST(end_exclusive AS TIMESTAMP),
      DATE_TRUNC('DAY', observed_at) + INTERVAL '1 DAY'
    ) AS effective_end_exclusive,
    LEAST(
      CAST(end_exclusive AS TIMESTAMP),
      DATE_TRUNC('DAY', observed_at) + INTERVAL '1 DAY'
    ) - INTERVAL '1 MICROSECOND' AS cutoff,
    MAKE_DATE(CAST(EXTRACT(YEAR FROM start_date) AS INT), 1, 1) AS year_start,
    MAKE_DATE(CAST(EXTRACT(YEAR FROM start_date) AS INT) + 1, 1, 1) AS next_year_start,
    GREATEST(
      CAST(0 AS DECIMAL),
      LEAST(
        CAST(1 AS DECIMAL),
        CAST((
          CAST(LEAST(
            CAST(end_exclusive AS TIMESTAMP),
            DATE_TRUNC('DAY', observed_at) + INTERVAL '1 DAY'
          ) AS DATE) - MAKE_DATE(CAST(EXTRACT(YEAR FROM start_date) AS INT), 1, 1)
        ) AS DECIMAL) / (
          MAKE_DATE(CAST(EXTRACT(YEAR FROM start_date) AS INT) + 1, 1, 1) - MAKE_DATE(CAST(EXTRACT(YEAR FROM start_date) AS INT), 1, 1)
        )
      )
    ) AS time_progress
  FROM parameters AS p
), account_rows AS MATERIALIZED (
  SELECT
    CAST(a.accountid AS TEXT) AS account_id,
    CAST(a.name AS TEXT) AS account_name,
    CAST(a.new_accountlevel AS TEXT) AS level_code,
    CAST(a.new_sapdate AS TIMESTAMP) AS sap_created_at,
    CAST(a.new_sapsubmitdate AS TIMESTAMP) AS sap_submitted_at,
    CAST(a.new_approved_time_facreview AS TIMESTAMP) AS account_factory_approved_at,
    CAST(a.new_submit_time_facreview AS TIMESTAMP) AS account_factory_submitted_at,
    CAST(a.new_sinosurestartdate AS TIMESTAMP) AS account_sinosure_start,
    CAST(a.new_sinosureenddate AS TIMESTAMP) AS account_sinosure_end,
    CAST(a.new_submit_time_accredit AS TIMESTAMP) AS account_credit_submitted_at,
    CAST(a.new_approvaltime_accredit AS TIMESTAMP) AS account_credit_approved_at,
    CAST(a.new_cdastartdate AS TIMESTAMP) AS account_cda_start,
    CAST(a.new_cdaenddate AS TIMESTAMP) AS account_cda_end,
    CAST(a.new_cda_submittime AS TIMESTAMP) AS account_cda_submitted_at,
    CAST(a.new_cda_approved_time AS TIMESTAMP) AS account_cda_approved_at,
    CAST(a.new_approvalstatus_facreview AS TEXT) AS account_factory_approval_status,
    CAST(a.new_sapcode AS TEXT) AS sap_code,
    CAST(a.new_issap AS TEXT) AS sap_registered,
    CAST(a.new_issapnew AS TEXT) AS sap_registration_kind,
    ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
      PARTITION BY a.accountid
      ORDER BY a.modifiedon DESC NULLS LAST, a.createdon DESC NULLS LAST
    ) AS rn
  FROM (
    SELECT
      __x360_raw.*
    FROM ded_public.p_fm_edw_v_ods_crm_account_esb AS __x360_raw
    CROSS JOIN context AS __x360_ctx
    WHERE
      CAST(__x360_raw.createdon AS TIMESTAMP) < __x360_ctx.as_of_exclusive
  ) AS a
  WHERE
    NULLIF(TRIM(CAST(a.accountid AS TEXT)), '') IS NOT NULL
), accounts AS MATERIALIZED (
  SELECT
    account_id,
    account_name,
    level_code,
    sap_created_at,
    sap_submitted_at,
    account_factory_approved_at,
    account_factory_submitted_at,
    account_sinosure_start,
    account_sinosure_end,
    account_credit_submitted_at,
    account_credit_approved_at,
    account_cda_start,
    account_cda_end,
    account_cda_submitted_at,
    account_cda_approved_at,
    account_factory_approval_status,
    sap_code,
    sap_registered,
    sap_registration_kind
  FROM account_rows
  WHERE
    rn = 1
), opportunity_rows AS MATERIALIZED (
  SELECT
    ranked.*
  FROM (
    SELECT
      CAST(o.opportunityid AS TEXT) AS opportunity_id,
      CAST(o.parentaccountid AS TEXT) AS account_id,
      CAST(o.name AS TEXT) AS project_name,
      CAST(o.ownerid AS TEXT) AS owner_id,
      CASE
        WHEN CAST(o.new_accproducttype AS TEXT) IN ('1', '电芯')
        THEN '电芯'
        WHEN CAST(o.new_accproducttype AS TEXT) IN ('2', 'PACK')
        THEN 'PACK'
        ELSE '其他'
      END AS product_type,
      o.__x360_asof_process_stage AS process_stage,
      CAST(o.statecode AS TEXT) AS system_state,
      CAST(o.new_demandinput AS TEXT) AS demand_status,
      CAST(o.createdon AS TIMESTAMP) AS created_at,
      CAST(o.new_stage1enddate AS TIMESTAMP) AS s1,
      CAST(o.new_stage2enddate AS TIMESTAMP) AS s2,
      CAST(o.new_stage3enddate AS TIMESTAMP) AS s3,
      CAST(o.new_stage4enddate AS TIMESTAMP) AS s4,
      CAST(o.new_stage5enddate AS TIMESTAMP) AS s5,
      CAST(o.new_cdastartdate AS TIMESTAMP) AS new_cdastartdate,
      CAST(o.new_cdaenddate AS TIMESTAMP) AS new_cdaenddate,
      CAST(o.new_approved_time_acneed AS TIMESTAMP) AS new_approved_time_acneed,
      CAST(o.new_submit_time_acneed AS TIMESTAMP) AS new_submit_time_acneed,
      CAST(o.new_approved_time_projectassess AS TIMESTAMP) AS new_approved_time_projectassess,
      CAST(o.new_submit_time_projectassess AS TIMESTAMP) AS new_submit_time_projectassess,
      CAST(o.new_sampletestpass_time AS TIMESTAMP) AS new_sampletestpass_time,
      CAST(o.new_sampletime AS TIMESTAMP) AS new_sampletime,
      CAST(o.new_technicalsigningdate AS TIMESTAMP) AS new_technicalsigningdate,
      CAST(o.new_submit_time_techcon AS TIMESTAMP) AS new_submit_time_techcon,
      CAST(o.new_warrantysigningdate AS TIMESTAMP) AS new_warrantysigningdate,
      CAST(o.new_submit_time_qsl AS TIMESTAMP) AS new_submit_time_qsl,
      CAST(o.new_isneedcda AS TEXT) AS new_isneedcda,
      CAST(o.new_approvalstatus_acneed AS TEXT) AS new_approvalstatus_acneed,
      CAST(o.new_approvalstatus_projectassess AS TEXT) AS new_approvalstatus_projectassess,
      CAST(o.new_approvalstatus_techcon AS TEXT) AS new_approvalstatus_techcon,
      CAST(o.new_approvalstatus_qsl AS TEXT) AS new_approvalstatus_qsl,
      CAST(o.new_sampletestresult AS TEXT) AS new_sampletestresult,
      ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
        PARTITION BY o.opportunityid
        ORDER BY o.modifiedon DESC NULLS LAST, o.createdon DESC NULLS LAST
      ) AS rn
    FROM (
      SELECT
        __x360_raw.*,
        CASE
          WHEN CAST(__x360_raw.new_stage1enddate AS TIMESTAMP) IS NULL
          OR CAST(__x360_raw.new_stage1enddate AS TIMESTAMP) >= __x360_ctx.as_of_exclusive
          THEN '11'
          WHEN CAST(__x360_raw.new_stage2enddate AS TIMESTAMP) IS NULL
          OR CAST(__x360_raw.new_stage2enddate AS TIMESTAMP) >= __x360_ctx.as_of_exclusive
          THEN '12'
          WHEN CAST(__x360_raw.new_stage3enddate AS TIMESTAMP) IS NULL
          OR CAST(__x360_raw.new_stage3enddate AS TIMESTAMP) >= __x360_ctx.as_of_exclusive
          THEN '13'
          WHEN CAST(__x360_raw.new_stage4enddate AS TIMESTAMP) IS NULL
          OR CAST(__x360_raw.new_stage4enddate AS TIMESTAMP) >= __x360_ctx.as_of_exclusive
          THEN '14'
          WHEN CAST(__x360_raw.new_stage5enddate AS TIMESTAMP) IS NULL
          OR CAST(__x360_raw.new_stage5enddate AS TIMESTAMP) >= __x360_ctx.as_of_exclusive
          THEN '15'
          ELSE 'completed'
        END AS __x360_asof_process_stage
      FROM ded_public.p_fm_edw_v_ods_crm_opportunity_esb AS __x360_raw
      CROSS JOIN context AS __x360_ctx
    ) AS o
    WHERE
      NULLIF(TRIM(CAST(o.opportunityid AS TEXT)), '') IS NOT NULL
  ) AS ranked
  CROSS JOIN context AS p
  WHERE
    ranked.created_at < p.as_of_exclusive
), opportunities AS MATERIALIZED (
  SELECT
    o.opportunity_id,
    o.account_id,
    o.project_name,
    o.owner_id,
    o.product_type,
    o.process_stage,
    o.demand_status,
    o.created_at,
    o.s1,
    o.s2,
    o.s3,
    o.s4,
    o.s5,
    a.account_name,
    a.level_code,
    o.new_cdastartdate,
    o.new_cdaenddate,
    o.new_approved_time_acneed,
    o.new_submit_time_acneed,
    o.new_approved_time_projectassess,
    o.new_submit_time_projectassess,
    o.new_sampletestpass_time,
    o.new_sampletime,
    o.new_technicalsigningdate,
    o.new_submit_time_techcon,
    o.new_warrantysigningdate,
    o.new_submit_time_qsl,
    o.new_isneedcda,
    o.new_approvalstatus_acneed,
    o.new_approvalstatus_projectassess,
    o.new_approvalstatus_techcon,
    o.new_approvalstatus_qsl,
    o.new_sampletestresult,
    a.sap_created_at,
    a.sap_submitted_at,
    a.sap_code,
    a.account_factory_approved_at,
    a.account_factory_submitted_at,
    a.account_sinosure_start,
    a.account_sinosure_end,
    a.account_credit_submitted_at,
    a.account_credit_approved_at,
    a.account_cda_start,
    a.account_cda_end,
    a.account_cda_submitted_at,
    a.account_cda_approved_at,
    a.account_factory_approval_status
  FROM opportunity_rows AS o
  LEFT JOIN accounts AS a
    USING (account_id)
  CROSS JOIN context AS p
  WHERE
    o.rn = 1 AND (
      o.created_at < p.as_of_exclusive
    )
), orders AS MATERIALIZED (
  SELECT DISTINCT
    CAST(salesorderid AS TEXT) AS order_id
  FROM ded_public.p_fm_edw_v_ods_crm_salesorder_esb
  WHERE
    NULLIF(TRIM(CAST(salesorderid AS TEXT)), '') IS NOT NULL
), order_line_links AS MATERIALIZED (
  SELECT DISTINCT
    CAST(l.new_opportunity_id AS TEXT) AS opportunity_id,
    CAST(l.salesorderid AS TEXT) AS order_id
  FROM ded_public.p_fm_edw_v_ods_crm_salesorderdetail_esb AS l
  WHERE
    NULLIF(TRIM(CAST(l.new_opportunity_id AS TEXT)), '') IS NOT NULL
    AND NULLIF(TRIM(CAST(l.salesorderid AS TEXT)), '') IS NOT NULL
), signed_orders AS MATERIALIZED (
  SELECT
    l.opportunity_id,
    COUNT(DISTINCT l.order_id) AS order_count
  FROM order_line_links AS l
  JOIN orders AS o
    USING (order_id)
  GROUP BY
    l.opportunity_id
), opportunity_flags AS MATERIALIZED (
  SELECT
    o.*,
    COALESCE(s.order_count, 0) AS order_count,
    CASE
      WHEN COALESCE(s.order_count, 0) = 0
      THEN FALSE
      WHEN o.s4 IS NULL
      THEN FALSE
      ELSE o.s4 < p.as_of_exclusive
    END AS signed,
    (
      COALESCE(s.order_count, 0) > 0 AND o.s4 IS NULL
    ) AS missing_p3_end
  FROM opportunities AS o
  LEFT JOIN signed_orders AS s
    USING (opportunity_id)
  CROSS JOIN context AS p
), forecast_rows AS MATERIALIZED (
  SELECT
    CAST(m.new_oppmonthid AS TEXT) AS forecast_id,
    CAST(m.new_opportunity_id AS TEXT) AS opportunity_id,
    CAST(m.new_accountdate AS TIMESTAMP) AS forecast_month,
    CAST(m.new_forecast_amt_rmb AS DECIMAL) AS amount_yuan,
    CAST(m.new_whprice AS DECIMAL) AS wh_price,
    ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
      PARTITION BY m.new_opportunity_id, DATE_TRUNC('MONTH', CAST(m.new_accountdate AS TIMESTAMP))
      ORDER BY m.createdon DESC NULLS LAST, m.modifiedon DESC NULLS LAST, m.new_oppmonthid DESC NULLS LAST
    ) AS rn
  FROM (
    SELECT
      __x360_raw.*
    FROM ded_public.p_fm_edw_v_ods_crm_new_oppmonth_esb AS __x360_raw
    CROSS JOIN context AS __x360_ctx
    WHERE
      CAST(__x360_raw.createdon AS TIMESTAMP) < __x360_ctx.as_of_exclusive
  ) AS m
  CROSS JOIN context AS p
  WHERE
    NULLIF(TRIM(CAST(m.new_oppmonthid AS TEXT)), '') IS NOT NULL
    AND NULLIF(TRIM(CAST(m.new_opportunity_id AS TEXT)), '') IS NOT NULL
    AND CAST(m.new_accountdate AS TIMESTAMP) >= p.start_date
    AND CAST(m.new_accountdate AS TIMESTAMP) < p.end_exclusive
), forecast_facts AS MATERIALIZED (
  SELECT
    f.forecast_id,
    f.forecast_month,
    o.*,
    f.amount_yuan / CAST(100000000 AS DECIMAL) AS amount_yi,
    f.amount_yuan / NULLIF(f.wh_price, 0) / CAST(1000000000 AS DECIMAL) AS energy_gwh
  FROM forecast_rows AS f
  JOIN opportunity_flags AS o
    USING (opportunity_id)
  WHERE
    f.rn = 1
), opportunity_forecast AS MATERIALIZED (
  SELECT
    opportunity_id,
    COUNT(*) AS forecast_rows,
    SUM(amount_yi) AS amount_yi,
    SUM(energy_gwh) AS energy_gwh,
    COUNT(*) FILTER(WHERE
      amount_yi IS NULL) AS missing_amount_rows,
    COUNT(*) FILTER(WHERE
      energy_gwh IS NULL) AS missing_energy_rows
  FROM forecast_facts
  GROUP BY
    opportunity_id
), stage_facts AS MATERIALIZED (
SELECT
    o.*,
    v.stage_code,
    v.started_at,
    v.finished_at,
    CASE
      WHEN v.started_at IS NOT NULL AND v.finished_at > v.started_at
      THEN EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM (
        v.finished_at - v.started_at
      )) / CAST(86400 AS DECIMAL)
    END AS elapsed_days,
    (
      v.finished_at >= p.start_date AND v.finished_at < p.effective_end_exclusive
    ) AS in_window,
    FALSE AS inflight,
    (
      v.started_at IS NULL OR v.finished_at IS NULL OR v.finished_at <= v.started_at
    ) AS invalid_dates
  FROM opportunity_flags AS o
  CROSS JOIN context AS p
  CROSS JOIN LATERAL (
    VALUES
      (CAST('P0' AS TEXT), o.created_at, o.s1),
      (CAST('P1' AS TEXT), o.s1, o.s2),
      (CAST('P2' AS TEXT), o.s2, o.s3),
      (CAST('P3' AS TEXT), o.s3, o.s4),
      (CAST('P4' AS TEXT), o.s4, o.s5)
  ) AS v(stage_code, started_at, finished_at)
  WHERE
    v.finished_at IS NOT NULL
    AND v.finished_at >= p.start_date
    AND v.finished_at < p.effective_end_exclusive
), stage_means AS MATERIALIZED (
SELECT stage_code, product_type,
    AVG(elapsed_days) FILTER (WHERE NOT invalid_dates) AS mean_days,
    CASE stage_code
      WHEN 'P0' THEN 32.6::numeric
      WHEN 'P1' THEN 21.8::numeric
      WHEN 'P2' THEN 7.2::numeric
      WHEN 'P3' THEN 57.2::numeric
      WHEN 'P4' THEN 15.3::numeric
    END AS baseline_days,
    COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE NOT invalid_dates) AS sample_count,
    COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE invalid_dates) AS invalid_count,
    COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE finished_at = started_at) AS zero_duration_count,
    0::bigint AS inflight_count
  FROM stage_facts WHERE in_window
  GROUP BY stage_code, product_type
), stage_overdue AS MATERIALIZED (
SELECT f.*,m.mean_days,m.baseline_days,
    (f.elapsed_days-m.baseline_days) AS excess_days,
    (f.elapsed_days-m.baseline_days)/NULLIF(m.baseline_days,0) AS excess_ratio,
    ofc.amount_yi,ofc.energy_gwh,
    (m.baseline_days > 0 AND f.elapsed_days > 1.5::numeric*m.baseline_days) AS overdue
  FROM stage_facts f JOIN stage_means m USING(stage_code,product_type)
  LEFT JOIN opportunity_forecast ofc USING(opportunity_id)
  WHERE f.in_window AND NOT f.invalid_dates
), metric_results AS MATERIALIZED (
SELECT
    43 AS sort_no,
    CAST('P3-02' AS TEXT) AS code,
    CAST('合同签订阶段超过静态基线 50%% 的商机预测总量' AS TEXT) AS metric_name,
    CAST(NULL AS TEXT) AS product_team,
    CAST((
      SUM(amount_yi)
    ) AS DECIMAL) AS amount_yi,
    CAST((
      SUM(energy_gwh)
    ) AS DECIMAL) AS energy_gwh,
    CAST((
      COUNT(DISTINCT opportunity_id)
    ) AS BIGINT) AS item_count,
    CAST((
      NULL
    ) AS DECIMAL) AS ratio_value,
    CAST((
      NULL
    ) AS DECIMAL) AS days_value,
    CAST('查询已实现；缺失输入及部分合计见明细' AS TEXT) AS status,
    CAST('超过本阶段静态基线1.5倍；同商机每阶段只计一次；该商机期间预测先聚合后关联，不因订单或预测行重复累计。' AS TEXT) AS note,
    CAST((
      JSONB_AGG(
        JSONB_BUILD_OBJECT('商机ID', opportunity_id, '产品', product_type, '周期天', elapsed_days, '静态基线天', baseline_days, '超出基线天数', excess_days, '超出基线比例_原始小数', excess_ratio, '超出基线百分比数值', excess_ratio*100)
      )
    ) AS JSONB) AS detail
  FROM stage_overdue AS f
  WHERE
    stage_code = 'P3' AND in_window AND overdue
)
SELECT
  r.code AS "指标序号",
  r.metric_name AS "指标名称",
  r.product_team AS "产品团队",
  p.start_date AS "期间开始",
  p.end_exclusive AS "期间结束不含",
  p.cutoff AS "周期观察截止",
  r.amount_yi AS "金额_亿元",
  r.energy_gwh AS "电量_GWh",
  r.item_count AS "数量",
  r.ratio_value AS "比率_原始小数",
  r.days_value AS "平均周期_天",
  CASE
    WHEN r.status = '查询已实现；缺失输入及部分合计见明细'
    THEN CASE
      WHEN r.amount_yi IS NOT NULL
      OR r.energy_gwh IS NOT NULL
      OR r.item_count IS NOT NULL
      OR r.ratio_value IS NOT NULL
      OR r.days_value IS NOT NULL
      THEN '已有查询结果；完整性与适用列见明细'
      ELSE '没有可计算结果；检查输入、时间及关联范围'
    END
    ELSE r.status
  END AS "计算说明状态",
  r.note AS "取值说明",
  r.detail AS "分组明细及缺口"
FROM metric_results AS r
CROSS JOIN context AS p
ORDER BY
  r.sort_no,
  r.product_team;

P3-03.name: 完成批量报价平均周期
P3-03.definition: 报价申请单.new_approved_time－new_oasubmitdate，按报价申请ID去重后取平均，换算天。
P3-03.formula:
通过报价申请明细关联商机，沿用当前最新关联报价申请；按OA审批时间归年/月。只算真实起止，不再回退P3阶段。
阶段及普通环节按各自真实结束时间归所选期间，结束须早于MIN(end_exclusive,观察日次日)；起点可早于期初，不计未结束在途。P0～P4阶段只计起止完整且周期严格大于0的样本；普通独立环节仍沿用各自完整非逆序规则。
P3-03.attributes: LE05-A0001 accountid、LE05-A0295 createdon、LE05-A0297 modifiedon、LE05-A0277 name、LE05-A0244 new_accountlevel、LE05-A0191 new_approvalstatus_facreview、LE05-A0057 new_approvaltime_accredit、LE05-A0217 new_approved_time_facreview、LE05-A0167 new_cda_approved_time、LE05-A0088 new_cda_submittime、LE05-A0208 new_cdaenddate、LE05-A0229 new_cdastartdate、LE05-A0016 new_issap、LE05-A0042 new_issapnew、LE05-A0099 new_sapcode、LE05-A0258 new_sapdate、LE05-A0061 new_sapsubmitdate、LE05-A0070 new_sinosureenddate、LE05-A0083 new_sinosurestartdate、LE05-A0197 new_submit_time_accredit、LE05-A0235 new_submit_time_facreview、LE01-A0490 createdon、LE01-A0492 modifiedon、LE01-A0477 name、LE01-A0044 new_accproducttype、LE01-A0430 new_approvalstatus_acneed、LE01-A0431 new_approvalstatus_projectassess、LE01-A0022 new_approvalstatus_qsl、LE01-A0052 new_approvalstatus_techcon、LE01-A0386 new_approved_time_acneed、LE01-A0038 new_approved_time_projectassess、LE01-A0115 new_cdaenddate、LE01-A0153 new_cdastartdate、LE01-A0185 new_demandinput、LE01-A0145 new_isneedcda、LE01-A0451 new_processstage、LE01-A0055 new_sampletestpass_time、LE01-A0143 new_sampletestresult、LE01-A0434 new_sampletime、LE01-A0101 new_stage1enddate、LE01-A0243 new_stage2enddate、LE01-A0100 new_stage3enddate、LE01-A0007 new_stage4enddate、LE01-A0151 new_stage5enddate、LE01-A0290 new_submit_time_acneed、LE01-A0404 new_submit_time_projectassess、LE01-A0147 new_submit_time_qsl、LE01-A0096 new_submit_time_techcon、LE01-A0062 new_technicalsigningdate、LE01-A0441 new_warrantysigningdate、LE01-A0001 opportunityid、LE01-A0486 ownerid、LE01-A0476 parentaccountid、LE01-A0488 statecode、LE07-A0001 salesorderid、LE08-A0025 new_opportunity_id、LE08-A0109 salesorderid、LE14-A0021 createdon、LE14-A0007 new_approvalstatus、LE14-A0003 new_approved_time、LE14-A0005 new_oasubmitdate、LE14-A0001 new_quoteapplyid、LE15-A0012 new_opportunity_id、LE15-A0008 new_quoteapply_id
P3-03.physicalFields: 报价申请单.new_quoteapplyid/new_oasubmitdate/new_approved_time/createdon；报价申请明细.new_opportunity_id/new_quoteapply_id；商机.opportunityid。
P3-03.notes:
用户红字：报价申请单时间进行计算，oa提交-oa审批
处理：按红字启用报价OA周期；与P1-06复用同一计算结果，不读取全空的批量报价确认完成日期。
P3-03.sqlStatus: 按结果动态判定（见调用SQL）；已同步红字口径
P3-03.v3Change: 按红字修订同步：实际调用SQL及计算步骤已更新；待确认项保持NULL。
P3-03.role: 跨阶段参考（不参与本节点链路）
P3-03.ctes: parameters → context → account_rows → accounts → opportunity_rows → opportunities → orders → order_line_links → signed_orders → opportunity_flags → node_quote_headers → node_quote_links → node_quote_latest → review_quote_cycle_events → review_quote_cycle_facts → review_quote_cycle_samples → review_quote_cycle_stats → review_quote_cycle_quality
P3-03.sql:
WITH parameters AS MATERIALIZED (
  SELECT
    CAST(%s AS DATE) AS start_date,
    CAST(%s AS DATE) AS end_exclusive,
    CAST(%s AS TIMESTAMP) AS observed_at,
    CAST(ARRAY['1'] AS TEXT[]) AS strategic_levels,
    CAST(ARRAY['1', '2'] AS TEXT[]) AS focus_levels,
    CAST(1000000 AS DECIMAL) AS target_power_units_per_gwh
), context AS MATERIALIZED (
  SELECT
    p.*,
    CAST((
      DATE_TRUNC('DAY', observed_at) + INTERVAL '1 DAY'
    ) AS TIMESTAMP) AS as_of_exclusive,
    LEAST(
      CAST(end_exclusive AS TIMESTAMP),
      DATE_TRUNC('DAY', observed_at) + INTERVAL '1 DAY'
    ) AS effective_end_exclusive,
    LEAST(
      CAST(end_exclusive AS TIMESTAMP),
      DATE_TRUNC('DAY', observed_at) + INTERVAL '1 DAY'
    ) - INTERVAL '1 MICROSECOND' AS cutoff,
    MAKE_DATE(CAST(EXTRACT(YEAR FROM start_date) AS INT), 1, 1) AS year_start,
    MAKE_DATE(CAST(EXTRACT(YEAR FROM start_date) AS INT) + 1, 1, 1) AS next_year_start,
    GREATEST(
      CAST(0 AS DECIMAL),
      LEAST(
        CAST(1 AS DECIMAL),
        CAST((
          CAST(LEAST(
            CAST(end_exclusive AS TIMESTAMP),
            DATE_TRUNC('DAY', observed_at) + INTERVAL '1 DAY'
          ) AS DATE) - MAKE_DATE(CAST(EXTRACT(YEAR FROM start_date) AS INT), 1, 1)
        ) AS DECIMAL) / (
          MAKE_DATE(CAST(EXTRACT(YEAR FROM start_date) AS INT) + 1, 1, 1) - MAKE_DATE(CAST(EXTRACT(YEAR FROM start_date) AS INT), 1, 1)
        )
      )
    ) AS time_progress
  FROM parameters AS p
), account_rows AS MATERIALIZED (
  SELECT
    CAST(a.accountid AS TEXT) AS account_id,
    CAST(a.name AS TEXT) AS account_name,
    CAST(a.new_accountlevel AS TEXT) AS level_code,
    CAST(a.new_sapdate AS TIMESTAMP) AS sap_created_at,
    CAST(a.new_sapsubmitdate AS TIMESTAMP) AS sap_submitted_at,
    CAST(a.new_approved_time_facreview AS TIMESTAMP) AS account_factory_approved_at,
    CAST(a.new_submit_time_facreview AS TIMESTAMP) AS account_factory_submitted_at,
    CAST(a.new_sinosurestartdate AS TIMESTAMP) AS account_sinosure_start,
    CAST(a.new_sinosureenddate AS TIMESTAMP) AS account_sinosure_end,
    CAST(a.new_submit_time_accredit AS TIMESTAMP) AS account_credit_submitted_at,
    CAST(a.new_approvaltime_accredit AS TIMESTAMP) AS account_credit_approved_at,
    CAST(a.new_cdastartdate AS TIMESTAMP) AS account_cda_start,
    CAST(a.new_cdaenddate AS TIMESTAMP) AS account_cda_end,
    CAST(a.new_cda_submittime AS TIMESTAMP) AS account_cda_submitted_at,
    CAST(a.new_cda_approved_time AS TIMESTAMP) AS account_cda_approved_at,
    CAST(a.new_approvalstatus_facreview AS TEXT) AS account_factory_approval_status,
    CAST(a.new_sapcode AS TEXT) AS sap_code,
    CAST(a.new_issap AS TEXT) AS sap_registered,
    CAST(a.new_issapnew AS TEXT) AS sap_registration_kind,
    ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
      PARTITION BY a.accountid
      ORDER BY a.modifiedon DESC NULLS LAST, a.createdon DESC NULLS LAST
    ) AS rn
  FROM (
    SELECT
      __x360_raw.*
    FROM ded_public.p_fm_edw_v_ods_crm_account_esb AS __x360_raw
    CROSS JOIN context AS __x360_ctx
    WHERE
      CAST(__x360_raw.createdon AS TIMESTAMP) < __x360_ctx.as_of_exclusive
  ) AS a
  WHERE
    NULLIF(TRIM(CAST(a.accountid AS TEXT)), '') IS NOT NULL
), accounts AS MATERIALIZED (
  SELECT
    account_id,
    account_name,
    level_code,
    sap_created_at,
    sap_submitted_at,
    account_factory_approved_at,
    account_factory_submitted_at,
    account_sinosure_start,
    account_sinosure_end,
    account_credit_submitted_at,
    account_credit_approved_at,
    account_cda_start,
    account_cda_end,
    account_cda_submitted_at,
    account_cda_approved_at,
    account_factory_approval_status,
    sap_code,
    sap_registered,
    sap_registration_kind
  FROM account_rows
  WHERE
    rn = 1
), opportunity_rows AS MATERIALIZED (
  SELECT
    ranked.*
  FROM (
    SELECT
      CAST(o.opportunityid AS TEXT) AS opportunity_id,
      CAST(o.parentaccountid AS TEXT) AS account_id,
      CAST(o.name AS TEXT) AS project_name,
      CAST(o.ownerid AS TEXT) AS owner_id,
      CASE
        WHEN CAST(o.new_accproducttype AS TEXT) IN ('1', '电芯')
        THEN '电芯'
        WHEN CAST(o.new_accproducttype AS TEXT) IN ('2', 'PACK')
        THEN 'PACK'
        ELSE '其他'
      END AS product_type,
      o.__x360_asof_process_stage AS process_stage,
      CAST(o.statecode AS TEXT) AS system_state,
      CAST(o.new_demandinput AS TEXT) AS demand_status,
      CAST(o.createdon AS TIMESTAMP) AS created_at,
      CAST(o.new_stage1enddate AS TIMESTAMP) AS s1,
      CAST(o.new_stage2enddate AS TIMESTAMP) AS s2,
      CAST(o.new_stage3enddate AS TIMESTAMP) AS s3,
      CAST(o.new_stage4enddate AS TIMESTAMP) AS s4,
      CAST(o.new_stage5enddate AS TIMESTAMP) AS s5,
      CAST(o.new_cdastartdate AS TIMESTAMP) AS new_cdastartdate,
      CAST(o.new_cdaenddate AS TIMESTAMP) AS new_cdaenddate,
      CAST(o.new_approved_time_acneed AS TIMESTAMP) AS new_approved_time_acneed,
      CAST(o.new_submit_time_acneed AS TIMESTAMP) AS new_submit_time_acneed,
      CAST(o.new_approved_time_projectassess AS TIMESTAMP) AS new_approved_time_projectassess,
      CAST(o.new_submit_time_projectassess AS TIMESTAMP) AS new_submit_time_projectassess,
      CAST(o.new_sampletestpass_time AS TIMESTAMP) AS new_sampletestpass_time,
      CAST(o.new_sampletime AS TIMESTAMP) AS new_sampletime,
      CAST(o.new_technicalsigningdate AS TIMESTAMP) AS new_technicalsigningdate,
      CAST(o.new_submit_time_techcon AS TIMESTAMP) AS new_submit_time_techcon,
      CAST(o.new_warrantysigningdate AS TIMESTAMP) AS new_warrantysigningdate,
      CAST(o.new_submit_time_qsl AS TIMESTAMP) AS new_submit_time_qsl,
      CAST(o.new_isneedcda AS TEXT) AS new_isneedcda,
      CAST(o.new_approvalstatus_acneed AS TEXT) AS new_approvalstatus_acneed,
      CAST(o.new_approvalstatus_projectassess AS TEXT) AS new_approvalstatus_projectassess,
      CAST(o.new_approvalstatus_techcon AS TEXT) AS new_approvalstatus_techcon,
      CAST(o.new_approvalstatus_qsl AS TEXT) AS new_approvalstatus_qsl,
      CAST(o.new_sampletestresult AS TEXT) AS new_sampletestresult,
      ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
        PARTITION BY o.opportunityid
        ORDER BY o.modifiedon DESC NULLS LAST, o.createdon DESC NULLS LAST
      ) AS rn
    FROM (
      SELECT
        __x360_raw.*,
        CASE
          WHEN CAST(__x360_raw.new_stage1enddate AS TIMESTAMP) IS NULL
          OR CAST(__x360_raw.new_stage1enddate AS TIMESTAMP) >= __x360_ctx.as_of_exclusive
          THEN '11'
          WHEN CAST(__x360_raw.new_stage2enddate AS TIMESTAMP) IS NULL
          OR CAST(__x360_raw.new_stage2enddate AS TIMESTAMP) >= __x360_ctx.as_of_exclusive
          THEN '12'
          WHEN CAST(__x360_raw.new_stage3enddate AS TIMESTAMP) IS NULL
          OR CAST(__x360_raw.new_stage3enddate AS TIMESTAMP) >= __x360_ctx.as_of_exclusive
          THEN '13'
          WHEN CAST(__x360_raw.new_stage4enddate AS TIMESTAMP) IS NULL
          OR CAST(__x360_raw.new_stage4enddate AS TIMESTAMP) >= __x360_ctx.as_of_exclusive
          THEN '14'
          WHEN CAST(__x360_raw.new_stage5enddate AS TIMESTAMP) IS NULL
          OR CAST(__x360_raw.new_stage5enddate AS TIMESTAMP) >= __x360_ctx.as_of_exclusive
          THEN '15'
          ELSE 'completed'
        END AS __x360_asof_process_stage
      FROM ded_public.p_fm_edw_v_ods_crm_opportunity_esb AS __x360_raw
      CROSS JOIN context AS __x360_ctx
    ) AS o
    WHERE
      NULLIF(TRIM(CAST(o.opportunityid AS TEXT)), '') IS NOT NULL
  ) AS ranked
  CROSS JOIN context AS p
  WHERE
    ranked.created_at < p.as_of_exclusive
), opportunities AS MATERIALIZED (
  SELECT
    o.opportunity_id,
    o.account_id,
    o.project_name,
    o.owner_id,
    o.product_type,
    o.process_stage,
    o.demand_status,
    o.created_at,
    o.s1,
    o.s2,
    o.s3,
    o.s4,
    o.s5,
    a.account_name,
    a.level_code,
    o.new_cdastartdate,
    o.new_cdaenddate,
    o.new_approved_time_acneed,
    o.new_submit_time_acneed,
    o.new_approved_time_projectassess,
    o.new_submit_time_projectassess,
    o.new_sampletestpass_time,
    o.new_sampletime,
    o.new_technicalsigningdate,
    o.new_submit_time_techcon,
    o.new_warrantysigningdate,
    o.new_submit_time_qsl,
    o.new_isneedcda,
    o.new_approvalstatus_acneed,
    o.new_approvalstatus_projectassess,
    o.new_approvalstatus_techcon,
    o.new_approvalstatus_qsl,
    o.new_sampletestresult,
    a.sap_created_at,
    a.sap_submitted_at,
    a.sap_code,
    a.account_factory_approved_at,
    a.account_factory_submitted_at,
    a.account_sinosure_start,
    a.account_sinosure_end,
    a.account_credit_submitted_at,
    a.account_credit_approved_at,
    a.account_cda_start,
    a.account_cda_end,
    a.account_cda_submitted_at,
    a.account_cda_approved_at,
    a.account_factory_approval_status
  FROM opportunity_rows AS o
  LEFT JOIN accounts AS a
    USING (account_id)
  CROSS JOIN context AS p
  WHERE
    o.rn = 1 AND (
      o.created_at < p.as_of_exclusive
    )
), orders AS MATERIALIZED (
  SELECT DISTINCT
    CAST(salesorderid AS TEXT) AS order_id
  FROM ded_public.p_fm_edw_v_ods_crm_salesorder_esb
  WHERE
    NULLIF(TRIM(CAST(salesorderid AS TEXT)), '') IS NOT NULL
), order_line_links AS MATERIALIZED (
  SELECT DISTINCT
    CAST(l.new_opportunity_id AS TEXT) AS opportunity_id,
    CAST(l.salesorderid AS TEXT) AS order_id
  FROM ded_public.p_fm_edw_v_ods_crm_salesorderdetail_esb AS l
  WHERE
    NULLIF(TRIM(CAST(l.new_opportunity_id AS TEXT)), '') IS NOT NULL
    AND NULLIF(TRIM(CAST(l.salesorderid AS TEXT)), '') IS NOT NULL
), signed_orders AS MATERIALIZED (
  SELECT
    l.opportunity_id,
    COUNT(DISTINCT l.order_id) AS order_count
  FROM order_line_links AS l
  JOIN orders AS o
    USING (order_id)
  GROUP BY
    l.opportunity_id
), opportunity_flags AS MATERIALIZED (
  SELECT
    o.*,
    COALESCE(s.order_count, 0) AS order_count,
    CASE
      WHEN COALESCE(s.order_count, 0) = 0
      THEN FALSE
      WHEN o.s4 IS NULL
      THEN FALSE
      ELSE o.s4 < p.as_of_exclusive
    END AS signed,
    (
      COALESCE(s.order_count, 0) > 0 AND o.s4 IS NULL
    ) AS missing_p3_end
  FROM opportunities AS o
  LEFT JOIN signed_orders AS s
    USING (opportunity_id)
  CROSS JOIN context AS p
), node_quote_headers AS MATERIALIZED (
  SELECT
    CAST(q.new_quoteapplyid AS TEXT) AS quote_id,
    CAST(q.createdon AS TIMESTAMP) AS created_at,
    CAST(q.new_oasubmitdate AS TIMESTAMP) AS submitted_at,
    CAST(q.new_approved_time AS TIMESTAMP) AS approved_at,
    CAST(q.new_approvalstatus AS TEXT) AS approval_status
  FROM ded_public.p_fm_edw_v_ods_crm_new_quoteapply_esb AS q
  WHERE
    q.new_quoteapplyid IS NOT NULL
), node_quote_links AS MATERIALIZED (
  SELECT DISTINCT
    CAST(d.new_opportunity_id AS TEXT) AS opportunity_id,
    CAST(d.new_quoteapply_id AS TEXT) AS quote_id
  FROM ded_public.p_fm_edw_v_ods_crm_new_quoteapplydetail_esb AS d
  WHERE
    NULLIF(TRIM(CAST(d.new_opportunity_id AS TEXT)), '') IS NOT NULL
    AND NULLIF(TRIM(CAST(d.new_quoteapply_id AS TEXT)), '') IS NOT NULL
), node_quote_latest AS MATERIALIZED (
  SELECT
    opportunity_id,
    quote_id,
    submitted_at,
    approved_at,
    approval_status
  FROM (
    SELECT
      o.opportunity_id,
      q.quote_id,
      q.submitted_at,
      q.approved_at,
      q.approval_status,
      ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
        PARTITION BY o.opportunity_id
        ORDER BY q.created_at DESC NULLS LAST, q.quote_id DESC
      ) AS rn
    FROM opportunity_flags AS o
    JOIN node_quote_links AS l
      USING (opportunity_id)
    JOIN node_quote_headers AS q
      USING (quote_id)
    CROSS JOIN context AS p
    WHERE
      q.created_at <= p.cutoff
  ) AS ranked
  WHERE
    rn = 1
), review_quote_cycle_events AS MATERIALIZED (
  SELECT
    CAST('QUOTE_OA' AS TEXT) AS kind,
    q.quote_id AS event_id,
    o.product_type,
    q.submitted_at AS started_at,
    q.approved_at AS finished_at,
    q.approved_at AS period_at
  FROM opportunity_flags AS o
  JOIN node_quote_latest AS q
    USING (opportunity_id)
), review_quote_cycle_facts AS MATERIALIZED (
  SELECT
    r.*,
    p.cutoff,
    CASE
      WHEN r.finished_at >= p.start_date
      AND r.finished_at < p.effective_end_exclusive
      AND r.event_id IS NOT NULL
      AND r.started_at IS NOT NULL
      AND r.finished_at >= r.started_at
      THEN EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM (
        r.finished_at - r.started_at
      )) / CAST(86400 AS DECIMAL)
    END AS duration_days
  FROM review_quote_cycle_events AS r
  CROSS JOIN context AS p
), review_quote_cycle_samples AS MATERIALIZED (
  SELECT DISTINCT
    kind,
    event_id,
    product_type,
    duration_days
  FROM review_quote_cycle_facts
  WHERE
    duration_days IS NOT NULL
  UNION ALL
  SELECT DISTINCT
    kind,
    event_id,
    '全部',
    duration_days
  FROM review_quote_cycle_facts
  WHERE
    duration_days IS NOT NULL
), review_quote_cycle_stats AS MATERIALIZED (
  SELECT
    kind,
    product_type,
    COUNT(*) AS sample_count,
    AVG(duration_days) AS mean_days
  FROM review_quote_cycle_samples
  GROUP BY
    kind,

), review_quote_cycle_quality AS MATERIALIZED (
  SELECT
    kind,

  FROM review_quote_cycle_facts

), metric_results AS MATERIALIZED (

    CAST('报价申请单.new_approved_time－new_oasubmitdate，按报价申请ID去重后取平均，换算天。 通过报价申请明细关联商机，沿用当前最新关联报价申请；按OA审批时间归年/月。只算真实起止，不再回退P3阶段。 按红字启用报价OA周期；与P1-06复用同一计算结果，不读取全空的批量报价确认完成日期。' AS TEXT) AS note,

SELECT

仅new_issap=1且SAP基准日期落所选期间。商机createdon＜SAP基准日期时为0天并参与平均；不满足的其他情况暂留空。未进SAP或SAP两日期都空不计入周期。
SAP基准还须早于观察日次日；原商机createdon＜SAP基准记0天的规则保持，其他情况仍NULL。
