    CAST(%s AS DATE) AS start_date,
    CAST(%s AS DATE) AS end_exclusive,
    CAST(%s AS TIMESTAMP) AS observed_at,
    CAST(ARRAY['1'] AS TEXT[]) AS strategic_levels,
    CAST(ARRAY['1', '2'] AS TEXT[]) AS focus_levels,
    CAST(1000000 AS DECIMAL) AS target_power_units_per_gwh
), context AS MATERIALIZED (
  SELECT
    p.*,
    CAST((
      DATE_TRUNC('DAY', observed_at) + INTERVAL '1 DAY'
    ) AS TIMESTAMP) AS as_of_exclusive,
    LEAST(
      CAST(end_exclusive AS TIMESTAMP),
      DATE_TRUNC('DAY', observed_at) + INTERVAL '1 DAY'
    ) AS effective_end_exclusive,
    LEAST(
      CAST(end_exclusive AS TIMESTAMP),
      DATE_TRUNC('DAY', observed_at) + INTERVAL '1 DAY'
    ) - INTERVAL '1 MICROSECOND' AS cutoff,
    MAKE_DATE(CAST(EXTRACT(YEAR FROM start_date) AS INT), 1, 1) AS year_start,
    MAKE_DATE(CAST(EXTRACT(YEAR FROM start_date) AS INT) + 1, 1, 1) AS next_year_start,
    GREATEST(
      CAST(0 AS DECIMAL),
      LEAST(
        CAST(1 AS DECIMAL),
        CAST((
          CAST(LEAST(
            CAST(end_exclusive AS TIMESTAMP),
            DATE_TRUNC('DAY', observed_at) + INTERVAL '1 DAY'
          ) AS DATE) - MAKE_DATE(CAST(EXTRACT(YEAR FROM start_date) AS INT), 1, 1)
        ) AS DECIMAL) / (
          MAKE_DATE(CAST(EXTRACT(YEAR FROM start_date) AS INT) + 1, 1, 1) - MAKE_DATE(CAST(EXTRACT(YEAR FROM start_date) AS INT), 1, 1)
        )
      )
    ) AS time_progress
  FROM parameters AS p
), account_rows AS MATERIALIZED (
  SELECT
    CAST(a.accountid AS TEXT) AS account_id,
    CAST(a.name AS TEXT) AS account_name,
    CAST(a.new_accountlevel AS TEXT) AS level_code,
    CAST(a.new_sapdate AS TIMESTAMP) AS sap_created_at,
    CAST(a.new_sapsubmitdate AS TIMESTAMP) AS sap_submitted_at,
    CAST(a.new_approved_time_facreview AS TIMESTAMP) AS account_factory_approved_at,
    CAST(a.new_submit_time_facreview AS TIMESTAMP) AS account_factory_submitted_at,
    CAST(a.new_sinosurestartdate AS TIMESTAMP) AS account_sinosure_start,
    CAST(a.new_sinosureenddate AS TIMESTAMP) AS account_sinosure_end,
    CAST(a.new_submit_time_accredit AS TIMESTAMP) AS account_credit_submitted_at,
    CAST(a.new_approvaltime_accredit AS TIMESTAMP) AS account_credit_approved_at,
    CAST(a.new_cdastartdate AS TIMESTAMP) AS account_cda_start,
    CAST(a.new_cdaenddate AS TIMESTAMP) AS account_cda_end,
    CAST(a.new_cda_submittime AS TIMESTAMP) AS account_cda_submitted_at,
    CAST(a.new_cda_approved_time AS TIMESTAMP) AS account_cda_approved_at,
    CAST(a.new_approvalstatus_facreview AS TEXT) AS account_factory_approval_status,
    CAST(a.new_sapcode AS TEXT) AS sap_code,
    CAST(a.new_issap AS TEXT) AS sap_registered,
    CAST(a.new_issapnew AS TEXT) AS sap_registration_kind,
    ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
      PARTITION BY a.accountid
      ORDER BY a.modifiedon DESC NULLS LAST, a.createdon DESC NULLS LAST
    ) AS rn
  FROM (
    SELECT
      __x360_raw.*
    FROM ded_public.p_fm_edw_v_ods_crm_account_esb AS __x360_raw
    CROSS JOIN context AS __x360_ctx
    WHERE
      CAST(__x360_raw.createdon AS TIMESTAMP) < __x360_ctx.as_of_exclusive
  ) AS a
  WHERE
    NULLIF(TRIM(CAST(a.accountid AS TEXT)), '') IS NOT NULL
), accounts AS MATERIALIZED (
  SELECT
    account_id,
    account_name,
    level_code,
    sap_created_at,
    sap_submitted_at,
    account_factory_approved_at,
    account_factory_submitted_at,
    account_sinosure_start,
    account_sinosure_end,
    account_credit_submitted_at,
    account_credit_approved_at,
    account_cda_start,
    account_cda_end,
    account_cda_submitted_at,
    account_cda_approved_at,
    account_factory_approval_status,
    sap_code,
    sap_registered,
    sap_registration_kind
  FROM account_rows
  WHERE
    rn = 1
), opportunity_rows AS MATERIALIZED (
  SELECT
    ranked.*
  FROM (
    SELECT
      CAST(o.opportunityid AS TEXT) AS opportunity_id,
      CAST(o.parentaccountid AS TEXT) AS account_id,
      CAST(o.name AS TEXT) AS project_name,
      CAST(o.ownerid AS TEXT) AS owner_id,
      CASE
        WHEN CAST(o.new_accproducttype AS TEXT) IN ('1', '电芯')
        THEN '电芯'
        WHEN CAST(o.new_accproducttype AS TEXT) IN ('2', 'PACK')
        THEN 'PACK'
        ELSE '其他'
      END AS product_type,
      o.__x360_asof_process_stage AS process_stage,
      CAST(o.statecode AS TEXT) AS system_state,
      CAST(o.new_demandinput AS TEXT) AS demand_status,
      CAST(o.createdon AS TIMESTAMP) AS created_at,
      CAST(o.new_stage1enddate AS TIMESTAMP) AS s1,
      CAST(o.new_stage2enddate AS TIMESTAMP) AS s2,
      CAST(o.new_stage3enddate AS TIMESTAMP) AS s3,
      CAST(o.new_stage4enddate AS TIMESTAMP) AS s4,
      CAST(o.new_stage5enddate AS TIMESTAMP) AS s5,
      CAST(o.new_cdastartdate AS TIMESTAMP) AS new_cdastartdate,
      CAST(o.new_cdaenddate AS TIMESTAMP) AS new_cdaenddate,
      CAST(o.new_approved_time_acneed AS TIMESTAMP) AS new_approved_time_acneed,
      CAST(o.new_submit_time_acneed AS TIMESTAMP) AS new_submit_time_acneed,
      CAST(o.new_approved_time_projectassess AS TIMESTAMP) AS new_approved_time_projectassess,
      CAST(o.new_submit_time_projectassess AS TIMESTAMP) AS new_submit_time_projectassess,
      CAST(o.new_sampletestpass_time AS TIMESTAMP) AS new_sampletestpass_time,
      CAST(o.new_sampletime AS TIMESTAMP) AS new_sampletime,
      CAST(o.new_technicalsigningdate AS TIMESTAMP) AS new_technicalsigningdate,
      CAST(o.new_submit_time_techcon AS TIMESTAMP) AS new_submit_time_techcon,
      CAST(o.new_warrantysigningdate AS TIMESTAMP) AS new_warrantysigningdate,
      CAST(o.new_submit_time_qsl AS TIMESTAMP) AS new_submit_time_qsl,
      CAST(o.new_isneedcda AS TEXT) AS new_isneedcda,
      CAST(o.new_approvalstatus_acneed AS TEXT) AS new_approvalstatus_acneed,
      CAST(o.new_approvalstatus_projectassess AS TEXT) AS new_approvalstatus_projectassess,
      CAST(o.new_approvalstatus_techcon AS TEXT) AS new_approvalstatus_techcon,
      CAST(o.new_approvalstatus_qsl AS TEXT) AS new_approvalstatus_qsl,
      CAST(o.new_sampletestresult AS TEXT) AS new_sampletestresult,
      ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
        PARTITION BY o.opportunityid
        ORDER BY o.modifiedon DESC NULLS LAST, o.createdon DESC NULLS LAST
      ) AS rn
    FROM (
      SELECT
        __x360_raw.*,
        CASE
          WHEN CAST(__x360_raw.new_stage1enddate AS TIMESTAMP) IS NULL
          OR CAST(__x360_raw.new_stage1enddate AS TIMESTAMP) >= __x360_ctx.as_of_exclusive
          THEN '11'
          WHEN CAST(__x360_raw.new_stage2enddate AS TIMESTAMP) IS NULL
          OR CAST(__x360_raw.new_stage2enddate AS TIMESTAMP) >= __x360_ctx.as_of_exclusive
          THEN '12'
          WHEN CAST(__x360_raw.new_stage3enddate AS TIMESTAMP) IS NULL
          OR CAST(__x360_raw.new_stage3enddate AS TIMESTAMP) >= __x360_ctx.as_of_exclusive
          THEN '13'
          WHEN CAST(__x360_raw.new_stage4enddate AS TIMESTAMP) IS NULL
          OR CAST(__x360_raw.new_stage4enddate AS TIMESTAMP) >= __x360_ctx.as_of_exclusive
          THEN '14'
          WHEN CAST(__x360_raw.new_stage5enddate AS TIMESTAMP) IS NULL
          OR CAST(__x360_raw.new_stage5enddate AS TIMESTAMP) >= __x360_ctx.as_of_exclusive
          THEN '15'
          ELSE 'completed'
        END AS __x360_asof_process_stage
      FROM ded_public.p_fm_edw_v_ods_crm_opportunity_esb AS __x360_raw
      CROSS JOIN context AS __x360_ctx
    ) AS o
    WHERE
      NULLIF(TRIM(CAST(o.opportunityid AS TEXT)), '') IS NOT NULL
  ) AS ranked
  CROSS JOIN context AS p
  WHERE
    ranked.created_at < p.as_of_exclusive
), opportunities AS MATERIALIZED (
  SELECT
    o.opportunity_id,
    o.account_id,
    o.project_name,
    o.owner_id,
    o.product_type,
    o.process_stage,
    o.demand_status,
    o.created_at,
    o.s1,
    o.s2,
    o.s3,
    o.s4,
    o.s5,
    a.account_name,
    a.level_code,
    o.new_cdastartdate,
    o.new_cdaenddate,
    o.new_approved_time_acneed,
    o.new_submit_time_acneed,
    o.new_approved_time_projectassess,
    o.new_submit_time_projectassess,
    o.new_sampletestpass_time,
    o.new_sampletime,
    o.new_technicalsigningdate,
    o.new_submit_time_techcon,
    o.new_warrantysigningdate,
    o.new_submit_time_qsl,
    o.new_isneedcda,
    o.new_approvalstatus_acneed,
    o.new_approvalstatus_projectassess,
    o.new_approvalstatus_techcon,
    o.new_approvalstatus_qsl,
    o.new_sampletestresult,
    a.sap_created_at,
    a.sap_submitted_at,
    a.sap_code,
    a.account_factory_approved_at,
    a.account_factory_submitted_at,
    a.account_sinosure_start,
    a.account_sinosure_end,
    a.account_credit_submitted_at,
    a.account_credit_approved_at,
    a.account_cda_start,
    a.account_cda_end,
    a.account_cda_submitted_at,
    a.account_cda_approved_at,
    a.account_factory_approval_status
  FROM opportunity_rows AS o
  LEFT JOIN accounts AS a
    USING (account_id)
  CROSS JOIN context AS p
  WHERE
    o.rn = 1 AND (
      o.created_at < p.as_of_exclusive
    )
), orders AS MATERIALIZED (
  SELECT DISTINCT
    CAST(salesorderid AS TEXT) AS order_id
  FROM ded_public.p_fm_edw_v_ods_crm_salesorder_esb
  WHERE
    NULLIF(TRIM(CAST(salesorderid AS TEXT)), '') IS NOT NULL
), order_line_links AS MATERIALIZED (
  SELECT DISTINCT
    CAST(l.new_opportunity_id AS TEXT) AS opportunity_id,
    CAST(l.salesorderid AS TEXT) AS order_id
  FROM ded_public.p_fm_edw_v_ods_crm_salesorderdetail_esb AS l
  WHERE
    NULLIF(TRIM(CAST(l.new_opportunity_id AS TEXT)), '') IS NOT NULL
    AND NULLIF(TRIM(CAST(l.salesorderid AS TEXT)), '') IS NOT NULL
), signed_orders AS MATERIALIZED (
  SELECT
    l.opportunity_id,
    COUNT(DISTINCT l.order_id) AS order_count
  FROM order_line_links AS l
  JOIN orders AS o
    USING (order_id)
  GROUP BY
    l.opportunity_id
), opportunity_flags AS MATERIALIZED (
  SELECT
    o.*,
    COALESCE(s.order_count, 0) AS order_count,
    CASE
      WHEN COALESCE(s.order_count, 0) = 0
      THEN FALSE
      WHEN o.s4 IS NULL
      THEN FALSE
      ELSE o.s4 < p.as_of_exclusive
    END AS signed,
    (
      COALESCE(s.order_count, 0) > 0 AND o.s4 IS NULL
    ) AS missing_p3_end
  FROM opportunities AS o
  LEFT JOIN signed_orders AS s
    USING (opportunity_id)
  CROSS JOIN context AS p
), forecast_rows AS MATERIALIZED (
  SELECT
    CAST(m.new_oppmonthid AS TEXT) AS forecast_id,
    CAST(m.new_opportunity_id AS TEXT) AS opportunity_id,
    CAST(m.new_accountdate AS TIMESTAMP) AS forecast_month,
    CAST(m.new_forecast_amt_rmb AS DECIMAL) AS amount_yuan,
    CAST(m.new_whprice AS DECIMAL) AS wh_price,
    ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
      PARTITION BY m.new_opportunity_id, DATE_TRUNC('MONTH', CAST(m.new_accountdate AS TIMESTAMP))
      ORDER BY m.createdon DESC NULLS LAST, m.modifiedon DESC NULLS LAST, m.new_oppmonthid DESC NULLS LAST
    ) AS rn
  FROM (
    SELECT
      __x360_raw.*
    FROM ded_public.p_fm_edw_v_ods_crm_new_oppmonth_esb AS __x360_raw
    CROSS JOIN context AS __x360_ctx
    WHERE
      CAST(__x360_raw.createdon AS TIMESTAMP) < __x360_ctx.as_of_exclusive
  ) AS m
  CROSS JOIN context AS p
  WHERE
    NULLIF(TRIM(CAST(m.new_oppmonthid AS TEXT)), '') IS NOT NULL
    AND NULLIF(TRIM(CAST(m.new_opportunity_id AS TEXT)), '') IS NOT NULL
    AND CAST(m.new_accountdate AS TIMESTAMP) >= p.start_date
    AND CAST(m.new_accountdate AS TIMESTAMP) < p.end_exclusive
), forecast_facts AS MATERIALIZED (
  SELECT
    f.forecast_id,
    f.forecast_month,
    o.*,
    f.amount_yuan / CAST(100000000 AS DECIMAL) AS amount_yi,
    f.amount_yuan / NULLIF(f.wh_price, 0) / CAST(1000000000 AS DECIMAL) AS energy_gwh
  FROM forecast_rows AS f
  JOIN opportunity_flags AS o
    USING (opportunity_id)
  WHERE
    f.rn = 1
), opportunity_forecast AS MATERIALIZED (
  SELECT
    opportunity_id,
    COUNT(*) AS forecast_rows,
    SUM(amount_yi) AS amount_yi,
    SUM(energy_gwh) AS energy_gwh,
    COUNT(*) FILTER(WHERE
      amount_yi IS NULL) AS missing_amount_rows,
    COUNT(*) FILTER(WHERE
      energy_gwh IS NULL) AS missing_energy_rows
  FROM forecast_facts
  GROUP BY
    opportunity_id
), stage_facts AS MATERIALIZED (
SELECT
    o.*,
    v.stage_code,
    v.started_at,
    v.finished_at,
    CASE
      WHEN v.started_at IS NOT NULL AND v.finished_at > v.started_at
      THEN EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM (
        v.finished_at - v.started_at
      )) / CAST(86400 AS DECIMAL)
    END AS elapsed_days,
    (
      v.finished_at >= p.start_date AND v.finished_at < p.effective_end_exclusive
    ) AS in_window,
    FALSE AS inflight,
    (
      v.started_at IS NULL OR v.finished_at IS NULL OR v.finished_at <= v.started_at
    ) AS invalid_dates
  FROM opportunity_flags AS o
  CROSS JOIN context AS p
  CROSS JOIN LATERAL (
    VALUES
      (CAST('P0' AS TEXT), o.created_at, o.s1),
      (CAST('P1' AS TEXT), o.s1, o.s2),
      (CAST('P2' AS TEXT), o.s2, o.s3),
      (CAST('P3' AS TEXT), o.s3, o.s4),
      (CAST('P4' AS TEXT), o.s4, o.s5)
  ) AS v(stage_code, started_at, finished_at)
  WHERE
    v.finished_at IS NOT NULL
    AND v.finished_at >= p.start_date
    AND v.finished_at < p.effective_end_exclusive
), stage_means AS MATERIALIZED (
SELECT stage_code, product_type,
    AVG(elapsed_days) FILTER (WHERE NOT invalid_dates) AS mean_days,
    CASE stage_code
      WHEN 'P0' THEN 32.6::numeric
      WHEN 'P1' THEN 21.8::numeric
      WHEN 'P2' THEN 7.2::numeric
      WHEN 'P3' THEN 57.2::numeric
      WHEN 'P4' THEN 15.3::numeric
    END AS baseline_days,
    COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE NOT invalid_dates) AS sample_count,
    COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE invalid_dates) AS invalid_count,
    COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE finished_at = started_at) AS zero_duration_count,
    0::bigint AS inflight_count
  FROM stage_facts WHERE in_window
  GROUP BY stage_code, product_type
), stage_overdue AS MATERIALIZED (
SELECT f.*,m.mean_days,m.baseline_days,
    (f.elapsed_days-m.baseline_days) AS excess_days,
    (f.elapsed_days-m.baseline_days)/NULLIF(m.baseline_days,0) AS excess_ratio,
    ofc.amount_yi,ofc.energy_gwh,
    (m.baseline_days > 0 AND f.elapsed_days > 1.5::numeric*m.baseline_days) AS overdue
  FROM stage_facts f JOIN stage_means m USING(stage_code,product_type)
  LEFT JOIN opportunity_forecast ofc USING(opportunity_id)
  WHERE f.in_window AND NOT f.invalid_dates
), metric_results AS MATERIALIZED (
SELECT
    49 AS sort_no,
    CAST('P4-02' AS TEXT) AS code,
    CAST('批量交付阶段超过静态基线 50%% 的商机预测总量' AS TEXT) AS metric_name,
    CAST(NULL AS TEXT) AS product_team,
    CAST((
      SUM(amount_yi)
    ) AS DECIMAL) AS amount_yi,
    CAST((
      SUM(energy_gwh)
    ) AS DECIMAL) AS energy_gwh,
    CAST((
      COUNT(DISTINCT opportunity_id)
    ) AS BIGINT) AS item_count,
    CAST((
      NULL
    ) AS DECIMAL) AS ratio_value,
    CAST((
      NULL
    ) AS DECIMAL) AS days_value,
    CAST('查询已实现；缺失输入及部分合计见明细' AS TEXT) AS status,
    CAST('超过本阶段静态基线1.5倍；同商机每阶段只计一次；该商机期间预测先聚合后关联，不因订单或预测行重复累计。' AS TEXT) AS note,
    CAST((
      JSONB_AGG(
        JSONB_BUILD_OBJECT('商机ID', opportunity_id, '产品', product_type, '周期天', elapsed_days, '静态基线天', baseline_days, '超出基线天数', excess_days, '超出基线比例_原始小数', excess_ratio, '超出基线百分比数值', excess_ratio*100)
      )
    ) AS JSONB) AS detail
  FROM stage_overdue AS f
  WHERE
    stage_code = 'P4' AND in_window AND overdue
)
SELECT
  r.code AS "指标序号",
  r.metric_name AS "指标名称",
  r.product_team AS "产品团队",
  p.start_date AS "期间开始",
  p.end_exclusive AS "期间结束不含",
  p.cutoff AS "周期观察截止",
  r.amount_yi AS "金额_亿元",
  r.energy_gwh AS "电量_GWh",
  r.item_count AS "数量",
  r.ratio_value AS "比率_原始小数",
  r.days_value AS "平均周期_天",
  CASE
    WHEN r.status = '查询已实现；缺失输入及部分合计见明细'
    THEN CASE
      WHEN r.amount_yi IS NOT NULL
      OR r.energy_gwh IS NOT NULL
      OR r.item_count IS NOT NULL
      OR r.ratio_value IS NOT NULL
      OR r.days_value IS NOT NULL
      THEN '已有查询结果；完整性与适用列见明细'
      ELSE '没有可计算结果；检查输入、时间及关联范围'
    END
    ELSE r.status
  END AS "计算说明状态",
  r.note AS "取值说明",
  r.detail AS "分组明细及缺口"
FROM metric_results AS r
CROSS JOIN context AS p
ORDER BY
  r.sort_no,
  r.product_team;

P4-03.name: 订单交付情况平均周期
P4-03.definition: 订单明细逐行new_shipping_return_qty≥quantity，所有明细均已发足才认定整单完全发货；完全发货日期取该订单全部明细new_shipping_time的最大值。周期＝完全发货日期－订单头new_approval_time，换算天后按订单ID去重取平均。
P4-03.formula:
按订单明细主键取最新记录，逐明细比较已发货数量与订单数量，相等也算发足，不跨明细或计量单位直接加数量抵消未发部分。完全发货日期按MAX(new_shipping_time)归年/月；任一明细缺数量、缺主键或缺发货日期时保留未知，不自动回退其他表日期。仅有数量发足证据而没有完整日期时，不计入交付周期均值。
阶段及普通环节按各自真实结束时间归所选期间，结束须早于MIN(end_exclusive,观察日次日)；起点可早于期初，不计未结束在途。P0～P4阶段只计起止完整且周期严格大于0的样本；普通独立环节仍沿用各自完整非逆序规则。
P4-03.attributes: LE07-A0166 createdon、LE07-A0168 modifiedon、LE07-A0186 new_approval_time、LE07-A0072 new_oasubmitdate、LE07-A0001 salesorderid、LE08-A0119 createdon、LE08-A0121 modifiedon、LE08-A0025 new_opportunity_id、LE08-A0106 new_shipping_return_qty、LE08-A0095 new_shipping_time、LE08-A0113 quantity、LE08-A0001 salesorderdetailid、LE08-A0109 salesorderid、LE05-A0001 accountid、LE05-A0295 createdon、LE05-A0297 modifiedon、LE05-A0277 name、LE05-A0244 new_accountlevel、LE05-A0191 new_approvalstatus_facreview、LE05-A0057 new_approvaltime_accredit、LE05-A0217 new_approved_time_facreview、LE05-A0167 new_cda_approved_time、LE05-A0088 new_cda_submittime、LE05-A0208 new_cdaenddate、LE05-A0229 new_cdastartdate、LE05-A0016 new_issap、LE05-A0042 new_issapnew、LE05-A0099 new_sapcode、LE05-A0258 new_sapdate、LE05-A0061 new_sapsubmitdate、LE05-A0070 new_sinosureenddate、LE05-A0083 new_sinosurestartdate、LE05-A0197 new_submit_time_accredit、LE05-A0235 new_submit_time_facreview、LE01-A0490 createdon、LE01-A0492 modifiedon、LE01-A0477 name、LE01-A0044 new_accproducttype、LE01-A0430 new_approvalstatus_acneed、LE01-A0431 new_approvalstatus_projectassess、LE01-A0022 new_approvalstatus_qsl、LE01-A0052 new_approvalstatus_techcon、LE01-A0386 new_approved_time_acneed、LE01-A0038 new_approved_time_projectassess、LE01-A0115 new_cdaenddate、LE01-A0153 new_cdastartdate、LE01-A0185 new_demandinput、LE01-A0145 new_isneedcda、LE01-A0451 new_processstage、LE01-A0055 new_sampletestpass_time、LE01-A0143 new_sampletestresult、LE01-A0434 new_sampletime、LE01-A0101 new_stage1enddate、LE01-A0243 new_stage2enddate、LE01-A0100 new_stage3enddate、LE01-A0007 new_stage4enddate、LE01-A0151 new_stage5enddate、LE01-A0290 new_submit_time_acneed、LE01-A0404 new_submit_time_projectassess、LE01-A0147 new_submit_time_qsl、LE01-A0096 new_submit_time_techcon、LE01-A0062 new_technicalsigningdate、LE01-A0441 new_warrantysigningdate、LE01-A0001 opportunityid、LE01-A0486 ownerid、LE01-A0476 parentaccountid、LE01-A0488 statecode
P4-03.physicalFields: 订单.salesorderid/new_approval_time；订单明细.salesorderdetailid/salesorderid/quantity/new_shipping_return_qty/new_shipping_time/modifiedon/createdon；订单明细.new_opportunity_id仅用于产品分组。
P4-03.notes: 按客户最新确认，完成状态与日期均取订单明细：已发货数量≥订单数量、全部明细满足，完成时间取MAX(new_shipping_time)。直接实现该方法，不自动改用发货单日期或其他替代方法；订单审批、数量及明细日期缺失时周期仍为NULL。
P4-03.sqlStatus: 按结果动态判定（见调用SQL）；已同步红字口径
P4-03.v3Change: 按红字修订同步：实际调用SQL及计算步骤已更新；待确认项保持NULL。
P4-03.role: 跨阶段参考（不参与本节点链路）
P4-03.ctes: parameters → context → supplement_order_rows → supplement_order_latest → order_line_links → account_rows → accounts → opportunity_rows → opportunities → orders → signed_orders → opportunity_flags → review_order_products → review_order_line_source → review_order_lines → review_unkeyed_order_lines → review_order_quantity_status → review_full_orders → review_delivery_cycle_events → review_delivery_cycle_facts → review_delivery_cycle_samples → review_delivery_cycle_stats → review_delivery_cycle_quality
P4-03.sql:
WITH parameters AS MATERIALIZED (
  SELECT
    CAST(%s AS DATE) AS start_date,
    CAST(%s AS DATE) AS end_exclusive,
    CAST(%s AS TIMESTAMP) AS observed_at,
    CAST(ARRAY['1'] AS TEXT[]) AS strategic_levels,
    CAST(ARRAY['1', '2'] AS TEXT[]) AS focus_levels,
    CAST(1000000 AS DECIMAL) AS target_power_units_per_gwh
), context AS MATERIALIZED (
  SELECT
    p.*,
    CAST((
      DATE_TRUNC('DAY', observed_at) + INTERVAL '1 DAY'
    ) AS TIMESTAMP) AS as_of_exclusive,
    LEAST(
      CAST(end_exclusive AS TIMESTAMP),
      DATE_TRUNC('DAY', observed_at) + INTERVAL '1 DAY'
    ) AS effective_end_exclusive,
    LEAST(
      CAST(end_exclusive AS TIMESTAMP),
      DATE_TRUNC('DAY', observed_at) + INTERVAL '1 DAY'
    ) - INTERVAL '1 MICROSECOND' AS cutoff,
    MAKE_DATE(CAST(EXTRACT(YEAR FROM start_date) AS INT), 1, 1) AS year_start,
    MAKE_DATE(CAST(EXTRACT(YEAR FROM start_date) AS INT) + 1, 1, 1) AS next_year_start,
    GREATEST(
      CAST(0 AS DECIMAL),
      LEAST(
        CAST(1 AS DECIMAL),
        CAST((
          CAST(LEAST(
            CAST(end_exclusive AS TIMESTAMP),
            DATE_TRUNC('DAY', observed_at) + INTERVAL '1 DAY'
          ) AS DATE) - MAKE_DATE(CAST(EXTRACT(YEAR FROM start_date) AS INT), 1, 1)
        ) AS DECIMAL) / (
          MAKE_DATE(CAST(EXTRACT(YEAR FROM start_date) AS INT) + 1, 1, 1) - MAKE_DATE(CAST(EXTRACT(YEAR FROM start_date) AS INT), 1, 1)
        )
      )
    ) AS time_progress
  FROM parameters AS p
), supplement_order_rows AS MATERIALIZED (
  SELECT
    CAST(salesorderid AS TEXT) AS order_id,
    CAST(createdon AS TIMESTAMP) AS created_at,
    CAST(new_oasubmitdate AS TIMESTAMP) AS submitted_at,
    CAST(new_approval_time AS TIMESTAMP) AS approved_at,
    ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
      PARTITION BY salesorderid
      ORDER BY modifiedon DESC NULLS LAST, createdon DESC NULLS LAST
    ) AS rn
  FROM ded_public.p_fm_edw_v_ods_crm_salesorder_esb
  WHERE
    NULLIF(TRIM(CAST(salesorderid AS TEXT)), '') IS NOT NULL
), supplement_order_latest AS MATERIALIZED (
  SELECT
    order_id,
    created_at,
    submitted_at,
    approved_at
  FROM supplement_order_rows
  WHERE
    rn = 1
), order_line_links AS MATERIALIZED (
  SELECT DISTINCT
    CAST(l.new_opportunity_id AS TEXT) AS opportunity_id,
    CAST(l.salesorderid AS TEXT) AS order_id
  FROM ded_public.p_fm_edw_v_ods_crm_salesorderdetail_esb AS l
  WHERE
    NULLIF(TRIM(CAST(l.new_opportunity_id AS TEXT)), '') IS NOT NULL
    AND NULLIF(TRIM(CAST(l.salesorderid AS TEXT)), '') IS NOT NULL
), account_rows AS MATERIALIZED (
  SELECT
    CAST(a.accountid AS TEXT) AS account_id,
    CAST(a.name AS TEXT) AS account_name,
    CAST(a.new_accountlevel AS TEXT) AS level_code,
    CAST(a.new_sapdate AS TIMESTAMP) AS sap_created_at,
    CAST(a.new_sapsubmitdate AS TIMESTAMP) AS sap_submitted_at,
    CAST(a.new_approved_time_facreview AS TIMESTAMP) AS account_factory_approved_at,
    CAST(a.new_submit_time_facreview AS TIMESTAMP) AS account_factory_submitted_at,
    CAST(a.new_sinosurestartdate AS TIMESTAMP) AS account_sinosure_start,
    CAST(a.new_sinosureenddate AS TIMESTAMP) AS account_sinosure_end,
    CAST(a.new_submit_time_accredit AS TIMESTAMP) AS account_credit_submitted_at,
    CAST(a.new_approvaltime_accredit AS TIMESTAMP) AS account_credit_approved_at,
    CAST(a.new_cdastartdate AS TIMESTAMP) AS account_cda_start,
    CAST(a.new_cdaenddate AS TIMESTAMP) AS account_cda_end,
    CAST(a.new_cda_submittime AS TIMESTAMP) AS account_cda_submitted_at,
    CAST(a.new_cda_approved_time AS TIMESTAMP) AS account_cda_approved_at,
    CAST(a.new_approvalstatus_facreview AS TEXT) AS account_factory_approval_status,
    CAST(a.new_sapcode AS TEXT) AS sap_code,
    CAST(a.new_issap AS TEXT) AS sap_registered,
    CAST(a.new_issapnew AS TEXT) AS sap_registration_kind,
    ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
      PARTITION BY a.accountid
      ORDER BY a.modifiedon DESC NULLS LAST, a.createdon DESC NULLS LAST
    ) AS rn
  FROM (
    SELECT
      __x360_raw.*
    FROM ded_public.p_fm_edw_v_ods_crm_account_esb AS __x360_raw
    CROSS JOIN context AS __x360_ctx
    WHERE
      CAST(__x360_raw.createdon AS TIMESTAMP) < __x360_ctx.as_of_exclusive
  ) AS a
  WHERE
    NULLIF(TRIM(CAST(a.accountid AS TEXT)), '') IS NOT NULL
), accounts AS MATERIALIZED (
  SELECT
    account_id,
    account_name,
    level_code,
    sap_created_at,
    sap_submitted_at,
    account_factory_approved_at,
    account_factory_submitted_at,
    account_sinosure_start,
    account_sinosure_end,
    account_credit_submitted_at,
    account_credit_approved_at,
    account_cda_start,
    account_cda_end,
    account_cda_submitted_at,
    account_cda_approved_at,
    account_factory_approval_status,
    sap_code,
    sap_registered,
    sap_registration_kind
  FROM account_rows
  WHERE
    rn = 1
), opportunity_rows AS MATERIALIZED (
  SELECT
    ranked.*
  FROM (
    SELECT
      CAST(o.opportunityid AS TEXT) AS opportunity_id,
      CAST(o.parentaccountid AS TEXT) AS account_id,
      CAST(o.name AS TEXT) AS project_name,
      CAST(o.ownerid AS TEXT) AS owner_id,
      CASE
        WHEN CAST(o.new_accproducttype AS TEXT) IN ('1', '电芯')
        THEN '电芯'
        WHEN CAST(o.new_accproducttype AS TEXT) IN ('2', 'PACK')
        THEN 'PACK'
        ELSE '其他'
      END AS product_type,
      o.__x360_asof_process_stage AS process_stage,
      CAST(o.statecode AS TEXT) AS system_state,
      CAST(o.new_demandinput AS TEXT) AS demand_status,
      CAST(o.createdon AS TIMESTAMP) AS created_at,
      CAST(o.new_stage1enddate AS TIMESTAMP) AS s1,
      CAST(o.new_stage2enddate AS TIMESTAMP) AS s2,
      CAST(o.new_stage3enddate AS TIMESTAMP) AS s3,
      CAST(o.new_stage4enddate AS TIMESTAMP) AS s4,
      CAST(o.new_stage5enddate AS TIMESTAMP) AS s5,
      CAST(o.new_cdastartdate AS TIMESTAMP) AS new_cdastartdate,
      CAST(o.new_cdaenddate AS TIMESTAMP) AS new_cdaenddate,
      CAST(o.new_approved_time_acneed AS TIMESTAMP) AS new_approved_time_acneed,
      CAST(o.new_submit_time_acneed AS TIMESTAMP) AS new_submit_time_acneed,
      CAST(o.new_approved_time_projectassess AS TIMESTAMP) AS new_approved_time_projectassess,
      CAST(o.new_submit_time_projectassess AS TIMESTAMP) AS new_submit_time_projectassess,
      CAST(o.new_sampletestpass_time AS TIMESTAMP) AS new_sampletestpass_time,
      CAST(o.new_sampletime AS TIMESTAMP) AS new_sampletime,
      CAST(o.new_technicalsigningdate AS TIMESTAMP) AS new_technicalsigningdate,
      CAST(o.new_submit_time_techcon AS TIMESTAMP) AS new_submit_time_techcon,
      CAST(o.new_warrantysigningdate AS TIMESTAMP) AS new_warrantysigningdate,
      CAST(o.new_submit_time_qsl AS TIMESTAMP) AS new_submit_time_qsl,
      CAST(o.new_isneedcda AS TEXT) AS new_isneedcda,
      CAST(o.new_approvalstatus_acneed AS TEXT) AS new_approvalstatus_acneed,
      CAST(o.new_approvalstatus_projectassess AS TEXT) AS new_approvalstatus_projectassess,
      CAST(o.new_approvalstatus_techcon AS TEXT) AS new_approvalstatus_techcon,
      CAST(o.new_approvalstatus_qsl AS TEXT) AS new_approvalstatus_qsl,
      CAST(o.new_sampletestresult AS TEXT) AS new_sampletestresult,
      ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
        PARTITION BY o.opportunityid
        ORDER BY o.modifiedon DESC NULLS LAST, o.createdon DESC NULLS LAST
      ) AS rn
    FROM (
      SELECT
        __x360_raw.*,
        CASE
          WHEN CAST(__x360_raw.new_stage1enddate AS TIMESTAMP) IS NULL
          OR CAST(__x360_raw.new_stage1enddate AS TIMESTAMP) >= __x360_ctx.as_of_exclusive
          THEN '11'
          WHEN CAST(__x360_raw.new_stage2enddate AS TIMESTAMP) IS NULL
          OR CAST(__x360_raw.new_stage2enddate AS TIMESTAMP) >= __x360_ctx.as_of_exclusive
          THEN '12'
          WHEN CAST(__x360_raw.new_stage3enddate AS TIMESTAMP) IS NULL
          OR CAST(__x360_raw.new_stage3enddate AS TIMESTAMP) >= __x360_ctx.as_of_exclusive
          THEN '13'
          WHEN CAST(__x360_raw.new_stage4enddate AS TIMESTAMP) IS NULL
          OR CAST(__x360_raw.new_stage4enddate AS TIMESTAMP) >= __x360_ctx.as_of_exclusive
          THEN '14'
          WHEN CAST(__x360_raw.new_stage5enddate AS TIMESTAMP) IS NULL
          OR CAST(__x360_raw.new_stage5enddate AS TIMESTAMP) >= __x360_ctx.as_of_exclusive
          THEN '15'
          ELSE 'completed'
        END AS __x360_asof_process_stage
      FROM ded_public.p_fm_edw_v_ods_crm_opportunity_esb AS __x360_raw
      CROSS JOIN context AS __x360_ctx
    ) AS o
    WHERE
      NULLIF(TRIM(CAST(o.opportunityid AS TEXT)), '') IS NOT NULL
  ) AS ranked
  CROSS JOIN context AS p
  WHERE
    ranked.created_at < p.as_of_exclusive
), opportunities AS MATERIALIZED (
  SELECT
    o.opportunity_id,
    o.account_id,
    o.project_name,
    o.owner_id,
    o.product_type,
    o.process_stage,
    o.demand_status,
    o.created_at,
    o.s1,
    o.s2,
    o.s3,
    o.s4,
    o.s5,
    a.account_name,
    a.level_code,
    o.new_cdastartdate,
    o.new_cdaenddate,
    o.new_approved_time_acneed,
    o.new_submit_time_acneed,
    o.new_approved_time_projectassess,
    o.new_submit_time_projectassess,
    o.new_sampletestpass_time,
    o.new_sampletime,
    o.new_technicalsigningdate,
    o.new_submit_time_techcon,
    o.new_warrantysigningdate,
    o.new_submit_time_qsl,
    o.new_isneedcda,
    o.new_approvalstatus_acneed,
    o.new_approvalstatus_projectassess,
    o.new_approvalstatus_techcon,
    o.new_approvalstatus_qsl,
    o.new_sampletestresult,
    a.sap_created_at,
    a.sap_submitted_at,
    a.sap_code,
    a.account_factory_approved_at,
    a.account_factory_submitted_at,
    a.account_sinosure_start,
    a.account_sinosure_end,
    a.account_credit_submitted_at,
    a.account_credit_approved_at,
    a.account_cda_start,
    a.account_cda_end,
    a.account_cda_submitted_at,
    a.account_cda_approved_at,
    a.account_factory_approval_status
  FROM opportunity_rows AS o
  LEFT JOIN accounts AS a
    USING (account_id)
  CROSS JOIN context AS p
  WHERE
    o.rn = 1 AND (
      o.created_at < p.as_of_exclusive
    )
), orders AS MATERIALIZED (
  SELECT DISTINCT
    CAST(salesorderid AS TEXT) AS order_id
  FROM ded_public.p_fm_edw_v_ods_crm_salesorder_esb
  WHERE
    NULLIF(TRIM(CAST(salesorderid AS TEXT)), '') IS NOT NULL
), signed_orders AS MATERIALIZED (
  SELECT
    l.opportunity_id,
    COUNT(DISTINCT l.order_id) AS order_count
  FROM order_line_links AS l
  JOIN orders AS o
    USING (order_id)
  GROUP BY
    l.opportunity_id
), opportunity_flags AS MATERIALIZED (
  SELECT
    o.*,
    COALESCE(s.order_count, 0) AS order_count,
    CASE
      WHEN COALESCE(s.order_count, 0) = 0
      THEN FALSE
      WHEN o.s4 IS NULL
      THEN FALSE
      ELSE o.s4 < p.as_of_exclusive
    END AS signed,
    (
      COALESCE(s.order_count, 0) > 0 AND o.s4 IS NULL
    ) AS missing_p3_end
  FROM opportunities AS o
  LEFT JOIN signed_orders AS s
    USING (opportunity_id)
  CROSS JOIN context AS p
), review_order_products AS MATERIALIZED (
  SELECT
    l.order_id,
    CASE
      WHEN COUNT(DISTINCT o.product_type) = 1
      AND COUNT(DISTINCT l.opportunity_id) = COUNT(DISTINCT l.opportunity_id) FILTER(WHERE
        o.opportunity_id IS NOT NULL)
      THEN MIN(o.product_type)
      ELSE '未唯一识别产品'
    END AS product_type
  FROM order_line_links AS l
  LEFT JOIN opportunity_flags AS o
    USING (opportunity_id)
  GROUP BY
    l.order_id
), review_order_line_source AS MATERIALIZED (
  SELECT
    CAST(salesorderdetailid AS TEXT) AS line_id,
    CAST(salesorderid AS TEXT) AS order_id,
    CAST(quantity AS DECIMAL) AS order_qty,
    CAST(new_shipping_return_qty AS DECIMAL) AS shipped_qty,
    CAST(new_shipping_time AS TIMESTAMP) AS shipped_at,
    CAST(modifiedon AS TIMESTAMP) AS modified_at,
    CAST(createdon AS TIMESTAMP) AS created_at
  FROM ded_public.p_fm_edw_v_ods_crm_salesorderdetail_esb
), review_order_lines AS MATERIALIZED (
  SELECT
    *
  FROM (
    SELECT
      l.*,
      ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
        PARTITION BY line_id
        ORDER BY modified_at DESC NULLS LAST, created_at DESC NULLS LAST
      ) AS rn
    FROM review_order_line_source AS l
    WHERE
      NULLIF(TRIM(line_id), '') IS NOT NULL
  ) AS r
  WHERE
    rn = 1
), review_unkeyed_order_lines AS MATERIALIZED (
  SELECT DISTINCT
    order_id
  FROM review_order_line_source
  WHERE
    NULLIF(TRIM(order_id), '') IS NOT NULL AND NULLIF(TRIM(line_id), '') IS NULL
), review_order_quantity_status AS MATERIALIZED (
  SELECT
    l.order_id,
    COUNT(*) AS line_count,
    COUNT(*) FILTER(WHERE
      order_qty > 0) AS positive_quantity_lines,
    COUNT(*) FILTER(WHERE
      order_qty IS NULL OR shipped_qty IS NULL OR order_qty < 0) AS missing_or_invalid_quantity_lines,
    COUNT(*) FILTER(WHERE
      shipped_at IS NULL) AS missing_shipping_date_lines,
    COUNT(*) FILTER(WHERE
      shipped_qty < order_qty) AS not_fully_shipped_lines,
    CASE
      WHEN COUNT(*) FILTER(WHERE
        order_qty IS NULL OR shipped_qty IS NULL OR order_qty < 0) > 0
      OR EXISTS(
        SELECT
          1
        FROM review_unkeyed_order_lines AS u
        WHERE
          u.order_id = l.order_id
      )
      THEN NULL
      ELSE BOOL_AND(shipped_qty >= order_qty)
    END AS completely_shipped,
    CASE
      WHEN COUNT(*) FILTER(WHERE
        shipped_at IS NULL) > 0
      THEN NULL
      ELSE MAX(shipped_at)
    END AS fully_shipped_at
  FROM review_order_lines AS l
  WHERE
    NULLIF(TRIM(l.order_id), '') IS NOT NULL
  GROUP BY
    l.order_id
), review_full_orders AS MATERIALIZED (
  SELECT
    order_id,
    fully_shipped_at
  FROM review_order_quantity_status
  WHERE
    completely_shipped IS TRUE
), review_delivery_cycle_events AS MATERIALIZED (
  SELECT
    CAST('FULL_DELIVERY' AS TEXT) AS kind,
    s.order_id AS event_id,
    COALESCE(t.product_type, '未唯一识别产品') AS product_type,
    s.approved_at AS started_at,
    f.fully_shipped_at AS finished_at,
    f.fully_shipped_at AS period_at
  FROM supplement_order_latest AS s
  JOIN review_full_orders AS f
    USING (order_id)
  LEFT JOIN review_order_products AS t
    USING (order_id)
), review_delivery_cycle_facts AS MATERIALIZED (
  SELECT
    r.*,
    p.cutoff,
    CASE
      WHEN r.finished_at >= p.start_date
      AND r.finished_at < p.effective_end_exclusive
      AND r.event_id IS NOT NULL
      AND r.started_at IS NOT NULL
      AND r.finished_at >= r.started_at
      THEN EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM (
        r.finished_at - r.started_at
      )) / CAST(86400 AS DECIMAL)
    END AS duration_days
  FROM review_delivery_cycle_events AS r
  CROSS JOIN context AS p
), review_delivery_cycle_samples AS MATERIALIZED (
  SELECT DISTINCT
    kind,
    event_id,
    product_type,
    duration_days
  FROM review_delivery_cycle_facts
  WHERE
    duration_days IS NOT NULL
  UNION ALL
  SELECT DISTINCT
    kind,
    event_id,
    '全部',
    duration_days
  FROM review_delivery_cycle_facts
  WHERE
    duration_days IS NOT NULL
), review_delivery_cycle_stats AS MATERIALIZED (
  SELECT
    kind,
    product_type,
    COUNT(*) AS sample_count,
    AVG(duration_days) AS mean_days
  FROM review_delivery_cycle_samples
  GROUP BY
    kind,
    product_type
), review_delivery_cycle_quality AS MATERIALIZED (
  SELECT
    kind,
    COUNT(*) AS source_rows,
    COUNT(*) FILTER(WHERE
      started_at IS NULL) AS missing_start_rows,
    COUNT(*) FILTER(WHERE
      finished_at IS NULL) AS missing_end_rows,
    COUNT(*) FILTER(WHERE
      finished_at < started_at) AS reversed_rows,
    COUNT(*) FILTER(WHERE
      duration_days IS NOT NULL) AS valid_linked_rows
  FROM review_delivery_cycle_facts
  GROUP BY
    kind
), metric_results AS MATERIALIZED (
  SELECT
    50 AS sort_no,
    CAST('P4-03' AS TEXT) AS code,
    CAST('订单交付情况平均周期' AS TEXT) AS metric_name,
    CAST(NULL AS TEXT) AS product_team,
    CAST(NULL AS DECIMAL) AS amount_yi,
    CAST(NULL AS DECIMAL) AS energy_gwh,
    CAST(COALESCE(s.sample_count, 0) AS BIGINT) AS item_count,
    CAST(NULL AS DECIMAL) AS ratio_value,
    CAST(s.mean_days AS DECIMAL) AS days_value,
    CAST(CASE WHEN s.sample_count > 0 THEN '已按用户红字口径计算' ELSE '口径已修改；所选期间无有效起止配对' END AS TEXT) AS status,
    CAST('订单明细逐行new_shipping_return_qty≥quantity，所有明细均已发足才认定整单完全发货；完全发货日期取该订单全部明细new_shipping_time的最大值。周期＝完全发货日期－订单头new_approval_time，换算天后按订单ID去重取平均。 按订单明细主键取最新记录，逐明细比较已发货数量与订单数量，相等也算发足，不跨明细或计量单位直接加数量抵消未发部分。完全发货日期按MAX(new_shipping_time)归年/月；任一明细缺数量、缺主键或缺发货日期时保留未知，不自动回退其他表日期。仅有数量发足证据而没有完整日期时，不计入交付周期均值。 按客户最新确认，完成状态与日期均取订单明细：已发货数量≥订单数量、全部明细满足，完成时间取MAX(new_shipping_time)。直接实现该方法，不自动改用发货单日期或其他替代方法；订单审批、数量及明细日期缺失时周期仍为NULL。' AS TEXT) AS note,
    JSONB_BUILD_OBJECT(
      '产品分组',
      (
        SELECT
          JSONB_AGG(TO_JSONB(v))
        FROM review_delivery_cycle_stats AS v
        WHERE
          v.kind = 'FULL_DELIVERY'
      ),
      '输入质量',
      (
        SELECT
          TO_JSONB(q)
        FROM review_delivery_cycle_quality AS q
        WHERE
          q.kind = 'FULL_DELIVERY'
      ),
      '阶段回退',
      '已停用',
      '订单数量及日期核对',
      (
        SELECT
          JSONB_AGG(TO_JSONB(q))
        FROM review_order_quantity_status AS q
      )
    ) AS detail
  FROM context AS p
  LEFT JOIN review_delivery_cycle_stats AS s
    ON s.kind = 'FULL_DELIVERY' AND s.product_type = '全部'
)
SELECT
  r.code AS "指标序号",
  r.metric_name AS "指标名称",
  r.product_team AS "产品团队",
  p.start_date AS "期间开始",
  p.end_exclusive AS "期间结束不含",
  p.cutoff AS "周期观察截止",
  r.amount_yi AS "金额_亿元",
  r.energy_gwh AS "电量_GWh",
  r.item_count AS "数量",
  r.ratio_value AS "比率_原始小数",
  r.days_value AS "平均周期_天",
  CASE
    WHEN r.status = '查询已实现；缺失输入及部分合计见明细'
    THEN CASE
      WHEN r.amount_yi IS NOT NULL
      OR r.energy_gwh IS NOT NULL
      OR r.item_count IS NOT NULL
      OR r.ratio_value IS NOT NULL
      OR r.days_value IS NOT NULL
      THEN '已有查询结果；完整性与适用列见明细'
      ELSE '没有可计算结果；检查输入、时间及关联范围'
    END
    ELSE r.status
  END AS "计算说明状态",
  r.note AS "取值说明",
  r.detail AS "分组明细及缺口"
FROM metric_results AS r
CROSS JOIN context AS p
ORDER BY
  r.sort_no,
  r.product_team;

P4-04.name: 目标达成情况平均周期
P4-04.definition: 按当年月度目标出货电量，与当月实际发货电量按日累计比较。首次累计达到月目标即停止计时；周期＝达成日－当月1日＋1，25日达成记25天。对所选期间可计算月份取平均。
P4-04.formula:
月份按页面年/月选择；月目标沿当前目标表商机＋年度最新版本，取对应月power。实际电量＝发货数量×产品单套kWh÷10^6。未达成计至观察日或月底，并单列在途；目标≤0或核心输入缺失不作有效月份。
本项为月度达成天数的特殊算法：未达成仍按原方法计至观察日或月底并单列在途，不因普通阶段结束归期规则被统一排除；目标先创建截至后按原商机＋年度取最新，实绩仅使用观察日当天及以前的发货。

P4-04.sql:
-- PostgreSQL只读查询；按3个位置参数绑定业务期间和观察日期；参数顺序见parameters。
WITH parameters AS MATERIALIZED (
SELECT CAST(%s AS DATE) AS start_date,
 CAST(%s AS DATE) AS end_exclusive,
 CAST(%s AS TIMESTAMP) AS observed_at,
 ARRAY['1']::text[] AS strategic_levels,
 ARRAY['1','2']::text[] AS focus_levels,
 1000000::numeric AS target_power_units_per_gwh
), context AS MATERIALIZED (
SELECT p.*,
 (DATE_TRUNC('day',observed_at)+INTERVAL '1 day')::timestamp AS as_of_exclusive,
 LEAST(end_exclusive::timestamp,DATE_TRUNC('day',observed_at)+INTERVAL '1 day') AS effective_end_exclusive,
 LEAST(end_exclusive::timestamp,DATE_TRUNC('day',observed_at)+INTERVAL '1 day')-INTERVAL '1 microsecond' AS cutoff,
 MAKE_DATE(EXTRACT(YEAR FROM start_date)::integer,1,1) AS year_start,
 MAKE_DATE(EXTRACT(YEAR FROM start_date)::integer+1,1,1) AS next_year_start,
 GREATEST(0::numeric,LEAST(1::numeric,
   (LEAST(end_exclusive::timestamp,DATE_TRUNC('day',observed_at)+INTERVAL '1 day')::date
    -MAKE_DATE(EXTRACT(YEAR FROM start_date)::integer,1,1))::numeric
   /(MAKE_DATE(EXTRACT(YEAR FROM start_date)::integer+1,1,1)-MAKE_DATE(EXTRACT(YEAR FROM start_date)::integer,1,1)))) AS time_progress
 FROM parameters p
), product_types AS MATERIALIZED (
SELECT
    CAST(new_product_typeid AS TEXT) AS product_type_id,
    CASE
      WHEN COUNT(DISTINCT CAST(new_accproducttype AS TEXT)) = 1
      THEN MIN(CAST(new_accproducttype AS TEXT))
    END AS type_code
  FROM ded_public.p_fm_edw_v_ods_crm_new_product_type_esb
  GROUP BY
    CAST(new_product_typeid AS TEXT)
), teams AS MATERIALIZED (
SELECT
    CAST(teamid AS TEXT) AS team_id,
    MAX(CAST(name AS TEXT)) AS team_name
  FROM ded_public.p_fm_edw_v_ods_crm_team_esb
  GROUP BY
    CAST(teamid AS TEXT)
), team_members AS MATERIALIZED (
SELECT DISTINCT
    CAST(tm.systemuserid AS TEXT) AS owner_id,
    CAST(t.name AS TEXT) AS team_name
  FROM ded_public.p_fm_edw_v_ods_crm_teammembership_esb AS tm
  JOIN (
    SELECT
      team_id,
      team_name AS name
    FROM teams
  ) AS t
    ON t.team_id = CAST(tm.teamid AS TEXT)
  WHERE
    NULLIF(TRIM(CAST(t.name AS TEXT)), '') IS NOT NULL
), owner_teams AS MATERIALIZED (
SELECT
    owner_id,
    CASE WHEN COUNT(DISTINCT team_name) = 1 THEN MIN(team_name) END AS team_name
  FROM team_members
  GROUP BY
    owner_id
), target_rows AS MATERIALIZED (
SELECT
    CAST(t.new_targetid AS TEXT) AS target_id,
    CAST(t.new_opportunity_id AS TEXT) AS opportunity_id,
    CAST(t.new_year AS INT) AS year_no,
    CAST(t.new_account_id AS TEXT) AS account_id,
    CAST(t.ownerid AS TEXT) AS owner_id,
    CAST(t.owningteam AS TEXT) AS owning_team_id,
    CAST(t.new_producttype_id AS TEXT) AS product_type_id,
    t.new_month1,
    t.new_month2,
    t.new_month3,
    t.new_month4,
    t.new_month5,
    t.new_month6,
    t.new_month7,
    t.new_month8,
    t.new_month9,
    t.new_month10,
    t.new_month11,
    t.new_month12,
    t.new_month1_power,
    t.new_month2_power,
    t.new_month3_power,
    t.new_month4_power,
    t.new_month5_power,
    t.new_month6_power,
    t.new_month7_power,
    t.new_month8_power,
    t.new_month9_power,
    t.new_month10_power,
    t.new_month11_power,
    t.new_month12_power,
    ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
      PARTITION BY COALESCE(NULLIF(TRIM(CAST(t.new_opportunity_id AS TEXT)), ''), CAST(t.new_targetid AS TEXT)), t.new_year
      ORDER BY t.createdon DESC NULLS LAST, t.new_targetid DESC NULLS LAST
    ) AS rn
  FROM (SELECT __x360_raw.*
 FROM ded_public.p_fm_edw_v_ods_crm_new_target_esb __x360_raw CROSS JOIN context __x360_ctx
 WHERE __x360_raw.createdon::timestamp<__x360_ctx.as_of_exclusive) AS t
  CROSS JOIN context AS p
  WHERE
    CAST(t.new_year AS INT) = CAST(EXTRACT(YEAR FROM p.start_date) AS INT)
    AND t.new_targetid IS NOT NULL
), review_month_target_facts AS MATERIALIZED (
SELECT
    t.target_id,
    t.account_id,
    CASE
      WHEN pt.type_code IN ('1', '电芯')
      THEN '电芯'
      WHEN pt.type_code IN ('2', 'PACK')
      THEN 'PACK'
      ELSE '其他'
    END AS product_type,
    COALESCE(NULLIF(TRIM(owned.team_name), ''), ot.team_name) AS team_name,
    CAST(v.amount_yuan AS DECIMAL) / CAST(100000000 AS DECIMAL) AS amount_yi,
    CAST(v.power_value AS DECIMAL) / p.target_power_units_per_gwh AS energy_gwh,
    MAKE_DATE(t.year_no, v.month_no, 1) AS target_month
  FROM target_rows AS t
  CROSS JOIN context AS p
  CROSS JOIN LATERAL (
    VALUES
      (1, t.new_month1, t.new_month1_power),
      (2, t.new_month2, t.new_month2_power),
      (3, t.new_month3, t.new_month3_power),
      (4, t.new_month4, t.new_month4_power),
      (5, t.new_month5, t.new_month5_power),
      (6, t.new_month6, t.new_month6_power),
      (7, t.new_month7, t.new_month7_power),
      (8, t.new_month8, t.new_month8_power),
      (9, t.new_month9, t.new_month9_power),
      (10, t.new_month10, t.new_month10_power),
      (11, t.new_month11, t.new_month11_power),
      (12, t.new_month12, t.new_month12_power)
  ) AS v(month_no, amount_yuan, power_value)
  LEFT JOIN product_types AS pt
    USING (product_type_id)
  LEFT JOIN owner_teams AS ot
    USING (owner_id)
  LEFT JOIN teams AS owned
    ON owned.team_id = t.owning_team_id
  WHERE
    t.rn = 1
    AND MAKE_DATE(t.year_no, v.month_no, 1) >= p.year_start
    AND MAKE_DATE(t.year_no, v.month_no, 1) < p.next_year_start
), review_month_targets AS MATERIALIZED (
SELECT
    target_month AS month_start,
    SUM(energy_gwh) AS target_gwh,
    COUNT(*) AS target_rows,
    COUNT(*) FILTER(WHERE
      energy_gwh IS NULL) AS missing_target_rows
  FROM review_month_target_facts
  CROSS JOIN context AS p
  WHERE
    target_month < p.end_exclusive
    AND target_month + INTERVAL '1 MONTH' > p.start_date
    AND target_month <= p.cutoff
  GROUP BY
    target_month
), product_codes AS MATERIALIZED (
SELECT
    CAST(productnumber AS TEXT) AS product_code,
    CASE
      WHEN COUNT(DISTINCT new_system_energy) = 1
      THEN CAST(MAX(new_system_energy) AS DECIMAL)
    END AS energy_kwh
  FROM ded_public.p_fm_edw_v_ods_crm_product_esb
  WHERE
    NULLIF(TRIM(CAST(productnumber AS TEXT)), '') IS NOT NULL
  GROUP BY
    CAST(productnumber AS TEXT)
), review_header_source AS MATERIALIZED (
SELECT
    CAST(new_ord_shipmentid AS TEXT) AS shipment_id,
    CAST(new_shipping2_date AS TIMESTAMP) AS shipped_at,
    statecode,
    CAST(modifiedon AS TIMESTAMP) AS modified_at,
    CAST(createdon AS TIMESTAMP) AS created_at
  FROM ded_public.p_fm_edw_v_ods_crm_new_ord_shipment_esb
), review_headers_latest AS MATERIALIZED (
SELECT
    *
  FROM (
    SELECT
      s.*,
      ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
        PARTITION BY shipment_id
        ORDER BY modified_at DESC NULLS LAST, created_at DESC NULLS LAST
      ) AS rn
    FROM review_header_source AS s
    WHERE
      NULLIF(TRIM(shipment_id), '') IS NOT NULL
  ) AS r
  WHERE
    rn = 1
), review_item_source AS MATERIALIZED (
SELECT
    CAST(new_ord_shipmentitemid AS TEXT) AS line_id,
    CAST(new_ord_shipment_id AS TEXT) AS shipment_id,
    CAST(new_ord_salesorder_id AS TEXT) AS order_id,
    CAST(new_product_id AS TEXT) AS product_id,
    CAST(new_uom_id AS TEXT) AS uom_id,
    CAST(new_productcode AS TEXT) AS product_code,
    CAST(new_qty AS DECIMAL) AS qty,
    CAST(new_amount_base AS DECIMAL) / CAST(100000000 AS DECIMAL) AS amount_yi,
    CAST(modifiedon AS TIMESTAMP) AS modified_at,
    CAST(createdon AS TIMESTAMP) AS created_at
  FROM ded_public.p_fm_edw_v_ods_crm_new_ord_shipmentitem_esb
), review_items_latest AS MATERIALIZED (
SELECT
    *
  FROM (
    SELECT
      i.*,
      ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
        PARTITION BY line_id
        ORDER BY modified_at DESC NULLS LAST, created_at DESC NULLS LAST
      ) AS rn
    FROM review_item_source AS i
    WHERE
      NULLIF(TRIM(line_id), '') IS NOT NULL
  ) AS r
  WHERE
    rn = 1
), review_month_energy_days AS MATERIALIZED (
SELECT
    CAST(h.shipped_at AS DATE) AS shipped_date,
    SUM(i.qty * pc.energy_kwh / CAST(1000000 AS DECIMAL)) AS energy_gwh,
    COUNT(*) FILTER(WHERE
      i.qty IS NULL OR pc.energy_kwh IS NULL) AS missing_energy_rows
  FROM review_items_latest AS i
  JOIN review_headers_latest AS h
    USING (shipment_id)
  LEFT JOIN product_codes AS pc
    USING (product_code)
  CROSS JOIN context AS p
  WHERE
    h.statecode = 0
    AND i.qty > 0
    AND h.shipped_at >= DATE_TRUNC('MONTH', CAST(p.start_date AS TIMESTAMP))
    AND h.shipped_at < p.end_exclusive
    AND h.shipped_at <= p.cutoff
  GROUP BY
    CAST(h.shipped_at AS DATE)
), review_month_cumulative AS MATERIALIZED (
SELECT
    d.*,
    CAST(DATE_TRUNC('MONTH', shipped_date) AS DATE) AS month_start,
    SUM(energy_gwh) OVER (
      PARTITION BY DATE_TRUNC('MONTH', shipped_date)
      ORDER BY shipped_date
      ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW
    ) AS cumulative_gwh
  FROM review_month_energy_days AS d
), review_month_achievement AS MATERIALIZED (
SELECT
    t.*,
    MIN(d.shipped_date) FILTER(WHERE
      d.cumulative_gwh >= t.target_gwh) AS first_achieved_date,
    COALESCE(SUM(d.missing_energy_rows), 0) AS missing_actual_rows,
    MAX(d.cumulative_gwh) AS known_cumulative_max,
    LEAST(
      CAST((
        t.month_start + INTERVAL '1 MONTH'
      ) AS DATE) - 1,
      CASE
        WHEN CAST(p.cutoff AS TIME) = CAST('00:00:00' AS TIME)
        THEN CAST(p.cutoff AS DATE) - 1
        ELSE CAST(p.cutoff AS DATE)
      END
    ) AS through_date
  FROM review_month_targets AS t
  LEFT JOIN review_month_cumulative AS d
    USING (month_start)
  CROSS JOIN context AS p
  GROUP BY
    t.month_start,
    t.target_gwh,
    t.target_rows,
    t.missing_target_rows,
    p.cutoff
), review_month_days AS MATERIALIZED (
  SELECT
    m.*,
    CASE
      WHEN target_gwh > 0
      AND missing_target_rows = 0
      AND missing_actual_rows = 0
      AND through_date >= month_start
      THEN CAST((
        COALESCE(first_achieved_date, through_date) - month_start + 1
      ) AS DECIMAL)
    END AS duration_days,
    first_achieved_date IS NULL AS not_achieved
  FROM review_month_achievement AS m /* 每月1日起按自然日含首日计数：25号首次达到月目标即25天。未达成算至观察日/月底。 */ /* 目标非正或核心输入不全不编造达成日期；没有该月发货记录按累计0、未达成处理。 */
), metric_results AS MATERIALIZED (
  SELECT
    51 AS sort_no,
    CAST('P4-04' AS TEXT) AS code,
    CAST('目标达成情况平均周期' AS TEXT) AS metric_name,
    CAST(NULL AS TEXT) AS product_team,
    CAST(NULL AS DECIMAL) AS amount_yi,
    CAST(NULL AS DECIMAL) AS energy_gwh,
    CAST(COUNT(duration_days) AS BIGINT) AS item_count,
    CAST(NULL AS DECIMAL) AS ratio_value,
    CAST(AVG(duration_days) AS DECIMAL) AS days_value,
    CAST(CASE
      WHEN COUNT(duration_days) > 0
      THEN '已按月度出货目标达成天数计算'
      ELSE '口径已修改；缺正数月目标或完整电量输入'
    END AS TEXT) AS status,
    CAST('月目标与实际出货电量同为GWh；按自然月累计，首次达到目标即停止计时，25日达成记25天。未达成计至观察日或月底并单列未达成；目标非正/缺值、实际核心输入不全不编造周期。当前按总体月份统计，数量列为可计算月份数，不是商机数。' AS TEXT) AS note,
    JSONB_BUILD_OBJECT(
      '逐月明细',
      JSONB_AGG(TO_JSONB(m)),
      '已达成月份数',
      COUNT(duration_days) FILTER(WHERE
        NOT not_achieved),
      '未达成月份数',
      COUNT(duration_days) FILTER(WHERE
        not_achieved),
      '阶段回退',
      '已停用'
    ) AS detail
  FROM review_month_days AS m
)
SELECT
  r.code AS "指标序号",
  r.metric_name AS "指标名称",
  r.product_team AS "产品团队",
  p.start_date AS "期间开始",
  p.end_exclusive AS "期间结束不含",
  p.cutoff AS "周期观察截止",
  r.amount_yi AS "金额_亿元",
  r.energy_gwh AS "电量_GWh",
  r.item_count AS "数量",
  r.ratio_value AS "比率_原始小数",
  r.days_value AS "平均周期_天",
  CASE
    WHEN r.status = '查询已实现；缺失输入及部分合计见明细'
    THEN CASE
      WHEN r.amount_yi IS NOT NULL
      OR r.energy_gwh IS NOT NULL
      OR r.item_count IS NOT NULL
      OR r.ratio_value IS NOT NULL
      OR r.days_value IS NOT NULL
      THEN '已有查询结果；完整性与适用列见明细'
      ELSE '没有可计算结果；检查输入、时间及关联范围'
    END
    ELSE r.status
  END AS "计算说明状态",
  r.note AS "取值说明",
  r.detail AS "分组明细及缺口"
FROM metric_results AS r
CROSS JOIN context AS p
ORDER BY
  r.sort_no,
  r.product_team;

R12.sql:
WITH parameters AS MATERIALIZED (
  SELECT
    CAST(%s AS DATE) AS start_date,
    CAST(%s AS DATE) AS end_exclusive,
    CAST(%s AS TIMESTAMP) AS observed_at,
    CAST(ARRAY['1'] AS TEXT[]) AS strategic_levels,
    CAST(ARRAY['1', '2'] AS TEXT[]) AS focus_levels,
    CAST(1000000 AS DECIMAL) AS target_power_units_per_gwh
), context AS MATERIALIZED (
  SELECT
    p.*,
    CAST((
      DATE_TRUNC('DAY', observed_at) + INTERVAL '1 DAY'
    ) AS TIMESTAMP) AS as_of_exclusive,
    LEAST(
      CAST(end_exclusive AS TIMESTAMP),
      DATE_TRUNC('DAY', observed_at) + INTERVAL '1 DAY'
    ) AS effective_end_exclusive,
    LEAST(
      CAST(end_exclusive AS TIMESTAMP),
      DATE_TRUNC('DAY', observed_at) + INTERVAL '1 DAY'
    ) - INTERVAL '1 MICROSECOND' AS cutoff,
    MAKE_DATE(CAST(EXTRACT(YEAR FROM start_date) AS INT), 1, 1) AS year_start,
    MAKE_DATE(CAST(EXTRACT(YEAR FROM start_date) AS INT) + 1, 1, 1) AS next_year_start,
    GREATEST(
      CAST(0 AS DECIMAL),
      LEAST(
        CAST(1 AS DECIMAL),
        CAST((
          CAST(LEAST(
            CAST(end_exclusive AS TIMESTAMP),
            DATE_TRUNC('DAY', observed_at) + INTERVAL '1 DAY'
          ) AS DATE) - MAKE_DATE(CAST(EXTRACT(YEAR FROM start_date) AS INT), 1, 1)
        ) AS DECIMAL) / (
          MAKE_DATE(CAST(EXTRACT(YEAR FROM start_date) AS INT) + 1, 1, 1) - MAKE_DATE(CAST(EXTRACT(YEAR FROM start_date) AS INT), 1, 1)
        )
      )
    ) AS time_progress
  FROM parameters AS p
), account_rows AS MATERIALIZED (
  SELECT
    CAST(a.accountid AS TEXT) AS account_id,
    CAST(a.name AS TEXT) AS account_name,
    CAST(a.new_accountlevel AS TEXT) AS level_code,
    CAST(a.new_sapdate AS TIMESTAMP) AS sap_created_at,
    CAST(a.new_sapsubmitdate AS TIMESTAMP) AS sap_submitted_at,
    CAST(a.new_approved_time_facreview AS TIMESTAMP) AS account_factory_approved_at,
    CAST(a.new_submit_time_facreview AS TIMESTAMP) AS account_factory_submitted_at,
    CAST(a.new_sinosurestartdate AS TIMESTAMP) AS account_sinosure_start,
    CAST(a.new_sinosureenddate AS TIMESTAMP) AS account_sinosure_end,
    CAST(a.new_submit_time_accredit AS TIMESTAMP) AS account_credit_submitted_at,
    CAST(a.new_approvaltime_accredit AS TIMESTAMP) AS account_credit_approved_at,
    CAST(a.new_cdastartdate AS TIMESTAMP) AS account_cda_start,
    CAST(a.new_cdaenddate AS TIMESTAMP) AS account_cda_end,
    CAST(a.new_cda_submittime AS TIMESTAMP) AS account_cda_submitted_at,
    CAST(a.new_cda_approved_time AS TIMESTAMP) AS account_cda_approved_at,
    CAST(a.new_approvalstatus_facreview AS TEXT) AS account_factory_approval_status,
    CAST(a.new_sapcode AS TEXT) AS sap_code,
    CAST(a.new_issap AS TEXT) AS sap_registered,
    CAST(a.new_issapnew AS TEXT) AS sap_registration_kind,
    ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
      PARTITION BY a.accountid
      ORDER BY a.modifiedon DESC NULLS LAST, a.createdon DESC NULLS LAST
    ) AS rn
  FROM (
    SELECT
      __x360_raw.*
    FROM ded_public.p_fm_edw_v_ods_crm_account_esb AS __x360_raw
    CROSS JOIN context AS __x360_ctx
    WHERE
      CAST(__x360_raw.createdon AS TIMESTAMP) < __x360_ctx.as_of_exclusive
  ) AS a
  WHERE
    NULLIF(TRIM(CAST(a.accountid AS TEXT)), '') IS NOT NULL
), accounts AS MATERIALIZED (
  SELECT
    account_id,
    account_name,
    level_code,
    sap_created_at,
    sap_submitted_at,
    account_factory_approved_at,
    account_factory_submitted_at,
    account_sinosure_start,
    account_sinosure_end,
    account_credit_submitted_at,
    account_credit_approved_at,
    account_cda_start,
    account_cda_end,
    account_cda_submitted_at,
    account_cda_approved_at,
    account_factory_approval_status,
    sap_code,
    sap_registered,
    sap_registration_kind
  FROM account_rows
  WHERE
    rn = 1
), opportunity_rows AS MATERIALIZED (
  SELECT
    ranked.*
  FROM (
    SELECT
      CAST(o.opportunityid AS TEXT) AS opportunity_id,
      CAST(o.parentaccountid AS TEXT) AS account_id,
      CAST(o.name AS TEXT) AS project_name,
      CAST(o.ownerid AS TEXT) AS owner_id,
      CASE
        WHEN CAST(o.new_accproducttype AS TEXT) IN ('1', '电芯')
        THEN '电芯'
        WHEN CAST(o.new_accproducttype AS TEXT) IN ('2', 'PACK')
        THEN 'PACK'
        ELSE '其他'
      END AS product_type,
      o.__x360_asof_process_stage AS process_stage,
      CAST(o.statecode AS TEXT) AS system_state,
      CAST(o.new_demandinput AS TEXT) AS demand_status,
      CAST(o.createdon AS TIMESTAMP) AS created_at,
      CAST(o.new_stage1enddate AS TIMESTAMP) AS s1,
      CAST(o.new_stage2enddate AS TIMESTAMP) AS s2,
      CAST(o.new_stage3enddate AS TIMESTAMP) AS s3,
      CAST(o.new_stage4enddate AS TIMESTAMP) AS s4,
      CAST(o.new_stage5enddate AS TIMESTAMP) AS s5,
      CAST(o.new_cdastartdate AS TIMESTAMP) AS new_cdastartdate,
      CAST(o.new_cdaenddate AS TIMESTAMP) AS new_cdaenddate,
      CAST(o.new_approved_time_acneed AS TIMESTAMP) AS new_approved_time_acneed,
      CAST(o.new_submit_time_acneed AS TIMESTAMP) AS new_submit_time_acneed,
      CAST(o.new_approved_time_projectassess AS TIMESTAMP) AS new_approved_time_projectassess,
      CAST(o.new_submit_time_projectassess AS TIMESTAMP) AS new_submit_time_projectassess,
      CAST(o.new_sampletestpass_time AS TIMESTAMP) AS new_sampletestpass_time,
      CAST(o.new_sampletime AS TIMESTAMP) AS new_sampletime,
      CAST(o.new_technicalsigningdate AS TIMESTAMP) AS new_technicalsigningdate,
      CAST(o.new_submit_time_techcon AS TIMESTAMP) AS new_submit_time_techcon,
      CAST(o.new_warrantysigningdate AS TIMESTAMP) AS new_warrantysigningdate,
      CAST(o.new_submit_time_qsl AS TIMESTAMP) AS new_submit_time_qsl,
      CAST(o.new_isneedcda AS TEXT) AS new_isneedcda,
      CAST(o.new_approvalstatus_acneed AS TEXT) AS new_approvalstatus_acneed,
      CAST(o.new_approvalstatus_projectassess AS TEXT) AS new_approvalstatus_projectassess,
      CAST(o.new_approvalstatus_techcon AS TEXT) AS new_approvalstatus_techcon,
      CAST(o.new_approvalstatus_qsl AS TEXT) AS new_approvalstatus_qsl,
      CAST(o.new_sampletestresult AS TEXT) AS new_sampletestresult,
      ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
        PARTITION BY o.opportunityid
        ORDER BY o.modifiedon DESC NULLS LAST, o.createdon DESC NULLS LAST
      ) AS rn
    FROM (
      SELECT
        __x360_raw.*,
        CASE
          WHEN CAST(__x360_raw.new_stage1enddate AS TIMESTAMP) IS NULL
          OR CAST(__x360_raw.new_stage1enddate AS TIMESTAMP) >= __x360_ctx.as_of_exclusive
          THEN '11'
          WHEN CAST(__x360_raw.new_stage2enddate AS TIMESTAMP) IS NULL
          OR CAST(__x360_raw.new_stage2enddate AS TIMESTAMP) >= __x360_ctx.as_of_exclusive
          THEN '12'
          WHEN CAST(__x360_raw.new_stage3enddate AS TIMESTAMP) IS NULL
          OR CAST(__x360_raw.new_stage3enddate AS TIMESTAMP) >= __x360_ctx.as_of_exclusive
          THEN '13'
          WHEN CAST(__x360_raw.new_stage4enddate AS TIMESTAMP) IS NULL
          OR CAST(__x360_raw.new_stage4enddate AS TIMESTAMP) >= __x360_ctx.as_of_exclusive
          THEN '14'
          WHEN CAST(__x360_raw.new_stage5enddate AS TIMESTAMP) IS NULL
          OR CAST(__x360_raw.new_stage5enddate AS TIMESTAMP) >= __x360_ctx.as_of_exclusive
          THEN '15'
          ELSE 'completed'
        END AS __x360_asof_process_stage
      FROM ded_public.p_fm_edw_v_ods_crm_opportunity_esb AS __x360_raw
      CROSS JOIN context AS __x360_ctx
    ) AS o
    WHERE
      NULLIF(TRIM(CAST(o.opportunityid AS TEXT)), '') IS NOT NULL
  ) AS ranked
  CROSS JOIN context AS p
  WHERE
    ranked.created_at < p.as_of_exclusive
), opportunities AS MATERIALIZED (
  SELECT
    o.opportunity_id,
    o.account_id,
    o.project_name,
    o.owner_id,
    o.product_type,
    o.process_stage,
    o.demand_status,
    o.created_at,
    o.s1,
    o.s2,
    o.s3,
    o.s4,
    o.s5,
    a.account_name,
    a.level_code,
    o.new_cdastartdate,
    o.new_cdaenddate,
    o.new_approved_time_acneed,
    o.new_submit_time_acneed,
    o.new_approved_time_projectassess,
    o.new_submit_time_projectassess,
    o.new_sampletestpass_time,
    o.new_sampletime,
    o.new_technicalsigningdate,
    o.new_submit_time_techcon,
    o.new_warrantysigningdate,
    o.new_submit_time_qsl,
    o.new_isneedcda,
    o.new_approvalstatus_acneed,
    o.new_approvalstatus_projectassess,
    o.new_approvalstatus_techcon,
    o.new_approvalstatus_qsl,
    o.new_sampletestresult,
    a.sap_created_at,
    a.sap_submitted_at,
    a.sap_code,
    a.account_factory_approved_at,
    a.account_factory_submitted_at,
    a.account_sinosure_start,
    a.account_sinosure_end,
    a.account_credit_submitted_at,
    a.account_credit_approved_at,
    a.account_cda_start,
    a.account_cda_end,
    a.account_cda_submitted_at,
    a.account_cda_approved_at,
    a.account_factory_approval_status
  FROM opportunity_rows AS o
  LEFT JOIN accounts AS a
    USING (account_id)
  CROSS JOIN context AS p
  WHERE
    o.rn = 1 AND (
      o.created_at < p.as_of_exclusive
    )
), orders AS MATERIALIZED (
  SELECT DISTINCT
    CAST(salesorderid AS TEXT) AS order_id
  FROM ded_public.p_fm_edw_v_ods_crm_salesorder_esb
  WHERE
    NULLIF(TRIM(CAST(salesorderid AS TEXT)), '') IS NOT NULL
), order_line_links AS MATERIALIZED (
  SELECT DISTINCT
    CAST(l.new_opportunity_id AS TEXT) AS opportunity_id,
    CAST(l.salesorderid AS TEXT) AS order_id
  FROM ded_public.p_fm_edw_v_ods_crm_salesorderdetail_esb AS l
  WHERE
    NULLIF(TRIM(CAST(l.new_opportunity_id AS TEXT)), '') IS NOT NULL
    AND NULLIF(TRIM(CAST(l.salesorderid AS TEXT)), '') IS NOT NULL
), signed_orders AS MATERIALIZED (
  SELECT
    l.opportunity_id,
    COUNT(DISTINCT l.order_id) AS order_count
  FROM order_line_links AS l
  JOIN orders AS o
    USING (order_id)
  GROUP BY
    l.opportunity_id
), opportunity_flags AS MATERIALIZED (
  SELECT
    o.*,
    COALESCE(s.order_count, 0) AS order_count,
    CASE
      WHEN COALESCE(s.order_count, 0) = 0
      THEN FALSE
      WHEN o.s4 IS NULL
      THEN FALSE
      ELSE o.s4 < p.as_of_exclusive
    END AS signed,
    (
      COALESCE(s.order_count, 0) > 0 AND o.s4 IS NULL
    ) AS missing_p3_end
  FROM opportunities AS o
  LEFT JOIN signed_orders AS s
    USING (opportunity_id)
  CROSS JOIN context AS p
), forecast_rows AS MATERIALIZED (
  SELECT
    CAST(m.new_oppmonthid AS TEXT) AS forecast_id,
    CAST(m.new_opportunity_id AS TEXT) AS opportunity_id,
    CAST(m.new_accountdate AS TIMESTAMP) AS forecast_month,
    CAST(m.new_forecast_amt_rmb AS DECIMAL) AS amount_yuan,
    CAST(m.new_whprice AS DECIMAL) AS wh_price,
    ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
      PARTITION BY m.new_opportunity_id, DATE_TRUNC('MONTH', CAST(m.new_accountdate AS TIMESTAMP))
      ORDER BY m.createdon DESC NULLS LAST, m.modifiedon DESC NULLS LAST, m.new_oppmonthid DESC NULLS LAST
    ) AS rn
  FROM (
    SELECT
      __x360_raw.*
    FROM ded_public.p_fm_edw_v_ods_crm_new_oppmonth_esb AS __x360_raw
    CROSS JOIN context AS __x360_ctx
    WHERE
      CAST(__x360_raw.createdon AS TIMESTAMP) < __x360_ctx.as_of_exclusive
  ) AS m
  CROSS JOIN context AS p
  WHERE
    NULLIF(TRIM(CAST(m.new_oppmonthid AS TEXT)), '') IS NOT NULL
    AND NULLIF(TRIM(CAST(m.new_opportunity_id AS TEXT)), '') IS NOT NULL
    AND CAST(m.new_accountdate AS TIMESTAMP) >= p.start_date
    AND CAST(m.new_accountdate AS TIMESTAMP) < p.end_exclusive
), forecast_facts AS MATERIALIZED (
  SELECT
    f.forecast_id,
    f.forecast_month,
    o.*,
    f.amount_yuan / CAST(100000000 AS DECIMAL) AS amount_yi,
    f.amount_yuan / NULLIF(f.wh_price, 0) / CAST(1000000000 AS DECIMAL) AS energy_gwh
  FROM forecast_rows AS f
  JOIN opportunity_flags AS o
    USING (opportunity_id)
  WHERE
    f.rn = 1
), opportunity_forecast AS MATERIALIZED (
  SELECT
    opportunity_id,
    COUNT(*) AS forecast_rows,
    SUM(amount_yi) AS amount_yi,
    SUM(energy_gwh) AS energy_gwh,
    COUNT(*) FILTER(WHERE
      amount_yi IS NULL) AS missing_amount_rows,
    COUNT(*) FILTER(WHERE
      energy_gwh IS NULL) AS missing_energy_rows
  FROM forecast_facts
  GROUP BY
    opportunity_id
), dynamic_stage_definitions AS MATERIALIZED (
  SELECT
    *
  FROM (VALUES
    (CAST('P0' AS TEXT), CAST('商机获取' AS TEXT)),
    (CAST('P1' AS TEXT), CAST('技术交流' AS TEXT)),
    (CAST('P2' AS TEXT), CAST('方案推动' AS TEXT))) AS v(stage_code, stage_name)
), dynamic_stage_facts AS MATERIALIZED (
SELECT
    o.opportunity_id,
    o.product_type,
    o.process_stage,
    b.stage_code,
    b.stage_name,
    v.started_at,
    v.finished_at,
    p.cutoff,
    CASE
      WHEN v.started_at IS NOT NULL AND v.finished_at > v.started_at
      THEN EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM (
        v.finished_at - v.started_at
      )) / CAST(86400 AS DECIMAL)
    END AS duration_days,
    CASE
      WHEN v.started_at IS NULL
      THEN '缺阶段开始时间；不参与周期及分档'
      WHEN v.finished_at < v.started_at
      THEN '日期逆序；不参与周期及分档'
      WHEN v.finished_at = v.started_at THEN '零周期；不参与周期及分档'
      ELSE '所选期间已结束；使用严格大于0的完整实际周期'
    END AS timing_status
  FROM opportunity_rows AS o
  CROSS JOIN context AS p
  CROSS JOIN LATERAL (
    VALUES
      (CAST('P0' AS TEXT), o.created_at, o.s1),
      (CAST('P1' AS TEXT), o.s1, o.s2),
      (CAST('P2' AS TEXT), o.s2, o.s3)
  ) AS v(stage_code, started_at, finished_at)
  JOIN dynamic_stage_definitions AS b
    ON b.stage_code = v.stage_code
  WHERE
    o.rn = 1
    AND v.finished_at IS NOT NULL
    AND v.finished_at >= p.start_date
    AND v.finished_at < p.effective_end_exclusive
), dynamic_stage_means AS MATERIALIZED (
SELECT stage_code,stage_name,product_type,
    CASE stage_code
      WHEN 'P0' THEN 32.6::numeric
      WHEN 'P1' THEN 21.8::numeric
      WHEN 'P2' THEN 7.2::numeric
      WHEN 'P3' THEN 57.2::numeric
      WHEN 'P4' THEN 15.3::numeric
    END AS baseline_days,
    AVG(duration_days) AS actual_mean_days,
    COUNT(duration_days)::bigint AS baseline_samples
  FROM dynamic_stage_facts
  GROUP BY stage_code,stage_name,product_type
), dynamic_stage_bands AS MATERIALIZED (
SELECT
    f.*,
    m.baseline_days,
    m.baseline_samples,
    (duration_days-baseline_days) AS excess_days,
  (duration_days-baseline_days)/NULLIF(baseline_days,0) AS excess_ratio,
    CASE
      WHEN baseline_days IS NULL OR baseline_days <= 0 OR duration_days IS NULL
      THEN CAST(NULL AS TEXT)
      WHEN duration_days > baseline_days
      AND duration_days < baseline_days * CAST(1.5 AS DECIMAL)
      THEN CAST('LT50' AS TEXT)
      WHEN duration_days >= baseline_days * CAST(1.5 AS DECIMAL)
      THEN CAST('GE50' AS TEXT)
      WHEN duration_days IS NOT NULL
      THEN CAST('NOT_OVERDUE' AS TEXT)
      ELSE CAST(NULL AS TEXT)
    END AS band_code
  FROM dynamic_stage_facts AS f
  JOIN dynamic_stage_means AS m
    USING (stage_code, stage_name, product_type)
), dynamic_stage_evidence AS MATERIALIZED (
  SELECT
    f.*,
    ofc.forecast_rows,
    ofc.amount_yi,
    ofc.energy_gwh,
    ofc.missing_amount_rows,
    ofc.missing_energy_rows
  FROM dynamic_stage_bands AS f
  LEFT JOIN opportunity_forecast AS ofc
    USING (opportunity_id)
), dynamic_stage_metric_map AS MATERIALIZED (
SELECT
    *
  FROM (VALUES
    (
      80,
      CAST('R12' AS TEXT),
      CAST('商机获取阶段超期商机数及预测量' AS TEXT),
      CAST('P0' AS TEXT),
      CAST('LT50' AS TEXT)
    ),
    (
      81,
      CAST('R13' AS TEXT),
      CAST('商机获取阶段严重超期商机数及预测量' AS TEXT),
      CAST('P0' AS TEXT),
      CAST('GE50' AS TEXT)
    ),
    (
      82,
      CAST('R14' AS TEXT),
      CAST('技术交流阶段超期商机数及预测量' AS TEXT),
      CAST('P1' AS TEXT),
      CAST('LT50' AS TEXT)
    ),
    (
      83,
      CAST('R15' AS TEXT),
      CAST('技术交流阶段严重超期商机数及预测量' AS TEXT),
      CAST('P1' AS TEXT),
      CAST('GE50' AS TEXT)
    ),
    (
      84,
      CAST('R16' AS TEXT),
      CAST('方案推动阶段超期商机数及预测量' AS TEXT),
      CAST('P2' AS TEXT),
      CAST('LT50' AS TEXT)
    ),
    (
      85,
      CAST('R17' AS TEXT),
      CAST('方案推动阶段严重超期商机数及预测量' AS TEXT),
      CAST('P2' AS TEXT),
      CAST('GE50' AS TEXT)
    )) AS v(sort_no, code, metric_name, stage_code, band_code)
), severe_stage_summary AS MATERIALIZED (
SELECT
    COALESCE(SUM(h.stage_record_count),0)::bigint AS stage_record_count,
    COUNT(h.opportunity_id)::bigint AS opportunity_count,
    SUM(f.amount_yi) AS amount_yi,
    SUM(f.energy_gwh) AS energy_gwh,
    COUNT(h.opportunity_id) FILTER(WHERE f.opportunity_id IS NULL) AS missing_forecast_opportunities,
    COUNT(h.opportunity_id) FILTER(WHERE f.amount_yi IS NULL) AS missing_amount_opportunities,
    COUNT(h.opportunity_id) FILTER(WHERE f.energy_gwh IS NULL) AS missing_energy_opportunities,
    COALESCE(SUM(f.missing_amount_rows),0)::bigint AS missing_amount_rows,
    COALESCE(SUM(f.missing_energy_rows),0)::bigint AS missing_energy_rows,
    (SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT stage_code) FROM dynamic_stage_evidence WHERE band_code='GE50') AS hit_stage_count
  FROM (
    SELECT opportunity_id,COUNT(*)::bigint AS stage_record_count
    FROM dynamic_stage_evidence WHERE band_code='GE50'
    GROUP BY opportunity_id
  ) h
  LEFT JOIN opportunity_forecast f USING(opportunity_id)
), severe_stage_by_stage AS MATERIALIZED (
SELECT d.stage_code,d.stage_name,
    CASE d.stage_code WHEN 'P0' THEN 32.6::numeric WHEN 'P1' THEN 21.8::numeric WHEN 'P2' THEN 7.2::numeric END AS baseline_days,
    COUNT(f.opportunity_id)::bigint AS stage_record_count,
    COUNT(DISTINCT f.opportunity_id)::bigint AS opportunity_count,
    SUM(f.amount_yi) AS amount_yi,SUM(f.energy_gwh) AS energy_gwh,
    COUNT(f.opportunity_id) FILTER(WHERE COALESCE(f.forecast_rows,0)=0) AS missing_forecast_opportunities,
    COUNT(f.opportunity_id) FILTER(WHERE f.amount_yi IS NULL) AS missing_amount_opportunities,
    COUNT(f.opportunity_id) FILTER(WHERE f.energy_gwh IS NULL) AS missing_energy_opportunities,
    COALESCE(SUM(f.missing_amount_rows),0)::bigint AS missing_amount_rows,
    COALESCE(SUM(f.missing_energy_rows),0)::bigint AS missing_energy_rows
  FROM dynamic_stage_definitions d
  LEFT JOIN dynamic_stage_evidence f ON f.stage_code=d.stage_code AND f.band_code='GE50'
  GROUP BY d.stage_code,d.stage_name
), dynamic_stage_results AS MATERIALIZED (
SELECT
    m.sort_no,
    m.code,
    m.metric_name,
    CAST(NULL AS TEXT) AS product_team,
    CAST(SUM(f.amount_yi) AS DECIMAL) AS amount_yi,
    CAST(SUM(f.energy_gwh) AS DECIMAL) AS energy_gwh,
    CAST(COUNT(f.opportunity_id) AS BIGINT) AS item_count,
    CAST(NULL AS DECIMAL) AS ratio_value,
    CAST(NULL AS DECIMAL) AS days_value,
    CAST(CASE
      WHEN COUNT(f.opportunity_id) > 0
      THEN '已输出命中数量；预测完整性见明细'
      WHEN EXISTS(
        SELECT
          1
        FROM dynamic_stage_bands AS d
        WHERE
          d.stage_code = m.stage_code AND d.band_code IS NULL
      )
      THEN '未命中；部分时间不足或静态基线不可用，不能判为全部正常'
      ELSE '所选期间无命中商机'
    END AS TEXT) AS status,
    CAST('阶段静态基线：P0=32.6天、P1=21.8天、P2=7.2天、P3=57.2天、P4=15.3天，同阶段各产品共用基线；结束归期且仅周期>0参与分档。比例=(实际天数-静态基线)/静态基线；预测先聚合到商机，不影响周期样本。 LT50展示为超期，GE50展示为严重超期。严重超期跨阶段总览先按商机ID去重，再关联期间预测汇总金额及电量；阶段记录数和去重商机数分别列示，分阶段金额不可直接相加作为去重总金额。' AS TEXT) AS note,
    JSONB_BUILD_OBJECT(
      '阶段',
      b.stage_name,
      '档位', m.band_code,
      '档位名称', CASE m.band_code WHEN 'LT50' THEN '超期' WHEN 'GE50' THEN '严重超期' END,
      '严重超期汇总_跨阶段去重', (SELECT TO_JSONB(s) FROM severe_stage_summary s),
      '严重超期分阶段汇总', (SELECT JSONB_AGG(TO_JSONB(s) ORDER BY s.stage_code) FROM severe_stage_by_stage s),
      '各产品静态基线及有效正周期样本数',
      (
        SELECT
          JSONB_AGG(
            JSONB_BUILD_OBJECT('产品类型', d.product_type, '静态基线天', d.baseline_days, '有效正周期样本数', d.baseline_samples) ORDER BY d.product_type
          )
        FROM dynamic_stage_means AS d
        WHERE
          d.stage_code = m.stage_code
      ),
      '期间阶段记录数',
      (
        SELECT
          COUNT(*)
        FROM dynamic_stage_bands AS d
        WHERE
          d.stage_code = m.stage_code
      ),
      '阶段日期不足记录数',
      (
        SELECT
          COUNT(*)
        FROM dynamic_stage_bands AS d
        WHERE
          d.stage_code = m.stage_code AND d.duration_days IS NULL
      ),
      '静态基线缺失或非正记录数',
      (
        SELECT
          COUNT(*)
        FROM dynamic_stage_bands AS d
        WHERE
          d.stage_code = m.stage_code
          AND (
            d.baseline_days IS NULL OR d.baseline_days <= 0
          )
      ),
      '命中商机数',
      COUNT(f.opportunity_id),
      '有期间预测商机数',
      COUNT(f.opportunity_id) FILTER(WHERE
        COALESCE(f.forecast_rows, 0) > 0),
      '无期间预测商机数',
      COUNT(f.opportunity_id) FILTER(WHERE
        COALESCE(f.forecast_rows, 0) = 0),
      '命中商机金额不可计算数',
      COUNT(f.opportunity_id) FILTER(WHERE
        f.amount_yi IS NULL),
      '命中商机电量不可计算数',
      COUNT(f.opportunity_id) FILTER(WHERE
        f.energy_gwh IS NULL),
      '预测金额为空记录数',
      COALESCE(SUM(f.missing_amount_rows), 0),
      '预测电量输入缺失记录数',
      COALESCE(SUM(f.missing_energy_rows), 0),
      '预测合计说明',
      'SUM忽略单个NULL；缺失统计非零时金额或电量可能是部分合计；全部缺失保留NULL，不补0。',
      '商机明细',
      COALESCE(
        JSONB_AGG(
          JSONB_BUILD_OBJECT(
            '商机ID',
            f.opportunity_id,
            '产品',
            f.product_type,
            '截至日阶段推断',
            f.process_stage,
            '阶段开始',
            f.started_at,
            '阶段结束',
            f.finished_at,
            '计时状态',
            f.timing_status,
            '实际天数',
            f.duration_days,
            '基线天数', f.baseline_days,
            '超出基线天数', f.excess_days,
            '有效正周期样本数',
            f.baseline_samples,
            '超基线比例_原始小数',
            f.excess_ratio,
            '超基线百分比数值',
            f.excess_ratio * 100,
            '预测金额_亿元',
            f.amount_yi,
            '预测电量_GWh',
            f.energy_gwh
          ) ORDER BY f.duration_days DESC, f.opportunity_id
        ) FILTER(WHERE
          f.opportunity_id IS NOT NULL),
        CAST('[]' AS JSONB)
      )
    ) AS detail
  FROM dynamic_stage_metric_map AS m
  JOIN dynamic_stage_definitions AS b
    USING (stage_code)
  LEFT JOIN dynamic_stage_evidence AS f
    ON f.stage_code = m.stage_code AND f.band_code = m.band_code
  GROUP BY
    m.sort_no,
    m.code,
    m.metric_name,
    m.stage_code,
    m.band_code,
    b.stage_name
), metric_results AS MATERIALIZED (
SELECT
    *
  FROM dynamic_stage_results
  WHERE
    code = 'R12'
)
SELECT
  r.code AS "指标序号",
  r.metric_name AS "指标名称",
  r.product_team AS "产品团队",
  p.start_date AS "期间开始",
  p.end_exclusive AS "期间结束不含",
  p.cutoff AS "周期观察截止",
  r.amount_yi AS "金额_亿元",
  r.energy_gwh AS "电量_GWh",
  r.item_count AS "数量",
  r.ratio_value AS "比率_原始小数",
  r.days_value AS "平均周期_天",
  r.status AS "计算说明状态",
  r.note AS "取值说明",
  r.detail AS "分组明细及缺口"
FROM metric_results AS r
CROSS JOIN context AS p
ORDER BY
  r.sort_no,
  r.product_team;

R13.name: 商机获取阶段严重超期商机数及预测量
R13.definition: P0（createdon→new_stage1enddate）完整有效已结束且周期严格大于0的阶段中，超静态基线比例>=50%的商机数与期间预测。本阶段静态基线为32.6天，同一阶段统一使用，不随所选期间或样本变化。
R13.formula: 以本阶段结束时间归期，开始可跨年；使用P0固定基线32.6天，逐笔计算(实际天数－静态基线)÷静态基线。只计完整已结束且严格正周期，0天、缺值、逆序及未结束不参与。R12/R14/R16为0<超基线比例<50%并列展示，R13/R15/R17为超基线比例>=50%触发原风险；同一阶段统一使用该静态基线。不同阶段可重复命中，跨阶段合计须区分阶段累加和商机去重。结束还须早于观察日次日，缺预测不排除周期样本，当前阶段枚举不作过滤。 展示档位为“严重超期”。
R13.attributes:
LE01-A0101 商机管理.阶段一结束日期（new_stage1enddate，空 63.04%）
LE01-A0451 商机管理.项目阶段（new_processstage，空 0%）
LE01-A0490 商机管理.创建时间（createdon，空 0%）
LE02-A0020 项目月度销售预测.创建时间（createdon，空 0%）
LE05-A0295 客户.创建时间（createdon，空 0%）
R13.notes: 阶段静态基线：P0=32.6天、P1=21.8天、P2=7.2天、P3=57.2天、P4=15.3天。P*-02严格>对应静态基线1.5倍；GE50为>=1.5倍；两者仅计完整已结束且周期严格大于0的样本，边界不同，各阶段使用统一固定基线。 计数与去重：商机按opportunityid取modifiedon、createdon最新版本；每商机每阶段1条。不同阶段可分别计数；预测先聚合到商机后关联，不放大数量或金额。 预测：沿用本文件B02：new_accountdate筛所选预测期间；同商机＋预测月份按createdon、modifiedon、new_oppmonthid降序取最新。金额new_forecast_amt_rmb÷10^8；电量new_forecast_amt_rmb÷NULLIF(new_whprice,0)÷10^9。先按商机累计，再一对一关联阶段事实。 新增超出静态基线天数与比例；合并风险总览使用跨阶段去重商机及去重预测金额，分阶段记录数可重复商机。
R13.sqlStatus: 查询已实现；使用3个位置参数[start_date,end_exclusive,observed_at]；客户库实际执行及调用端适配待核实。
R13.role: 触发指标（RK11）＋判定指标（RC08）；最终分析仅读总体、客户、商机及阶段事实，范围见BR-V12
R13.ctes: parameters → context → account_rows → accounts → opportunity_rows → opportunities → orders → order_line_links → signed_orders → opportunity_flags → forecast_rows → forecast_facts → opportunity_forecast → dynamic_stage_definitions → dynamic_stage_facts → dynamic_stage_means → dynamic_stage_bands → dynamic_stage_evidence → dynamic_stage_metric_map → severe_stage_summary → severe_stage_by_stage → dynamic_stage_results
R13.sql:
WITH parameters AS MATERIALIZED (
  SELECT
    CAST(%s AS DATE) AS start_date,
    CAST(%s AS DATE) AS end_exclusive,
    CAST(%s AS TIMESTAMP) AS observed_at,
    CAST(ARRAY['1'] AS TEXT[]) AS strategic_levels,
    CAST(ARRAY['1', '2'] AS TEXT[]) AS focus_levels,
    CAST(1000000 AS DECIMAL) AS target_power_units_per_gwh
), context AS MATERIALIZED (
  SELECT
    p.*,
    CAST((
      DATE_TRUNC('DAY', observed_at) + INTERVAL '1 DAY'
    ) AS TIMESTAMP) AS as_of_exclusive,
    LEAST(
      CAST(end_exclusive AS TIMESTAMP),
      DATE_TRUNC('DAY', observed_at) + INTERVAL '1 DAY'
    ) AS effective_end_exclusive,
    LEAST(
      CAST(end_exclusive AS TIMESTAMP),
      DATE_TRUNC('DAY', observed_at) + INTERVAL '1 DAY'
    ) - INTERVAL '1 MICROSECOND' AS cutoff,
    MAKE_DATE(CAST(EXTRACT(YEAR FROM start_date) AS INT), 1, 1) AS year_start,
    MAKE_DATE(CAST(EXTRACT(YEAR FROM start_date) AS INT) + 1, 1, 1) AS next_year_start,
    GREATEST(
      CAST(0 AS DECIMAL),
      LEAST(
        CAST(1 AS DECIMAL),
        CAST((
          CAST(LEAST(
            CAST(end_exclusive AS TIMESTAMP),
            DATE_TRUNC('DAY', observed_at) + INTERVAL '1 DAY'
          ) AS DATE) - MAKE_DATE(CAST(EXTRACT(YEAR FROM start_date) AS INT), 1, 1)
        ) AS DECIMAL) / (
          MAKE_DATE(CAST(EXTRACT(YEAR FROM start_date) AS INT) + 1, 1, 1) - MAKE_DATE(CAST(EXTRACT(YEAR FROM start_date) AS INT), 1, 1)
        )
      )
    ) AS time_progress
  FROM parameters AS p
), account_rows AS MATERIALIZED (
  SELECT
    CAST(a.accountid AS TEXT) AS account_id,
    CAST(a.name AS TEXT) AS account_name,
    CAST(a.new_accountlevel AS TEXT) AS level_code,
    CAST(a.new_sapdate AS TIMESTAMP) AS sap_created_at,
    CAST(a.new_sapsubmitdate AS TIMESTAMP) AS sap_submitted_at,
    CAST(a.new_approved_time_facreview AS TIMESTAMP) AS account_factory_approved_at,
    CAST(a.new_submit_time_facreview AS TIMESTAMP) AS account_factory_submitted_at,
    CAST(a.new_sinosurestartdate AS TIMESTAMP) AS account_sinosure_start,
    CAST(a.new_sinosureenddate AS TIMESTAMP) AS account_sinosure_end,
    CAST(a.new_submit_time_accredit AS TIMESTAMP) AS account_credit_submitted_at,
    CAST(a.new_approvaltime_accredit AS TIMESTAMP) AS account_credit_approved_at,
    CAST(a.new_cdastartdate AS TIMESTAMP) AS account_cda_start,
    CAST(a.new_cdaenddate AS TIMESTAMP) AS account_cda_end,
    CAST(a.new_cda_submittime AS TIMESTAMP) AS account_cda_submitted_at,
    CAST(a.new_cda_approved_time AS TIMESTAMP) AS account_cda_approved_at,
    CAST(a.new_approvalstatus_facreview AS TEXT) AS account_factory_approval_status,
    CAST(a.new_sapcode AS TEXT) AS sap_code,
    CAST(a.new_issap AS TEXT) AS sap_registered,
    CAST(a.new_issapnew AS TEXT) AS sap_registration_kind,
    ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
      PARTITION BY a.accountid
      ORDER BY a.modifiedon DESC NULLS LAST, a.createdon DESC NULLS LAST
    ) AS rn
  FROM (
    SELECT
      __x360_raw.*
    FROM ded_public.p_fm_edw_v_ods_crm_account_esb AS __x360_raw
    CROSS JOIN context AS __x360_ctx
    WHERE
      CAST(__x360_raw.createdon AS TIMESTAMP) < __x360_ctx.as_of_exclusive
  ) AS a
  WHERE
    NULLIF(TRIM(CAST(a.accountid AS TEXT)), '') IS NOT NULL
), accounts AS MATERIALIZED (
  SELECT
    account_id,
    account_name,
    level_code,
    sap_created_at,
    sap_submitted_at,
    account_factory_approved_at,
    account_factory_submitted_at,
    account_sinosure_start,
    account_sinosure_end,
    account_credit_submitted_at,
    account_credit_approved_at,
    account_cda_start,
    account_cda_end,
    account_cda_submitted_at,
    account_cda_approved_at,
    account_factory_approval_status,
    sap_code,
    sap_registered,
    sap_registration_kind
  FROM account_rows
  WHERE
    rn = 1
), opportunity_rows AS MATERIALIZED (
  SELECT
    ranked.*
  FROM (
    SELECT
      CAST(o.opportunityid AS TEXT) AS opportunity_id,
      CAST(o.parentaccountid AS TEXT) AS account_id,
      CAST(o.name AS TEXT) AS project_name,
      CAST(o.ownerid AS TEXT) AS owner_id,
      CASE
        WHEN CAST(o.new_accproducttype AS TEXT) IN ('1', '电芯')
        THEN '电芯'
        WHEN CAST(o.new_accproducttype AS TEXT) IN ('2', 'PACK')
        THEN 'PACK'
        ELSE '其他'
      END AS product_type,
      o.__x360_asof_process_stage AS process_stage,
      CAST(o.statecode AS TEXT) AS system_state,
      CAST(o.new_demandinput AS TEXT) AS demand_status,
      CAST(o.createdon AS TIMESTAMP) AS created_at,
      CAST(o.new_stage1enddate AS TIMESTAMP) AS s1,
      CAST(o.new_stage2enddate AS TIMESTAMP) AS s2,
      CAST(o.new_stage3enddate AS TIMESTAMP) AS s3,
      CAST(o.new_stage4enddate AS TIMESTAMP) AS s4,
      CAST(o.new_stage5enddate AS TIMESTAMP) AS s5,
      CAST(o.new_cdastartdate AS TIMESTAMP) AS new_cdastartdate,
      CAST(o.new_cdaenddate AS TIMESTAMP) AS new_cdaenddate,
      CAST(o.new_approved_time_acneed AS TIMESTAMP) AS new_approved_time_acneed,
      CAST(o.new_submit_time_acneed AS TIMESTAMP) AS new_submit_time_acneed,
      CAST(o.new_approved_time_projectassess AS TIMESTAMP) AS new_approved_time_projectassess,
      CAST(o.new_submit_time_projectassess AS TIMESTAMP) AS new_submit_time_projectassess,
      CAST(o.new_sampletestpass_time AS TIMESTAMP) AS new_sampletestpass_time,
      CAST(o.new_sampletime AS TIMESTAMP) AS new_sampletime,
      CAST(o.new_technicalsigningdate AS TIMESTAMP) AS new_technicalsigningdate,
      CAST(o.new_submit_time_techcon AS TIMESTAMP) AS new_submit_time_techcon,
      CAST(o.new_warrantysigningdate AS TIMESTAMP) AS new_warrantysigningdate,
      CAST(o.new_submit_time_qsl AS TIMESTAMP) AS new_submit_time_qsl,
      CAST(o.new_isneedcda AS TEXT) AS new_isneedcda,
      CAST(o.new_approvalstatus_acneed AS TEXT) AS new_approvalstatus_acneed,
      CAST(o.new_approvalstatus_projectassess AS TEXT) AS new_approvalstatus_projectassess,
      CAST(o.new_approvalstatus_techcon AS TEXT) AS new_approvalstatus_techcon,
      CAST(o.new_approvalstatus_qsl AS TEXT) AS new_approvalstatus_qsl,
